533e5b35.description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.
  
  
Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.
  
  
We boldly go.
  
  
**Where Is The Work**
Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.
  
  
At Trane Technologies and through our businesses, including Trane® and Thermo King®, we create innovative climate solutions for buildings, homes, and transportation that challenge what’s possible for a sustainable world. We are a team that dares to look at the world’s challenges and see impactful possibilities. We believe in a better future when we uplift others and enable our people to thrive at work and at home. We boldly go.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient environments, we put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, sustainability is not just how we do business; it is our business. If you’re passionate about making an impact and want to contribute to a better future, we invite you to join us in boldly challenging what’s possible for a sustainable world.
  
  
**Thrive at work and at home**
We support our people and their families in leading fulfilling lives at work and at home through:
  
  

* An Inclusive Wellbeing Program with resources for physical, social, emotional, and financial health.
* Comprehensive learning and development programs, including education/certification reimbursement.
* A sense of belonging and connection through Employee Resource Groups.
* Eight hours of paid volunteer time each year.
* The Trane Technologies Helping Hands Fund to assist employees during unforeseen personal hardship.

**Where is the work**
This position is designated as On-Site and is based in Bengaluru location
  
  
**What Will You Do**
Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Collaborate with Business Stakeholders: Work closely with business stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and manage expectations.
* Architect Salesforce Solutions: Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that leverage the Salesforce platform.
* Lead Technical Design Sessions: Conduct technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between current and desired end states.
* Project Oversight and Governance: Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects.
* Coding Standards and Code Reviews: Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed.
* Technical Delivery Management: Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of Salesforce implementation.
* Debugging and Issue Resolution: Understand projects in-depth and debug issues as needed.

**What You Will Bring**

* Experience: Experience: 10-15 years in Salesforce development and Minimum 3 years of architecture, with absolute clarity on data architecture and integration.
* Salesforce Expertise: Expert-level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds.
* Systems Architecture: Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable, performance-driven solutions.
* Design Patterns and Best Practices: Knowledge of key design patterns, large data volume limitations, and best practices.
* Data Sharing and Visibility: Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and their impact on platform architecture.
* Authentication Patterns: Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth).
* Data Integration Tools: Experience with data integration tools and integrating Salesforce with various business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.).
* Environment and Release Management: Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies.
* Platform Security: Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL).
* System Architecture Landscapes: Expert-level experience in defining system architecture landscapes, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering comprehensive solutions to achieve desired business outcomes.
* Web-Based Systems Development: Strong background in the design/development of large web-based systems or complete software product lifecycle exposure.
* Communication and Interpersonal Skills: Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Key Competencies**

* Salesforce Products: Experience with Salesforce CPQ, Tableau, OMS, or other Salesforce products.
* Data Technologies: Knowledge of data warehousing, big data technologies, and data analytics.
* Agile Methodologies: Familiarity with Agile development methodologies. Salesforce Technical Architect
* Cloud Platforms: Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and Google Cloud.

**Career break**
We recognize that life happens, and taking a career break is sometimes necessary. We welcome applicants looking to return to the workforce after time away and are committed to supporting a seamless transition back to your career.

2d2ab04d.title: Solution Architect(Dotnet Core, React & Azure system & AI/Python)_Bangalore
2d2ab04d.description:
Payroll company - BDO India (Client deputed role)

**Role Summary**

**We are looking for a Solution Architect to support the design, implementation, integration, and scaling a human-verified AI patient engagement platform built for premium ophthalmology practices.**

**The role will act as a bridge between business teams, product teams, engineering, IT, customer success, and external clinic partners. The Solution Architect will be responsible for understanding clinic workflows, defining technical solution designs, supporting integrations, ensuring secure and scalable implementation, and helping convert business requirements into practical technology solutions.**

**This role requires a strong understanding of SaaS platforms, healthcare workflows, AI-enabled products, API integrations, data security, and enterprise IT governance.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Solution Design & Architecture**
• Design scalable, secure, and clinic-ready solution architectures for VisioGen implementations. • Convert business and customer requirements into clear technical solution designs. • Define end-to-end workflows covering chatbot interface, AI response generation, human review, clinic escalation, reporting, and system integration. • Ensure the platform architecture supports reliability, performance, security, and future scalability.

**2. Customer & Clinic Implementation Support**
• Work with US ophthalmology clinics to understand their website, patient inquiry flow, appointment booking process, CRM usage, and operational workflow. • Identify how VisioGen can be embedded into each clinic’s digital ecosystem. • Support technical discovery calls with customers, partners, and vendors. • Prepare implementation documents, integration notes, workflow maps, and technical requirement documents.

**3. Integration & API Management**
• Evaluate and design integrations with clinic websites, CRMs, scheduling tools, marketing platforms, analytics tools, and communication systems. • Work with APIs, webhooks, data exchange formats, and middleware platforms such as Zapier, HubSpot, or similar systems. • Coordinate with internal and external development teams to ensure integrations are delivered correctly. • Troubleshoot integration gaps and recommend practical workarounds where needed.

**4. Security, Compliance & Governance**
• Ensure all solution designs follow healthcare data privacy, security, and compliance expectations, including HIPAA-aligned workflows where applicable. • Work closely with ZEISS IT, CIT, InfoSec, and compliance teams for tool approvals and architecture reviews. • Support risk assessment, data flow documentation, access control planning, and vendor evaluation. • Ensure AI workflows are designed with appropriate human-in-the-loop review and governance.

**5. Product & Platform Enablement**
• Partner with product managers to define technical feasibility for new product features. • Provide architecture inputs for dashboards, analytics, reporting, AI workflows, and clinic-specific customization. • Identify reusable implementation models that can reduce deployment time across multiple clinics. • Support creation of internal playbooks, SOPs, technical FAQs, and implementation templates.

6
**. Cross-Functional Collaboration**
• Collaborate with sales, customer success, clinical operations, engineering, product, IT, and external clinic stakeholders. • Support pre-sales conversations by explaining technical capabilities in simple business language. • Help sales teams respond to technical questions from clinics, marketing partners, and service providers. • Act as the technical owner during implementation and post-go-live stabilization.

**Required Skills & Experience Technical Skills**
• Strong experience in solution architecture, SaaS implementation, or enterprise platform design. • Good understanding of APIs, webhooks, system integrations, middleware, and cloud-based platforms. • Experience with CRM, scheduling, chatbot, marketing automation, or patient engagement platforms is preferred. • Understanding of AI-enabled workflows, GenAI platforms, and human-in-the-loop review models. • Ability to create technical diagrams, workflow maps, data flow documents, and integration architecture notes. • Basic understanding of cloud infrastructure, authentication, access control, monitoring, and data security.

**Healthcare / Domain Skills**
• Experience in healthcare technology, digital health, ophthalmology, patient engagement, or clinical workflow platforms is preferred. • Understanding of HIPAA, healthcare data privacy, and patient communication workflows will be an advantage. • Ability to understand clinic operations, patient inquiry journeys, appointment booking workflows, and escalation models.

**Business & Communication Skills**
• Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions. • Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. • Strong documentation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. • Comfortable working with global teams, especially US-based customers and internal ZEISS stakeholders. • Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to balance speed, compliance, and scalability.

**Preferred Qualifications**
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Digital Health, or related field. • 10-20 years of experience in solution architecture, technical consulting, SaaS implementation, or healthcare IT. • Prior experience working with startups, venture-backed products, or fast-moving digital product teams is a plus. • Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Zapier, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Google Analytics, or similar platforms is an advantage. • Experience preparing architecture documents for IT, security, compliance, or enterprise approval processes.

**Key Success Metrics**
• Faster and smoother VisioGen clinic implementations. • Reduced dependency on ad hoc technical decision-making. • Clear integration and architecture documentation for each customer. • Improved collaboration between business, product, IT, and engineering teams. • Scalable implementation framework for onboarding multiple ophthalmology clinics. • Secure, compliant, and reliable solution designs.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* **The ideal candidate is someone who can think like an architect, communicate like a consultant, and execute like a product implementation owner. They should be comfortable working in a startup-like environment within a large enterprise ecosystem. They should be able to simplify complex technical topics, work with multiple stakeholders, and design solutions that are practical, secure, scalable, and customer-ready.**

080cb6c1.title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect/SME
080cb6c1.description:
**Summary & Role Information:**

  

SAP S/4HANA Finance Subject Matter Expert (SME) drives end-to-end implementation and optimization of financial processes (GL, AP/AR, Asset Accounting, Controlling, Group Reporting) using SAP best practices and Fiori apps. This role requires 12+ years of experience, including multiple full-cycle S/4HANA implementations, Brownfield, Greenfield and SDT approaches, strong configuration skills, and expertise in universal journal (ACDOCA) and SAP Activate methodology.

* **Solution Design & Architecture**:

+ Define target operating models, future-state architecture, and business transformation roadmaps, acting as a trusted advisor
+ Should have experience in building end-to-end response for proactive and reactive customer requirement for S/4HANA Transformation.

* **Configuration & Implementation:**

+ Strong experience in implementing SAP Finance and Controlling modules such as GL, AP, AR, AA banking, cost centre accounting, profit centre accounting, profitability analysis and product costing.
+ Sound working knowledge in system conversion projects (brownfield) from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA, fixing finance inconsistencies and errors in S/4HANA conversion projects
+ Deep knowledge of New Asset Accounting, Universal Journal (ACDOCA), Group Reporting, and FSCM.
+ Sound working knowledge of implementation, configuration and optimization of SAP S/4HANA Central Finance systems including the handling of data mapping, SLT replication and master data harmonization.
+ Should have a minimum 3 S/4HANA transformation project experience and minimum 2 Application support project experience.
+ Should have experience in S/4HANA Rise and Public Cloud Implementation with experience in deploying Business AI.

* **Project Leadership:**

+ Manage project phases (blueprint, design, test, go-live) using SAP Activate methodology.

* **Stakeholder Management:**

+ Collaborate with business stakeholders to map requirements to standard SAP solutions, minimizing custom developments.

* **Mentorship:**

+ Mentor junior consultants and provide technical leadership.

  

**Education, Skills and Competencies**

* The ideal candidate will have at minimum a bachelors degree in commerce with any post-graduation degree in Accountancy (Chartered Accountancy, Cost & Management Accountancy, Chartered financial Analyst, MCom or MBA finance) preferably with an SAP Certification.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned tasks.
* Should have proficiency in SAP AI and Business AI
* Should have certification in SAP S/4HANA Finance Certification.

Excellent oral and written communications skills in English, with the ability to effectively interact with all levels of customers and management, both internal and external.

b3c4a708.title: SAP Treasury and Risk Management Consultant (Architect)
b3c4a708.description:
**Role Overview:**

As the Senior Capability Lead SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM), you will lead the end-to-end capability for SAP Treasury within a global services organization. This strategic role requires deep functional expertise in SAP S/4HANA Treasury and Cash Management, along with proven leadership in building competencies, driving solution innovation, and supporting complex digital finance transformations across industries.

You will work closely with clients CFO organizations to reimagine their Cash, Liquidity, Risk, and Bank Communication functions using SAP solutionsenabling real-time visibility, financial risk mitigation, and intelligent automation.

  
  

**Job Description:**

**Practice & Capability Leadership**

* Build and manage the global SAP TRM and Cash Management capability, including training, asset development, and certification roadmap.
* Establish solution blueprints, accelerators, and industry-specific templates for treasury transformations.
* Mentor consultants, architects, and solution leads; develop a scalable delivery model across regions.
* Ensure continuous upskilling in TRM functional areas and S/4HANA innovations (Embedded Analytics, Fiori, BTP, AI).

  

Functional Expertise in SAP TRM Areas You will own capability and delivery oversight across the following SAP TRM functional areas.

You will own capability and delivery oversight across the following SAP TRM functional areas:

**Core Treasury Modules (S/4HANA):**

* Cash and Liquidity Management
* Cash Positioning & Forecasting
* Liquidity Planning & Analysis
* Group-wide Cash Visibility
* Bank Account Management with workflows
* In-House Cash
* Centralized payments & receivables
* Intercompany Netting & Settlement
* Internal Banking Setup
* Bank Communication Management (BCM)
* Payment approval workflows
* Digital Signature Management
* Integration with SWIFT and multibank networks

**Financial Risk Management:**

* Transaction Manager
* FX, MM, Derivatives, Debt, Investments
* Deal capture, valuation, accruals, and settlements
* Market Risk Analyzer
* Market data integration (e.g., Reuters, Bloomberg)
* MTM, PV, Risk Metrics
* Credit Risk Analyzer
* Exposure Management & Limits Monitoring
* Hedge Management and Hedge Accounting (HMA)
* IFRS 9 / ASC 815 compliant
* Effectiveness testing and accounting

**Cash Management & Integration Areas:**

* Bank Statement Processing (MT940, BAI2)
* Payment Integration with AP/AR/FI-CA
* Integration with external banks, SWIFT Service Bureau, Payment Hubs
* Advanced Cash Pooling (Notional/Physical)
* Solutioning & Delivery Oversight
* Act as Solution Architect or Treasury Track Lead on large programs.
* Review solution designs and ensure alignment with best practices and industry standards.
* Govern project delivery across regions ensure quality, scope, and client satisfaction.

  

**Business Development & Thought Leadership**

* Lead response for RFPs, client presentations, and demonstrations focused on TRM & Cash Management.
* Collaborate with industry, sales, and SAP alliance teams for GTM planning.
* Represent the firm in SAP forums, Treasury Summits, and co-innovation events.

  

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* 15+ years total SAP experience, with 10+ years in SAP TRM and Cash Management.
* Experience with at least 3 end-to-end implementations in S/4HANA Treasury (on-premise or cloud).
* Deep understanding of Treasury operations, financial instruments, cash visibility needs, and risk frameworks.
* Strong configuration and process knowledge across all TRM areas listed above.
* Cross-functional exposure to SAP FI, FSCM, BTP, MDG-BP, and integration with third-party payment/banking platforms.

  

**Qualifications:**

* MBA (Finance) / Chartered Accountant / CFA / CTP
* SAP Certified in Treasury or S/4HANA Finance
* Experience with Central Finance, Shared Services Treasury, or AI-based treasury analytics
* Experience in regulated industries like Banking, FMCG, Manufacturing, or Life Sciences

  

**Travel Requirement:**

Willingness to travel (up to 40%) based on project and client location.

  

**What You Get:**

* Strategic role in a high-growth SAP practice with treasury transformation focus
* Opportunity to lead global programs for Fortune 500 clients
* Access to internal innovation platforms, SAP BTP, and AI-based treasury solutions
* Mentoring and growth opportunities across leadership tracks

FICO – Sr. Consultant – L3
  
  
Lead and deliver end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Finance implementations (Private and Public Cloud) for global clients. You will be responsible for solution design, configuration, integration, and deployment of core Finance processes, ensuring best practices and business value.

* Own the end-to-end design and configuration of core finance modules: FI-GL, FI-AP, FI-AR, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, and Cash Management.
* Integrate FI with other modules (CO, MM, SD, etc.).
* Architect and deliver robust integrations between S/4HANA Finance and external systems (e.g., payment gateways, banks, customer portals).
* Manage data migration, cutover, and post-go-live support.
* Conduct Fit-to-Standard and Delta Design workshops, balancing statutory, regulatory, and performance requirements.

* Proven track record designing API- and event-driven integrations via SAP BTP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration (CPI), IDoc/AIF, OData & SOAP services.
* Hands-on experience with payment integrations (Direct Debit, SEPA, card tokenization, open-banking APIs).
* Solid grasp of IFRS / local GAAP and public-sector finance compliance.
* Demonstrated ability to tune system performance and lead large-scale data migrations.
* Experience with SAP Activate methodology and Agile or hybrid delivery.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting or related field.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* SAP S/4HANA certification (FI or FICO).
* Experience with SAP Public Cloud and Private Cloud editions.
* Exposure to SAP BRIM, Subscription Billing, CPQ, or Revenue Accounting.
* Experience in Integration Monitoring and Exception Handling for public-cloud landscapes.
* Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to lead workshops and training sessions.
* Proactive, self-driven, and adaptable to new technologies.

Master's Degree

* Large Data Repository Management: Experience managing and maintaining large data repositories (terabyte scale or larger), ensuring scalability and performance.

5e1d9666.title: Senior Oracle Cloud HCM Consultant
5e1d9666.description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking a Senior Oracle Cloud HCM Consultant to drive the optimization, delivery, and scaling of our global HR technology platform. You will serve as the functional subject matter expert, translating complex HR, payroll, and talent strategies into seamless system configurations.

In this role, you will partner directly with HR leaders to streamline processes, manage critical module rollouts, and ensure our Oracle Human Capital Management infrastructure fully supports a modern, global workforce.

  

Key Responsibilities:

  

Module Configuration: Lead the functional design, system setup, and maintenance across core modules including Global Human Resources (Core HR), Benefits, Absence Management, and Talent Management.

Business Process Automation: Architect and configure complex HCM design structures, including enterprise/workforce components, position management, and automated approval workflows via BPM Worklist.

System Integrations: Collaborate with technical teams to build, test, and maintain robust data exchanges between Oracle HCM, internal payroll systems, and third party vendor platforms using HCM Extracts and HDL (HCM Data Loader).

Reporting & Analytics: Design and deliver executive dashboards, operational HR metrics, and compliance reporting using OTBI (Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence) and BI Publisher.

Release Management: Oversee the evaluation, testing, and deployment of Oracles quarterly cloud upgrades, identifying new features to enhance user experience and process efficiency.

Security & Compliance: Manage and audit HCM security profiles, custom role definitions, and data privacy controls to ensure strict alignment with global regulations (such as GDPR or HIPAA).

  

Required Qualifications & Skills Experience:

  

Minimum of 46 years of hands on experience implementing or managing Oracle Cloud HCM, including at least two full lifecycle global deployments.

Technical Tools: Advanced proficiency with HDL, HCM Extracts, Spreadsheet Data Loader (HSDL), and Fast Formulas.

Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of core HR business processes, compensation structures, time tracking logic, and talent lifecycle management.

Reporting Mastery: Proven capability in building advanced, real time reports within OTBI and utilizing BI Publisher for scheduled, highly formatted document generation.

Communication: Exceptional consultative skills with a track record of translating complex human resources requirements into lean, logical system behaviors.

83bcc878.title: Senior Salesforce Developer - Service Cloud
83bcc878.description:
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Service Cloud Engineering**

* Design, build and maintain the case lifecycle: record types, case assignment, escalation, queues, milestones, entitlements and SLA enforcement.
* Build and tune Omni-Channel routing skills-based routing, capacity models, presence, and queue design — against real support workload patterns.
* Develop Lightning Web Components and Apex to streamline the agent console: custom quick actions, guided flows, related-record panels, and macros that remove clicks from high-volume work.
* Configure and extend intake channels: Email-to-Case, Web-to-Case, Experience Cloud customer portal, chat/messaging, and in-product case creation.
* Build and maintain Knowledge: article types, approval and publishing workflows, data categories, article recommendations, and attach-to-case behaviour.
* Implement CSAT/NPS survey capture and feed the results back into reporting and coaching workflows.

**AI and Automation**

* Build Agentforce service agents for case deflection, summarisation, and assisted resolution, including topic and action design, grounding in Knowledge and Data Cloud, and testing against real case history.
* Implement Einstein capabilities such as case classification, article recommendations, reply recommendations, and work summaries.
* Design the guardrails: escalation to a human, confidence thresholds, audit logging, and measurement of whether the automation actually helped.
* Automate repetitive support operations work with Flow, Apex, and scheduled jobs.

**Integrations**

* Integrate Service Cloud with telephony/CTI (Amazon Connect, Genesys, Five9 or similar), engineering issue trackers (Jira or Azure DevOps), ERP and entitlement sources, and the data warehouse.
* Build and maintain API-based integrations using REST/SOAP, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and middleware such as MuleSoft.
* Own error handling, retry logic, and reconciliation so that failed integrations are visible and recoverable rather than silent.

**Quality and Operations**

* Write unit tests with meaningful assertions and maintain coverage well above the platform minimum.
* Participate in code review both as author and reviewer, and mentor junior developers on the team.
* Support production incidents affecting the support organisation, perform root-cause analysis, and prevent recurrence.
* Deploy through a Git-based CI/CD pipeline and keep metadata under source control.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Experience:** 5–9 years in software development, including at least 4 years building on Salesforce with substantial Service Cloud work.
* **Service Cloud depth:** Hands-on with case management, Omni-Channel routing, entitlements and milestones, Knowledge, the Service Console, and at least two intake channels in production.
* **Apex:** Strong Apex — trigger frameworks, asynchronous processing, bulkification, governor limits, and SOQL optimisation for large data volumes.
* **LWC:** Production Lightning Web Component development with modern JavaScript, including Apex wiring, events, and console-specific APIs.
* **Declarative craft:** Strong Flow skills and good judgement about when a Flow is the right answer and when it is not.
* **Integration:** Experience building API integrations with authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT, Named Credentials) and robust error handling.
* **DevOps:** Salesforce DX, Git, and deployment through a CI/CD pipeline.
* **Communication:** Comfortable gathering requirements directly from support managers and agents, and pushing back with a better option when the requested solution is the wrong one.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Production experience with Agentforce, Einstein for Service, or Data Cloud.
* CTI/telephony integration experience.
* Salesforce Field Service experience.
* Experience Cloud customer or partner portal development.
* Experience supporting an internal support organisation in a SaaS or software company.
* Familiarity with support metrics — first response time, time to resolution, deflection rate, CSAT — and how platform design moves them.

**CERTIFICATIONS**

* **Required:** Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I.
* **Strongly preferred:** Salesforce Certified Service Cloud Consultant.
* **Valued:** Platform Developer II, Agentforce Specialist, Agentforce Service Consultant, JavaScript Developer I, or Platform Administrator.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* **By 60 days:** You understand our case lifecycle and routing model end to end and have shipped your first production changes.
* **By 6 months:** You own a meaningful area of the Service Cloud platform outright, have delivered at least one measurable improvement to agent efficiency or customer response time, and support operations comes to you directly.
* **By 12 months:** Agentforce or Einstein capability you built is live, measured, and demonstrably deflecting or accelerating case work.

d5612e2b.title: Service Delivery Manager – GAM & CSM
d5612e2b.description:
·       
**Service ownership:**
Own overall operational service performance and user experience across GAM and CSM within their respective agreed scope, service levels and support guidelines. Maintain clear responsibilities, workflows, priorities and escalation paths for each team.

·       
**GAM tiered operations:**
Coordinate daily activities across L1, L2 and L3. Ensure L1 handles standard access requests, identity checks and Joiner/Mover/Leaver processes; L2 resolves escalated and complex requests, supports access reviews and maintains runbooks; and L3 provides expert escalation support, root cause analysis, governance, automation definition and knowledge ownership.

·       
**CSM managed-service delivery:**
Oversee delivery against the agreed service model and customer commitments. Maintain visibility of service scope, deliverables, dependencies, risks and outstanding actions, with clear ownership and follow-through rather than assuming GAM’s tiered structure applies to CSM.

·       
**Service levels and reporting:**
Monitor SLA compliance, customer satisfaction, service consistency, workload and ageing. Use separate views for GAM and CSM so differences in demand, delivery commitments and outcomes remain visible; agree measures and targets appropriate to each service.

·       
**Escalations and service recovery:**
Lead operational escalation coordination, prioritisation and stakeholder communications. Ensure critical issues have clear resolution owners and that recurring incidents lead to root cause investigation and corrective actions.

·       
**Demand, capacity and supplier coordination:**
Oversee workload distribution, resource coverage and capacity planning with team leads and L3 engineers. Balance daily operations with improvement work and planned demand, escalating resource constraints and delivery risks. Provide resource and cost forecasts to support planning, and coordinate supplier dependencies within agreed responsibilities and delegated authority.

·       
**Process and knowledge management:**
Maintain consistent incident, request, problem, change and knowledge management practices. Ensure teams use current procedures, runbooks and knowledge articles, while preserving workflows appropriate to each service model.

·       
**Governance and compliance:**
Ensure operational activities follow access policies, controls and audit requirements. Coordinate evidence collection, access governance activities, risk assessments and remediation tracking with the responsible teams.

·       
**Stakeholder and customer engagement:**
Act as the operational point of contact for business stakeholders and service customers. Lead regular service reviews covering performance, risks, escalations, customer feedback and improvement actions for GAM and CSM.

·       
**Automation roadmap and prioritisation:**
Own the operational automation backlog across GAM and CSM within their respective agreed scopes. Identify opportunities in recurring access requests, Joiner/Mover/Leaver activities, request routing, reporting and evidence collection. Prioritise opportunities using workload, manual effort, error patterns, customer impact, risk and feasibility. Define business requirements, expected benefits and acceptance criteria with service stakeholders, and coordinate delivery with L3 engineers and automation or platform owners. Lead operational acceptance and adoption, with technical design and implementation owned by the relevant technical teams.

·       
**Continual improvement:**
Drive Lean improvements, standardisation and reduction of process variability. Prioritise opportunities to reduce manual work, repeat incidents and unnecessary escalations, coordinating automation delivery with technical owners.

·       
**Team development:**
Support training, coaching, mentoring and knowledge transfer across both teams. Work with GAM L3 engineers to strengthen L1/L2 capability and ensure CSM has the knowledge and coverage needed for its managed-service commitments.

·

18a47296.title: Service Delivery Manager
18a47296.description:
About the Role

The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) – Cloud Management & Operations Platform is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end operational support, customer satisfaction, and service reliability for an enterprise multi-tenant cloud management platform. In this leadership role, you manage a tiered operational organization comprising L1 (Incident Monitoring & Triage), L2 (Platform & Agentic Operations), and L3 (SRE & Core Platform Escalations) teams. You will act as the primary operational liaison between external enterprise customers and internal engineering organizations. You will own Service Level Agreements (SLAs/SLOs), drive major incident governance, lead post-incident reviews (RCAs), optimize support workflows, and spearhead continuous operational improvements to minimize customer downtime and maximize adoption of the cloud management platform.

Responsibilities

* Tiered Team Leadership & Resource Management: Direct, mentor, and allocate resources across 24/7/365 L1, L2, and L3 support teams. Define shift coverage, on-call rotations, escalation matrices, and technical career progression pathways for support engineers.
* SLA/SLO Ownership & Service Governance: Accountable for meeting contractual Service Level Agreements (MTTA, MTTR, availability targets) across all customer accounts. Maintain live service health dashboards and deliver periodic operational reviews (QBRs/MBRs) to customer leadership.
* Major Incident Management (MIM): Act as the executive incident commander during Critical/P1 outages impacting customer cloud environments or platform availability. Direct the cross-functional resolution bridge, manage external crisis communications, and eliminate operational bottlenecks.
* Problem Management & RCA Delivery: Partner with L3 engineers, SREs, and product engineering to lead Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) following outages. Track post-incident corrective and preventative action items (CAPAs) to ensure systemic platform vulnerabilities are resolved.
* Operational Shift-Left & Automation: Drive "shift-left" operational strategies—empowering L1 teams to resolve recurring issues through automated runbooks developed by L2/L3 engineers, thereby reducing MTTR and tier-escalation volume.
* Customer Relationship & Escalation Handling: Serve as the designated operational escalation contact for enterprise customer stakeholders. Manage client friction, track recurring customer pain points, and translate operational findings into feature requests for the product roadmap.
* Vendor & Tooling Operations: Oversee support tools and platforms, including ITSM systems (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management), paging systems (PagerDuty, Opsgenie), and client-facing status portals.

Requirements

* Experience: 7–12 years in IT service management, technical support leadership, or cloud infrastructure operations, with at least 3+ years directly managing multi-tiered technical teams (L1/L2/L3) in a B2B SaaS, Managed Service Provider (MSP), or Cloud Platform setting.
* ITSM & Framework Expertise: Deep practical knowledge of ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management), with demonstrated experience tailoring frameworks to agile cloud environments.
* Cloud & Platform Technical Acumen: Broad understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts (AWS, Azure, or GCP), container platforms (Kubernetes, Docker), and cloud operational paradigms (monitoring, log ingestion, and API-based integrations).
* Incident & Crisis Leadership: Proven track record acting as Incident Commander or escalation manager during complex, high-impact enterprise production outages.
* Metrics & Analytics Driven: Strong ability to track, analyze, and present operational KPIs (Ticket Volume, First-Contact Resolution, SLA Breaches, MTTA/MTTR trends, CSAT) using reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, Jira dashboards).
* Communication & Executive Presence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate technical failures and remediation steps clearly to C-level client executives and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

* Certifications: ITIL v4 Foundation / Managing Professional, PMP (Project Management Professional), or Certified Scrum Master (CSM).
* Cloud Certifications: Foundational cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner / Solutions Architect Associate, Azure Fundamentals AZ-900).
* DevOps & SRE Alignment: Experience transitioning traditional ITSM support structures toward modern Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices and error budget management.
* Tooling Proficiency: Deep administrative experience configuring workflows, SLAs, and routing rules inside ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or Zendesk.
* FinOps/Contract Knowledge: Exposure to cloud economics, consumption models, and managing operational support profitability (P&L tracking, statement of work commitments).

Pay: ₹1,079,000.00 - ₹2,230,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP?
* Do you have Experience in SLA/SLO Management & Operational KPI Reporting

Experience:

* IT service management: 8 years (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

0a405f3d.title: Community Growth & Engagement Manager
0a405f3d.description:
**Company:** The Marcom Avenue

**Client:** Leading Consumer Technology Brand

**Location:** Gurugram / Delhi NCR

**Experience:** 4–7 years (preferred)

**Department:** Digital Strategy & Community Growth

**Role Type:** Full-time | Client-facing

About the Role

We are looking for a **community-first thinker, growth strategist, and relationship builder** who can help transform our client's brand community app into a thriving ecosystem of engaged users, loyal brand advocates, and meaningful conversations.

This is not a traditional client servicing or social media management role.

We need someone who understands that **a community is not built by posting more content. It is built by giving people compelling reasons to participate, contribute, connect, and return.**

**You will act as the strategic bridge between the client and The Marcom Avenue, aligning brand objectives, community insights, creative execution, and measurable growth.**

Key Responsibilities

**1. Own Community Growth**

* Develop and execute strategies to drive app registrations, active users, engagement, and retention.
* Identify opportunities to acquire new community members through digital campaigns, partnerships, influencers, product launches, and referral programs.
* Build initiatives that convert passive members into active participants and brand advocates.
* Identify friction points in the user journey and recommend improvements to onboarding, activation, and repeat engagement.

**2. Drive Community Engagement & Advocacy**

* Create innovative community-led IPs, challenges, contests, discussions, recognition programs, and exclusive experiences.
* Build engagement opportunities around the client's products, technology, photography, gaming, lifestyle, and innovation.
* Develop super-user, ambassador, and advocacy programs that reward meaningful participation.
* Encourage authentic user-generated content, peer-to-peer interactions, and community-led conversations.
* Ensure community initiatives go beyond vanity metrics and contribute to sustained participation.

**3. Act as the Strategic Brand–Agency Liaison**

* Serve as the primary coordination and strategic interface between the client's stakeholders and TMA's internal teams.
* Translate brand objectives into actionable community growth briefs, campaigns, and execution plans.
* Proactively recommend new growth opportunities instead of waiting for client instructions.
* Coordinate with creative, content, performance marketing, technology, and analytics teams to ensure timely execution.
* Conduct regular client reviews, document decisions, and maintain clear ownership of action items.
* Build a trusted relationship with the client through proactive thinking, responsiveness, and measurable outcomes.

**4. Build a Data-Driven Growth Engine**

* Track app acquisition, activation, daily/monthly active users, retention, and engagement.
* Analyze member behavior, content performance, participation patterns, and campaign effectiveness.
* Identify what makes users join, participate, return, and advocate.
* Develop weekly growth dashboards and monthly performance reviews.
* Translate data into experiments, recommendations, and measurable improvements.

**5. Bring Fresh Thinking & Innovation**

* Research successful global brand communities and emerging community engagement trends.
* Identify opportunities for gamification, loyalty, rewards, member recognition, and exclusive access.
* Explore collaborations with creators, technology enthusiasts, student communities, and relevant interest groups.
* Build a continuous pipeline of experiments to improve community acquisition, engagement, and retention.
* Work with relevant stakeholders to improve the overall community experience.

Skills & Experience Required

* 4–7 years of experience in community growth, consumer engagement, digital growth, product marketing, or brand communities.
* Proven experience driving measurable user acquisition, engagement, or retention.
* Strong understanding of digital communities, consumer psychology, and engagement mechanics.
* Experience working with consumer technology, smartphones, gaming, lifestyle, or youth-focused brands preferred.
* Ability to understand app analytics, user funnels, retention cohorts, and growth dashboards.
* Strong client communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
* Ability to translate business objectives into creative, executable campaigns.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and multiple stakeholders.
* Familiarity with community platforms, CRM, gamification, and growth experimentation is advantageous.

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

Someone who:

* Thinks like a **growth marketer**, not just an account manager.
* Understands community behavior, not just content calendars.
* Is obsessed with what makes users return to an app.
* Can challenge conventional thinking and bring fresh ideas to the client.
* Combines creativity with numbers and execution discipline.
* Takes ownership of outcomes rather than simply coordinating tasks.
* Understands how to turn customers into contributors, and contributors into advocates.

Why This Role Matters

Our client's community should become more than another brand-owned digital platform.

**It should become a destination where people come for the experience, stay for the connections, and advocate because they genuinely belong.**

* **Your job is to help make that happen.**

Interested? reach out on 8448989429

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹1,300,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

We enable healthcare organizations to be future ready and our customer obsession is our driving force. We ensure that our customers achieve what they truly want. We are bold in our actions, nimble in our decision-making, and industrious in the way we work.

**Job Description**

Technology Program Manager (B2/B3)

Role Summary

The Technology Program Manager will own end-to-end program management and governance for a portfolio of technology programs and platforms across the enterprise — spanning enterprise platforms, AI/ML and GenAI products, cloud and infrastructure, and API-integration and product-engineering programs. This individual will drive predictable delivery across multiple, concurrent client engagements while ensuring the stable, secure, and scalable steady-state operation of the platforms they support.

The role requires close collaboration with Engineering, Product, Business, Security, and Infrastructure teams to drive predictable outcomes, operational excellence, and a “no-surprises” delivery model with minimal escalations across all engagements.

We are especially keen on PMs with Tech products / services experience — e.g. enterprise platforms, AI/ML & GenAI products, cloud/infra, and API-integration & product-engineering programs.

Key Responsibilities

Program Leadership

* Own end-to-end delivery accountability for a portfolio of technology programs — enterprise platforms, AI/ML & GenAI products, cloud/infra, and API-integration & product-engineering programs — spanning pilots, scaled deployments, and enterprise rollouts.
* Define program strategy, set measurable goals, and drive delivery in fast-moving, often ambiguous environments where both the business problem and the technical solution are still taking shape.
* Lead, mentor, and scale Program Managers and delivery squads handling complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives.
* Establish and enforce delivery standards, governance frameworks, execution rhythms, roadmaps, and release schedules across all programs.
* Apply strong technical judgment to challenge assumptions, simplify complex architectures, and keep engineering teams focused on solving the right problems in the right way.
* Proactively manage risks, dependencies, and cross-program / critical-path conflicts to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery.

Steady-State Platform & Operations Management

* Oversee steady-state delivery and operational health of the platforms in your portfolio — including availability, performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Define and manage SLAs, KPIs, and operational metrics for platforms and services.
* Ensure a smooth transition from build to run, with clear ownership, runbooks, and support models.

Support & Incident Management

* Set up and scale technical support desks (L2/L3), including processes, tooling, staffing, and escalation paths.
* Ensure rapid incident resolution, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement to reduce repeat issues.
* Drive a strong “first-time-right” culture to minimize client escalations and operational disruptions.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Management

* Act as the senior delivery interface across Engineering, Product, Business, Security, and Infrastructure teams.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for program communications with leadership — including deep dives, operational reviews, and status reporting.
* Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and ensure delivery transparency and confidence.
* Anticipate and neutralize potential escalations before they reach senior leadership or clients.

Client Management & Experience

* Own the client relationship and experience throughout the programs — maintaining trust, transparency, and confidence at every stage.
* Treat exceptional client experience as a core program outcome — anticipate concerns, manage expectations, and ensure sponsors and clients feel the value delivered at each milestone.
* Own, track, and continuously improve client-experience metrics — Net Promoter Score (NPS) and CSAT scores— using feedback to drive concrete improvements across the program.
* Build enduring client partnerships that extend beyond the current program, positioning Indegene as a trusted long-term partner.

Governance, Quality & Continuous Improvement

* Establish strong governance for programs — including compliance, security, data privacy, and, where relevant, responsible-AI considerations.
* Define KPIs/SLAs used to drive business outcomes, and report progress and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership.
* Build scalable mechanisms and processes that improve delivery velocity, quality, and cost efficiency across programs and platforms.
* Leverage data and insights to identify systemic issues and implement corrective actions at scale.

Required Experience & Qualifications

* 8+ years of experience in technology delivery, technical program management, or large-scale enterprise implementations.
* Proven experience managing technical programs across cross-functional teams, working directly with software engineering and product teams, and coordinating roadmaps and release schedules.
* Hands on experience with tools like Jira, MS Projects, or equivalent.
* Hands-on experience delivering and operating one or more of: enterprise platforms, AI/ML & GenAI products, data platforms, cloud-native / infrastructure programs, or API-integration & product-engineering programs.
* Strong grounding in project-management disciplines — scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical-path management.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile, and hybrid delivery models, plus platform operations and steady-state run.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience. Recognized certifications (Agile, Scrum, or equivalent).
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills.

Preferred Experience

* A software development background or hands-on technical depth (architecture, data structures, integrations, big-data or ML concepts).
* Program certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent).
* Experience with GenAI/LLMs, AI platforms, MLOps, or data-intensive systems.
* Experience defining KPIs/SLAs used to run multi-million-dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership.
* Exposure to regulated or high-compliance environments (life sciences, BFSI, healthcare, etc.).
* Experience setting up global or distributed delivery and support teams.

Leadership Competencies

* Strong ownership mindset with a bias for execution and outcomes.
* Ability to operate calmly under pressure and resolve ambiguity.
* Structured thinker with exceptional problem-solving and technical judgment.
* Influential leader who can align diverse teams without formal authority.

Success Metrics

* On-time, on-budget delivery of technology programs with minimal escalations.
* High platform stability, SLA adherence, and support effectiveness.
* Strong client satisfaction and trust in delivery outcomes.
* Exceptional client experience, evidenced by strong and improving NPS and CSAT scores.
* Scalable delivery and support models that grow with the portfolio.

**Qualifications**

(Tech BE/ Btech/ BCA/ MTech / MCA / ME) + MBA

**Additional Information**

We are especially keen on PMs with Tech products / services experience - e.g. enterprise platforms, AI/ML & GenAI products, cloud/infra, and API-integration & product-engineering programs.

c4c56744.title: Program Manager - Project Management Job
c4c56744.description:
YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.
  
  
At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.
  
  
**We are looking forward to hire Project Management Professionals in the following areas :**
**Job Title:**
QAD Delivery & Program Manager
  
  
**Experience:**
20+ Years
  
  
**Domain:**
QAD ERP / Manufacturing ERP / Enterprise Applications
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Role Level:**
Senior Management
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an experienced QAD Delivery & Program Manager to lead the successful delivery of complex QAD ERP implementation, upgrade, transformation, and support programs across multiple customers and geographies.
  
  
The individual will be responsible for end-to-end program governance, delivery management, customer satisfaction, financial performance, resource optimization, risk management, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The role requires a strong combination of QAD ERP domain expertise, program management capabilities, manufacturing business process knowledge, and stakeholder management skills. The candidate will act as a strategic partner to customers and internal leadership, ensuring programs are delivered within agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and budgets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Program & Delivery Management**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of multiple QAD ERP implementation, upgrade, enhancement, and support programs.
* Establish program governance, delivery frameworks, project plans, milestones, and execution strategies.
* Manage large-scale and multi-site QAD ERP transformation programs across global locations.
* Ensure delivery commitments are met within agreed scope, schedule, budget, and quality parameters.
* Drive program-level planning, execution, monitoring, and reporting.
* Manage dependencies across functional, technical, integration, infrastructure, and business workstreams.
* Establish effective delivery methodologies using Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches.

**2. Customer & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary escalation point for customers and executive stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customer leadership, business stakeholders, and IT teams.
* Conduct executive steering committee meetings, program reviews, and governance sessions.
* Proactively identify customer concerns, manage escalations, and drive resolution.
* Ensure customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term strategic partnerships.
* Identify opportunities for account expansion and additional consulting services.

**3. QAD ERP Expertise & Solution Governance**

* Provide leadership and oversight for QAD ERP implementations, upgrades, and transformation initiatives.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of QAD Enterprise Edition, QAD Adaptive ERP, and QAD manufacturing business processes.
* Provide guidance on QAD solution architecture, functional design, technical development, integrations, and system enhancements.
* Oversee solution design governance and ensure alignment with business requirements and ERP best practices.
* Lead modernization initiatives involving QAD ERP, integrations, automation, and digital transformation.
* Ensure effective management of customizations, technical debt, and system performance.

**4. Financial & Commercial Management**

* Manage program budgets, revenue forecasts, profitability, and delivery margins.
* Monitor project financials, resource costs, billing milestones, and commercial commitments.
* Drive financial discipline and ensure adherence to contractual obligations.
* Identify risks to project profitability and implement corrective actions.
* Support proposals, RFP/RFI responses, effort estimation, commercial negotiations, and Statements of Work.
* Partner with sales and presales teams for strategic opportunities and account growth.

**5. Resource & Workforce Management**

* Manage resource allocation, capacity planning, utilization, and workforce forecasting.
* Ensure appropriate availability of QAD functional, technical, integration, and project management resources.
* Drive resource productivity, utilization, and effective deployment across programs.
* Identify skill gaps and develop capability-building and cross-training initiatives.
* Collaborate with competency leaders on hiring, talent development, succession planning, and resource retention.
* Build and maintain high-performing delivery teams across geographies.

**6. Risk, Quality & Governance**

* Establish program governance, quality assurance, and delivery control mechanisms.
* Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate program risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Ensure compliance with organizational delivery standards and customer contractual requirements.
* Drive defect management, testing governance, cutover planning, and go-live readiness.
* Implement lessons learned, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence practices.
* Maintain effective program reporting, dashboards, and executive-level communication.

**7. Leadership & Business Growth**

* Lead, mentor, and develop project managers, program leads, solution architects, and delivery teams.
* Drive a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer-centricity, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Sales, Presales, Competency, HR, and Finance teams.
* Contribute to strategic planning, service line growth, and delivery capability expansion.
* Promote innovation through AI-enabled delivery, automation, and ERP modernization initiatives.

**Required Skills & Qualifications Mandatory Qualifications**

* 20+ years of experience in ERP implementation, consulting, and program delivery.
* 10+ years of experience in QAD ERP environments.
* Proven experience managing large-scale QAD ERP programs, including implementation, upgrade, and support engagements.
* Strong understanding of QAD ERP manufacturing, supply chain, distribution, and financial processes.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong program governance, financial management, risk management, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Excellent customer-facing communication, leadership, and decision-making skills.
* Experience managing project budgets, resource utilization, revenue forecasts, and delivery margins.

**QAD Technical & Functional Knowledge**

* QAD Enterprise Edition (EE) and QAD Adaptive ERP.
* QAD MFG/PRO and legacy QAD ERP environments.
* Manufacturing, MRP, Procurement, Inventory, Sales & Distribution, Finance, and Supply Chain.
* QAD ERP upgrades, data migration, integrations, testing, and deployment.
* QAD technical landscape, including Progress 4GL, Qxtend, APIs, EDI, and integration technologies.
* QAD solution architecture and ERP modernization strategies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, or equivalent program management certification.
* Six Sigma, ITIL, or Agile certifications.
* Experience managing global ERP transformation programs.
* Experience in manufacturing industries such as Automotive, Industrial Manufacturing, Life Sciences, and Consumer Goods.
* Exposure to AI-enabled ERP transformation and delivery automation.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* On-time and within-budget program delivery.
* Customer satisfaction and customer referenceability.
* Program profitability and delivery margin achievement.
* Resource utilization and workforce productivity.
* Reduction in delivery escalations and critical risks.
* Quality of deliverables and post-go-live defect reduction.
* Revenue growth and account expansion.
* Employee retention, competency development, and team engagement.

**Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic thinking and business acumen.
* Strong customer relationship management.
* Executive communication and stakeholder influence.
* Effective decision-making and problem-solving.
* Financial and commercial awareness.
* Change management and organizational leadership.
* Team development and talent management.
* Continuous improvement and innovation mindset.

**Expected Outcome**
The QAD Delivery & Program Manager will ensure predictable, high-quality, and profitable delivery of QAD ERP programs while strengthening customer relationships, improving operational efficiency, developing delivery capabilities, and supporting sustainable business growth.
  
  
At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale.
  
  
**Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles**

* Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
* Agile self-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
* All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
* Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

8510eeb4.title: Pre-Sales Techno-Commercial manager
8510eeb4.description:
**Position Summary:**

The Pre-Sales Techno-Commercial professional will support enterprise sales teams by designing, sizing, and proposing end-to-end IT infrastructure solutions. This role combines deep technical expertise (compute, storage, networking, virtualization, data center) with strong commercial understanding to drive successful deal closures and profitable growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Solution Design & Architecture**

* Engage with customers to understand current IT infrastructure, workloads, and business needs.
* Design end-to-end infrastructure solutions covering:
* Servers & compute platforms
* Storage (SAN/NAS/HCI)
* Networking (LAN/WAN, SD-WAN)
* Virtualization & HCI
* Backup, DR, and data protection
* Create scalable, high-availability, and cost-optimized architectures.

**2. Techno-Commercial Proposal Management**

* Prepare detailed proposals including:
* Solution architecture diagrams
* Bill of Quantities (BoQ)
* Sizing and configuration
* Pricing and commercials
* Optimize BOM and pricing to balance competitiveness and margins.
* Handle RFPs, RFQs, and tender submissions with complete documentation.

**3. Sales Support & Deal Closure**

* Work closely with account managers on opportunity qualification and strategy.
* Participate in customer discussions, presentations, and technical workshops.
* Deliver solution presentations, PoCs, and demos where required.
* Address technical queries, objections, and commercial concerns.

**4. Vendor / OEM Engagement**

* Coordinate with OEMs
* Secure deal registrations, special pricing, and technical validations.
* Stay updated on OEM product roadmaps, certifications, and partner programs.

**5. Sizing, Performance & Cost Optimization**

* Perform workload sizing, capacity planning, and performance analysis.
* Recommend right-fit configurations (avoid over/under sizing).
* Optimize TCO/ROI for customers while protecting margins.

**6. Solution Positioning & Advisory**

* Position infrastructure solutions aligned to business outcomes (performance, uptime, scalability, security).
* Recommend modernization strategies (virtualization, HCI, hybrid cloud readiness).
* Act as a trusted advisor to enterprise customers.

**7. Internal Enablement**

* Train sales teams on infrastructure offerings and positioning.
* Develop reusable solution templates, proposals, and presentations.
* Support cross-SBU collaboration (cloud, security, software).

**8. Market Intelligence**

* Track trends in data center, HCI, hybrid cloud, and edge infrastructure.
* Analyze competitor solutions and pricing benchmarks.
* Identify new opportunities for solution bundling.

**Key Requirements**

**Experience**

* 4–8 years in pre-sales / solution engineering for IT infrastructure.
* Experience handling enterprise customers and complex solutioning.
* Exposure to RFPs and large deal cycles.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of:
* Servers (rack/blade), storage, and networking
* Virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix)
* Backup & disaster recovery solutions
* Data center architecture & design
* Ability to perform sizing and create architecture diagrams.

**Commercial Skills**

* Strong understanding of pricing, margins, and deal structuring.
* Experience with BOM optimization and vendor pricing models.
* Ability to balance competitiveness with profitability.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
* Customer-facing and consultative approach
* High attention to detail in proposals

**Key Competencies**

* Techno-commercial balance
* Solution-oriented thinking
* Ownership and responsiveness
* Collaboration across sales, OEMs, and delivery teams

**KPIs / Success Metrics**

* Win rate / conversion ratio
* Proposal turnaround time
* Accuracy of sizing and costing
* Revenue influenced / supported
* Gross margin on deals
* Sales team feedback / enablement effectiveness

**Reporting To**

* SBU Head – Infrastructure Solutions

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* Strong technical depth in infrastructure + commercial awareness
* Experience in multi-vendor enterprise environments
* Ability to handle complex, high-value deals
* Proactive, structured, and execution-driven

**Educational Qualifications:**

Graduation in any stream

Good working knowledge in MS Office,especially excel) Zoho / CRM

c27d3724.title: Senior Solutions Architect
c27d3724.description:
We are looking for passionate technologists to join our Pre-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.
  
  
MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. Our team is made up of seasoned technical sales professionals, software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. You'll work closely with our sales executives, helping customers solve business problems by leveraging our solutions, playing a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Mumbai for our hybrid working model.
  
  
As an ideal candidate, you will have
  
  

* Ideally 8 to 11 years of related experience in a customer facing role, with 5 to 7 years of experience in pre-sales with enterprise software
* Minimum of 3 years experience with modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, SQL) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Java, C#) in a professional capacity
* Experience designing with scalable and highly available distributed systems in the cloud and on-prem
* Demonstrated ability to work with customers to review complex architecture of existing applications, providing guidance on how to improve by leveraging technology
* Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and business concepts in a clear and compelling manner to technology and business leadership
* Ability to strategize with sales teams and provide recommendations on how to drive a multi-threaded account strategy, aligning other MongoDB and ecosystem resources to move towards a mutually beneficial account plan
* The ability to travel up to 25%
* A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

You may also have
  
  

* Experience selling databases and/or deploying applications with any of the major cloud providers
* Experience with database programming and data models
* Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects
* Experience in transforming legacy systems and platforms into modern, scalable, and efficient technology stacks
* Understanding of popular sales methodologies/ frameworks such as MEDDPICC/ Command of the Message
* A MongoDB Certification
* A Cloud Provider Certification

What you do at MongoDB
  
  
In this role, you will work on complex opportunities where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors. You will:
  
  

* Design and Architect: Design scalable and performant applications, systems and infrastructure for large software projects leveraging MongoDB
* Customer Advising and Value Articulation: Guide customers on architecture patterns and optimisation strategies for MongoDB, while clearly communicating its business value to the relevant stakeholders
* Sales Partnership: Collaborate with the sales team to drive account success through account planning, opportunity prioritization/qualification and pipeline generation strategy, while taking ownership of the technical aspects (including but not limited to technical discovery, demos, proof of value, presentations, sizing and documentation)
* Demand Generation: Proactively generate demand within the sales territory through self-driven technical initiatives, participation in events such as industry trade shows and account-based marketing events
* Customer Success: Foster strong customer relationships, build champions and ensure customer success and satisfaction
* Innovation and Improvement: Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve MongoDB solutions and processes (e.g. by relaying field feedback to the product team), as well as proactively mentor other Solutions Consulting team members
* Personal Training and Development: Engage in ongoing training and professional development to stay abreast of MongoDB product suite as well as industry trends

What you will learn
  
  
MongoDB Product Suite Mastery
  
  

* Core Database Server: Master the fundamentals and advanced features of MongoDB's core database
* Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts
* Relational Migrator: Learn to migrate from relational databases seamlessly

**Interested in a career that matters?**




At Novonesis, we believe biology holds the key to solving some of the world's biggest challenges. To unlock that potential, we are scaling AI capabilities that help our sales, marketing, and technical service teams work smarter, serve customers better, and create measurable business impact.

As an **Applied AI Solutions Engineer** , you will join the Strategy Deployment team within the Planetary Health Biosolutions (PHB) business division. Working at the intersection of applied AI, commercial problem-solving, and business transformation, you will help turn high-value opportunities into practical AI solutions that transform how commercial teams operate.

This is a forward-deployed engineering opportunity for someone who wants to combine strong technical expertise with visible business impact. You will move between commercial workflows, solution design, and hands-on development, owning the journey from identifying a business challenge to delivering solutions that users genuinely adopt and value.

**The Role & Your Impact**

In this role, you will design, build, deploy, and continuously improve AI solutions that enable PHB commercial teams to work more effectively and create measurable business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Solution Development**

* Work directly with PHB commercial teams to understand workflows, user needs, and business challenges, translating them into practical AI solutions.
* Design and build AI agents, applications, and workflows utilizing prompting, grounding, retrieval, tool usage, actions, and orchestration.
* Develop thin-slice solutions to rapidly validate user value and technical feasibility.
* Build iteratively with users, leveraging feedback and evidence to improve, redesign, or discontinue solutions where appropriate.

**Integration & Engineering**

* Securely connect AI solutions to enterprise platforms and data sources, including Salesforce, Microsoft 365, and approved AI services.
* Build integrations using APIs, connectors, and workflow technologies with appropriate identity, security, and approval controls.
* Work with structured and unstructured data, enterprise knowledge sources, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns.
* Design and develop solutions with security, privacy, responsible AI, maintainability, and reuse in mind.

**Evaluation, Deployment & Scale**

* Design and execute functional, integration, regression, and AI-specific evaluations covering groundedness, retrieval quality, agent behavior, reliability, and user experience.
* Test solutions with end users and make data-driven decisions on whether to scale, iterate, or stop initiatives.
* Deploy, monitor, support, and continuously improve production solutions in partnership with Central IT, ComEx, and other enterprise stakeholders.
* Document solutions, technical patterns, and key learnings to support ongoing maintenance, reuse, and scale across the organization.

**What You'll Need to Be Successful**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2–6 years of relevant professional experience building and deploying AI, GenAI, or agent-based solutions in production environments.
* Hands-on experience with LLMs, AI agents, prompting, grounding, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use, and orchestration frameworks.
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience working with APIs, data integration, Git/version control, testing practices, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience building workflows and integrations using technologies such as Microsoft Power Platform, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, Salesforce Flow, REST APIs, or similar tools.
* Experience taking AI solutions from prototype through deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
* Good understanding of cloud platforms, identity and access management, secure enterprise data handling, responsible AI, and production reliability.
* Ability to work directly with business users and technical teams to translate business challenges into practical technology solutions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Salesforce Agentforce, UiPath, or comparable technologies.
* Experience supporting sales, marketing, customer engagement, or commercial business functions.
* Curiosity and adaptability to work across different AI models, platforms, and frameworks while selecting the best technology for the business problem.
* Experience working in fast-paced environments with evolving priorities and emerging technologies.

What We Offer

At Novonesis, you will help shape how AI transforms commercial operations across a global, purpose-driven organization. You will work alongside experienced colleagues, gain exposure to cutting-edge AI technologies, and contribute to solutions that create tangible value for customers and the business.

We offer an environment that encourages innovation, learning, ownership, and professional growth while supporting our purpose of unlocking the power of biology to address global challenges.

**Application Deadline:** November 23rd November 2026 - *We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.*

**Our purpose guides the way**

In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.

**Opportunities for everyone**

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.

**Explore other openings**

If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

**About the opportunity**

Ericsson’s Service Architecture team, within Service Management in the Operate Service Line, seeks an AI & Cloud Architect to define the strategy for an enterprise AI platform at global telecom scale. You will shape secure, reliable cloud-native capabilities that automate and augment managed service operations across ML/LLM platforms, MLOps, vector databases, knowledge graphs, RAG, and Agentic AI. As technical authority, you will connect engineering, product, enterprise architecture, and senior leadership, guiding teams from PoC to production using TOGAF-aligned practices.

**What you will do**

* Own architecture for data ingestion, feature stores, model training, inference, retrieval, graph context, and agent orchestration.
* Define reusable reference architectures for LLM, RAG, and multi-agent solutions.
* Lead architecture reviews, ADRs, technology radar updates, and build-versus-buy decisions.
* Design multi-region ML inference on AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, including GPU scaling, versioning, and safe deployments.

* Set patterns for self-hosted models using vLLM/TGI/Triton and commercial models through secure API gateways.
