* Establish vector database standards using Pinecone, pgvector, Weaviate, Milvus, or equivalent, including embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking, privacy, and index lifecycle.
* Design property-graph and RDF/ontology architecture using Neo4j, Neptune, Cypher, or SPARQL for graph-enhanced reasoning.
* Architect agent memory, tools, guardrails, human escalation, recovery, evaluation, and golden datasets; integrate agents with OSS/BSS, APIs, and event streams.
* Set standards for IAM, network security, PII redaction, audit logging, GDPR/AI Act, OpenTelemetry, SRE, and GPU FinOps.

**You will bring**

* 8–15 years of software/systems engineering experience, including 4+ years as an architect or principal engineer.
* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or equivalent; advanced degree preferred.
* PMP or Project management related certificate is mandatory
* Proven production delivery of large-scale AI/ML systems with vector retrieval, knowledge graphs, and Agentic AI/LLM systems using open-source and licensed models.
* Strong cloud-native experience on AWS, Azure, or GCP; multi-cloud is an advantage.
* TOGAF Foundation/Practitioner or equivalent enterprise architecture practice.
* Expert Python and proficient PySpark; experience with Spark, SQL, Kafka/Flink, Delta Lake/Iceberg, and distributed ML.
* Knowledge of supervised, unsupervised, deep learning, reinforcement learning, and sequence/time-series models, including validation and bias assessment.
* Experience with Terraform/Pulumi, Kubeflow, MLflow, Weights & Biases, LangGraph/AutoGen/CrewAI/Semantic Kernel, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana.

* 6 years of experience in cloud computing, with a focus on machine learning architecture, software development, and model deployment in a customer-facing or consulting role.
* Experience engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders.
* Experience in programming/scripting languages such as Python.
* Experience developing and deploying data solutions.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience translating ambiguous customer requirements into actionable AI roadmaps, defining the technical architecture for fine-tuning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and custom model development.
* Experience in architecting and developing software or infrastructure for scalable, distributed systems.
* Proven track record of managing stakeholder expectations and building consensus around complex AI initiatives, including navigating discussions on AI ethics, model bias, and return on investment (ROI).
* Understanding of the AI/ML landscape, including familiarity with model evaluation frameworks, prompt engineering, and the integration of third-party foundation models.

**About The Job**
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
  
  
The APAC Google Forge Team partners with customers to bring their goals to life. We collaborate closely to understand their challenges and ideas, then design and build practical working solutions using data, analytics, AI, and software engineering. Our goal is to demonstrate how these technologies can work together to achieve impactful business results.
  
  
In this role, you will lead the design and development of cutting-edge prototypes, demonstrating the transformative power of data, analytics, AI, and software engineering to solve complex business challenges for our customers. You will play a key role in mentoring team members and contributing to the strategic direction of our solution-building efforts.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the technical relationship with partners, empowering them to drive a successful pilot or proof-of-concept, support partners in driving customer acceptance of the technical proposal, leading to an agreement, and work with partners during the migration phase to ensure they have all the tools necessary to deliver a successful deployment.
* Build trusted advisory relationships and make recommendations on integration strategies, enterprise architectures, platforms, and application infrastructure required to successfully implement a complete solution for customers to optimize Google Cloud effectiveness.
* Lead the design, development, and iterative refinement of data-centric and AI-powered solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), showcasing the potential of data and AI to address specific business needs.
* Establish and promote innovative best practices and methodologies for AI-driven solutions, actively contributing to industry thought leadership through publications, presentations, and community engagement.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. * Mentor and guide junior developers on AI engineering practices, prompt design, and workflow orchestration.
* Act as a technical point of contact for AI-related initiatives, engaging stakeholders across business and IT to translate needs into practical AI solutions.
* Stay current with the fast-moving AI ecosystem (models, frameworks, agent protocols) and champion responsible adoption across the organization.

Your skills
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience building AI-powered applications, automations, or agents, with around 9–12 years of overall software/solution development experience.

* Demonstrated ability to define technical strategy for AI initiatives, evaluate tools and models, and lead solution architecture discussions.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, comfortable engaging senior technical and business audiences on AI opportunities and risk.
* Proven track record delivering software/automation projects across the full lifecycle, including mentoring junior team members.

0f85a90b.description:
* Job ID: 911747
* 12 - 16 Years
* 1 Opening
* Bengaluru, Kolkata

  

### **Role description**

### **Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **Oracle EPM Senior Solution Architect** to lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale Oracle EPM solutions. The role requires strong functional and technical expertise across the Oracle EPM Cloud suite, combined with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable and maintainable solutions.

The ideal candidate will be a **hands-on architect** who can provide technical leadership, guide project teams, conduct solution reviews, troubleshoot complex issues, and work directly with business and technology stakeholders throughout the implementation lifecycle.

### **Skills**

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead solution architecture and design for **Oracle EPM Cloud** implementations, enhancements, and transformation programs.
* Design scalable solutions across:
  + Planning / PBCS / EPBCS
  + FreeForm Planning
  + Financial Consolidation and Close (FCCS)
  + Account Reconciliation (ARCS)
  + Enterprise Data Management (EDMCS)
  + Profitability and Cost Management
  + Narrative Reporting
  + Essbase
* Lead requirements gathering and translate business requirements into functional and technical solution designs.
* Define application architecture including dimensions, metadata, forms, business rules, calculations, security, integrations, reporting, and workflow.
* Design complex **Essbase calculations, Calc Manager rules, Groovy rules, and performance optimization strategies**.
* Architect integrations between Oracle EPM and ERP, HCM, data warehouses, and other enterprise systems using appropriate Oracle integration technologies.
* Provide architecture guidance for data integration, metadata management, reconciliation, and automation.
* Perform solution and design reviews to ensure adherence to Oracle EPM best practices and enterprise architecture standards.
* Troubleshoot complex application, calculation, data integration, performance, and environment issues.
* Lead technical discussions with customers, business stakeholders, infrastructure teams, and Oracle Support when required.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to consultants, developers, and support teams.
* Support estimation, solution planning, project execution, risk identification, and technical decision-making.
* Participate in pre-sales activities, solution assessments, proposals, effort estimation, and customer presentations when required.
* Establish reusable standards, implementation methodologies, design patterns, and documentation for EPM delivery.
* Support production deployments, quarterly Oracle Cloud updates, regression testing, and application lifecycle management.

### **Required Skills & Experience**

* Strong experience implementing and supporting **Oracle EPM Cloud** solutions.
* Deep expertise in at least two or more major Oracle EPM modules, with broad understanding of the overall EPM platform.
* Strong knowledge of:
  + Oracle Planning / PBCS / EPBCS
  + Essbase / ASO / BSO
  + Calculation scripts and Calc Manager
  + Groovy business rules
  + Data Integration / Data Management
  + REST APIs and automation
  + Smart View and reporting
  + Security and application administration
* Strong understanding of multidimensional application design, metadata architecture, calculation optimization, and EPM performance tuning.
* Experience designing integrations between EPM and Oracle ERP Cloud or other financial systems.
* Strong understanding of financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, management reporting, and close processes.
* Ability to diagnose and resolve complex functional and technical issues.
* Experience leading architecture discussions and design workshops with senior stakeholders.
* Strong communication, presentation, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to lead multiple workstreams and provide technical oversight across project teams.

### **Leadership Expectations**

The Senior Solution Architect should be able to:

* Own the EPM solution from **architecture through successful deployment**.
* Challenge designs and recommend simpler, scalable alternatives.
* Provide hands-on support when teams encounter complex technical problems.
* Mentor senior consultants and technical leads.
* Communicate technical decisions clearly to both business leadership and technical teams.
* Balance immediate project requirements with long-term maintainability and application performance.

### **Suggested Experience Level**

**14+ years of overall EPM experience**, with significant hands-on Oracle EPM experience and demonstrated responsibility for solution architecture and technical leadership.

  

**About Grant Thornton INDUS**
------------------------------

Grant Thornton INDUS is the global capability center for Grant Thornton US, the U.S. member firm of Grant Thornton International Ltd., a leading global network of independent audit, tax, and advisory firms. Founded in Chicago in 1924, Grant Thornton US is one of the leading accounting and advisory firms in the U.S., bringing together $4B+ in revenue, 56 U.S. offices, and a multi-national platform spanning 20 countries with 25,000 people. It combines deep expertise, advanced technology, and a collaborative mindset to help clients solve complex challenges and grow with confidence. Since 2012, Grant Thornton INDUS has brought together 3,300+ professionals across Tax, Audit, Advisory, Client Services, Innovation, and Enabling Functions to deliver high-impact solutions for Grant Thornton US and its global network. Recognized as a Great Place To Work® for three consecutive years and among India’s Top 15 Best Workplaces™ in Professional Services 2026, INDUS offers a high-performance culture where people are trusted, supported, and empowered to grow.

You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
  
  
You will be part of a culture of innovation where you’ll use AWS services to help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. Enable innovation through continuous deployment in DevOps, build highly scalable web & mobile applications with data store technologies.
  
  
AWS services cover a wide range of technologies including operational security, infrastructure, DevOps, highly available software architectures, observability, machine learning and analytics. Our customer solutions usually involve many of these at once. AWS Solutions Architects are expected to have at least one technical areas of depth, but also need to be capable of leading discussions across most of these areas.
  
  
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon diversity conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
  
  
Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.
  
  
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, you will provide architectural and technical leadership to a portfolio of customers who are looking to leverage AWS services at scale. You will be the domain expert guiding architectural design decisions, while demonstrating customer obsession to ensure high availability and performance of the customers applications. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and be curious while evangelizing the latest innovations and best practices in infrastructure, engineering and application design. You will mentor peers and customers while growing your knowledge.
  
  
As a core member of the account team, you will drive revenue growth across a specific customer. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand and implement advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a strategy to build knowledge and broad use of AWS. You will also need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other teams within AWS such as services teams, marketing, and professional services, as well as representing your team to executive management.

The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Knowledge of cloud architecture
* 10+ years of architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc. experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of software development tools and methodologies
* Knowledge of AWS services, market segments, customer base and industry verticals
* 7+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or AWS Professional level certification
* Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
* 10+ years' experience in designing and implementing large distributed systems, with deep expertise in core infrastructure, solution architecture, and distributed computing patterns.
* Professional experience in pre-sales consulting with proven presentation skills, executive engagement capabilities, and track record of effectively communicating with stakeholders at all levels while managing ambiguous requirements.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. 29ea3ae9.title: Forward Deployed Architect
29ea3ae9.description:
Are you passionate about designing AI systems that solve real customer challenges?

Do you enjoy working hands-on with customers to turn complex business problems into scalable, production-ready AI solutions?

Are you excited by the opportunity to shape agentic AI architectures that deliver measurable business impact?

At SoftwareOne, we help organizations unlock the value of AI, cloud, and data through practical, scalable, and outcome-focused solutions. We are looking for a Forward Deployed Architect - Agentic AI to lead the technical architecture behind production-grade AI systems deployed in real customer environments.

As a Forward Deployed Architect, you will work at the intersection of customer context, systems architecture, and applied AI. You will lead customer engagements from problem discovery through solution design, deployment, and iteration, ensuring AI solutions are technically robust, scalable, and aligned with business outcomes.

**Your key responsibilities:**

* Leading customer engagements from discovery through architecture design, deployment, and continuous improvement.
* Translating complex business challenges into practical agentic AI architectures, including multi-step workflows, tool use, and external system integrations.
* Designing production-grade AI systems, including data flows, system boundaries, monitoring, observability, and operational readiness.
* Defining architecture patterns and technical standards for integrating models, agents, and AI workflows into customer environments.
* Guiding prototypes into scalable, reliable, and maintainable production solutions while balancing speed, quality, and business value.
* Mentoring engineers and architects, sharing best practices, and raising delivery standards across AI projects.

**Job Requirements**

* Strong experience architecting and delivering AI, ML, or software systems in production environments.
* Hands-on technical expertise in Python or comparable programming languages such as Go, Rust, or similar.
* Practical knowledge of modern AI and ML frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face, or equivalent technologies.
* Solid understanding of AI/ML lifecycles, including deployment, monitoring, iteration, and production reliability.
* Strong software architecture fundamentals across distributed systems, data modeling, integration patterns, and system design.
* Excellent customer-facing communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs and business value clearly.

**Company description**


SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.
  
  

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.
  
  

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

ff0bf7f3.title: Cloud Security Architect
ff0bf7f3.description:
Role Purpose

Secure enterprise cloud environments on at least one platform: Azure, AWS or GCP. The candidate should combine cloud-security engineering or architecture with IAM/PAM, Zero Trust, governance, compliance and DevSecOps. Practical AI/ML or GenAI exposure is mandatory.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and implement security controls in Azure, AWS or GCP.
* Secure cloud identity, privileged access, networks, workloads, data, keys, secrets and logging.
* Implement IAM/PAM, least privilege, conditional access and Zero Trust patterns.
* Establish cloud governance, policies, guardrails and compliance evidence.
* Integrate cloud security into CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code workflows.
* Use CSPM, CNAPP, SIEM or native cloud-security services to detect and remediate risk.
* Apply AI/ML or GenAI for security posture summarization, alert triage, policy generation, threat detection, remediation guidance or control mapping.
* Evaluate AI output, restrict sensitive data exposure and maintain approval for high-impact security changes.

Mandatory Skills

* Strong Azure, AWS or GCP security
* IAM and PAM
* Zero Trust
* Cloud governance and compliance
* DevSecOps
* CSPM / CNAPP
* Cloud networking and workload security
* Infrastructure as Code security
* Logging, monitoring and incident integration

Artificial Intelligence / Generative AI / AI-ML

Preferred Tools and Platforms

* Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Entra ID, Sentinel, Azure Policy
* AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, IAM, CloudTrail, Config, KMS
* Google Security Command Center, Cloud IAM and logging services
* Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Orca or equivalent CNAPP/CSPM
* Terraform, Checkov, tfsec, CI/CD platforms
* CyberArk or cloud privileged-access controls
* Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex AI or ML services

8fcb03b7.title: Senior Manager  Solution Architect/Enterprise Architect
8fcb03b7.description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**

Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose:  to make a meaningful impact.  We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter.  Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.

At Cognizant, careers transcend titles.  We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose – always guided by our core values.  Join us in shaping future of business.

**About the Role**

As a **Senior Manager – Solution Architect / Enterprise Architect**, you will lead the design and governance of enterprise-scale, production-grade technology solutions that enable business transformation and innovation. You will be a key member of the Architecture and Engineering leadership team, collaborating with business stakeholders, product teams, engineering, security, infrastructure, and operations teams.

You will have the opportunity to shape technology strategy, define future-state architectures, and guide the delivery of scalable, secure, and resilient cloud solutions. This role requires balancing strategic thinking with hands-on architecture leadership while driving technology excellence across complex enterprise environments.

**In this Role, You Will:**

* Define end-to-end architecture for enterprise platforms, applications, integrations, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Design scalable, secure, high-availability, and production-grade cloud-native solutions.
* Establish architecture standards, governance frameworks, and reusable design patterns.
* Lead cloud transformation, modernization, migration, and deployment strategy initiatives.
* Drive architecture reviews, technology evaluations, and solution approval processes.
* Ensure solutions meet key non-functional requirements including security, performance, reliability, scalability, and compliance.
* Partner with engineering, security, data, infrastructure, and business teams to deliver strategic technology outcomes.
* Mentor architects and technical leaders while promoting architecture best practices across the organization.
* Embrace our vibrant culture by striving for excellence, focusing on meaningful outcomes, and collaborating effectively. Take ownership, build relationships, and focus on personal growth to drive business strategy and foster an inclusive culture, creating unmatched career opportunities and impactful work.

**What You Must Have to Be Considered**

1. 12+ years of experience in technology delivery with significant experience in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, or Technology Leadership roles.
2. Proven experience designing and governing enterprise-scale, production-grade solutions.
3. Deep expertise in cloud platforms (Azure preferred), cloud-native architectures, and modern application design patterns.
4. Strong understanding of microservices, APIs, integration architectures, DevSecOps, CI/CD, and deployment strategies.
5. Experience defining and implementing non-functional requirements including security, scalability, availability, performance, and disaster recovery.
6. Strong stakeholder management, leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
7. A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for work that serves a greater good for customers, communities, or global challenges.
8. The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The Right Thing, & Own It.

**These Will Help You Succeed**

1. Experience with AI/GenAI, Data & Analytics, and intelligent automation platforms.
2. Expertise in Kubernetes, container platforms, and Infrastructure as Code.
3. Experience leading large-scale cloud modernization and digital transformation programs.
4. Knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks and governance practices.
5. Experience with multi-cloud, event-driven, and distributed system architectures.
6. Strong mentoring and technical leadership capabilities.
7. Ability to influence senior executives and drive strategic technology decisions.

**Work model –**

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3-4 days a week in a client or Cognizant office. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

133a2dfe.title: TechOps-CloudOps-DevOps-Staff
133a2dfe.description:
Location: Kochi

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Nov 11, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1757946

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**The opportunity**

We are looking for a Staff CloudOps Engineer with 3–4 years of hands-on experience in AWS and Azure environments. The primary focus of this role is supporting DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, automation scripting, and container orchestration. The role also involves contributing to basic cloud infrastructure management and support. You will assist in troubleshooting, support deployment pipelines, and participate in operations across cloud-native environments.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Assist in resolving infrastructure and DevOps-related incidents and service requests.
* Support CI/CD pipeline operations and automation workflows.
* Implement infrastructure as code using Terraform.
* Monitor platform health using native tools like AWS CloudWatch and Azure Monitor.
* Collaborate with CloudOps and DevOps teams to address deployment or configuration issues.
* Maintain and update runbooks, SOPs, and automation scripts as needed.
* You will be responsible for executing tasks with increasing autonomy, applying sound judgment within defined parameters, and contributing to team outcomes. You are expected to demonstrate initiative, resolve routine issues independently, and support junior colleagues.
* You will anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team.
* In line with EY commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of high quality and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Working knowledge of AWS and Azure core services.
* Experience with Terraform; exposure to CloudFormation or ARM templates is a plus.
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/AKS), and Helm.
* Basic scripting in Bash; knowledge of Python is a plus.
* Understanding of ITSM tools such as ServiceNow.
* Knowledge of IAM, security groups, VPC/VNet, and basic networking.
* Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 3–4 years of experience in CloudOps, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure support.
* Hands-on experience in supporting cloud platforms like AWS and/or Azure.
* Familiarity with infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, and container platforms.
* Relevant cloud certification (AWS/Azure) preferred.
* Willingness to work in a 24x7 rotational shift-based support environment.
* No location constraints

  

**Technologies and Tools**

**Must haves**

* Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (hands-on)
* CI/CD: Basic experience with GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or AWS CodePipeline
* Containerization: Exposure to Kubernetes (EKS/AKS), Docker
* Monitoring: AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor
* Scripting: Bash
* Incident Management: Familiarity with ServiceNow or similar ITSM tool

  

**Good to have**

* Templates: CloudFormation, ARM templates
* Scripting: Python
* Security: IAM Policies, RBAC
* Observability: Datadog, Splunk, OpenTelemetry
* Networking: VPC/VNet basics, load balancers
* Certification: AWS/Azure (Associate-level preferred)

  

**What we look for**

* **Enthusiastic learners with a passion for cloud technologies and DevOps practices.**
* **Problem solvers with a proactive approach to troubleshooting and optimization.**
* **Team players who can collaborate effectively in a remote or hybrid work environment.**
* **Detail-oriented professionals with strong documentation skills.**

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

bd7bc12c.title: IN-Technical Consultant Int - Cloud
bd7bc12c.description:
Scope: The IN-Technical Consultant Int – Cloud acts as the point of escalation for infrastructure operations, responsible for handling complex issues, driving root cause analysis, and implementing long-term solutions. 7263b93b.description:
**Overview**

The MS portfolio consists of complex, multi-disciplinary, large scale, multi-year datacenter construction and lease projects. In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

The Datacenter Engineering Lease Program Manager will support the delivery and technical oversight of lease data centers and short-term AI Infrastructure-as-a-Service contracts across the APAC region. This role will focus on evaluating the technical readiness, compliance, and ongoing performance of third-party datacenter infrastructure supporting high-density AI/GPU deployments.

* The Technical Program Manager will serve as a primary engineering interface between Microsoft and external providers, coordinating across regional engineering, operations, construction, networking, and other technical stakeholders.
* The role will lead **technical feasibility assessments for prospective sites, engineering audits of existing facilities, and troubleshooting of infrastructure issues at operational sites**.
* A strong **electrical or mechanical engineering background** is critical for this position. The Lease Program Manager must be able to evaluate mission-critical infrastructure serving high-density compute environments, identify technical risks and gaps, engage the appropriate engineering SMEs, and drive issues through resolution.

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Lead technical audits and compliance assessments of third-party datacenter facilities supporting cloud and AI infrastructure service contracts.

* Review provider design documentation and technical information against Microsoft requirements, with particular focus on electrical and mechanical infrastructure supporting high-density compute deployments.
* Provide technical support and coordinate troubleshooting for **existing operational sites**, partnering with providers, Microsoft Operations, and engineering SMEs to understand infrastructure issues and drive resolution.

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's Degree AND 6+ years of experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.
* 3+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of experience in mission-critical or high-tech infrastructure such as datacenters, semiconductor facilities, large-scale manufacturing, pharmaceutical facilities, or oil and gas.
* 8+ years of experience managing complex, cross-functional engineering or infrastructure projects.
* Demonstrated electrical and/or mechanical engineering expertise in mission-critical infrastructure, including the ability to independently evaluate engineering designs, system capacity, redundancy, reliability, technical risks, and infrastructure limitations.
* Ability to perform mechanical reviews of cooling plant and distribution, liquid cooling/CDU integration, heat rejection, controls, and high-density rack-to-facility integration will be plus
* Experience working with technical vendors, engineering consultants, contractors, or infrastructure providers.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex engineering issues into clear risks, actions, and decisions.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical organizations and with both internal and external stakeholders.
* Review proposed solutions and technical studies, escalating complex discipline matters to SMEs as required.

You will

* Embed data security, access control and compliance with GDPR and other relevant regulations by design in all solutions and integrations.

* Collaborate with IT leadership, business stakeholders, enterprise architects and external vendors, and advise them on technology choices, risks and trade-offs.
* Mentor and coach consultants and developers, set engineering and configuration best practices, and keep architecture documentation and knowledge material current.

Your skills
  
  

* Around 12+ years of overall IT experience, including a minimum of 6+ years designing and architecting enterprise applications and solutions, with at least 3+ years in an architect or technical lead role.
* Solid experience in solution and enterprise architecture across application, data, integration and security domains, with a track record of leading implementations from design to go-live.
* Strong knowledge of integration architecture and patterns, including REST/SOAP APIs, messaging, event-driven and file-based interfaces, middleware and API management.

* Good to have: knowledge of the wider HR systems landscape, including SAP HCM, payroll, time management and identity/access integration.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline. Architecture certifications (e.g. TOGAF) are a plus; SAP SuccessFactors and OpenText certifications are nice-to-have.
* Excellent communication, leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions, mentor others and interact with stakeholders at all levels.
* Exposure to AI tools will be an add-on advantage.

cfb86ce1.title: Salesforce Senior Technical Consultant- Health/Lifesciences Cloud
cfb86ce1.description:
**The Experience**

Salesforce Technical Consultants deliver solutions that transform our customers' businesses and their customers' experiences. In the Life Sciences vertical, this role involves partnering with project teams and client stakeholders to discover, design, code, and deploy specialized Salesforce Platform and Industry solutions (including Life Sciences Cloud and Health Cloud) tailored for pharmaceutical, biotech, medtech, and healthcare organizations.

Approximately 7075% of this role involves hands-on programming and system integration using Apex, JavaScript, Lightning Web Components (LWC), OmniStudio, and REST/SOAP APIs, while ensuring compliance with stringent regulatory standards.

The ideal technical consultant is a demonstrated practitioner and emerging thought leader who bridges deep Salesforce development capabilities with domain understanding of regulated industries. You will evaluate implementation options, build scalable architectures, guide client technical teams, proactively manage risk areas, and commit to seeing complex engineering challenges through to resolution.

**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Hands-on Development & Customization: Code enterprise-grade solutions using Salesforce Apex, JavaScript, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and modern web frameworks integrated with middleware and core Life Sciences backend systems.
* Domain & Regulatory Solutioning: Implement Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Health Cloud, and OmniStudio features that comply with strict industry regulatory and security frameworks (e.g., HIPAA, GxP, PHI).
* AI-First Workflow Execution: Champion an AI-first development workflow by leveraging advanced AI developer tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate custom Apex, LWC, and integration delivery while maintaining platform governor limits and security compliance.
* Architecture & Data Modeling: Define and build secure, scalable data models (1:M, M:M relationships), sharing rules, security models, and object structures optimized for Life Sciences and Healthcare workflows.
* Integrations & Interoperability: Build, optimize, and document API-based integrations connecting Salesforce to enterprise platforms, EHR/EMR systems, and middleware standard tools (utilizing HL7/FHIR standards where applicable).
* Technical Leadership & Workshops: Facilitate functional and technical workshops, review user stories, map end-to-end user journeys, and apply modern Apex and UI design patterns to solve complex business requirements.
* Delivery & Best Practices: Adhere to Salesforce Services development best practices, participate in DevOps/release management workflows, and drive high Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) scores.
* Travel: Travel to client sites as required by engagement scope (average of 50%, varying based on project needs).

  

**You're Our Person If...**

* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent.
* 5+ years of technology development experience, with 3+ years in client-facing consulting or system implementation roles.
* Strong object-oriented programming experience (Apex, Java, C#, or Python) alongside fluent JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and web component engineering.
* Proven hands-on experience designing data models, custom logic, and platform integrations on the Salesforce ecosystem.
* Foundational domain awareness of Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Medical Devices, or Healthcare Providers, including exposure to compliance constraints (HIPAA, GxP, PHI).
* Experience with API integrations (REST, SOAP, JSON, XML) and system security protocols.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex requirements, design adaptable technical solutions, and work independently as a self-starter.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with client facilitation experience.

  

**Even Better If...**

* Salesforce Product Expertise: Prior development experience with Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Health Cloud, OmniStudio framework, or Veeva CRM.
* Healthcare Interoperability: Experience with healthcare data standards and protocols such as HL7 and FHIR.
* Certifications: Highly beneficial to hold existing Salesforce certifications upon joining. Success in this role includes acquiring core certifications within the onboarding phase:Salesforce Certified AdministratorSalesforce Certified Platform App BuilderSalesforce Certified Platform Developer ISalesforce Certified JavaScript Developer ISalesforce Health Cloud Accredited / OmniStudio Developer (Bonus)
* DevOps & Integration Skills: Experience with CI/CD tools, version control (Git), automated testing frameworks, and middleware platforms (e.g., MuleSoft).
* AI Tooling Fluency: Practical experience using AI coding assistants to optimize daily development velocity, document custom code, and automate repetitive engineering tasks.

  

ATTRIBUTES

* Consultative Leader: Ability to clearly communicate the business and technical value of Salesforce platform features to both business stakeholders and client engineering teams.
* Results-Driven: Tenacious and focused on delivering high-quality, maintainable code in fast-paced environments.
* Adaptable Learner: Quick to master emerging platform updates, regulatory guidelines, and AI development techniques.
* Collaborative & Positive: Solves complex multi-system challenges with a constructive, solution-oriented mindset that motivates team members.

d4f4cba7.title: DE-Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer-GDSF02
d4f4cba7.description:
Location: Chennai

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Sep 4, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1724204

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Career Family : Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer**

  

**The opportunity**

We are the only professional services organization who has a separate business dedicated exclusively to the financial services marketplace. Join Digital Engineering Team and you will work with multi-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global perspective. Aligned to key industry groups including Asset management, Banking and Capital Markets, Insurance and Private Equity, Health, Government, Power and Utilities, we provide integrated advisory, assurance, tax, and transaction services. Through diverse experiences, world-class learning and individually tailored coaching you will experience ongoing professional development. That’s how we develop outstanding leaders who team to deliver on our promises to all of our stakeholders, and in so doing, play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, for our clients and for our communities. Sound interesting? Well, this is just the beginning. Because whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

  

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Security & Networking Engineer with 4-8 years of IT experience and deep expertise in designing, deploying, and managing secure cloud network architectures. The role requires strong hands-on skills in Azure and AWS (with GCP as an added advantage), implementing Zero Trust security, cloud-native networking, and enterprise-grade compliance frameworks. You will work closely with cloud architects, security leaders, and application teams to ensure resilient, secure, and scalable environments across hybrid and multi-cloud platforms.

  

EY Digital Engineering is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. The Digital Engineering practice works with clients to analyse, formulate, design, mobilize and drive digital transformation initiatives. We advise clients on their most pressing digital challenges and opportunities surround business strategy, customer, growth, profit optimization, innovation, technology strategy, and digital transformation. We also have a unique ability to help our clients translate strategy into actionable technical design, and transformation planning/mobilization. Through our unique combination of competencies and solutions, EY’s DE team helps our clients sustain competitive advantage and profitability by developing strategies to stay ahead of the rapid pace of change and disruption and supporting the execution of complex transformations

  

**Your key responsibilities**

  

**Cloud Security**

* Design, deploy, and manage Azure infrastructure across compute, networking, storage, identity, security, and monitoring services.
* Develop reusable Terraform modules and automate infrastructure provisioning across development, test, staging, and production environments.
* Build and maintain GitHub Actions workflows for application and infrastructure deployments.
* Implement end-to-end CI/CD pipelines covering build, testing, security validation, approvals, deployment, release, and rollback.
* Enable continuous delivery for application stacks including Java, .NET, Angular, Python, and Big Data workloads.
* Deploy, configure, and manage Kubernetes platforms, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), supporting cloud-native and microservices-based workloads.
* Manage AKS capabilities including namespaces, deployments, services, ingress, autoscaling, RBAC, secrets, networking, and monitoring.
* Implement Azure security controls using Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identities, RBAC, Key Vault, NSGs, Private Endpoints, and Azure Policy.
* Configure monitoring and observability using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Support cloud migration, modernization, and platform upgrade initiatives, including environment readiness and cutover activities.
* Troubleshoot issues across Azure infrastructure, Terraform, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, and AKS environments.
* Collaborate with architecture, application, cybersecurity, and operations teams to deliver secure, scalable, and highly available solutions.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, SOPs, and engineering best practices.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

  

**Mandatory Skills**

* 4-8 years of experience with strong hands-on experience in Azure Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps engineering.
* Strong knowledge of Azure services covering virtual networks, subnets, NSGs, virtual machines, load balancing, storage, identity, security, and monitoring.
* Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, including reusable modules, remote state, provider configuration, variables, outputs, and environment-based deployments.
* Strong hands-on experience creating and maintaining GitHub Actions workflows.
* Experience building automated CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployment.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), including deployment, scaling, upgrades, networking, security, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of Git, branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, and release management.
* Scripting experience using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
* Hands-on experience in cloud migration and modernization, including infrastructure migration, lifecycle upgrades, and environment cutovers.
* Good understanding of cloud security, networking, monitoring, high availability, backup, and disaster recovery concepts.
* Strong troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.

  

**Good to have Skills**

* Azure DevOps or Jenkins
* Docker and Helm
* Argo CD or other GitOps tools
* Azure Landing Zone implementation
* Cloud migration and modernization experience
* DevSecOps and security scanning integration
* FinOps exposure

  

**Preferred Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
* HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or equivalent

  

**Education:**

* **Degree**: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you**: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture**: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

58af5560.title: Founding AI FDE Lead / Architect – Enterprise AI Solutions
58af5560.description:
**The Opportunity – Build, Lead & Architect the Future of Enterprise AI**

We are looking for a **Founding AI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) Lead / Architect** to take ownership of Anthrobyte's end-to-end AI technology function.

This is not a conventional AI leadership position focused solely on strategy, team management, or architecture reviews. It is a high-impact, hands-on leadership opportunity for someone who can move seamlessly between enterprise client conversations, AI solution architecture, hands-on engineering, production deployment, and technology leadership.

You will work directly with the CEO and enterprise stakeholders, translating complex business challenges into scalable, production-ready AI solutions.

From identifying high-value AI opportunities and architecting intelligent systems to building engineering teams, establishing project pods, and driving successful enterprise deployments, you will own the complete AI solution lifecycle.

**Your mandate will be to build the technology function, establish architectural excellence, lead client-facing AI engagements, and evolve Anthrobyte's engineering capabilities as the company scales.**

Key Responsibilities1. Enterprise AI Consulting & Strategic Client Engagement

* Lead enterprise and mid-market client engagements across global markets, driving technical discovery and AI transformation conversations.
* Engage directly with CXOs, CTOs, CIOs, VPs of Operations, and technology decision-makers to understand business challenges, operational bottlenecks, and AI opportunities.
* Conduct AI readiness assessments, technical workshops, stakeholder interviews, and value-stream mapping exercises.
* Translate ambiguous business requirements into clearly defined AI use cases, technical roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes.
* Establish yourself as a trusted AI advisor, building strategic client relationships that drive long-term partnerships and business expansion.

2. Pre-Sales, Solution Consulting & Business Enablement

* Own technical pre-sales engagements, solution discovery, opportunity qualification, and AI solution positioning.
* Develop compelling Proof of Concepts (PoCs), technical demonstrations, architecture blueprints, and enterprise solution proposals.
* Lead technical responses to RFPs, RFIs, and complex enterprise solution requirements.
* Define solution scope, implementation feasibility, data requirements, resource estimates, delivery timelines, and expected ROI.
* Partner with the commercial and leadership teams to convert enterprise opportunities into successful AI engagements.

3. AI Architecture & Hands-on Engineering Leadership

* Design and architect scalable, secure, production-grade AI/ML systems for complex enterprise environments.
* Lead the development of advanced AI capabilities, including:
* Large Language Models (LLMs) and Small Language Models (SLMs).
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
* Agentic AI systems and multi-agent orchestration.
* Multimodal AI solutions.
* NLP and Computer Vision applications.
* LLM orchestration, intelligent automation, and workflow agents.
* Enterprise AI integrations and advanced analytics.
* Build and optimize AI pipelines using Python and frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, and other emerging technologies.
* Drive cloud-native AI architecture and deployment across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Establish best practices for model evaluation, prompt engineering, observability, MLOps, model monitoring, security, and governance.
* Optimize inference costs, token consumption, cloud credits, model performance, latency, and infrastructure utilization.
* Remain technically hands-on and capable of debugging, prototyping, and solving complex engineering challenges.

4. End-to-End Delivery & Production Ownership

* Own the complete AI solution lifecycle, from initial discovery and architecture through development, deployment, and continuous optimization.
* Ensure seamless integration with enterprise systems, databases, APIs, and existing business workflows.
* Drive production readiness, deployment planning, scalability, reliability, and performance optimization.
* Oversee go-live milestones, client acceptance, and post-deployment performance.
* Establish measurable success metrics and ensure solutions deliver tangible business value.
* Take complete accountability for production issues, technical challenges, and solution improvements.

5. Technology Function & Engineering Team Leadership

* Build and develop Anthrobyte's AI engineering and technology function from the ground up.
* Establish a scalable engineering organization with clearly defined ownership, responsibilities, and delivery standards.
* Create dedicated project-based engineering pods, aligning AI engineers, data scientists, backend engineers, and consultants with individual client engagements.
* Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams.
* Establish engineering standards, architectural governance, technical documentation, and development methodologies.
* Build reusable frameworks, accelerators, and solution components to improve delivery efficiency.
* Develop a culture of technical ownership, experimentation, collaboration, and execution excellence.

6. Technology Innovation & Product Evolution

* Define and continuously evolve Anthrobyte's enterprise AI architecture strategy.
* Identify emerging AI technologies, frameworks, research, and industry developments that can create a competitive advantage.
* Translate relevant innovations into practical enterprise solutions and reusable product capabilities.
* Work closely with the leadership team to evolve the company's services-plus-product business model.
* Contribute to the product roadmap, technology vision, and long-term engineering strategy.
* Develop technical case studies, internal playbooks, solution accelerators, and architecture standards.

**Ideal Candidate Profile:-**

We are looking for a technology leader who combines deep AI engineering expertise, enterprise consulting capabilities, commercial awareness, and the entrepreneurial mindset required to build a technology organization from zero to one.

Mandatory Experience & Leadership Requirements

**1. AI/ML Engineering Experience**

* 7+ years of overall professional experience, with substantial hands-on experience delivering production-grade AI/ML solutions.
* Strong expertise in LLMs, NLP, Computer Vision, advanced analytics, or enterprise AI applications.
* Proven experience building and deploying sophisticated AI systems rather than working exclusively on research or theoretical implementations.

**2. Advanced AI Architecture & Engineering**

* Demonstrated expertise in designing and implementing RAG pipelines, SLMs, agentic AI systems, multi-agent workflows, LLM orchestration, and multimodal architectures.
* Ability to make hands-on technical decisions involving model selection, fine-tuning, evaluation, inference optimization, and deployment.
* Strong understanding of AI infrastructure, scalability, performance, cost optimization, and production constraints.

**3. Enterprise Client-Facing & Consulting Experience**

* At least 4 years of experience in client-facing technical consulting, enterprise solution architecture, pre-sales, or AI solution delivery.
* Proven experience engaging with CXOs, VPs, business leaders, and enterprise technology stakeholders.
* Strong track record in technical discovery, solution design, business case development, PoC demonstrations, and enterprise proposals.

**4. AI Solution Delivery & Implementation**

* Experience owning end-to-end enterprise AI implementations, including data ingestion, pipelines, model development, integration, deployment, monitoring, and optimization.
* Strong understanding of production environments, enterprise integrations, deployment challenges, and change management.
* Demonstrated accountability for successful go-live, client acceptance, and post-deployment outcomes.

**5. Team Building & Technology Leadership**

* Proven experience building, managing, and mentoring AI/ML engineering teams.
* Ability to establish project-based engineering pods and manage multiple client delivery engagements.
* Experience defining technical standards, architecture patterns, delivery processes, and engineering practices.
* Capable of balancing strategic leadership with hands-on technical execution.

**6. Technical Skills**

* **Programming:** Python.
* **AI/ML:** LLMs, SLMs, NLP, Computer Vision, Deep Learning.
* **Frameworks:** LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face.
* **AI Architecture:** RAG, Agentic AI, Multi-Agent Systems, Multimodal AI, LLM Orchestration.
* **Cloud Platforms:** AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform.
* **Engineering:** API Integrations, MLOps, Model Deployment, Monitoring, AI Optimization.

**7. Business & Communication Skills**

* Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to explain complex AI architectures and technical concepts to non-technical business stakeholders.
* Strong business acumen with an understanding of enterprise ROI, commercial feasibility, and solution scalability.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and taking ownership in a fast-moving startup environment.

Preferred Industry & Background

* Experience working with AI/ML services companies, enterprise technology firms, data analytics organizations, or AI-focused product companies.
* Exposure to both services-led consulting and product development environments.
* Experience in early-stage startups or high-growth organizations, particularly in building AI solutions from the ground up.
* Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Logistics, B2B SaaS, Enterprise AI, or MLOps domain exposure will be a strong advantage.
* Experience serving international clients, particularly across the US, Europe, Middle East, or Southeast Asia.

**Educational Background:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related technical discipline.
* Graduates from IITs, BITS, NITs, IIITs, or other reputed institutions are preferred.
* Strong technical expertise and demonstrated delivery capabilities will also be considered.

Pay: ₹6,000,000.00 - ₹9,000,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* How many years of overall professional experience do you have, including at least 7 years in AI/ML, software engineering, or related technology domains?
* Do you have a minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in enterprise client-facing roles, AI consulting, solution architecture, or technical pre-sales, including CXO-level stakeholder engagement?
* Have you independently architected and deployed production-grade AI solutions involving LLMs, RAG pipelines, SLMs, Agentic AI, or multi-agent workflows?
* Are you proficient in Python, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP), with practical implementation experience?
* Have you owned end-to-end enterprise AI engagements, including technical discovery, business use-case identification, solution architecture, PoC development, RFP/RFI responses, and production deployment?

* Have you built and led AI/ML engineering teams, established project-based delivery pods, and mentored engineers while remaining technically hands-on?

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Sovereign Cloud Client Manager will lead Lenovo’s growth agenda for sovereign, private, hybrid and disconnected cloud solutions across strategic enterprise and public-sector customers. The role will identify, shape and close complex opportunities where data control, jurisdictional requirements, security, operational authority, resilience and regulatory compliance are critical.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the primary customer-facing sales leader, engaging CXOs, technology leaders, risk and compliance stakeholders, and lines of business. The role will orchestrate Lenovo infrastructure, services, software, security, financing and partner capabilities to deliver end-to-end sovereign cloud outcomes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategic Account Leadership
  
  

* Own the sovereign cloud strategy and sales plan for a defined portfolio of high-potential accounts and sectors.
* Develop account plans, stakeholder maps, opportunity roadmaps and executive engagement strategies.
* Build trusted-advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, CDOs, risk and compliance leaders, and business decision makers.
* Lead long-term transformation conversations rather than transactional infrastructure sales.

Sovereign Cloud Opportunity Creation
  
  

* Identify opportunities across sovereign private cloud, hybrid cloud, disconnected environments, data residency, regulated workloads, secure collaboration, sovereign AI and workload repatriation.
* Qualify customer requirements covering data location, access control, encryption-key custody, operational control, auditability, resilience and legal or regulatory exposure.
* Translate business, security and compliance challenges into measurable customer outcomes and compelling business cases.
* Build and maintain a robust, qualified pipeline with clear next steps, decision criteria and forecast discipline.

Solution Shaping Advisory
  
  

* Work with solution architects and services teams to define the customer’s target sovereignty posture and deployment model.
* Shape solutions spanning Lenovo ThinkAgile, compute, storage, networking, security, management, lifecycle services and as-a-service capabilities.
* Position hybrid and disconnected operating models based on workload criticality, regulatory needs, connectivity and operational requirements.
* Ensure the proposed architecture aligns infrastructure, software, services, governance and customer operating processes.

Pursuit Deal Management
  
  

* Lead pursuit strategy for complex, multi-stakeholder sovereign cloud opportunities.
* Orchestrate resources across ISG, SSG, product, pre-sales, security, finance, legal, delivery and business partners.
* Drive proposal development, bid governance, commercial negotiations, risk management and deal closure.
* Maintain opportunity hygiene, forecasting accuracy, review cadence and executive sponsorship.

Executive Ecosystem Engagement
  
  

* Create and execute CXO engagement plans, executive briefings, workshops and sovereignty discovery sessions.
* Position Lenovo as a strategic partner for secure, compliant and resilient cloud transformation.
* Collaborate with Microsoft and other cloud, software, security, networking and services partners to build differentiated solutions.
* Represent customer requirements internally and influence solution, go-to-market and investment priorities.

Success Measures
  
  

* Qualified sovereign cloud pipeline and progression through agreed sales stages.
* Revenue, margin and signings performance against assigned targets.
* Conversion of strategic opportunities and expansion within priority accounts.
* Quality of account plans, executive relationships, forecast accuracy and cross-functional execution.
* Customer adoption outcomes and creation of repeatable references or use cases.

Education Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required; full-time MBA preferred.
* 12-18 years of overall experience, including at least 10 years in enterprise technology sales.
* Minimum 3 years of consultative or value-based solution selling in cloud, data center, security, infrastructure, managed services or complex transformation programs.
* Demonstrated experience managing large accounts and multi-party pursuits involving customers, OEMs, cloud providers, software partners and system integrators.
* Experience in regulated industries, government, critical infrastructure or customers with stringent sovereignty requirements is strongly preferred.

Skills Competencies

* Working knowledge of hybrid/private cloud architectures, virtualization, containers, compute, storage, networking, security and lifecycle operations.
* Ability to connect technical and regulatory requirements with commercial value and business outcomes.

* Proven influencing, negotiation, stakeholder management and pursuit leadership skills.
* High collaboration across functions, geographies and partner ecosystems.
* Strong account planning, opportunity management, pipeline hygiene and forecasting discipline.
* Comfort operating in an emerging market with evolving offerings, regulations and customer requirements.

The individual will be responsible for end-to-end program governance, delivery management, customer satisfaction, financial performance, resource optimization, risk management, and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Program & Delivery Management**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of multiple QAD ERP implementation, upgrade, enhancement, and support programs.

* Manage large-scale and multi-site QAD ERP transformation programs across global locations.

* Proactively identify customer concerns, manage escalations, and drive resolution.
* Ensure customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term strategic partnerships.

* Lead modernization initiatives involving QAD ERP, integrations, automation, and digital transformation.

### **4. Financial & Commercial Management**

* Drive financial discipline and ensure adherence to contractual obligations.
* Identify risks to project profitability and implement corrective actions.

* Drive resource productivity, utilization, and effective deployment across programs.
* Identify skill gaps and develop capability-building and cross-training initiatives.

* Drive defect management, testing governance, cutover planning, and go-live readiness.

* Partner with Sales, Presales, Competency, HR, and Finance teams.
* Contribute to strategic planning, service line growth, and delivery capability expansion.
* Promote innovation through AI-enabled delivery, automation, and ERP modernization initiatives.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
------------------------------------

* 20+ years of experience in ERP implementation, consulting, and program delivery.

* Proven experience managing large-scale QAD ERP programs, including implementation, upgrade, and support engagements.
