A self-driven, technically strong, execution-focused leader with excellent Program Management skills and a broad understanding of SoC architecture and design, Design Verification (DV), DFx/DFT, Physical Design (PD), packaging, firmware/software, post-silicon bring-up and productization.
  
  
The candidate should be comfortable engaging in technical discussions across engineering disciplines, understanding cross-domain dependencies and risks, challenging assumptions, and working with cross-functional teams, executive management, and customers to drive technically sound decisions and execution closure.
  
  
Must have strong communication, organizational, customer-facing, and influencing skills and be able to operate effectively in a fast-paced, geographically distributed, matrixed engineering organization.
  
  
Preferred experience level: 15+ years of SoC/ASIC engineering, technical program management, or technical leadership experience.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Plan and drive end-to-end cross-functional technical execution of complex SoC/ASIC programs from architecture and requirements definition through design, verification, implementation, tape-out, post-silicon bring-up, qualification, and production.
* Drive AMD product solution deliverables and alignment with customer platforms to ensure the highest level of customer satisfaction throughout the product lifecycle.
* Engage with technical leadership to understand and document program scope, establish integrated schedules, identify critical technical dependencies, assess and manage program progress and risk, and create resource and budget plans.
* Work closely with SoC Architecture, Design, IP, DV, DFx/DFT, PD, Packaging, Firmware/Software, Validation, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to drive technical readiness and closure of cross-functional issues.
* Develop a strong understanding of key program-level technical challenges and drive alignment on architecture, performance, power, area, timing, verification, testability, physical implementation, package, and silicon readiness trade-offs.
* Partner with Chief Engineers, SoC Leads, Product Architects, and technical leads to identify cross-domain dependencies, drive root-cause analysis, assess technical and schedule impact, and facilitate timely engineering trade-off decisions.
* Drive tape-out readiness and post-silicon readiness, ensuring critical Design, DV, DFx, PD, Packaging, Firmware, and Validation dependencies, risks, and closure criteria are understood and managed.
* Drive cross-functional execution during post-silicon bring-up, debug, validation, qualification, and production readiness, ensuring critical silicon issues are appropriately prioritized and driven to closure.
* Establish clear ownership and accountability for technical deliverables, proactively identify execution and technical risks, and drive mitigation/recovery plans to protect program milestones and customer commitments.
* Represent the Semi-Custom Engineering organization in corporate, CEC, customer, and executive planning and execution forums.
* Own clear executive-level program reporting covering technical readiness, schedule, critical-path items, risks, options, recommendations, and decisions required.
* Work with the Finance team and engineering leads to maintain program resource and budget alignment.
* Work with the Core Leadership Team, including Chief Engineer, BU Heads, SoC Leads, Product Architects, and relevant engineering teams, to ensure compliance with customer gate checklists and attainment of contractual milestones in partnership with Business Development.
* Drive structured management of requirements and engineering changes, including assessment of impacts across architecture, design, DV, DFx, PD, package, firmware, silicon, schedule, and customer commitments.
* Drive continuous improvement in engineering execution, program governance, technical readiness metrics, automation, and cross-functional processes.
* Act as the “Voice of the Customer” while working with internal teams, balancing customer requirements with technical feasibility, quality, performance, power, area, cost, schedule, and business objectives.

**Required Skills**

* Strong technical foundation in SoC/ASIC design and development. This is a technical leadership role and requires significantly more than traditional program-management experience.
* Strong understanding of the complete SoC development lifecycle, including architecture, RTL/design and IP integration, DV, DFx/DFT, synthesis, PD, timing and physical sign-off, packaging, tape-out, post-silicon bring-up, validation, qualification, and production.
* Strong technical understanding of SoC architecture and design, including IP/subsystem integration, interfaces/interconnect, clock/reset architecture, power management, and overall SoC integration.
* Good working knowledge of Design Verification, including verification planning, coverage, regression, bug management, and SoC-level verification readiness.
* Good working knowledge of DFx/DFT, including scan, MBIST/BIST, manufacturing test, debug, and testability requirements.
* Good working knowledge of Physical Design, including floorplanning, implementation, timing closure, power integrity, EM/IR, and physical sign-off.
* Understanding of packaging and die/package interactions, including bump/interface planning, power delivery, signal integrity, thermal considerations, and package-level dependencies.
* Understanding of post-silicon bring-up, silicon debug, validation, characterization, and product qualification, including interactions across silicon, firmware, package, platform, and system-level environments.
* Demonstrated ability to understand complex cross-domain engineering issues, ask the right technical questions, challenge assumptions, identify dependencies and facilitate technically sound trade-off decisions.
* Strong understanding of Performance, Power, and Area (PPA) trade-offs and their relationship to architecture, design, verification, physical implementation, packaging, cost, and schedule.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, project planning, risk-management, and execution-management skills.
* Proven ability to deliver large, technically complex, cross-functional silicon programs and strategic initiatives.
* Ability to influence horizontally across multiple internal functional organizations and drive results and accountability without direct reporting authority.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills, with the ability to translate complex engineering issues into clear impact, options, trade-offs, recommendations, and decisions required.
* Strong networking and interpersonal skills with demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior technical leaders, executives, customers, and partners.
* Skilled in interfacing with customers and partners and managing complex joint-development projects.
* Business savvy with the ability to think strategically and make intelligent technical-versus-business trade-off recommendations.
* Ability to adapt to dynamic business, customer, and technical requirements and drive clarity and execution in ambiguous situations.
* Energized by working in a fast-paced, matrixed technical organization and multi-site environment.
* AI awareness and demonstrated use of AI and automation tools to improve engineering productivity, program execution, risk identification, communication, and decision support.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.

ed5702c4.title: Technical Program Manager
ed5702c4.description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Technical Program Manager**
to lead technology initiatives spanning product integration and an AWS-to-GCP cloud migration. This person translates high-level goals into workstreams and dependencies, working directly with engineering teams on architecture, APIs, and technical blockers. Strong cloud knowledge and coordination across distributed teams are essential.

**What you will do**

* Lead the end-to-end technical program across MSCI engineering, First Street engineering, and AgileEngine engineering teams.
* Drive execution of the First Street product integration, including workflows, technical dependencies, testing, milestones, and delivery activities.
* Lead planning and coordination for the AWS-to-GCP cloud migration, including migration planning, dependencies, validation, parallel runs, testing, data reconciliation, and production cutover readiness.
* Translate high-level initiatives and backlog items into detailed workstreams, milestones, dependencies, sub-stories, execution plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Work closely with engineering teams and technical leads to understand architecture, components, APIs/integrations, cloud services, databases, and technical dependencies, and help unblock technical issues.
* Coordinate engineering, testing, data, cloud, and product activities across multiple teams and actively manage dependencies.
* Establish structures and processes for roadmap and backlog tracking, risk management, issue escalation, and follow-up.
* Ensure milestones and delivery commitments are met, while transparently raising risks, blockers, dependencies, and deviations to senior stakeholders.
* Prepare and distribute weekly program/status reports and present progress, risks, decisions, and actions to relevant stakeholders and senior management.
* Work with engineering and business stakeholders to continuously refine the roadmap and detailed backlog as integration and migration work progresses.
* Drive effective collaboration across geographically distributed teams, particularly India and New York.
* Maintain a strong understanding of
  **AWS and GCP**
  and the mapping of AWS services and capabilities to GCP equivalents.
* Use AI-assisted tools and automation where they can improve program execution, engineering efficiency, reporting, and technical problem solving.

**Must haves**

* **10+ years of experience**
  with strong technical program management, technical delivery, engineering leadership, or a comparable technical role.
* Proven experience leading complex technology programs involving multiple engineering teams and significant technical dependencies.
* Strong technical understanding of software systems, architecture, components, APIs/integrations, databases, and engineering delivery processes.
* Practical understanding of cloud platforms, particularly
  **AWS and GCP**
  , including how AWS services map to GCP services.
* Experience participating in or leading cloud migration programs; hands-on AWS-to-GCP migration experience is highly desirable.
* Ability to break down high-level programs into detailed technical workstreams, milestones, dependencies, and execution plans.
* Experience coordinating testing, validation, parallel runs, data reconciliation, release/cutover activities, and production readiness in complex technology programs.
* Strong ownership, follow-through, risk management, issue escalation, stakeholder communication, and executive reporting skills.
* Upper-intermediate English level.

**Nice to haves**

* Experience with
  **GCP**
  services and data platforms such as BigQuery.
* Familiarity with React-based applications and modern web product integration.
* Familiarity with Python and data/modeling workloads.
* Experience in Sustainability & Climate, physical risk, geospatial/data products, or the investment/financial-services domain.
* Experience working with geographically distributed engineering organizations across India and North America.
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools and automation to improve delivery, planning, reporting, or technical problem solving.

  Fair compensation in INR with dedicated budgets for your personal growth, education, and wellness.

  Leverage the latest tech and create cutting-edge solutions for world-recognized clients and the hottest startups.

919fcc48.title: Project Lead/ Project Manager- Manufacturing Solutions
919fcc48.description:
**Experience:** 5-8+ years preferred

  

**Department:** Project Delivery / Manufacturing Solutions

  

**Reports To:** Delivery Manager / Business Head

  

**About the Role:**

  

VLink Technology Solutions is seeking a results-driven Project Lead to manage client engagements in the manufacturing domain, with a focus on MRO optimization, asset management, spare parts master data, inventory optimization, and enterprise systems integration.

The role will serve as the primary coordination point between clients, internal teams, technology providers, and multiple delivery partners. The successful candidate will translate manufacturing business requirements into actionable project plans, manage cross-functional delivery, drive data quality and process improvement initiatives, and ensure measurable business outcomes.

This position requires a combination of project management, manufacturing process knowledge, stakeholder management, and technical coordination. It also offers a potential career path toward a Business Manager role for individuals demonstrating strong leadership, commercial awareness, and customer relationship management capabilities.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**1. Project Planning and Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end project planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery across manufacturing and MRO transformation engagements.
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, resource plans, milestones, budgets, RAID logs, and status reports.
* Manage scope, dependencies, risks, change requests, and escalations to ensure timely delivery.
* Establish project governance, quality standards, acceptance criteria, and stage-gate reviews.
* Track deliverables against agreed timelines, budgets, quality expectations, and customer requirements.

**2. Delivery Partner and Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Act as the central coordination point between clients, internal teams, technology providers, and multiple delivery partners.
* Define roles, responsibilities, dependencies, deliverables, and accountability across workstreams.
* Conduct regular project reviews, governance meetings, action tracking, and issue-resolution sessions.
* Identify delivery bottlenecks, resource constraints, and integration dependencies, and drive timely resolution.
* Ensure consistent communication, documentation, and reporting across geographically distributed teams.

**3. Client Engagement and Plant-Level Requirements**

* Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for customer stakeholders, including plant managers, maintenance, production, engineering, procurement, stores, and IT teams.
* Coordinate and participate in plant visits, discovery workshops, operational assessments, and requirements-gathering sessions.
* Understand current-state manufacturing processes, maintenance workflows, spare parts management, procurement practices, and operational challenges.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, project deliverables, action plans, and measurable acceptance criteria.
* Manage client expectations, resolve concerns, communicate project status, and maintain strong customer relationships.

**4. MRO, Asset and Inventory Optimization**

* Oversee project workstreams involving MRO material master cleansing, parts categorization, standardization, duplicate identification, and data enrichment.
* Coordinate asset hierarchy validation, equipment BOM creation, and preventive maintenance (PM) parts linkage in CMMS/EAM systems.
* Monitor ABC/Pareto analysis, asset and spare-parts criticality assessment, Min/Max optimization, safety stock, and reorder-point recommendations.
* Coordinate supplier master cleansing, vendor performance tracking, supplier segmentation, and Kraljic Matrix assessments.
* Oversee storeroom organization, physical inventory verification, QR/barcode tagging, and inventory location mapping.
* Ensure data quality, engineering validation, business-owner approvals, and traceability of master-data changes.

**5. Systems Integration and Digital Transformation**

* Coordinate implementation activities involving CMMS/EAM, ERP, maintenance systems, and related manufacturing applications.
* Work with technical teams to manage integration requirements, data mapping, system dependencies, testing, and deployment readiness.
* Coordinate system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), defect resolution, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization.
* Ensure technical documentation, integration dependencies, and support procedures are maintained.
* Facilitate collaboration between business stakeholders, IT/OT teams, implementation partners, and technology vendors.

**6. KPI Management and Business Outcomes**

* Define and monitor project KPIs covering schedule, scope, data quality, inventory accuracy, BOM completeness, PM parts linkage, and supplier data quality.
* Establish baselines, targets, reporting frequency, ownership, and evidence requirements for each KPI.
* Prepare project dashboards, management reports, and steering committee presentations.
* Track customer benefits such as improved spare-parts availability, reduced inventory exposure, faster parts retrieval, improved maintenance readiness, and reduced emergency purchasing.
* Coordinate with client Finance and operational owners to validate claimed savings and ensure benefits are evidence-based.
* Drive corrective actions where delivery performance or agreed KPIs fall below target.

**7. Risk, Quality and Governance Management**

* Maintain project risk, assumption, issue, dependency, decision, and change-control registers.
* Ensure master-data changes, duplicate merges, obsolete-part dispositions, and engineering decisions follow approved governance procedures.
* Monitor project quality through deliverable reviews, data-validation checks, testing evidence, and customer acceptance.
* Escalate operational, technical, commercial, and schedule risks through the appropriate governance channels.
* Ensure project documentation, audit trails, handover records, and acceptance evidence are complete.

**8. Commercial and Business Support**

* Support project estimation, resource planning, effort assessment, proposals, statements of work, and delivery planning.
* Monitor scope changes, resource utilization, delivery costs, and project-level commercial commitments.
* Identify opportunities for additional services, follow-on projects, and expansion across customer sites.
* Contribute to account planning, customer presentations, solution demonstrations, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Help develop reusable delivery methodologies, templates, reporting standards, and project management best practices.

**9. Team Leadership and Knowledge Transfer**

* Coordinate project managers, MRO engineers, data analysts, technical specialists, and delivery partner teams.
* Allocate work, monitor productivity, resolve blockers, and ensure accountability for assigned deliverables.
* Mentor junior coordinators and engineers in project governance, customer communication, and delivery discipline.
* Promote documentation, cross-training, and shared ownership to reduce dependency on individual resources.
* Ensure smooth transition to customer operations and support teams at project closure.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelors degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Approximately 5–8+ years of experience in project delivery, manufacturing consulting, industrial engineering, MRO optimization, or enterprise systems implementation.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating multiple stakeholders, delivery teams, vendors, or implementation partners.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, production, maintenance, procurement, inventory, and storeroom processes.
* Practical knowledge of MRO master data, asset BOMs, preventive maintenance, inventory optimization, and supplier management.
* Experience with project planning, risk management, KPI reporting, documentation, and customer acceptance.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, project tracking tools, and data analysis.
* Willingness to travel to customer manufacturing plants when required.

**Preferred Qualifications — Not Mandatory**

* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or equivalent project management certification.
* Experience with CMMS/EAM platforms such as Fiix, SAP PM, IBM Maximo, or Infor EAM.
* Exposure to SAP ERP/S/4HANA, enterprise data migration, or digital transformation programs.
* Experience with MRO data cleansing, UNSPSC classification, equipment BOM development, ABC analysis, Min/Max planning, or Kraljic Matrix assessments.
* Familiarity with API integrations, manufacturing systems, and IT/OT coordination.
* Experience in food and beverage manufacturing or other asset-intensive industries.

**Key Performance Indicators**

The Project Lead will be evaluated against approved project baselines and agreed customer acceptance criteria, including:

* On-time delivery of project milestones and deliverables.
* Scope, budget, resource, and change-control performance.
* Customer satisfaction and stakeholder engagement.
* Data quality and validation performance across MRO, asset, BOM, and supplier workstreams.
* Progress against inventory optimization and maintenance-readiness objectives.
* Timely resolution of risks, issues, dependencies, and escalations.
* Completion of testing, documentation, knowledge transfer, and customer handover.
* Finance-validated business benefits and opportunities for account growth.

**Expected Outcomes**

The successful candidate will establish predictable project governance, maintain strong client relationships, coordinate effective delivery across partners, and ensure that manufacturing transformation initiatives deliver validated operational improvements.

The individual will be expected to manage projects with increasing independence, strengthen delivery processes, reduce key-person dependency, and contribute to VLink’s growth in manufacturing solutions.

d3a47441.description:
* We deliver the world’s most complex projects.
* Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team .
* Enjoy a varied & challenging role.

**Building on our past. Ready for the future**
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.
  
  
Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.
  
  
We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.
  
  
**The Role**
***As a Senior Principal Digital Solutions Consultant with Worley,***
you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
  
  
**Purpose**
As part of Worley’s Digital Transformation group, the Principal AI Solutions Lead will design and shape AI products and solutions that enable Worley’s most critical and high-priority projects. Working at the intersection of business, delivery and technology, the role will engage project and functional leaders to understand their challenges, identify where AI can create measurable value, and translate those opportunities into secure, scalable and responsible solutions across Generative AI, Agentic AI, machine learning and intelligent automation. The role will operate within Worley’s overarching enterprise architecture framework, working closely with Enterprise Architecture, the AI Centre of Excellence (AI CoE), cybersecurity, data governance and delivery teams to ensure every solution aligns with agreed architecture principles, standards, guardrails and governance, and can be reused and scaled across the enterprise.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Working within Digital Transformation group, partnering with project, business and functional leaders to shape AI products that support Worley’s critical and priority projects.
* Lead discovery and solution-shaping workshops to understand business challenges and assess AI opportunities.
* Design end-to-end AI products and solutions, including Generative AI, Agentic AI, machine learning, intelligent automation and knowledge-enabled applications, from concept and proof of value.
* Work closely with the Digital Factory to translate solution designs and proofs of value into production-ready AI products.
* Work within Worley’s overarching enterprise architecture framework, applying its principles, standards, reference architectures, guardrails and decision-making processes consistently to every solution design.
* Produce solution artefacts, including solution designs, target-state and transition views, architecture decision records and roadmaps, in line with enterprise architecture templates and governance requirements.
* Shape Agentic AI solutions covering orchestration, specialist agents, tool use, memory, human-in-the-loop approvals, least-privilege access, traceability and auditability.
* Guide model selection and routing, prompt and context engineering, retrieval, grounding and evaluation approaches, ensuring solutions meet agreed production-readiness thresholds for quality, safety, reliability and cost.
* Provide solution guidance across Amazon Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI, UAIP and other approved platforms, making technology-agnostic decisions within enterprise standards.
* Align AI solutions with enterprise data platform, Lakehouse, integration, metadata, lineage, data-quality and knowledge-management strategies, minimizing unnecessary data movement across clouds.
* Partner with the AI CoE to contribute reusable assets, approved model catalogues, evaluation standards, delivery playbooks and communities of practice, feeding lessons from priority projects back into enterprise patterns.

**About You**
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  
**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* A master’s degree in a relevant discipline is desirable.

**Required Experience And Capabilities.**

* 12–15+ years of experience delivering enterprise technology, data, analytics, cloud or AI solutions, including significant time in solution consulting, solution architecture or technical advisory roles.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise Generative AI, Agentic AI, machine learning or intelligent-automation products from concept through production, ideally on business-critical or high-priority initiatives.
* Strong consulting capability, including leading discoveries, shaping use cases and business cases, and turning business problems into clear solution options and measurable outcomes
* Demonstrated experience working within an enterprise architecture framework such as TOGAF or equivalent, including architecture principles, standards, reference architecture, design authorities and architecture review processes.
* Strong knowledge of AWS, Microsoft Azure and Databricks AI and data services, with the ability to make technology-agnostic design decisions.
* Hands-on knowledge of RAG, enterprise search, knowledge assistants, AI copilots, vector retrieval, reranking, model serving, prompt engineering and Agentic AI.
* Solid understanding of LLM and model evaluation, including golden datasets, automated and human evaluation, LLM-as-a-judge approaches, regression testing and production monitoring.
* Strong understanding of foundation models, Responsible AI, model risk, AI assurance, security and production AI engineering.
* Knowledge of data platforms, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, APIs, events, metadata, lineage, data quality, knowledge graphs and enterprise knowledge architecture.
* Working knowledge of Python, SQL, APIs, CI/CD, MLOps and LLMOps, sufficient to guide engineering teams and validate solution designs.
* Excellent stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, communicate trade-offs and guide multiple product and delivery teams in an agile, federated environment.

**Desirable Experience And Qualifications**

* Experience with Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI or equivalent agent and orchestration frameworks.
* Experience with LLM evaluation and observability frameworks such as MLflow, Azure AI evaluation, Amazon Bedrock evaluation, LangSmith or equivalent capabilities.
* Experience in a digital transformation function or consulting practice, contributing to architecture review boards, AI governance forums, technology standards and enterprise reference architectures.
* Experience in engineering, energy, chemicals, resources, capital projects or another asset-intensive industry.
* AWS, Microsoft Azure, Databricks, TOGAF, machine learning, Generative AI or equivalent architecture certifications.

**Moving forward together**
We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
  
  
We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
  
  
And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
  
  
Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.
  
  
Worley takes personal data protection seriously and respects EU and local data protection laws. You can read our full Recruitment Privacy Notice Here.
  
  
Please note: If you are being represented by a recruitment agency you will not be considered, to be considered you will need to apply directly to Worley.

c9accefc.title: Technical Program Manager (Silicon Engineering)
c9accefc.description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

THE ROLE:

In this leadership role within the Engineering Core Team, the candidate will leverage their strong technical understanding of the end-to-end silicon engineering process, from SoC architecture and design through tape-out, post-silicon bring-up and production, to manage and drive the execution activities of cross-disciplinary engineering functions developing semi-custom ASIC solutions in collaboration with one of AMD’s largest customers.

The candidate will be part of the leadership team running the Chief Engineering Council (CEC) Forum, driving technical alignment, cross-functional execution, risk management, and timely decision-making across the program.

THE PERSON:

A self-driven, technically strong, execution-focused leader with excellent Program Management skills and a broad understanding of SoC architecture and design, Design Verification (DV), DFx/DFT, Physical Design (PD), packaging, firmware/software, post-silicon bring-up and productization.

The candidate should be comfortable engaging in technical discussions across engineering disciplines, understanding cross-domain dependencies and risks, challenging assumptions, and working with cross-functional teams, executive management, and customers to drive technically sound decisions and execution closure.

Must have strong communication, organizational, customer-facing, and influencing skills and be able to operate effectively in a fast-paced, geographically distributed, matrixed engineering organization.

Preferred experience level: 15+ years of SoC/ASIC engineering, technical program management, or technical leadership experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  

* Plan and drive end-to-end cross-functional technical execution of complex SoC/ASIC programs from architecture and requirements definition through design, verification, implementation, tape-out, post-silicon bring-up, qualification, and production.
* Drive AMD product solution deliverables and alignment with customer platforms to ensure the highest level of customer satisfaction throughout the product lifecycle.
* Engage with technical leadership to understand and document program scope, establish integrated schedules, identify critical technical dependencies, assess and manage program progress and risk, and create resource and budget plans.
* Work closely with SoC Architecture, Design, IP, DV, DFx/DFT, PD, Packaging, Firmware/Software, Validation, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to drive technical readiness and closure of cross-functional issues.
* Develop a strong understanding of key program-level technical challenges and drive alignment on architecture, performance, power, area, timing, verification, testability, physical implementation, package, and silicon readiness trade-offs.

d8e3de51.title: Senior Program Manager, RBS : Cost to Serve
d8e3de51.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Retail Business Services (RBS) accelerates Amazon's growth by improving customer and Selling Partner (SP) experiences, while optimizing costs across Stores WW. RBS operates at the intersection of retail, operations, technology, and finance, ensuring Amazon's systems and processes scale reliably while maintaining a high-quality customer and selling-partner experience.  
  
Cost to Serve (CtS) is a specialized organization within RBS focused on improving Amazon's per-unit economics across the global supply chain. CtS operates on two pillars: defect identification and defect elimination. The UDE Governance team builds mechanisms that enable standardized tracking and reporting of upstream defect elimination (UDE) outcomes — improving cost visibility, strengthening operational metric visibility, and enabling consistent governance across high-impact cost categories.
  
  
Amazon's RBS CtS organization is seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager to lead the charter for establishing governance mechanisms and automating them through AI-powered solutions. This role serves as the primary business point of contact, engaging with RBS and Retail/FBA/Ops Finance teams to: (i) Identify improvement opportunities in UDE reporting for cost-out delivery (ii) Define the right input metrics to track operational benefits delivered by cost-out projects and (iii) standardize reporting methodologies, terminologies, and formats across teams. Once these standards are established, this leader will drive automation of the end-to-end reporting journey by coordinating with RBS Tech and Analytics teams. These automations are aimed at improving productivity of PMs across RBS by 30%. Final delivery is a world-class UDE MBR P0 reporting that is traceable to P&L — presenting a holistic view of output and input metrics for each individual cost out project.  
  
This leader will define the project roadmap, engage with business and Finance leaders to align on reporting requirements, own the working-backward plan, and architect the automation framework. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable managing technical product delivery and presenting program health to Director-level leadership, with the judgment to navigate ambiguity in a fast-moving, high-visibility space.  
  
Why You’ll Love This Role  
  

* High Impact at Scale: You'll lead accurate reporting of cost out projects for the entire RBS Org.
* Build with Tech: Serve as the key business voice shaping an AI-powered automation solution that has the potential to be replicated across several Amazon orgs.
* Leadership Visibility: Own updates to senior leaders across business and Finance teams with direct influence on how the organization invests in automation long-term.

  
Key job responsibilities  

* Business/Tech Partnership & Requirements Definition: Serve as the primary business counterpart to the analytics and tech teams.
* Working Backward Planning: Own the milestone delivery plan for above two projects. Identify risks early, adjust plans proactively, and maintain credible path-to-green narratives for leadership.
* BA Team Oversight: Manage the Business Analysts who develop MLP of the products. Iteratively capture feedbacks from Stores leaders and ensure the feedback mechanism runs smoothly, quality standards are maintained, and BAs are effectively translating domain expertise into product development.
* Quality & Trade-off Decisions: Hold a high bar on output quality. When design or quality blockers arise, make trade-off decisions that balance speed, accuracy, and adoption — escalating to senior leaders for significant calls.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* 5+ years of managing stakeholders in cross-functional project experience
* Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2+ years of leading large complex programs experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

ad616df6.title: Operations Manager / Associate Delivery Manager – F&A Services
ad616df6.description:
### **REMOTE**

**Operations Manager / Associate Delivery Manager – F&A Services**
==================================================================

**ARDEM Data Services Private Limited**  
UNIT No B-1/ 5th Floor 504 & 505 DLF MY PAD, Vibhuti Khand Gomti Nagar, Lucknow – 226010, India

**Telephone:** 915.130.3150
  
**Email:** Recruitment\_ARDEMDataServices@ardem.com

**Position:** Operations Manager / Associate Delivery Manager – F&A Services (R2R / P2P / O2C)

**Location:** India – Work From Home (Remote)

**Shift:** US Business Hours (Night Shift, IST)

**Experience level:** 8–12 years

**Reports to:** Senior Delivery Manager / Portfolio Director

**Span of control:** 4–5 Team Leads across 15–25 client assignments

**Position Overview**
---------------------

We are seeking a highly operational, metric-focused, and data-driven Operations Manager / Associate Delivery Manager to lead a critical segment of our Finance & Accounting (F&A) d Services portfolio. You will take complete operational ownership of 4 to 5 Team Leads managing approximately 15 to 25 distinct client assignments. These assignments cover end-to-end transactional and general accounting functions: Record-to-Report (R2R), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), and Order-to-Cash (O2C).

This position requires a hands-on financial operations leader who excels at driving process stability, ensuring rigorous internal governance, and maintaining strong day-to-day operational relationships with US-based stakeholders during their business hours. The role focuses entirely on operational delivery, resource utilization, and SLA compliance. There is no direct P&L ownership.

This is a full-time work-from-home role. The detailed home-office requirements are listed below and are a condition of selection.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Operational Governance & F&A Excellence**

* **Metric ownership:** Drive 100% compliance across all service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs). This includes monthly closing timelines, invoice processing turnaround times, ledger accuracy thresholds (>98.5%), and collection metrics.
* **Daily micro-governance:** Monitor financial operations dashboards daily to identify, track, and mitigate processing bottlenecks, reconciliation discrepancies, or SLA risks before they impact the client.
* **Process standardization:** Continuously optimize accounting workflows across client assignments, identifying opportunities to deploy macros, robotic process automation (RPA), or standardized internal controls.

### **Client & Stakeholder Management**

* **Relationship stabilization:** Act as the primary operational point of contact for US-based corporate finance teams and controllers during their business hours, leading weekly operational syncs and monthly performance reviews.
* **Escalation resolution:** Resolve accounting process friction, transactional deviations, or client concerns using structured root-cause analysis (RCA) and permanent corrective action frameworks.

### **People Leadership & Resource Management**

* **Team development:** Provide direct leadership, coaching, and performance management to 4–5 Team Leads, mentoring them and building a robust secondary leadership pipeline.
* **Attrition mitigation:** Design and execute engagement, shift rotation, and wellness strategies tailored for F&A teams to manage burnout and keep night-shift attrition below the targeted corporate threshold.
* **Business continuity:** Manage capacity planning, resource utilization, and cross-training matrices to ensure seamless service delivery during month-end closing peaks and holiday cycles.

**Required Qualifications & Educational Background**
----------------------------------------------------

* **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s Degree in Commerce (B.Com), Accounting, or Finance.
* **Preferred higher education:** Master’s Degree in Commerce (M.Com), MBA in Finance, or a post-graduate diploma in financial management from a recognized institution.
* **Professional certifications (added advantage):** Semi-qualified or qualified professional tracks (e.g., CA-Inter, ICWA/CMA, or foundational clearings in ACCA/CPA) are highly preferred and will be given weight during selection.
* **Experience:** 8 to 12 years of core corporate F&A experience within a Tier-1 or Tier-2 BPO/KPO or d Services environment, with at least 3 years in a dedicated people-manager role managing Team Leads.
* **Domain expertise:** Deep hands-on knowledge of end-to-end Finance & Accounting delivery (R2R, P2P, and O2C workflows).
* **System knowledge:** Proven experience navigating enterprise ERP systems (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics) and BlackLine or similar reconciliation and workflow automation tools.
* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills, with documented experience presenting financial operational data to North American corporate stakeholders.
* **Flexibility:** Absolute willingness to work consistent US business hours (Night Shift) from home.
* **Remote leadership:** Prior experience managing distributed or remote teams is preferred.

**Work From Home Requirements**
-------------------------------

This role is delivered entirely from the candidate’s home during US business hours. Candidates must confirm they meet every requirement below before the offer stage; the setup may be verified through a system and connectivity check.

### **Workspace**

* A dedicated, quiet, and private room or enclosed work area, free from household interruptions and background noise throughout the night shift.
* A proper desk and ergonomic chair suitable for a full shift of screen-based work.
* A neutral, professional background and adequate lighting for video calls with US clients.
* A workspace where client data on screen cannot be seen or overheard by others.

### **Internet connectivity**

* A stable wired broadband or fibre connection with a minimum speed of 100 Mbps.
* A secondary backup connection (a second broadband line or a 4G/5G hotspot) ready for immediate switchover.
* A router placed close to the workstation, with a LAN cable connection preferred over Wi-Fi.

### **Power backup**

* An uninterrupted power supply (UPS or inverter) that supports the computer, monitor, and router for at least 4 hours.
* A workable contingency plan for extended outages, so that client calls and month-end deliverables are not missed.

### **System and equipment**

* A personal laptop or desktop with at least an Intel i5 (or equivalent) processor, 8 GB RAM (16 GB preferred), SSD storage, and a licensed, updated version of Windows 10 or 11.
* A working HD webcam and a noise-cancelling headset with microphone.
* A second monitor is strongly recommended for dashboard monitoring and reconciliation work.
* Licensed, up-to-date antivirus software and no unauthorized or pirated applications on the work system.

### **Data security and confidentiality**

* Client financial data must be accessed only through company-approved systems, VPN, and credentials.
* No downloading, printing, photographing, or storing of client data on personal devices, personal email, or personal cloud storage.
No use of public or d Wi-Fi networks, cyber cafes, or* d computers for work.
* The screen must be locked whenever the workstation is left unattended.
* Signing and adhering to the company’s non-disclosure, information security, and acceptable-use policies is mandatory.

### **Availability and conduct**

* Logged in and reachable for the full shift on company communication tools, with prompt responses to calls, chats, and emails.
* Camera on for client meetings, team huddles, reviews, and training sessions.
* Use of the company’s attendance, time-tracking, and productivity-monitoring tools as required.
* Immediate reporting of any internet, power, or system downtime to the reporting manager, with lost time made up as agreed.
* No parallel employment, freelancing, or other engagements during the tenure.
* Availability to work from a fixed home location in India; any change of work location must be approved in advance.
* Willingness to travel occasionally for team meetings, training, or client visits if required.

**30-60-90 Day Performance Expectations**
-----------------------------------------

The successful candidate is expected to reach the following milestones during the probation period.

### **By Day 30: Process absorption**

* Complete deep-dive process walkthroughs for all 15–25 client assignments in the sub-portfolio.
* Establish working rapport with the 4–5 reporting Team Leads and map their individual performance baselines.
* Shadow the current delivery lead on all US client weekly operational syncs.

### **By Day 60: Independent governance**

* Take 100% independent ownership of daily operational dashboards and US client communication loops.
* Achieve an error-free closure cycle for the first full US month-end closing peak.
* Identify the 3 highest-risk assignments in the portfolio and deliver structured risk mitigation plans for them.

### **By Day 90: Stabilization and optimization**

* Maintain a baseline of zero critical SLA defaults across the assigned portfolio.
* Demonstrate a clear, actionable cross-training matrix that ensures 100% coverage despite planned or unplanned team leaves.
* Propose at least one workflow optimization or automation initiative (e.g., standardizing macro steps or fixing systemic ERP matching exceptions) to improve process speed.

d7f22a4c.title: Specialist System Engineering (Cloud Migration Lead)
d7f22a4c.description:
The Cloud Migration Readiness Lead supports large-scale AWS Outposts, IT Private Cloud, cloud, infrastructure, and data center migration initiatives. The role provides end-to-end coordination from application and interface readiness through MAT execution, Go/No-Go preparation, cutover, and operational handoff.
  
  
The position serves as a primary liaison among application teams, migration engineering, cloud and solution architects, network and infrastructure teams, security organizations, operations teams, vendors, testing teams, and program leadership. Success requires a balanced combination of technical understanding, structured delivery management, governance discipline, and the ability to influence teams without direct authority.
  
  
Based on program need and individual capability, the selected candidate may lead a blended portfolio or be aligned more heavily to MAT/Cutover or Interface Management while operating under the same common readiness framework.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Assigned applications meet defined MAT entry, execution, and exit requirements.
* Application interfaces, connectivity requirements, and technical dependencies are accurately documented and migration ready.
* Cutover plans, approvals, evidence, operational checkpoints, and Go/No-Go inputs are complete and decision ready.
* Risks, defects, blockers, actions, and schedule concerns are visible, owned, escalated, and driven to closure.
* Jira and supporting program artifacts provide an accurate and auditable view of migration readiness.
* Own and coordinate readiness activities for assigned applications across assessment, design, testing, migration, cutover, and operational transition.
* Facilitate readiness reviews, working sessions, status meetings, technical discussions, and stakeholder communications.
* Maintain clear entry/exit criteria, evidence requirements, approval checkpoints, dependencies, due dates, and accountable owners.
* Track and report readiness status, risks, issues, actions, decisions, defects, dependencies, and milestones in Jira and other approved program tools.
* Proactively identify gaps or schedule concerns and escalate material blockers with clear impact, ownership, and recovery actions.
* Coordinate MAT planning, entry, execution, defect management, retesting, and exit for assigned applications.
* Confirm test scope, environments, test data, resources, access, dependencies, expected evidence, and acceptance criteria are defined before MAT begins.
* Monitor test progress and ensure defects, constraints, and unresolved risks are assigned, prioritized, and tracked to disposition.
* Coordinate with application, testing, infrastructure, security, operations, and migration teams to resolve MAT blockers.
* Prepare concise readiness reporting and support formal MAT exit recommendations based on completed evidence and approved criteria.
* Review, validate, and maintain application interface inventories, dependency records, data flows, and supporting documentation.
* Analyze connectivity requirements including protocols, ports, endpoints, certificates, encryption, secure transport, authentication, routing, firewall, DNS, and network dependencies.
* Assess integration patterns and interface impacts resulting from cloud, infrastructure, network, platform, or hosting changes.
* Validate interface data quality, identify documentation gaps and technical risks, and coordinate corrective actions with accountable teams.
* Ensure interface tracking artifacts remain accurate throughout the migration lifecycle, including source/target changes and cutover sequencing.
* Coordinate resolution of interface-related issues and migration blockers across application owners, vendors, architects, network, security, infrastructure, and engineering teams.
* Support development and validation of cutover plans, runbooks, activity sequencing, resource coverage, communication plans, checkpoints, fallback considerations, and recovery actions.
* Confirm prerequisite approvals, change records, access, implementation tasks, interface activities, validation steps, monitoring, support coverage, and operational documentation are complete.
* Coordinate Go/No-Go preparation and provide an evidence-based view of readiness, open risks, exceptions, dependencies, and required decisions.
* Partner with operations and support teams to validate monitoring, incident routing, ownership, handoff, and early-life support arrangements.
* Support migration execution and post-cutover validation, ensuring issues are triaged, assigned, communicated, and tracked through stabilization.
* Review application architectures, integration patterns, interface designs, and migration solution assumptions with the appropriate technical teams.
* Coordinate with cloud engineering, solution architecture, infrastructure, network, security, and operations teams to resolve technical challenges and dependencies.
* Review encryption and secure transport requirements and identify security risks associated with integrations and connectivity patterns.
* Ensure migration solutions, interfaces, evidence, and execution activities align with applicable enterprise architecture, security, change, and governance standards.
* Route decisions and exceptions to the appropriate approving authority; maintain traceability of outcomes without substituting for formal approval functions.

**Required Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in project/program management, release management, technical delivery, application migration, infrastructure delivery, integration coordination, or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting application, cloud, infrastructure, platform, or data center migration programs.
* Demonstrated ability to manage risks, issues, actions, defects, dependencies, schedules, evidence, and cross-team commitments.
* Working knowledge of testing lifecycles, deployment, change management, cutover planning, operational readiness, and production support transition.
* Working knowledge of application integrations, interface inventories, connectivity concepts, protocols, ports, endpoints, encryption, certificates, and technical dependencies.
* Strong written and verbal communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, organization, and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple applications and priorities in a complex, matrixed enterprise environment.
* Proficiency with Jira or a comparable work management platform, Microsoft Excel, SharePoint Online, PowerPoint, Teams, and Microsoft Office.
* Hands-on experience supporting AWS, AWS Outposts, private cloud, hybrid cloud, infrastructure modernization, or large-scale migration programs.
* Experience coordinating MAT, user acceptance testing, cutover, release, deployment, hypercare, or operational transition activities.
* Experience analyzing interfaces, integration patterns, network connectivity, security controls, or application dependency maps.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience with Power BI and Power Automate for portfolio reporting, workflow, or readiness automation.
* PMP, PMI-ACP, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, ITIL, AWS Cloud Practitioner, or comparable certification.

**Weekly Hours**
40

Regular

Join us to transform the way the world works.

**Job Description**

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

LinkedIn’s vision is to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. LinkedIn Talent Solutions plays a critical role in advancing this mission by helping organizations attract, hire, develop, and retain talent through a connected portfolio of recruiting, learning, insights, and skills-based solutions powered by LinkedIn’s Economic Graph.

The Senior Solution Engineer (SE) is a senior individual contributor within LinkedIn’s Go-to-Market organization and a strategic technical partner to Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams. This role owns the technical and solution strategy for complex, high-impact customer engagements, serving as a trusted technical advisor to customers and internal stakeholders.

Senior Solution Engineers combine deep technical expertise, strong business acumen, and executive presence to influence deal outcomes, shape best practices, and drive impact across the Talent Solutions organization. Their expertise spans customer lifecycle, from technical discovery, solution design, and architecture to integration consulting and implementation. They translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions and help customers realize sustained value from LinkedIn's solutions.

Responsibilities

Pre-Sales Strategy & Execution

* Own and lead pre-sales solution strategy for complex and strategic opportunities across LinkedIn Talent Solutions.
* Lead advanced discovery to understand business objectives, current technology landscape, risks, dependencies, and success measures.
* Partner with Account Directors, Account Executives, and Sales Leadership to influence deal approach, solution mapping, and long-term platform positioning.
* Serve as the specialist to assess technical fit, security considerations and value realization

Solution Design & Demonstration

* Design and deliver tailored, multi-product solution demonstrations that address customer-specific use cases and operating models.
* Articulate how LinkedIn Talent products work together as an integrated platform, including architectural considerations and dependencies.
* Lead technically oriented customer conversations, including integrations, data flows, identity/authentication, security, and compliance with credibility and clarity
* Develop solution recommendations that balance customer outcomes, product capabilities, implementation effort, and long-term scalability.
* Identify technical opportunities that contribute to customer growth and value realization.

Partnership & Delivery Readiness

* Partner with post sales and drive customer’s technical implementation activities, provide prescriptive technical consulting, including integrations, transformation, authentication, data mapping, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Manage complex technical engagements across multiple customers, ensuring clear ownership, milestones, stakeholder alignment, and timely resolution of technical challenges.

Strategic Impact & Innovation

* Develop scalable technical frameworks, reusable assets, and best practices that improve solution quality, delivery efficiency, and customer outcomes.
* Champion the adoption of AI and automation to improve technical workflows, customer engagement, and operational productivity.
* Influence technical standards, contribute to strategic initiatives, and enable cross-functional teams through knowledge sharing and technical thought leadership.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience in solution engineering, pre-sales, or technical consulting, supporting enterprise SaaS solutions.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
* Experience with proven ability to lead both consultative solution design and technical delivery across complex customer environments.
* Background in stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align different perspectives toward a shared outcome.
* Background in commercial acumen, with the ability to connect technical solutions to customer business objectives, adoption opportunities, and measurable business outcomes.
* Experience with enterprise integrations, APIs, identity and authentication, data flows, security protocols, and implementation lifecycle management.
* Experience in executive communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value.
* Experience in demonstrated initiative, judgment, self-motivation, and consistent delivery of high-quality outcomes for internal and external stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical engagements, influence senior stakeholders, navigate ambiguity, and drive cross-functional outcomes without direct authority.
* Strong curiosity about technology, data, AI, talent, and productivity, with a practical orientation toward experimentation and problem solving.

Title

Job ID
  
#JOL-SLE-IN-111126

Location
  
Bangalore, Karnataka, IN

**Summary**
  
Jolly Technologies is a Silicon Valley-based software company with more than 40,000 customers and millions of users, including many Fortune 500 companies and other world-renowned organizations.

Our products are B2B enterprise, multi-tenant, cloud-hosted SaaS platforms used by organizations with demanding business, security, and IT requirements across North America, Europe, Australia, and worldwide. Depending on business needs, you may work on one or more of our products.

We are looking for a technically fluent **Solutions Consultant** to conduct live product demonstrations for prospective customers in North America, Europe, Australia, and worldwide. You will run discovery with business stakeholders, tailor demos to their requirements, and confidently handle in-depth technical questions from their IT, security, and compliance teams across a wide range of enterprise topics.

**Working Hours (US Shift)**
  
Fully remote, work-from-home contract position. Our customer demos take place between 6:00 AM and 2:00 PM US Pacific Time. **You must be available approximately 7:30 PM - 3:30 AM IST on weekdays** (one hour earlier, 6:30 PM - 2:30 AM IST, during US daylight saving time).

**Responsibilities**
  

* Conduct live online demonstrations of our SaaS platforms for prospective enterprise customers
* Run discovery calls to understand business workflows, IT requirements, and decision criteria, and tailor each demo accordingly
* Answer in-depth technical questions from customer IT, security, and compliance teams on topics such as identity and access management (SSO, user provisioning, role-based access), APIs and webhooks, third-party integrations, data security and encryption, privacy and compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR), data residency and retention, hosting, availability, and disaster recovery, network and firewall requirements, mobile apps and device management, data import and export, audit logging, and multi-tenant architecture
* Assist with security questionnaires, RFPs, and technical requirement checklists
* Set up and configure trial accounts and proofs of concept to match customer scenarios
* Work with the sales team on deal strategy and next steps
* Share customer feedback, feature requests, and product gaps with the product and engineering teams
* Answer product questions from prospective and existing customers by email

**Requirements**
  

* Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
* 3+ years in pre-sales, solutions consulting, sales engineering, implementation, or technical account management for B2B SaaS or enterprise software
* Proven experience giving live software demonstrations to both business and IT audiences, ideally to international customers
* Strong working knowledge of enterprise IT and cloud SaaS architecture, including identity and access management (e.g., SAML/OIDC, SCIM, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta), REST APIs and webhooks, integration patterns, data security and encryption, compliance frameworks, and cloud hosting concepts
* Able to quickly learn new technical areas and research accurate answers to questions you have not seen before
* Comfortable reading API documentation and working with tools such as Postman and JSON (writing production code is not required)
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Professional, organized, self-motivated, and customer-focused
* Strong references from previous managers

**Important**
  
This is a technical, customer-facing pre-sales role. You will not write code, but you must be comfortable leading technical conversations with enterprise IT teams. If your demo experience is mainly with consumer products or services, or your background is primarily in call-center or BPO work, this role is not a fit.

**Compensation**
  
₹22,00,000 - ₹32,00,000 per year (commensurate with experience)

**Application Process**
  

* Reply with your resume (PDF or Word) to **jobs.2026 @ jollytech.com** with subject “JOL-SLE-IN-111126”
* Include your desired salary
* Include 3-5 concise bullet points describing the software products you have demonstrated and to whom
* **Include a link to a 2-3 minute video** (Loom, unlisted YouTube, Google Drive, etc.) in which you explain an enterprise technical concept of your choice to a customer's IT manager (for example, how single sign-on works, how a REST API integration works, or how customer data is kept separate in a multi-tenant SaaS platform). Applications without a video will not be considered.

43595e0b.title: Presales Engineer
43595e0b.description:
**About us**

Allmark started in Chennai in 2014, supplying barcode printers and scanners to factories around Sriperumbudur and Oragadam. Our customers kept coming back with bigger problems: labels that had to survive their process, mobile computers for their stores, scans that had to land correctly in SAP, and software to tie it all together. One example is the mobile inventory-tracking app we built for L&T Valves in Kanchipuram. The work kept growing with our customers, and that is what led us to build our own warehouse system, AllCommerce ACE-WMS.

Today our team looks after more than 75,000 devices at over 2,000 customers, including Larsen & Toubro, Nexteer Automotive and Seoyon E-Hwa Summit Automotive. We work closely with Zebra, Honeywell (now part of Brady), TSC, Godex, Newland and TVS Enterprise – AIDC.

**The job**

Before a customer signs a purchase order, someone has to stand on their floor and work out what will actually work: which label will survive the paint shop, where a fixed scanner should sit on the line, whether the stores team needs a handheld or a tablet, and how the data should reach SAP. At Allmark, that is the Presales Engineer.

You will work with our sales engineers from the first site visit to the final proposal, and stay close to our service team so that what we promise is what gets installed.

**Day to day**

* Visiting sites to study receiving, production, stores and dispatch, and writing down how things really run
* Recommending printers, label and ribbon combinations, scanners, mobile computers, and RFID where it genuinely fits
* Running demos and small proofs of concept, including AllCommerce ACE-WMS
* Working out integration with SAP, other ERPs or the customer’s warehouse system, together with our software team
* Preparing solution documents, bills of material and RFP responses with the sales team

**You will fit well if you**

* Have 2 to 5 years in presales, solution engineering or technical support in barcode or RFID, mobility or enterprise IT
* Have hands-on experience with barcode printers, scanners or mobile computers (RFID exposure is a plus)
* Understand networking basics, Android devices, and how data moves between a device, a WMS and an ERP
* Hold a BE, B.Tech or MCA, or have equivalent experience
* Can explain a technical choice simply to a stores supervisor, and in depth to an IT manager

**Where this can lead**

Presales sits between sales, software and service, so you learn the whole business quickly. Engineers who grow in this role can move into solution architecture, ACE-WMS implementation or key account roles, with product training from our OEM partners along the way.

**Salary and location**

₹5 to 8 lakh per year, depending on experience. Based in Chennai, with travel to customer sites in Hosur, Coimbatore and Bangalore.

**How to apply**

Apply here on LinkedIn, or email your CV to careers@allmark.in with "Presales Engineer" in the subject line.

e5c94ff6.title: Oracle Cloud Solution Architect
e5c94ff6.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Oracle Cloud Solution Architect based in India .**
In this role, you will provide strategic technical leadership across Oracle Cloud implementation projects, guiding teams through the entire project lifecycle, from pre-sales solution design to deployment and ongoing operations. You will act as a subject matter expert, ensuring the successful delivery of Oracle Cloud ERP and HCM solutions for enterprise clients, particularly in the North American market. You will combine deep functional expertise with architectural knowledge to design scalable solutions, manage implementation risks, and maintain high delivery standards. Working closely with clients, project teams, and technical specialists, you will lead workshops, guide testing cycles, and translate business requirements into effective technical solutions. You will also contribute to developing standardized methodologies, documentation, and reusable implementation assets. This is an opportunity to influence complex transformation initiatives while working with international clients in a collaborative, delivery-focused environment.
  
  
Accountabilities
  
  

* Act as the Oracle Cloud Solution Architect and subject matter expert for assigned Centers of Excellence (COEs), providing technical and functional leadership across multiple projects and implementation modules.
* Serve as the primary solution specialist and point of contact for assigned areas of expertise, supporting project teams and clients throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Lead high-level and detailed solution design activities, ensuring alignment with business requirements, Oracle Cloud architecture, and implementation best practices.
* Provide expertise throughout the project lifecycle, from pre-sales activities and solution estimation to implementation, deployment, and operational support.
* Guide implementation teams in applying Oracle Cloud implementation methodologies, ensuring consistency, efficiency, quality, and measurable business value.
* Lead client workshops, solution discussions, and working sessions with stakeholders at all levels, from senior leadership to operational teams.
* Drive Conference Room Pilot (CRP) sessions and testing cycles, ensuring outcomes are clearly documented, reviewed, and formally approved.
* Establish standardized documentation, project reporting, and review mechanisms to provide accurate visibility into project progress, deliverables, and implementation status.
* Identify potential project risks, assess their impact, and implement effective mitigation strategies to keep projects within agreed scope, timelines, and budgets.
* Develop reusable implementation assets, methodologies, templates, and documentation to improve delivery efficiency and knowledge retention.
* Collaborate with Organizational Change Management teams to develop effective knowledge transfer strategies and ensure long-term operational readiness.
* Support sales and estimation activities by contributing to high-level project plans, detailed work breakdown structures, and level-of-effort (LOE) estimates for specific Oracle Cloud pillars and modules.
* Work closely with technical teams to support integrations, resolve implementation challenges, and ensure effective coordination between functional and technical workstreams.
* Adapt responsibilities across different project roles as required by delivery priorities and business needs.

**Requirements**

* Extensive hands-on experience with Oracle Cloud implementation methodologies, including the ability to apply, train, and operationalize structured implementation approaches.
* Proven experience delivering at least three full lifecycle Oracle Cloud ERP and/or HCM implementations, including hands-on configuration.
* Strong expertise in Oracle Cloud SaaS architecture, with deep functional knowledge in at least one of the ERP or HCM pillars and working knowledge of the other.
* Previous experience supporting US-based clients, preferably within the public sector or higher education industries.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex implementation projects and provide architectural guidance across multiple teams and workstreams.
* Strong experience translating business requirements into scalable Oracle Cloud solutions and supporting both high-level architecture and detailed functional design.
* Proven ability to facilitate client workshops, stakeholder discussions, CRP sessions, and testing activities, ensuring clear documentation and approved outcomes.
* Experience establishing project governance, standardized documentation, reporting mechanisms, and review processes.
* Strong risk management skills, including identifying implementation challenges early, assessing potential impacts, and developing effective mitigation plans.
* Experience contributing to project planning, sales estimation, work breakdown structures, and effort assessments.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage confidently with senior executives, clients, technical specialists, and operational teams.
* Strong collaboration and leadership abilities, with the flexibility to take on different project responsibilities depending on business and delivery requirements.
* Ability to develop repeatable delivery assets, share expertise, mentor implementation teams, and improve organizational knowledge retention.

Additional experience and qualifications that would be a strong advantage:
  
  

* Experience designing and implementing Oracle Cloud solutions for North American public sector organizations.
* Knowledge of Subledger Accounting, Governmental Accounting Standards Board (GASB) requirements, and multi-fund accounting.
* Experience with Project-to-Payroll processes and third-party system integrations.
* Functional expertise in North American HR, Oracle Time and Labor (OTL), and Absence Management.
* Oracle Cloud certifications in implementation, support, engineering, or project management.

**Benefits**

* Remote working environment: Work remotely from India while collaborating with international clients and distributed implementation teams.
* International project exposure: Participate in complex Oracle Cloud transformation initiatives, particularly for North American organizations.
* Professional development: Expand your expertise across Oracle Cloud ERP, HCM, SaaS architecture, and enterprise implementation methodologies.
* Technical leadership opportunities: Take ownership of solution architecture, influence project delivery strategies, and contribute to organizational best practices.
* Knowledge-sharing culture: Develop reusable implementation assets, mentor colleagues, and collaborate with experienced professionals.
* Career growth: Strengthen your position as an Oracle Cloud subject matter expert through exposure to diverse projects and functional domains.

The company leads digital transformation through its ABCD framework, spanning Artificial Intelligence, Blockchain, Cybersecurity, and Datacenters & Infrastructure. DEV IT is a Microsoft Solutions Partner, AWS Advanced Services Partner, and Adobe Partner, providing cloud services, digital workplace solutions, enterprise applications, managed IT, and bespoke application development. Headquartered in Ahmedabad with offices in Canada and across India, the organization emphasizes a “People First, Business Always” philosophy and offers opportunities to work on complex, cutting-edge technology initiatives.

The Azure Cloud Architect is a full-time, on-site role based in Ahmedabad, responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing Azure-based cloud solutions. This role involves defining scalable solution architectures, selecting appropriate Azure services, and ensuring infrastructure reliability, security, and performance. The Azure Cloud Architect collaborates with software development and DevOps teams to design integrations, modernize legacy workloads, and support cloud-native application development. Daily tasks include assessing business and technical requirements, creating detailed architecture and infrastructure documentation, guiding implementation teams, and participating in design reviews and governance processes.
