6b4204ee.title: Project/Program Manager
6b4204ee.description:
**About us:**

ConveGenius is an impact-first organisation, building platforms and systems for public education and skilling at population scale. We work closely with governments, ecosystem partners, social enterprises, philanthropies and individual & institutional investors, with a goal to deliver the highest return on investment across offerings that improve learning, teaching, and governance.

Unlike traditional ed-tech companies that deliver content, we build infrastructure platforms that integrate deeply into public delivery systems, while enabling our partners to scale their missions with measurable results. Today, we operate across 22+ Indian states, trusted by governments and institutional investors alike, for aligning policy priorities with last mile impact. What started with belief and hope 13 years ago is now backed by evidence.

Our offerings include:

* SwiftChat (the platform on which we build with ecosystem partners)
* SwiftPAL – validated by a two-year RCT led by Nobel laureate Prof. Michael Kremer (Development Innovation Lab, University of Chicago), whose team found students gained “almost an additional 2 years of extra learning” in just 17 months
* Swiftee (the AI learning tutor built for Bharat)

Our team comprises thinkers, builders, innovators, and doers who show up every day with a strong action bias to build for Bharat.

Learn more about us: http://linktr.ee/convegenius11

**Background & Objective**

The Odisha Vidya Samiksha Kendra (VSK) Augmentation Project aims to strengthen the state’s education data ecosystem through improved data integration, analytics and monitoring. Over 12 months, the project builds an Integrated Dashboard Platform with 13 role-based dashboards, a Data Collection Module and a GenAI insights chatbot, hosted at the State Data Centre. This is followed by 36 months of operations and support.The Project Coordinator is the product and delivery anchor for the platform on the ground. The role turns state requirements into clear product specifications, tracks each dashboard from KPI definition to go-live, and keeps OSEPA, the directorates, EdCIL and our engineering teams aligned on scope, priorities and timelines.The role needs a blend of product management, product delivery and a working understanding of how SaaS platforms are configured, released, supported and adopted.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Product Management**

* Gather and document requirements from OSEPA, directorates and field users through workshops, field visits and review of existing systems.
* Lead KPI definition for the 13 dashboards (KPIs, formulas, targets, drill-downs, data sources) and get them signed off.
* Write product requirement documents, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Own the product backlog: prioritise features, enhancements and change requests against milestones and state priorities.
* Work with UX designers on user journeys and wireframes for the dashboards, Data Collection Module and chatbot, and validate them with users.
* Define role-based access: the user hierarchy from state to school, and the views and permissions for each role.

**Product Delivery & Release Management**

* Plan sprints and releases with the engineering, data and DevOps teams, and track progress against the quarter-wise plan.
* Coordinate QA and UAT: test cases, named UAT users, defect triage and sign-off.
* Manage release readiness: release notes, user communication, and go/no-go checks on SDC and NIC dependencies.
* Prepare milestone acceptance evidence, including the System Analysis Report and Phase 1 Part A and Part B sign-offs.
* Flag delivery risks and dependencies early and drive them to closure.C. SaaS Operations, Adoption & Support
* Oversee user onboarding and access provisioning at state, district and block levels.
* Track platform usage and adoption by role and district, and feed the insights into reviews and the product roadmap.
* Run the feedback loop: helpdesk tickets, user feedback and change requests, triaged into the backlog.
* Monitor service levels (P1, P2 and P3 response and resolution times) with the support team, and maintain the incident and change logs.
* Coordinate training plans and user manuals with OSEPA for state, district and block users.

**Stakeholder Coordination**

* Act as the day-to-day contact for JD VSK, directorate nodal officers, OCAC, NIC and EdCIL.
* Track state-side prerequisites, such as data-sharing approvals, user lists, system access and UAT users, against agreed dates.
* Organise and minute weekly project reviews and Steering Committee meetings, and maintain the action log.E. Reporting & Documentation
* Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports, and decks for state leadership and ConveGenius management.
* Maintain product documentation: requirements, KPI dictionary, release notes and the SOP for creating new dashboards.

**Required Qualifications:**

* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* MBA or a Master’s in Product Management, Technology Management, Business Analytics or a related field is preferred.

**Professional Experience**

* 5+ years of relevant experience, including at least 2 years in product management or product delivery for a SaaS or digital platform.
* Hands-on experience taking a data, dashboard or workflow product from requirements to go-live.
* Experience working with government departments or public-sector programmes is strongly preferred.

**Essential Competencies**

* Product management: Requirement gathering, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria and backlog prioritisation.
* Product delivery: Agile or Scrum ways of working, sprint planning, release management and UAT coordination, using Jira, Confluence or equivalent tools.
* SaaS understanding: Configuration versus customisation, role-based access, release cycles, SLAs and support tiers, and usage and adoption metrics.
* Data and dashboards: KPI design, BI tools such as Power BI, Superset or Metabase, and working SQL to validate data.
* Technical literacy: REST APIs and push or pull data integrations at a conceptual level, enough to work closely with engineers on data flows.
* Design: Wireframing in Figma or equivalent, and user-centred design basics.
* Stakeholder management: Clear written and spoken communication, presentations to senior officials, and meeting facilitation.
* Tools: MS Office or Google Workspace, and AI productivity tools.

**Desirable Experience**

* Exposure to VSK, NDEAR, UDISE+, APAAR or other education MIS and government dashboards is an added advantage
* Familiarity with State Data Centre or NIC-hosted deployments and the DPDP Act, 2023.
* Working knowledge of Odia. preferred
* Certifications such as CSPO, CSM or PMP.
* Consulting or start-up background.

**Expected Deliverables:**

* Signed-off KPI definitions and product requirements for all 13 dashboards, the Data Collection Module and the chatbot.
* A prioritised, up-to-date product backlog and release plan aligned to the quarter-wise project plan.
* UAT plans, test results and sign-offs for each dashboard release.
* Milestone acceptance documentation for the System Analysis Report and Phase 1 Part A and Part B.
* User onboarding, access provisioning and adoption reports by role and district.
* Weekly and monthly progress reports, Steering Committee minutes and action logs.
* Product documentation: KPI dictionary, release notes, user manuals and the SOP for new dashboards.

**Reporting & Coordination**

The Project Coordinator reports to the Project Delivery Manager / State Lead for the Odisha VSK Augmentation Project. The role works closely with internal product, engineering, data and DevOps teams, and with external stakeholders including OSEPA, the directorates, EdCIL, OCAC and NIC.

**Key Performance Expectations will be assessed on:**

* Timely sign-off of requirements and KPIs, and on-time releases against the project plan.
* UAT and milestone acceptance achieved without repeated rework.
* Platform adoption and active usage by role across state, district and block levels.
* Turnaround on user feedback and change requests, and adherence to service levels.
* Quality of documentation, reporting and stakeholder coordination.

**What We Offer and Why You Should Join ConveGeniusAt ConveGenius**

We create an environment where purpose meets growth. You will be part of a mission-driven organisation that is transforming how learning reaches children across India, especially at scale and where it matters most.

* Work with a diverse and passionate team spread across India, bringing together people from different backgrounds, perspectives and expertise.
* Be part of an organisation with a strong on-ground presence across more than two-thirds of India, giving you exposure to large-scale, real-world impact.
* Play a meaningful role in strengthening the education ecosystem and contributing directly to learning outcomes for millions of children.
* Gain experience working at the intersection of education, technology and public systems, building skills that are highly relevant and future-focused.
* Work in a culture that values ownership, learning and collaboration, with space to take initiative and grow professionally.
* Enjoy stability and peace of mind with employee-friendly benefits, including health insurance coverage and other supportive policies.

If you are driven by purpose, enjoy solving complex problems and want your work to create visible impact, ConveGenius offers a place to grow while making a difference.

The role translates customer needs into differentiated solution narratives, coordinates cross-functional bid teams, and develops high-quality proposals, presentations, estimates, and reusable go-to-market assets. The candidate will also use approved AI tools to accelerate research, requirement analysis, content development and knowledge reuse, while maintaining human accountability for accuracy, confidentiality and customer relevance.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Pursuit and bid management: Own or coordinate RFIs, RFQs, RFPs and proactive proposals from qualification through submission, including response plan, compliance matrix, workback schedule, reviews, approvals and final packaging.
* Customer requirement analysis: Interpret business and technical requirements, clarify scope and assumptions, identify dependencies and risks, and convert inputs into a clear response strategy.
* Solution orchestration: Work with Sales, Account Management, domain and solution teams, Delivery, Finance, Legal, HR and partners to build an integrated technical, delivery and commercial response.
* Proposal story and differentiation: Develop executive summaries, win themes, value propositions, solution narratives, case-study mapping, competitive positioning and evidence-based differentiators.
* Commercial support: Coordinate effort estimates, staffing and location models, pricing inputs, rate cards, assumptions and approval workflows with Delivery and Finance. Maintain version and change control.
* Review governance: Plan and facilitate solution, commercial, risk and leadership reviews; track actions to closure and ensure compliance with internal bid and approval processes.
* Presentations and workshops: Create customer-ready pitch decks and support discovery workshops, solution walkthroughs, demos, orals and internal deal reviews.
* Market and account insight: Research customer strategy, technology trends, competitors and buying context to develop point-of-view content and improve pursuit relevance.
* Knowledge management: Maintain proposal artifacts, case studies, credentials, templates, boilerplate content and lessons learned; improve reuse, quality and turnaround time.
* Continuous improvement: Track bid metrics and retrospective actions, and contribute to standard playbooks, automation and AI-assisted content development with appropriate human review.

**What You Need To Be Successful**
The successful candidate should be able to position services across several of the following areas, while engaging specialists for detailed solution ownership:
  
  

* Software-defined vehicle and vehicle E/E architecture
* Digital cockpit, infotainment, HMI and connected vehicle
* ADAS / autonomous driving engineering and validation
* Cloud, data platforms, AI/ML and analytics
* Embedded software, AUTOSAR, middleware and cybersecurity
* Test automation, verification and validation, DevOps / CI-CD and digital engineering
* Application development, modernization, support and managed services

**Bonus Points if You Have**
**AI-enabled presales practices**

* AI-assisted research and discovery: Use approved enterprise AI tools to synthesize customer, account, market and technology inputs; develop structured hypotheses and prepare sharper discovery questions.
* Requirement and RFP analysis: Apply AI to summarize bid documents, extract obligations, create first-pass compliance matrices, identify ambiguities and surface risks, assumptions and dependencies for expert validation.
* Proposal and presentation acceleration: Use generative AI to develop first drafts, alternative storylines, executive-summary options, win-theme language and presentation structures, followed by rigorous human review and tailoring.
* Knowledge reuse: Improve retrieval and adaptation of case studies, credentials, reusable proposal content and lessons learned using Copilot or equivalent enterprise-approved tools.
* Quality and governance: Validate factual accuracy, citations, calculations and customer-specific claims; protect confidential, personal and intellectual-property information; and comply with HARMAN policies and approved-tool requirements.
* Automation mindset: Identify repeatable presales activities that can be simplified through Microsoft 365 Copilot, Power Automate, approved agents or structured templates without weakening review controls.

**Required Experience And Qualifications**

* 5-6 years of total experience, with meaningful experience in presales, bid management, solution consulting, sales enablement or proposal management in engineering, IT or digital services.
* Experience contributing to complete proposal cycles, including planning, content coordination, solution documentation, estimation support, reviews and submission.
* Working knowledge of automotive software, embedded systems, digital engineering, cloud/data/AI, test and validation, or adjacent engineering-services domains.
* Ability to synthesize technical and commercial inputs into concise, persuasive customer-facing content.
* Practical AI literacy: ability to use enterprise generative AI responsibly for research, analysis, drafting and knowledge retrieval, with strong prompting, verification and data-handling discipline.
* Strong PowerPoint, Word and Excel skills; comfortable working with structured content repositories and collaboration tools.
* Clear written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, facilitation and project-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines and work effectively with globally distributed, cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related discipline.

**What Makes You Eligible**

* Prior exposure to automotive OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers or mobility technology companies.
* Exposure to commercial models such as time and material, fixed price, managed capacity, outcome-based or milestone-based engagements.
* Experience with competitive analysis, account research, case-study development, demos or customer workshops.
* Comfort using generative AI or automation tools to accelerate research and drafting while protecting confidential information and validating accuracy.

**What We Offer**

* Extensive training opportunities through our own HARMAN University

* Tuition reimbursement
* “Be Brilliant” employee recognition and rewards program

**You Belong Here**
HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.
  
  
**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology**
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
  
  
Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. **Experience:** 6+ Years  
**Industry:** BPO / BPM  
**Function:** Solutions Architecture / Pricing / Commercial Finance

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced **Solutions Architect – Pricing** professional with strong expertise in pricing strategy, financial modeling, cost analysis, and commercial deal management, preferably within the Mortgage BPO/BPM industry.

  

The candidate will be responsible for developing and governing pricing models for new business opportunities, contract renewals, and existing client engagements while ensuring commercial competitiveness and profitability.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop pricing strategies for mortgage origination, servicing, default management, and back-office outsourcing.
* Build pricing models covering FTE-based, transaction-based, outcome-based, and hybrid engagement models.
* Develop detailed cost models covering manpower, infrastructure, technology, overheads, and operational expenses.
* Perform financial modeling, P&L analysis, margin assessment, and pricing sensitivity analysis.
* Establish FTE rate cards, hourly rates, transaction rates, and unit-cost benchmarks.
* Evaluate onshore and offshore delivery cost structures across different geographies.
* Analyze staffing requirements, productivity, utilization, shrinkage, and supervisory ratios.
* Lead pricing development for RFPs, RFIs, proposals, renewals, and commercial negotiations.
* Partner with Sales, Operations, Finance, and Solutions Architecture teams to validate pricing assumptions.
* Identify cost optimization opportunities while maintaining profitability and service delivery commitments.
* Maintain pricing governance, standard cost assumptions, rate cards, and pricing frameworks.

e70a6131.title: Sr. Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India - HCLS
e70a6131.description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect in AWS Industries HCLS segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud and AI architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
  
  
You will partner some of the worlds largest companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a small set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind-share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.
  
  
**Here Are Some Other Qualities We Are Looking For**
Enjoy working with large, global customers as an active contributor to a diverse team. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
  
  
Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
* Architect AI-ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS
* In partnership with the account management team, formulate and execute a strategy
* Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
* Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
* Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community
* Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers
* Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
* Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

A day in the life
  
  

* Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
* Develop proof-of-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
* Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
* Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
* Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures

**About The Team**
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
  
  
The HCLS Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic Healthcare and Life Sciences accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in a professional field

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Are you an experienced cloud architect/developer who can assist customers in designing and developing cloud-native, AI-integrated applications and/or re-engineering applications to fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like working on game-changing projects at the forefront of application development, AI Agents, and cloud technology adoption?
  
  
AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands-on technical architects to accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. You'll join Amazon's world-class technical teams, working on diverse projects including reimagining customer agent-enabled applications, modernization, Generative AI adoption, and AI-DLC application development.

We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about:
  
  

* Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
* Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions

* Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC), from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement

* Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices

Diverse Experiences

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

* 10+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience

* 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience

**GEN AI Offshore Delivery Leader**

  

We are looking for an experienced Offshore Delivery Leader to own end-to-end delivery for GenAI-led enterprise programs, managing large distributed teams across onsite-offshore models, multiple client stakeholders, and complex SOW/commercial structures. This role sits at the intersection of technical delivery, program governance, and client relationship management someone who can go deep into a GenAI architecture conversation in the morning and hold a steering committee update in the afternoon.

Key Responsibilities

**Delivery Ownership**

* Own end-to-end delivery for one or more GenAI/AI-native programs (agentic workflows, LLM integration, MCP-based data/tooling integration, RAG pipelines, GenAI-infused QA/testing, legacy modernization with AI accelerators, etc.)
* Manage delivery across onsite-offshore pods, ensuring consistent velocity, quality, and predictability regardless of time zone spread
* Drive sprint/iteration cadences, release planning, and delivery governance (status reporting, RAID logs, steering committee updates)
* Own program-level risk management — technical risk, staffing risk, scope creep, and dependency risk — and drive mitigation before issues escalate to the client

**Team & People Management**

* Manage large, matrixed teams (30–100+ FTEs) spanning architects, engineers, QA, business analysts, and scrum masters across multiple pods/PODs
* Build and manage capacity plans, including pod scaling models, use-case intake and complexity scoring, and bench/utilization management
* Drive hiring, onboarding, and upskilling — including running or feeding a GenAI academy/training pipeline to build bench depth in emerging AI skills
* Manage performance, career development, and attrition for a large offshore team

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary offshore delivery point of contact for client stakeholders (delivery leads, product owners, procurement/sourcing, CXO-level sponsors where required)
* Run governance forums — biweekly/monthly status reviews, QBRs, executive steering committees
* Manage client expectations on scope, timelines, and commercial boundaries, especially where fixed-price or outcome-based commitments are in play
* Handle escalations calmly and directly, owning the resolution rather than deflecting upward

**Commercial & SOW Management**

* Understand and manage delivery against SOW terms — fixed price, T&M, unit/milestone pricing, or hybrid rate-card models
* Partner with sales/solutioning teams on SOW drafting, effort estimation, and commercial structuring for renewals and change requests
* Track margin, utilization, and delivery cost against committed rates; flag commercial risk early
* Support RFP/proposal responses with delivery-side inputs (staffing models, delivery methodology, risk mitigation, past performance evidence)

**GenAI Technical Fluency**

* Maintain working technical depth in GenAI concepts — LLM application patterns, agentic architectures, MCP/tool integration, prompt engineering fundamentals, RAG, and AI-assisted SDLC/QA tooling — enough to credibly review architecture decisions and challenge technical teams, not just report status
* Partner with solution architects to ensure delivery approach aligns with client's AI platform standards and security/compliance requirements
* Champion GenAI-led productivity improvements within the delivery org itself (AI-assisted coding, automated testing, ticket triage/routing, etc.)

**Required Qualifications**

* 12–18+ years in IT/software delivery, with at least 3–5 years leading large offshore or onsite-offshore blended delivery teams
* Demonstrated experience delivering at least one significant GenAI/AI program end-to-end (not just POC-stage — real production delivery)
* Strong grounding in Agile/Scrum delivery at scale; experience with SAFe or similar scaled frameworks a plus
* Proven experience managing SOWs, commercial models (T&M, fixed price, outcome-based, rate cards), and client contract nuances
* Experience managing enterprise client relationships at director/VP level, including handling escalations and governance forums independently
* Strong people management track record — hiring, performance management, capacity planning for teams of 30+

08270ede.title: Service Delivery Manager - Cyber Defence
08270ede.description:
**About Rackspace Cyber Defence**
Rackspace Cyber Defence is our next generation cyber defence and security operations capability that builds on 20+ years of securing customer environments to deliver proactive, risk-based, threat-informed and intelligence driven security services.
  
  
**Our purpose**
is to enable our customers to defend against the evolving threat landscape across on-premises, private cloud, public cloud and multi-cloud workloads.
  
  
**Our goal**
is to go beyond traditional security controls to deliver cloud-native, DevOps-centric and fully integrated 24x7x365 cyber defence capabilities that deliver a
**proactive**
,
**threat-informed**
,
**risk-based**
,
**intelligence-driven**
approach to detecting and responding to threats.
  
  
**Our Mission Is To Help Our Customers**

* Proactively detect and respond to cyber-attacks – 24x7x365.
* Defend against new and emerging risks that impact their business.
* Reduce their attack surface across private cloud, hybrid cloud, public cloud, and multi-cloud environments.
* Reduce their exposure to risks that impact their identity and brand.
* Develop operational resilience.
* Maintain compliance with legal, regulatory and compliance obligations.

**What We’re Looking For**
To support our continued success and deliver a Fanatical Experience™ to our customers, Rackspace Cyber Defence is looking for an India-based Security Delivery Manager.
  
  
This role is particularly well-suited to a self-starting, experienced and motivated Security Delivery Manager, who is commercially-aware, service-oriented and has a proven record of accomplishment in service delivery management, service management and/or customer success.
  
  
The Security Delivery Manager will be the face of Rackspace’s security services, delivering excellent customer service for our customers. Core delivery areas will include service delivery management, operational governance, contractual management, and financial performance.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Service Delivery Management

+ Oversight of customer onboarding and service transition.
+ Own the customer relationship and act as the customer’s key contact for your assigned customers.
+ Act as a service escalation point for internal and external teams (e.g. during major incidents.)
+ Prepare and deliver Monthly Security Service Reviews (MSSRs)
+ Serve as the operational interlock between customers and Rackspace delivery team(s).
+ Collaborate with wider account team(s) to deliver strategic initiatives.
+ Provide on-call services to customers (if applicable)
+ Proactively engage customers and identify opportunities for continual service improvement (CSI)
+ Build strong relationships with assigned customers and understand their business challenges.
+ Identify and drive opportunities to grow assigned accounts, in collaboration with the wider account team(s)
+ Solicit customer feedback ,testimonials, case studies and references to support both Customer Success and continuous improvement initiatives.
+ Willing to work in flexible working hours.

* Operational Governance

+ Regular engagement with internal service providers
+ Managing the performance of internal teams
+ Driving customer outcomes through service delivery teams
+ Assist in the development of policies and standards with specific regard to service design, service transition, service management and continuous service improvement.
+ Maintain service documentation to ensure business visibility of service processes.

* Contractual Management

+ Be the subject matter experts for your customers’ security contracts.
+ Ensuring new requirements are captured and contractually incorporated.
+ Ensure the required teams are engaged for key contractual milestones e.g renewals.

* Financial Performance

+ Monitor and manage the financial performance for your assigned customers contracts.
+ Forecast financial performance throughout the life of the service.
+ Highlight key commercial levers that may affect financial performance to key internal stakeholders.
+ Where possible, identify and deliver financial performance enhancing measures.

**Skills & Experience**

* Should have 5+ years’ experience in service delivery management, service management and/or customer success; ideally within a managed security services (MSSP) environment.
* Experience in monitoring and improving service performance.
* Managing key stakeholders both internal and external, understanding expected outcomes
* Experience of working with public cloud environments such as Azure, AWS and Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience of common service management standards such as ITIL or ISO 20000; as well as service transition.
* Knowledge of common project management practices such as Prince II, Agile and SCRUM; ideally in a DevOps-centric environment.
* Knowledge of security standards (good practice) such as NIST, ISO27001, CIS (Center for Internet Security), OWASP and Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM) etc
* Ideally, you will have experience delivering managed security services such as Attack Surface Management, Managed Detection & Response, Managed Extended Detection & Response and/or Defensive Security Services.
* A highly self-motivated and proactive individual who wants to learn and grow and has an attention to detail.
* Highly organised and detail oriented. Ability to prioritise, multitask and work under pressure.
* An individual who shows a willingness to go above and beyond in delighting the customer.
* A good communicator who can explain security concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

**About Rackspace Technology**
Rackspace Technology is the trusted operator of the full enterprise AI stack, from governed private cloud to AI inference and agents in production. From edge to core to cloud, we operate the infrastructure, data layer, and software integration to deliver business outcomes with the predictable cost, reliability, security, and compliance that regulated and mission-critical environments demand. We support customers in more than 120 countries with AI capabilities spanning private cloud, public cloud, applications, data and cyber resilience.
  
  
**More on Rackspace Technology**
Though we’re all different, Rackers thrive through our connection to a central goal: to be a valued member of a winning team on an inspiring mission. We bring our whole selves to work every day. And we embrace the notion that unique perspectives fuel innovation and enable us to best serve our customers and communities around the globe. We welcome you to apply today and want you to know that we are committed to offering equal employment opportunity without regard to age, color, disability, gender reassignment or identity or expression, genetic information, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity status, military or veteran status, nationality, ethnic or national origin, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any legally protected characteristic. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

f8252681.description:
**Location: Bangalore, India**  
**Experience: 8–12 years**  
**Industry: Consulting, Staffing, Professional Services**

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced Relationship Engagement & Vendor Manager to manage end-to-end consultant lifecycle operations while also acting as a key point of contact for client relationships in India and the UK.

**This hybrid role combines:**

* Consultant lifecycle ownership
* Vendor & client management
* Contract extension & negotiation
* Relationship engagement
* Legal & contract coordination
* Service delivery & account support

You will work closely with client stakeholders, consultants deployed at client sites, internal leadership, and the legal/commercial teams to ensure smooth operations, contract continuity, and a superior consultant experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Consultant Lifecycle Management**

* Manage the full consultant lifecycle: onboarding, deployment, confirmation, extension, and exit
* Coordinate offer letters, contracts, onboarding documents, and induction
* Ensure timely background verification and joining formalities
* Track consultant performance, attendance, timesheets, and project milestones

**2. Client & Vendor Relationship Management (India + UK)**

* Act as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders and vendor partners
* Build strong working relationships with project leads, hiring managers, procurement, and vendor teams
* Conduct regular cadence calls and feedback sessions with both clients and consultants
* Collaborate with clients to identify upcoming needs and opportunities

**3. Contract Extensions & Commercial Coordination**

* Drive contract extensions by proactively engaging clients and consultants
* Manage contract negotiations and commercial terms with clients
* Coordinate with internal legal teams for contract reviews, renewals, and documentation
* Ensure adherence to compliance, legal, and contractual obligations

**4. Operations & Service Delivery**

* Ensure seamless service delivery and consultant performance
* Work across procurement tools and vendor management platforms (Beeline, Fieldglass, PRO)
* Maintain accurate consultant records, trackers, and operational dashboards
* Support account teams in addressing operational issues, escalations, or delays

**5. Compliance & Documentation**

* Ensure compliance with statutory requirements (PF, ESIC, Gratuity, Shops & Establishment, etc.)
* Maintain audit-ready documentation and consultant records
* Coordinate with compliance, finance, and legal teams for updates and filings

**6. Payroll & Timesheet Coordination**

* Liaise with payroll & finance teams to ensure timely salary disbursal
* Track timesheets, client approvals, and billing cycles
* Resolve discrepancies related to pay, attendance, invoicing, or client approvals

**7. Consultant Engagement & HR Support**

* Conduct regular engagement check-ins and welfare calls
* Address consultant grievances, concerns, and escalations promptly
* Drive retention, motivation, and long-term consultant success
* Run engagement initiatives and communication programs

**8. Reporting & Stakeholder Communication**

* Prepare MIS reports, consultant dashboards, extension trackers, and status reports
* Provide timely updates to internal leadership and account managers
* Support client audits and business reviews

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree; MBA/PGDM in HR or related field preferred
* 7–12 years of experience in consulting, staffing, HR operations, account management, or vendor management
* Experience supporting UK or Europe-based clients (preferred)
* Strong understanding of consultant lifecycle, contracts, and compliance
* Familiarity with vendor management platforms (Beeline, Fieldglass, PRO, etc.)
* Strong English communication skills (verbal & written)

**Key Competencies**

* Excellent relationship-building & stakeholder management
* Strong negotiation & commercial awareness
* Solution-oriented mindset with high ownership
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and consultants simultaneously
* Strong organisational skills with attention to detail
* Empathy, professionalism & proactive communication
* Comfort in a fast-paced, dynamic consulting environment

**We empower companies with high-end IT services**

emagine is a high-end business, engineering & IT consulting company. Enabled by an extensive network of experts, emagine powers progress, solves challenges and delivers real results through tailored high-end consulting services. emagine is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with departments in France, Germany, Ireland, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Sweden, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates as well as India. Over the last couple of years, the company has grown extensively, increasing its international footprint to become one of the biggest consultancies in its segment in Europe and beyond. emagine A/S is owned by private equity company Axcel and a group of senior staff and board members.

**Are you our new colleague?**

At emagine, we value diversity immensely. Both when it comes to backgrounds and competences, but also in relation to personality and individual ambition. We are a diverse and well-rounded group made up of experienced specialists, generalists, recent graduates and self-taught people. We are generally curious, helpful and happy to share knowledge with our colleagues.

We are proud of our values that are based on honesty, kindness, helpfulness and solidarity. We nurture a strong community culture, where cooperation is paramount – not just locally but also across borders with our international departments. Only in unison can we provide the best service to our clients and affiliated consultants – and that is our goal. As an employee of emagine, you will experience a close-knit culture in which people stand side by side and where there is an emphasis on building close relationships. Going to work must be a fun and enriching experience yet still provide a challenge. That is why we take several steps to ensure that work is motivating and engaging. Finally, we also strive to create the right conditions for physical and mental wellbeing.

**Want to know more about what it is like to work at emagine?**

Visit our Instagram to get a better idea of who we are or get in contact with our HR department.

cf2d3c7c.title: Senior Silicon Technical Program Manager
cf2d3c7c.description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission.

The Methodology, Infrastructure & Labs Engineering (MILE) team within SCHIE provides the engineering compute infrastructure, computer-aided design (CAD) flows and methods, and labs that Microsoft's silicon teams rely on to design and deliver custom chips. Our team at the India Development Center (IDC) supports two closely linked areas: CAD, which delivers the electronic design automation (EDA) tools, flows and methodologies used by silicon design teams, and Silicon Design Compute Services (SDCS), which runs the high-performance compute, cloud, job scheduling and storage environment those flows depend on, together with managed service partners. As our silicon roadmap grows, we need a Technical Program Manager to drive CAD and SDCS programs to delivery and bring financial rigor to this portfolio.

As a Technical Program Manager in MILE, you will lead technical programs across our CAD and SDCS portfolios and own budget planning and financial operations for them, so that Microsoft's silicon teams get the tools and compute they need, on time and at the right cost.

#SCHIE

 **Responsibilities**

* Lead CAD programs end to end, including EDA tool and flow rollouts, version upgrades, methodology changes and license capacity planning for silicon projects, defining scope, milestones, dependencies and success criteria with CAD engineers and design teams.

* Lead SDCS programs for silicon design-compute infrastructure, such as high-performance compute cluster expansions, cloud migration and burst capacity, job scheduler and storage upgrades, and capacity planning against silicon project demand.

* Run program governance across CAD and SDCS: maintain roadmaps, plans and risk and issue logs, drive quarterly planning and objectives and key results (OKRs), and communicate status, risks and decisions clearly to leadership.

* Own end-to-end budget planning, forecasting and tracking for EDA/CAD software licenses, emulation hardware and software, compute infrastructure and vendor services across OPEX, CAPEX and COGS, partnering with Finance on quarterly and annual planning cycles.

* Partner with silicon engineering teams, EDA vendors, Procurement, Finance and managed service providers to align on demand, contracts, purchase orders and service levels, and run regular business and service reviews.

* Support delivery and financial health across the CAD and SDCS portfolio: identify risks, variances and optimization opportunities, drive trade-off decisions with leadership, and represent the programs in planning and executive reviews.

* Define and report metrics for program delivery, spend versus forecast, license and compute utilization, and vendor SLA performance, using data and dashboards to improve cost efficiency, reliability and on-time execution.

 **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Required Qualifications Instruction: Qualifications must be pulled from the Role Library and cannot deviate from what is listed.

Bachelor's Degree AND 5+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.

* 4+ years experience in cloud Infrastructure, EDA, or CAD, including 2+ years as a project or program manager and a BS(BA) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Information Systems, a related field.

* Strong understanding of Agile concepts and proven experience applying them in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

* Proficiency with project management tools such as Azure DevOps(ADO), Microsoft Project, Jira, etc.

**Other Requirements:**

* Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to, the following specialized security screening:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check. This position is required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.

* This role will require access to information that is controlled for export under export control regulations, potentially under the U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations or Export Administration Regulations, the EU Dual Use Regulation, and/or other export control regulations. As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide either proof of their country of citizenship or proof of their U.S. permanent residency or other protected status (e.g., under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)) for assessment of eligibility to access the export-controlled information. To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate’s citizenship will be verified with a valid passport. Lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees may verify status using other documents, where applicable.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with budgeting, financial forecasting and spend management for engineering or IT infrastructure (OPEX/CAPEX), including working with Finance and Procurement on purchase orders and contracts.

* Experience managing EDA/CAD tool and flow deployments, or high-performance compute, job scheduler, storage or cloud infrastructure programs, ideally in a semiconductor design environment.

* Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly with leaders and influence global, cross-functional teams and external vendors without direct authority.

* Experience managing vendors or managed services (statements of work, service reviews, SLA tracking) and proficiency with Excel or Power BI for financial and program reporting.

39d33a9c.title: Program Manager I, NOC Relay Ops
39d33a9c.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer-centric company? If so, meet Amazon.  
  
Over the past 20+ years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. Through our entrepreneurial culture, Amazon has developed new technologies and products (like Echo) and, enterprise services (like Amazon Web Services). APEX NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon's transportation network. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.  
Overall, Relay Ops plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.  
  
Responsibilities of Program Manager under Relay Ops/NOC  
We are looking for an experienced Program Manager to coordinate and lead efforts across operations, multiple technology and program teams. We're looking for a hands-on and motivated self-starter who's passionate about using data to help us measure every area of the business, drive efficiencies, optimizations and influence decision-making.  
  
A Program Manager is expected to have deep functional knowledge, ability to design new program frameworks/processes and running defect reduction programs. He should be proficient, in identifying the input and output metric to gauge the success of a program. In this role, he will work with business and operations team to analyze historic results, challenge status quo and make business recommendations to senior management based on those analyses – all in an environment of rapid growth and increasing complexity. The Program Manager will drive improvements to the reporting tools, methods, and processes utilized by the team to increase the availability and granularity of actionable data to internal and external partners.  
  
The successful candidate must have analytical skills and expert in excel. Knowledge of SQL and tools like R/Python would be an added advantage. He/she will be experienced at working with large data sets and the technical tools needed to work with them. He/she will have superb communication and customer-relationship skills, good analytic insight, and be a passionate advocate of operations team to other stakeholders. He/she will drive towards simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, have excellent project-management skills, and be able to communicate complex analytical results, both written and verbally, in a clear and easy-to-understand way.  
  
What are we really looking for?  

* You should be very analytical and be able to justify your decisions and approaches with data
* You should be able to deal with a high degree of ambiguity
* You should be able to take a complex problem and break it down to smaller digestible chunks
* You should be able to define a logical and step by step approach to achieving assigned goals
* You should be comfortable with processes and process design/analysis
* You should have the ability to influence without authority and do so by using data and facts
* You should be able to deal with varied stakeholders and earn their trust
* You are mature and able to function independently with limited guidance
* You should be willing to work in rotational shifts
* Languages proficiency (mandatory) – English.

  
Key job responsibilities  
The incumbent will own the following -  
1) They will be responsible for working with supply chain execution, transportation, FC, carriers and other Amazon teams to identify pain points and scope out large high impact projects  
2) They will be responsible for driving cost benefit analysis and go/no-go decisions on various initiatives  
3) Once a go decision is made, the program manager will work to evolve a plan and timeline for execution.  
4) The program manager will develop a roadmap and metrics to measure progress of the initiative they own. They will also own writing reports that detail the progress to leadership on a frequent basis  
5) They will liaise across functions to drive their project and help clear issues and bottlenecks.  
6) They will work with technology teams to scope out and drive any tech changes that are needed  
  
Other than this, the PM I is required to :  
A. Cost Reduction Strategy:  
(a) Develop and implement strategies to reduce costs in the transportation business  
(b) Analyze and optimize adhoc share, number of trips, and truck utilization  
(c) Participate in and contribute to WBR meetings with the core group  
  
B. Network Optimization:  
(a) Work on improving network design  
(b) Optimize NOC Governance Mechanism  
(c) Improve RLB adoption and truck utilization  
  
C. Forecasting and Scheduling:  
(a) Analyze and act on Frequent Adhoc & Frequent Cancellation (FAFC) trends  
(b) Optimize schedule capacity and reduce adhoc share  
  
D. Cost per Trip Reduction:  
(a) Address issues leading to increased cost per trip collaborate with all the miles to reduce unloading delays  
(b) Improve RLB conversion rates and manage manual adhoc rates  
  
E. Cross-functional Collaboration:  
(a) Work closely with FC, SC, EWH, and other teams to implement improvements  
(b) Coordinate with tech teams for necessary system enhancements  
(c) Manage stakeholder relationships and secure buy-in for new initiatives  
  
F. Data Analysis and Reporting:  
(a) Conduct cost-benefit analyses for proposed initiatives  
(b) Create and maintain performance dashboards  
(c) Provide regular updates on KPIs and project progress  
  
G. Continuous Improvement:  
(a) Identify new opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency improvement  
(b) Plan and execute pilot projects to test new ideas  
(c) Scale successful initiatives across the network  
  
This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, analytical skills, project management expertise, and cross-functional leadership to drive significant improvements in the linehaul network's efficiency and cost-effectiveness.  
  
About the team  
NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem-solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

05ba5a62.description:
**Description**
Picture this: You're about to lead the team that decides whether a customer in London gets their package tomorrow or next week, whether a family in Madrid pays €5 or €15 for delivery, and whether someone in Luxembourg receives three boxes or one perfectly consolidated package. We're looking for an L6 Sr. Technical program Manager to join our Delivery Experience (DEX) team – think of it as mission control for Amazon EU's delivery operations, where your decisions ripple across millions of doorsteps every single day. You'll be the strategic mastermind behind our vision of high-speed, low-cost delivery for all EU customers, juggling the exciting challenge of making deliveries faster while simultaneously making them cheaper (yes, we know that sounds like magic, but that's why we need you!). This isn't just any Sr. TPM role – you're getting a front-row seat with the STeam, driving Stores' biggest bets in EU, and basically becoming the person everyone turns to when they ask "how do we crack the customer delivery experience?" Based in Bengaluru, you'll be working on problems so complex and impactful that your morning coffee conversations will involve optimizing networks across entire countries. Ready to turn delivery from a logistics challenge into a customer superpower?
  
  
You understand that a successful program needs to solve meaningful problems for our customers, for our business, and for our technology. You will work with engineers, designers, and our business teams to build a global marketplace product that expedites Amazon’s expansion worldwide.
  
  
**You Are a Good Fit If**

* You can raise the bar on customer-obsessed thinking – at a global scale.
* You are strategic thinker with a strong focus on delivery on strategy and tech
* You communicate your ideas boldly and vision to all levels of the company – both verbally and in writing.
* You align stakeholders on your roadmap
* You thrive on data - a statement that is not supported by data is just another opinion.
* You are brave, have persistence and grit, never hesitate to challenge the status quo.
* You are curious, can dive into technical detail, and ask engineers insightful questions about the services and systems you influence.
* You are a self-starter who is able to work in an environment of high complexity and ambiguity.
* You think long-term, can balance diverse and conflicting customer needs, and converge on outcomes that earn customer loyalty.
* You break down the big picture into actionable goals and deliver them.

Key job responsibilities
  
  
**You Will Be Responsible For**

* You will own delivery and roadmap for 20+ HC team.
* Articulating tech vision and value proposition for Amazon’s worldwide marketplace expansion.
* Working backwards from the customers around the globe to build, manage, and deliver a technical marketplace expansion roadmap.
* Working with Amazon EU businesses around the globe to define solutions for Amazon’s worldwide marketplace expansions in the different regions.
* Influencing technical priorities and business strategy through data-driven contributions, working directly with business stakeholders, engineering managers, engineers, and designers.
* Driving product discussions as well as commissioning market research, usability studies, and focus groups.
* Developing product plans with clear measurable success criteria, using mechanisms and metrics for KPIs, funnels, conversion, and awareness.
* Supporting branding and marketing of your team and programs.

A day in the life
  
  
Successful applicants will have experience solid delivery, leading cross-functional teams, and communicating to a large number of diverse stakeholders.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

**An Overview Of This Role**
As a Technical Program Manager on GitLab's all-remote R&D PMO team, you will own complex, end-to-end programs that are central to our AI-powered DevSecOps strategy. You will drive high-priority initiatives across product, engineering, data, and security teams, transforming strategic vision into executable plans that deliver innovative capabilities like the GitLab Duo Agent Platform and next-generation developer tools. You will work closely with executive leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, serving as the bridge between strategy and execution through clear communication, proactive risk management, and structured program delivery. In your first year, you will independently lead strategic programs, driving predictable execution, thoughtful tradeoffs between quality and speed, and transparent stakeholder alignment.
  
  
**Some Examples Of Our Projects**

* Delivering data-intensive platform initiatives that enhance developer productivity and enterprise analytics capabilities
* Driving infrastructure modernization and scalability programs that support our growing customer base
* Orchestrating security and compliance initiatives that maintain our industry-leading DevSecOps standards

**What You Will Do**

* Lead end-to-end technical programs across product, engineering, data, and security, from initial scope through launch and continuous improvement
* Collaborate closely with executive leaders and senior stakeholders to translate strategic vision into actionable roadmaps and align on priorities and tradeoffs
* Coordinate distributed teams across time zones using strong asynchronous communication, providing structure, clarity, and consistent status updates
* Develop and maintain comprehensive program plans, proactively identifying and mitigating risks and dependencies while facilitating decisions that balance speed, quality, and customer impact
* Partner with customer success and cross-functional teams to refine communication plans, and operational workflows
* Champion GitLab's values and culture within programs, fostering collaborative excellence, continuous improvement, and innovation
* Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

**What You Will Bring**

* Proven experience leading technical program initiatives in product, engineering, data, or security environments, with demonstrated success delivering complex programs from inception through scaled adoption
* Demonstrated ability to define strategy and create clarity within extreme ambiguity
* Strong background in SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or DevOps technology companies, with ability to quickly master the GitLab platform and AI/ML initiatives
* Proven experience influencing and driving impact at a division and company-wide scale, affecting market position and revenue
* Excellence in cross-functional leadership, with experience partnering with engineering, product, security teams and engaging effectively with senior and C-level stakeholders
* Outstanding communication skills, including asynchronous collaboration, executive reporting, and the ability to translate technical complexity into clear business impact
* Track record of success in fast-paced, dynamic environments with evolving technical requirements and market opportunities
* Strong facilitation and influence skills, with ability to drive consensus across diverse stakeholder groups while building trust through transparency and delivery excellence
* Expertise in high-level stakeholder management, including masterful communication with Executive Boards and enterprise Customers
* Collaborative leadership style aligned with GitLab's values, including respect, openness to feedback, and commitment to team success
* Proven track record of redefining organizational operations and serving as an escalation point to resolve highly complex, enterprise-level challenges
* Welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds, including those with consulting, enterprise technology, or technical leadership experience who have owned outcomes and delivered transformational initiatives
* Ability to act as a visionary leader, shaping R&D direction and fostering technical excellence across the organization

**About the team:**
The Technical Program Management team sits within GitLab's R&D Program Management Office and drives product, engineering, data, and security initiatives across our AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You will join our growing, distributed team of Technical Program Managers currently spanning North America and Europe. We own the end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-functional programs including AI platform capabilities, enterprise customer initiatives, and strategic technology transformations. As an all-remote team, we excel at asynchronous communication to coordinate across time zones while partnering closely with executive leaders and stakeholders to deliver business-critical outcomes.

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
  
  
**Country Hiring Guidelines:**
GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
  
  
**Privacy Policy:**
Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

Customers include Coca-Cola, Nestlé, Colgate-Palmolive, Mondelez, Samsung, and Kellogg's. Backed by SoftBank, Insight Partners, and Madrona. Headquartered in Mountain View with teams across the US, India, Canada, and the UK. Pre-IPO.
  
  
**The role**
As a senior technical program manager (STPM), you'll lead our most complex, cross-team and cross-geography programs, such as cloud cost optimization, platform migrations, and large multi-team launches. You'll turn ambiguity into clear plans, keep every team aligned on what matters, and give senior leadership an honest, current view of progress, risks, and trade-offs.
  
  
You'll also be the bridge between executive leadership and engineering. You'll translate business priorities into engineering plans, and translate technical reality into decisions leaders can act on. You won't manage the engineers, but you'll earn their trust and drive results through influence.
  
  
**What you'll do**

* **Lead complex programs end to end.**
  Own programs that span multiple engineering, product, data, and finance teams across time zones, from scoping and planning through launch and post-launch review.
* **Coordinate product and engineering roadmaps.**
  Align product and engineering roadmaps across teams and regions. Reconcile priorities, capacity, and dependencies, keep one integrated view of what ships when, and flag trade-offs early so leadership can make informed calls.
* **Drive cost and efficiency initiatives.**
  Partner with engineering and finance to analyze cloud and infrastructure spend, identify savings, set targets, and track delivery against them.
* **Keep leadership informed.**
  Run regular program reviews and steering committees. Write concise executive updates covering status, milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions needed, and business impact.
* **Bridge executives and engineering.**
  Translate strategy and customer priorities into technical roadmaps and milestones, and explain technical constraints and trade-offs in plain business terms.
* **Manage dependencies and risk.**
  Surface cross-team dependencies early, own the critical path, escalate with clear options and recommendations, and keep the plan honest.
* **Define and track metrics.**
  Set KPIs, SLAs, and success criteria for each program, and report results with data that leaders can trust.
* **Build repeatable ways of working.**
  Improve planning, intake, prioritization, and delivery processes across engineering. Standardize the practices that work.
* **Raise the bar.**
  Mentor program managers and engineering leads, and share best practices across the organization.

**What you'll bring**

* 5+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering management, or a closely related role, including 5+ years leading cross-functional programs with software engineering teams.
* A track record of delivering large, multi-team programs across geographies, with measurable outcomes in scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
* Strong technical depth. You can discuss architecture, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and CI/CD with engineers and spot risk before it becomes a delay.
* Excellent written and verbal communication. You've presented to VP and C-level audiences and can turn complex detail into a clear story and a clear ask.
* Experience leading cost reduction or efficiency programs, including cloud spend (FinOps), vendor contracts, or resource optimization.
* Proven ability to influence without authority, resolve conflict, and make decisions with incomplete information.
* Comfort with program tooling (Jira, Confluence, or similar) and with building dashboards and reports from engineering and financial data.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to have**

* Background as a software engineer or technical lead.
* Experience at a SaaS, ecommerce, or data and AI company operating at scale.
* Experience with generative AI or agentic AI product development.

**How we'll measure success**

* Programs deliver on agreed scope, timeline, and budget, with risks raised early.
* Cost and efficiency targets are met and tracked transparently.
* Leadership has a current, accurate view of program status and the decisions needed.

**Why CommerceIQ**
You'll work on programs that shape how leading brands win in ecommerce, with direct access to senior leadership and real influence on how engineering operates. We put customers first, communicate clearly, and value people who take ownership.
