The ideal candidate should bring strong Retail domain understanding and should be comfortable engaging with global enterprise customers, leading discovery discussions, shaping solution narratives, preparing proposals, coordinating estimates and presenting to senior stakeholders.

* Lead discovery sessions, customer workshops, solution walkthroughs, and executive presentations.

* Retail Domain Contribution: Apply Retail domain knowledge to create business-relevant solutions for enterprise customers.
* Support opportunities across omnichannel retail, digital commerce, store operations, merchandising, customer experience, loyalty, inventory, fulfilment, supply chain, data analytics and AI-led transformation.
* Understand how retail business processes connect with technology platforms, operating models and transformation programs.
* Contribute domain insights during customer conversations, solutioning workshops and proposal development.

a728d2ad.title: Solution Architect - Insurance
a728d2ad.description:
The Industry Solution Architect - Insurance is responsible for shaping, designing, and governing end-to-end insurance solutions that align business outcomes with robust, scalable architectures. The role blends deep insurance domain expertise with hands-on solution architecture, ensuring solutions are practical, differentiated, and grounded in real insurer operating models.

The role supports pursuits and programs across major insurance markets including the US, UK, EU, Canada, ANZ, and ASEAN, requiring strong awareness of regional regulatory, operational, and technology considerations.

**Key Responsibilities & Deliverables**

**Solution Architecture & Design**

* Architect end-to-end insurance solutions spanning business processes, core platforms, digital channels, data, integration, and operations.
* Design business solution architectures across P&C, Life & Annuities, Specialty, Reinsurance, Pension, and Supplemental Health.
* Develop functional and technical blueprints that clearly map client requirements to Coforge capabilities, platforms, and delivery models.
* Define business architecture, solution patterns, and reusable assets to support consistency across pursuits and programs.

**Sales & Pursuit Support**

* Partner with Sales, Client Partners, and Industry Leads to support opportunity qualification and solution shaping.
* Contribute proposals, solution sections, executive summaries, and client presentations for strategic deals.
* Participate in client discussions to explain solution approaches, architectural choices, and delivery implications in clear business terms.

**Delivery Alignment & Governance**

* Ensure proposed solutions are realistic, deliverable, and aligned with delivery capabilities and constraints.
* Work closely with delivery architects and engineering teams to govern solution integrity through execution.
* Support transition from pre-sales to delivery, maintaining architectural continuity and intent.

**Technology & Industry Insight**

* Track emerging insurance platforms, core modernization approaches, cloud patterns, data architecture, and AI adoption.
* Apply industry and technology trends to evolve solution approaches and recommend modernization roadmaps.
* Contribute to the definition of new insurance offerings, accelerators, and solution assets.

**Architectural & Domain Expectations**

The Solution Architect is expected to think beyond point solutions, connecting insurer business outcomes to architecture decisions. This includes understanding insurer operating models, regulatory constraints, and modernization paths, and making pragmatic trade-offs that balance innovation with delivery feasibility.

**Required Experience, Skills & Qualifications Experience**

12 to 15 years of experience in insurance solution architecture, consulting, or large-scale transformation roles. Proven experience architecting solutions for insurers across at least two major global markets. Hands-on involvement in presales, solution shaping, and delivery transition for complex insurance engagements.

**Functional & Domain Expertise**

* Strong domain understanding across one or more insurance sub-domains: P&C, Life & Annuities, Specialty, Reinsurance, Pension, and Supplemental Health.
* Solid knowledge of insurance core systems, policy administration, underwriting, claims, billing, and distribution.
* Experience with integration architectures, data platforms, cloud-native solutions, and API-led ecosystems.
* Familiarity with insurance modernization themes such as core replacement, digital experience platforms, data & analytics, and AI-enabled operations.

**Architectural & Collaboration Skills**

* Ability to translate complex architectural concepts into clear, business-friendly explanations.
* Strong collaboration skills across Sales, Industry Leads, Delivery, and Engineering teams.
* Communication & Professional Skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience contributing to executive-level solution narratives.
* Ability to influence solution direction through credibility, clarity, and structured thinking.
* Bachelor's degree required.
* Business architectural qualifications preferred.
* Strong domain knowledge in Insurance

4ddb740f.description:
**Role Overview:**

  

The MES Solution Architect is responsible for end-to-end architecture, design, and delivery of Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions across complex manufacturing environments. The role requires deep expertise in Siemens Opcenter / Camstar platforms, strong understanding of Industry 4.0, and hands-on experience translating manufacturing processes into scalable, integrated digital manufacturing solutions aligned with global standards

  
  

Key Responsibilities

MES Architecture & Standards Alignment

 Architect, design, and lead MES implementations using Siemens Opcenter Core, Electronics, MDD, Semi and/or Delmia Apriso.

 Define MES reference architecture and solution blueprints aligned to ISA-95 and ISA-88 standards.

 Ensure clear separation and integration across ISA-95 levels (ERP, MES/MOM, Control, Field).

 ApplyISA-88 concepts such as equipment models, operations, phases, and recipes where applicable.

 Standardize MES designs formulti-plant and global rollout scenarios.

  
  

Integration & Interoperability

 Design and govern MES–ERP integration (SAP preferred) including master data, production orders, inventory, and quality data.

 LeadCamstar Interoperability (CIO) / MOM module implementations for equipment and ERP integration.

 Develop and manageinbound and outbound messaging, ensuring secure and reliable data exchange.

 Architect shop-floor connectivity with PLC, SCADA, OPC (UA), IoT platforms, and Edge systems

  
  

Cloud, Infrastructure & DevOps

 Design and deploy MES solutions on AWS or Microsoft Azure, including hybrid architectures.

 Define containerized and microservices-based deployments usingDocker, Kubernetes, and DevOps pipelines.

 Collaborate onnetwork design, Windows system administration, cybersecurity, and infrastructure services.

 Design database architectures using Oracle, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL, ensuring performance and scalability

  
  

Development & Low-Code Enablement

 Provide technical leadership for MES customization using .NET, C#, PowerShell, VB, VBScript.

 Oversee development standards, code quality, performance tuning, and maintainability.

 Enable rapid extensions using low-code / no-code platforms (Mendix) for user facing applications and workflows

  
  

Reporting, Analytics & Industry 4.0

 Architectmanufacturing reports, dashboards, and KPIs usingPower BI, SSRS, and Crystal Reports.

 Enablegenealogy, traceability, quality analytics, and production performance monitoring.

 ApplyIndustry 4.0 technologies including IoT, historians, edge computing, cyber security, digital twins, and digital control towers.

 Support smart factory initiatives such as paperless manufacturing and real-time operational visibility

  
  

Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

 Act as a solution authority and technical mentor for MES delivery teams.

 Leadtechnical workshops, solution reviews, and architecture governance.

 Supportpre-sales activities including solution definition, estimations, demos, and customer presentations.

 Collaborate with business, IT, automation, and operations stakeholders to align MES capabilities with business outcomes

  
  

Required Technical Skills MES & Manufacturing Systems

 Strong hands-on and architectural expertise in MES / MOM solutions.

 In-depth knowledge of Siemens Opcenter Core, Opcenter Electronics, Opcenter MDD, Opcenter Semi, Camstar, and/orDelmia Apriso.

 Implementation experience aligned with ISA-95 enterprise–MES–control integration models.

 Practical application of ISA-88 batch/process control concepts in MES design

  
  

Integration & Automation

 ERP integration (preferably SAP).

 Equipment integration using Camstar Interoperability (CIO), OPC, PLC, SCADA, IoT, and Edge technologies.

 Strong understanding of MES inbound and outbound messaging patterns

  
  

Cloud, Infrastructure & Databases

 Cloud platforms:AWS and/or Microsoft Azure.

 Containers, microservices, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines.

 Databases:Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL.

 Expertise innetworking, Windows system administration, and infrastructure services

  
  

Development & Tools

 Programming:.NET, C#,

 Reporting:Power BI, SSRS, Crystal Reports

  
  

Domain Expertise

 Proven experience in one or more manufacturing domains:

o Semiconductor o Electronics / EMS

o Automotive o Medical Devices

o Discrete Manufacturing

20d07c91.title: Solution Architect
20d07c91.description:
Join us as a Solution Architect at Barclays where you will lead solutioning and end-to-end design for projects across the software development lifecycle within Trade & Working Capital Technology, You will own the end-to-end technical and application architecture for your projects, ensure designs comply with architecture standards and governance, and advise senior stakeholders while managing risk and strengthening controls.
  
  
To be successful as a Solution Architect , you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* Experience as a technical Solution Architect, with strong experience creating technical documents such as E2E Design, High Level Design and Architectural Vision, system design
* Strong experience in relevant technologies (Java/.Net/DB)
* Experience in application integration technologies (Streaming services, APIs, Digital).
* Experience in application infrastructure, both on premises, external and Public Cloud (AWS)
* Experience and understanding in AI System design, infrastructure and languages.
* Experience in Project Management, both Agile and Waterfall, and previous evidence of drive, energy, commitment and enthusiasm

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Understanding of the Banking and Financial Services industry and the Trade and Working Capital domain, including experience with financial instruments, deposits, loans and treasury
* Professional certifications, e.g. TOGAF/ Cloud SA
* Strong data and database architecture expertise across enterprise relational and NoSQL platforms, and proven leadership in regulatory-driven design ensuring auditability, traceability, model transparency, and compliance
* Excellent senior stakeholder engagement and technology leadership, including mentoring architects, influencing roadmaps and driving cross-functional alignment

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
The role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To develop, and evolve the banks technology architecture through relevant solutions, strategies and execution plans aligned to and prioritized by business and technology objectives, including the development, evolution and adoption of foundational platforms and products.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development, evolution and implementation of the banks technology architecture and strategies aligned to the business and technology objectives, unlocking execution and run.
* Collaboration with stakeholders, including Enterprise Architecture teams and other developers to provide subject matter expertise and share knowledge to foster continuous improvement, and clients to understand and deliver on their technical needs.
* Motivation and leadership of a diverse collection of technologists, business and operations teams and enterprise leaders, with goal to align business & technology strategy & standards, identifying opportunities and connecting people.
* Assessment of new technologies to address current and future business needs, through a combination of curiosity and problem-solving skills.
* Determination of the optimal solutions while balancing continuous requirements imposed by compliance, governance, security and funding, through deep understanding of the business and customer outcomes and maintaining a strong and steady grasp on the underlying technologies.
* Monitoring and analysis of the performance, resiliency and stability of applications to identify and resolve issues and communicate and document key findings to stakeholders.
* Compliance with applicable regulatory standards and identification of industry developments that may impact the banks operations and controls to enhance the banks application portfolio.
* Support of engineering and architecture community initiatives to mentor team members, streamline operations, share and grow knowledge.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

c53e5bee.title: Solution Architect - Slack exp mandatory
c53e5bee.description:
**Description**
Solution Architect
  
  
Are you a designer and problem-solver who can shape the next generation of delivery excellence at Slack? Are you someone who thrives translating ambiguous customer needs into elegant, workable solutions in a fast-paced, AI-forward environment? We want to talk to you!
  
  
Slack is looking for an Solution Architect on the Solution Design team to join our global project delivery organization supporting enterprise customer implementations. We need someone who is creative, detail-oriented, and technically fluent — someone who shapes the right solution for each Enterprise customer, working within the Salesforce Delivery Methodology, and who helps unlock the full value of the Slack platform (including Slack AI) through thoughtful design.
  
  
You'll design, validate, and document solutions for Enterprise customers across use cases, teams, and geographies — balancing customer needs, platform capabilities, and delivery feasibility.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Own solution design across the Discover, Define, and Design stages of the Salesforce Delivery Methodology, translating customer requirements into clear, buildable solution designs
* Evaluate and recommend the right mix of out-of-the-box Slack/Slack AI capabilities (search & summaries, huddle notes, Workflow Builder, native Slackbot capabilities, Agentforce integrations) versus custom configuration, always favoring the simplest viable path
* Partner closely with Delivery Managers, Technical Architects, and customer stakeholders to align solution design with scope, timeline, and success measures
* Produce and maintain solution design artifacts — architecture diagrams, functional specs, configuration workbooks — that development and QA teams can build against
* Lead design workshops with customer technical and business stakeholders, facilitating trade-off discussions and driving toward a validated solution
* Proactively surface design risks and work cross-functionally to resolve them before they impact delivery
* Continuously improve design practices and reusable design patterns, incorporating AI-native tooling (e.g., Slackbot skills) to increase design efficiency and consistency across engagements
* Identify integration points with Salesforce products (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Agentforce) and design cross-cloud solutions that keep Slack at the center of the customer's workflow
* Support post-launch adoption by ensuring the solution design accounts for change management and long-term platform maturity

What you should have
  
  

* 8-10+ years of solution design, architecture, or technical consulting experience, preferably in SaaS and/or professional services
* Demonstrated experience designing enterprise-scale solutions involving collaboration, workflow, or integration platforms
* Working knowledge of (or ability to quickly ramp on) the Salesforce Delivery Methodology and Slack/Slack AI product capabilities
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguity and competing requirements to land on the right design
* Excellent communication skills for translating technical design decisions to both customer stakeholders and delivery teams
* Hands-on familiarity with integration patterns and API-based architecture, ideally including Salesforce products
* A collaborative mindset — comfortable partnering with Delivery Managers, Technical Architects, and customers to reach a shared design
* Natural curiosity, a love of learning, and a habit of sharing design knowledge and patterns with others
* Familiarity with Salesforce products and how they integrate with Slack (e.g., Agentforce, Sales/Service Cloud notifications) is a plus, though not required

Slack is the collaboration hub of choice for companies of all sizes worldwide — ensuring the right people stay in the loop, key information stays at their fingertips, and teams stay connected, now increasingly powered by Slack AI.

78a28cab.title: Solutions Architect - Insurance
78a28cab.description:
**Role Summary**
The Industry Solution Architect - Insurance is responsible for shaping, designing, and governing end-to-end insurance solutions that align business outcomes with robust, scalable architectures. The role blends deep insurance domain expertise with hands-on solution architecture, ensuring solutions are practical, differentiated, and grounded in real insurer operating models.

The role supports pursuits and programs across major insurance markets including the US, UK, EU, Canada, ANZ, and ASEAN, requiring strong awareness of regional regulatory, operational, and technology considerations.

**Key Responsibilities & Deliverables**

**Solution Architecture & Design**

* Architect end-to-end insurance solutions spanning business processes, core platforms, digital channels, data, integration, and operations.
* Design business solution architectures across P&C, Life & Annuities, Specialty, Reinsurance, Pension, and Supplemental Health.
* Develop functional and technical blueprints that clearly map client requirements to Coforge capabilities, platforms, and delivery models.
* Define business architecture, solution patterns, and reusable assets to support consistency across pursuits and programs.

**Sales & Pursuit Support**

* Partner with Sales, Client Partners, and Industry Leads to support opportunity qualification and solution shaping.
* Contribute proposals, solution sections, executive summaries, and client presentations for strategic deals.
* Participate in client discussions to explain solution approaches, architectural choices, and delivery implications in clear business terms.

**Delivery Alignment & Governance**

* Ensure proposed solutions are realistic, deliverable, and aligned with delivery capabilities and constraints.
* Work closely with delivery architects and engineering teams to govern solution integrity through execution.
* Support transition from pre-sales to delivery, maintaining architectural continuity and intent.

**Technology & Industry Insight**

* Track emerging insurance platforms, core modernization approaches, cloud patterns, data architecture, and AI adoption.
* Apply industry and technology trends to evolve solution approaches and recommend modernization roadmaps.
* Contribute to the definition of new insurance offerings, accelerators, and solution assets.

**Architectural & Domain Expectations**

The Solution Architect is expected to think beyond point solutions, connecting insurer business outcomes to architecture decisions. This includes understanding insurer operating models, regulatory constraints, and modernization paths, and making pragmatic trade-offs that balance innovation with delivery feasibility.

**Required Experience, Skills & Qualifications Experience**

12 to 15 years of experience in insurance solution architecture, consulting, or large-scale transformation roles. Proven experience architecting solutions for insurers across at least two major global markets. Hands-on involvement in presales, solution shaping, and delivery transition for complex insurance engagements.

**Functional & Domain Expertise**

* Strong domain understanding across one or more insurance sub-domains: P&C, Life & Annuities, Specialty, Reinsurance, Pension, and Supplemental Health.
* Solid knowledge of insurance core systems, policy administration, underwriting, claims, billing, and distribution.
* Experience with integration architectures, data platforms, cloud-native solutions, and API-led ecosystems.
* Familiarity with insurance modernization themes such as core replacement, digital experience platforms, data & analytics, and AI-enabled operations.

**Architectural & Collaboration Skills**

* Ability to translate complex architectural concepts into clear, business-friendly explanations.
* Strong collaboration skills across Sales, Industry Leads, Delivery, and Engineering teams.
* Communication & Professional Skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience contributing to executive-level solution narratives.
* Ability to influence solution direction through credibility, clarity, and structured thinking.
* Bachelor's degree required.
* Business architectural qualifications preferred.
* Strong domain knowledge in Insurance

Share resume on vrinda.gupta@coforge.com

Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Technical Architect will have to be execution-focused, support the full implementation lifecycle, from scoping to deployment in an evolving ecosystem consisting of clients and partners. As a Technical Architect, you will become a deep product expert with Industry Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud (including Health Cloud) applications, and work closely with our sales and delivery teams to ensure customer success.
  
  
The Technical Architect will lead the technical design and implementation of Salesforce solutions, ensuring compliance with industry regulations (HIPAA, GxP, etc.) and alignment with business goals. * Architect and design scalable, secure, and high-performance Salesforce solutions that align with industry best practices and compliance standards (e.g., HIPAA, PHI, GxP).

* Lead a team of developers driving optimized solutions across multi-cloud implementations, ensuring seamless integration between Health Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud and Omnistudio framework.

* Lead customer expectations; negotiate solutions to sophisticated problems with both the customer and third-party partners
* Guide our customers, partners, and implementation teams on how best to implement digital transformation with the Salesforce platform using Salesforce Industries.
* Establish trust with the customer's leadership, promoting and/or implementing standard processes with SFI and Salesforce
* Build out sophisticated business processes using native Salesforce Industries technology and the toolkit of the platform and integration tools.
* Research, recommend and implement AppExchange applications and Salesforce upgrades to help meet business needs.
* Successfully create custom enterprise applications using Salesforce and integrate Salesforce with other enterprise systems.
* Work closely with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs.
* Highlight and lead risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion.

**You're Our Person If...**

* 10+ years of experience in developing technology solutions.
* 3+ years of experience in handling client-facing projects in positions of increasing responsibility in the context of systems development and related business consulting.
* Proven experience architecting enterprise-level Salesforce solutions in the life sciences or Veeva product or healthcare industry.
* Strong understanding of compliance and regulatory requirements including HIPAA, GxP, PHI, HL7, and FHIR.
* Expertise in one or multiple domains of Healthcare Providers, Healthcare Payers,Life Science and Pharmaceuticals, Medical Devices, Public health & Government Healthcare programs, Insurance.
* Experience in healthcare domain (Preferred)
* Integration Architecture (Must have)
* Platform Security (Must have)
* Identity and Access Management / Integration Security
* Sharing and Visibility (Must have)
* Data Architecture and Management (Must have)
* Architectural Design Patterns (Must Have)
* Apex Design Patterns (Must Have)
* Salesforce/Apex, Triggers, Lightning Flows, Lightning, LWC, and experience with modern web and mobile technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web Components, others) or Veeva CRm experience
* Salesforce Certification Preferred (Admin, Developer, Sales, and Service Clouds, Application Architect, System Architect)
* OmniStudio Developer/Consultant
* Health Cloud Certification (Good to have).

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. 4d3453e4.title: Salesforce Functional Consultant - Revenue Cloud (CPQ) / Sales & Service Cloud
4d3453e4.description:
**Job Title:** Salesforce Functional Consultant - Revenue Cloud (CPQ) / Sales & Service Cloud

**Location:** Hyderabad

**Experience Required:** 4–6 years

**Role Summary**
----------------

As a Salesforce Functional Consultant with 4 to 6 years of real-time, end-to-end implementation experience, you will own the functional side of Salesforce projects from discovery to go-live and hypercare. You will independently run discovery workshops, manage client communication, translate business needs into solution designs and user stories, and configure the solution yourself. Experience with Salesforce CPQ / Revenue Cloud is preferred; strong Sales Cloud and Service Cloud implementation experience is also welcome. Exposure to Media Cloud, Agentforce and Data Cloud is a strong added advantage, as our upcoming projects include agentic implementations for media and advertising customers.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **End-to-End Project Ownership:** Drive the functional workstream across the full project lifecycle: discovery, requirements, solution design, build, UAT, go-live, hypercare and handover.
* **Discovery Workshops:** Independently plan and run discovery and requirement workshops with client stakeholders. Map current-state (As-Is) and future-state (To-Be) processes, identify gaps and recommend Salesforce-native solutions.
* **Client Communication:** Act as the day-to-day functional point of contact for clients. Run status updates, solution demos and sprint reviews. Manage scope clarifications, change requests and stakeholder expectations without escalation for routine matters.
* **Requirements & Documentation:** Write clear business requirement documents, functional specifications, user stories with acceptance criteria in JIRA, process flows and fit-gap analyses.
* **Revenue Cloud / CPQ Configuration:** Configure product catalogs, bundles, price rules, product rules, discount schedules, quote templates, approvals, amendments and renewals.
* **Sales & Service Cloud Configuration:** Configure lead-to-cash and case-to-resolution processes, including opportunity stages, forecasting, case management, Omni-Channel, entitlements and Lightning Knowledge.
* **Declarative Automation:** Build Flows (screen, record-triggered, scheduled), validation rules, approval processes, dynamic Lightning pages and custom metadata, keeping custom code to a minimum.
* **Security & Data Management:** Configure OWD, roles, profiles, permission sets and sharing rules. Plan and execute data migration, upserts and deduplication using Data Loader.
* **Reporting & Analytics:** Build custom report types, reports and dashboards for business users and leadership.
* **Developer Collaboration:** Identify where Apex/LWC or integrations are needed, write technical-ready stories for developers, and validate the delivered solution against requirements.
* **UAT & Training:** Prepare UAT scripts, run UAT sessions with clients, track defects to closure, and deliver end-user training and documentation.

**Requirements**
----------------

* **Experience:** 4–6 years of hands-on Salesforce functional consulting experience, with at least 2 full-lifecycle implementations delivered for real clients (not only support or enhancement work).
* **Client-Facing Delivery:** Proven experience independently leading discovery workshops and managing client communication on live projects.
* **Declarative Mastery:** Strong hands-on proficiency in Flows, validation rules, approval processes, assignment rules and permission structures.
* **Domain & Process Expertise:** Solid understanding of quote-to-cash, lead-to-cash and/or service center operations.
* **Documentation Skills:** Ability to produce clear BRDs, functional specs, process flows and user stories.
* **Data & Tools Proficiency:** Hands-on experience with Data Loader, JIRA, Confluence and Agile/Scrum delivery.
* **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal English; comfortable presenting to senior client stakeholders.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or a related field.
* **Certifications Required:**
* Salesforce Certified Administrator
* At least one of: Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, or Revenue Cloud / CPQ certification

**Preferred Skills & Qualifications (Added Advantage)**
-------------------------------------------------------

* **Revenue Cloud / CPQ:** Hands-on implementation of Salesforce CPQ or Revenue Cloud, including pricing, quoting, contracts, amendments, renewals or billing.
* **Media Cloud / OmniStudio:** Exposure to Salesforce Media Cloud/Vlocity, OmniStudio (OmniScripts, DataRaptors, FlexCards), subscriber management or digital ad sales processes.
* **Agentforce:** Understanding of Agentforce agents, topics and actions, and the ability to gather requirements and design conversation flows for AI agents.
* **Data Cloud:** Exposure to Data Cloud data streams, unified profiles and segmentation.
* **Specialized Certifications:** Revenue Cloud / CPQ certification, Agentforce Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant, Media Cloud Accredited Professional.
* **Extended Ecosystem:** Experience Cloud portals, CTI tools (e.g., Amazon Connect, Genesys) or CRM Analytics.

**Information Security & ISO 27001 Compliance**
-----------------------------------------------

Security is at the heart of everything we do. In this role, you will be strictly required to uphold our Information Security Management System (ISMS) policies in alignment with ISO/IEC 27001 standards. Responsibilities include safeguarding sensitive asset data, completing mandatory security awareness training, reporting potential security incidents or vulnerabilities immediately, and ensuring that daily operations comply with our rigorous data protection protocols.

e5dba1bc.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Oracle Cloud Security**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an
**Oracle**
**Cloud Security Consultant / OCI Security Architect**
to help organizations design, secure, and govern
**Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**
environments while protecting critical business applications, data, and cloud-native services. The role focuses on OCI security architecture, identity and access management, data protection, cloud governance, posture management, and secure cloud transformation initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and review secure OCI architectures, landing zones, and infrastructure security controls.
* Implement and govern OCI Identity and Access Management (IAM), policies, compartments, and least-privilege access models.
* Assess and improve OCI security posture using cloud security best practices.
* Design and implement data protection controls, including encryption, key management, vault services, and secrets management.
* Support Zero Trust initiatives, network segmentation, and secure connectivity using OCI networking services.
* Conduct OCI security assessments, threat modeling, architecture reviews, and compliance evaluations.
* Enable secure DevSecOps practices and protect CI/CD pipelines deployed within OCI environments.
* Secure Oracle PaaS and SaaS integrations, including database, analytics, and application workloads.
* Support cloud migration and modernization programs by embedding security controls into OCI landing zones and migrated workloads.
* Develop cloud security dashboards, security monitoring use cases, and compliance reporting capabilities.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, database, and business teams to operationalize security controls and remediate identified risks.
* Support incident response, security investigations, and cloud threat detection activities within OCI environments.

**Required Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) services and security capabilities.
* Strong understanding of OCI security architecture, governance, and operational best practices.
* Experience implementing OCI IAM, compartments, dynamic groups, federation, and privileged access controls.
* Knowledge of OCI Cloud Guard, Security Zones, Vault, and Key Management Services (KMS).
* Experience securing OCI networking components, including VCNs, NSGs, security lists, load balancers, and hybrid connectivity.
* Understanding of encryption, key lifecycle management, and secrets management.
* Familiarity with CSPM, cloud governance, and cloud compliance frameworks.
* Knowledge of DevSecOps practices, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and secure CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with cloud monitoring, logging.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Basic understanding of AI and securing AI-enabled cloud workloads.
* OCI certifications such as:
* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional
* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Security Professional
* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CCSK, or CISM.
* Experience supporting large-scale cloud migration, modernization, or Oracle workload transformation programs.
* Knowledge of compliance frameworks such as NIST, CIS Benchmarks, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, and SOC 2.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .

To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Customer Engagement & Technical Leadership

Team Leadership & Development

A team of high performing Solution Architects with diverse and strong technology backgrounds working together to help our ITS and GSI customers make the best of AWS services

* 8+ years of technology solutions development and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing experience
* Experience leading and growing teams of senior technology professionals, ideally in customer facing roles
* Bachelor's degree in mathematics, engineering, statistics, computer science, business administration or a related field
* 4+ years of managing a technical team of solution architects, sales engineers or similar technical roles experience
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc.

* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud

838d8a42.title: Delivery Manager (Technical)
838d8a42.description:
**Role Summary**

The Delivery Manager is responsible for end-to-end client delivery outcomes, operational stability, and account growth within assigned accounts. This is a
**technically hands-on delivery leadership role**
: you will be expected to understand architecture, code quality, environments, and release pipelines well enough to guide engineers, challenge estimates, and lead technical conversations with client stakeholders. The role operationalizes the
**3M Strategy (Manage, Monitor, Mine)**
, ensures adherence to the
**Tiered Operating Model**
, and acts as the primary day-to-day delivery contact for clients. You will work as a
**peer**
with global counterparts, drive client satisfaction, and proactively identify risks and expansion opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **1. Delivery Execution (MANAGE)**
  Own delivery commitments, including SLA tracking and quality assurance, for assigned accounts.
* Lead Agile sprint planning, execution, and demos in coordination with COEs, Solution Architects, and QA teams.
* Ensure hypercare stability (2–4 weeks post go-live) and transition to managed services.
* Manage resource allocation (onshore, nearshore, offshore) based on complexity and cost efficiency.
* Host weekly client delivery status meetings and internal syncs.
* Own major incident resolution, recovery planning, and corrective actions, including leading technical triage and root cause analysis (RCA) with engineering teams.
* Identify and implement process improvements to improve delivery efficiency and predictability.
* **2. Technical Leadership & Quality**
  Review solution designs, technical approaches, and estimates with architects and tech leads; challenge assumptions and flag technical risk early.
* Understand code, branching, CI/CD pipelines, environments, and release processes well enough to unblock teams and validate delivery status.
* Drive engineering quality practices: definition of done, technical debt tracking, and release readiness.
* Translate technical issues into clear business impact for client leadership, and client needs into clear technical direction for teams.
* Evaluate and promote the use of AI-assisted development and testing tools to improve team productivity and quality.
* **3. Risk & Opportunity Monitoring (MONITOR)**
  Continuously monitor client leadership changes, operational shifts, and market dynamics.
* Flag risks early using the
  **Account Health Dashboard (Green/Yellow/Red)**
  .
* Escalate delivery disputes or commercial risks to Delivery Director when thresholds are breached.
* Conduct continuous risk management and quality assurance checks.
* **4. Account Growth Support (MINE)**
  Partner with Account Executive (AE) and Client Success Team to identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities.
* Participate in Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) for key or at-risk accounts.
* Provide delivery health summaries and expansion recommendations to AEs.
* **5. Governance & Reporting**
  Produce
  **weekly status reports**
  rolled up to Delivery Director.
* Use PMO tools, playbooks, and dashboards per organizational standards.
* Co-run internal kickoffs with AE within
  **5 business days**
  of contract signing.
* Lead external client kickoffs within
  **1 business day**
  of tier/PM assignment.
* **6. Peer Collaboration (Global Delivery Model)**
  Operate as a peer with US and India Delivery Managers (no hierarchical silos).
* Participate in
  **weekly delivery health reviews**
  led by Delivery Director.
* Share best practices and resources across the global delivery organization.
* Provide a clean handover and clear escalation path for the hours you are offline, so clients are always covered.
* **7. Availability & Business Needs**
  Provide live support and be reachable for PST clients until approximately 1:00–2:00 AM IST, including client calls, release windows, and urgent escalations.
* Be available to attend the office on short notice when called upon by the business.
* Travel to client sites, delivery centers, or other locations as the need arises.
* **Success Metrics (KPIs)**
  Client satisfaction (CSAT / NPS) for assigned accounts
* Operational stability (missed SLAs < 5%, zero critical incidents without hypercare plan)
* Early risk identification (minimum 2 weeks before client escalation)
* Contribution to account growth (% of identified opportunities converted)
* Adherence to Tiered Model rules (no unauthorized dedicated PM for Tier 2/3)
* Weekly reporting compliance (100% on time)
* Responsiveness during PST coverage hours and quality of handovers
* Release and defect quality (escaped defects, on-time release rate, RCA closure)

**Qualifications**

* **Required**
  8+ years of delivery/project management in IT services or software engineering, with a hands-on technical background (developer, tech lead, architect, or DevOps/QA engineering) of at least 3 years
* Strong technical depth in modern software delivery: system design basics, APIs and integrations, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure), and CI/CD pipelines
* Ability to read and review code or technical designs and hold credible technical discussions with engineers and client architects
* Experience managing multiple clients simultaneously (shared PM model)
* Strong working knowledge of Agile, DevOps, and hybrid delivery models
* Proven ability to work with COEs (e.g., Modern Engineering, Integration, Cloud, ERP)
* Excellent client-facing communication and risk management skills, including experience working with US clients
* Familiarity with tools like Jira, Confluence, DevOps pipelines, and health dashboards
* Willingness and ability to work late-night hours (up to ~1:00–2:00 AM IST) for PST client coverage
* Willingness to come to the office on short notice and to travel as business needs arise
* A dedicated home workspace with reliable internet and power backup for remote work

Must-Have Skills

* Required • 8+ years of delivery/project management in IT services or software engineering, with a hands-on technical background (developer, tech lead, architect, or DevOps/QA engineering) of at least 3 years • Strong technical depth in modern software delivery: system design basics, APIs and integrations, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure), and CI/CD pipelines • Ability to read and review code or technical designs and hold credible technical discussions with engineers and client architects • Experience managing multiple clients simultaneously (shared PM model) • Strong working knowledge of Agile, DevOps, and hybrid delivery models • Proven ability to work with COEs (e.g., Modern Engineering, Integration, Cloud, ERP) • Excellent client-facing communication and risk management skills, including experience working with US clients • Familiarity with tools like Jira, Confluence, DevOps pipelines, and health dashboards

**Job Title: Customer Engagement Manager – AI Data Centers**

**Location: Mumbai / Hybrid.**

**Department: Commercial & Client Solutions / Enterprise Delivery**

**Reports To: AI Datacenter Head / SVP / Director of Customer Engagement & Commercial Delivery**

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a technically adept, client-facing Customer Engagement Manager to serve as the primary strategic interface between our internal design, construction, and operations teams and our hyperscale / enterprise AI clients.

You will lead the end-to-end customer journey—from technical deal structuring and site design customization through core & shell build tracking, liquid cooling layout sign-offs, and final data hall handover. This role requires an individual who can bridge the gap between high-level commercial relationship management and deep technical requirements for 100 kW to 150 kW+ per rack GPU deployments.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Technical Client Onboarding & Design Alignment

Requirement Translation: Act as the direct liaison between customer engineering teams and internal Design/MEP leads to translate high-density AI hardware roadmaps (NVIDIA H100/B200/GB200 clusters) into facility design specifications.

Liquid Cooling & Density Sign-Offs: Guide clients through core & shell layouts, secondary fluid loop handoffs, CDU placement preferences, and in-rack power/cooling boundaries (100 kW–150 kW+ per rack).

Service Level Agreements (SLAs): Co-author and refine technical SLAs, Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) guarantees, and environmental operating parameters within customer leases.

2. Project Buildout & Delivery Governance

Milestone Reporting: Provide enterprise clients with transparent progress updates across Civil/PEB milestones, MEP fit-out, long-lead equipment delivery, and Level 1–5 commissioning sequences.

Customer Change Management: Manage client-requested scope changes, evaluate cost and schedule impacts with the PMO team, and oversee execution of technical variation orders.

Audit & Inspection Facilitation: Organize and lead client technical teams through factory acceptance testing (FAT), field site walk-throughs, and Level 5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST) validations.

3. Relationship Management & Retention

Single Point of Contact (SPOC): Serve as the trusted single point of contact for customer escalations, schedule alignments, and operational readiness reviews.

Post-Handover Transition: Facilitate smooth transitions from construction/commissioning leads to live facility operations teams, ensuring client fit-out and server rack deployment start on time.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

Experience: 8–12+ years in technical customer account management, solutions engineering, or project delivery within hyperscale data centers or cloud infrastructure.

Technical Core: Solid understanding of data center design, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, power distribution (UPS/Busways), and high-density AI rack specifications.

Client Management: Proven track record managing C-suite, engineering, and procurement executives at major hyperscale (cloud) providers or large AI technology enterprises.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or Business/Construction Management.

Key Skills: SLA/MSA contract negotiation, technical client presentation, project progress reporting, change order negotiation, and cross-functional team leadership.

08533e0d.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Infrastructure
08533e0d.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

We are seeking an accomplished, highly self-driven Senior Technical Program Manager to lead programs supporting Rubrik IT's Global Infrastructure and Platform Services (GIPS) organization. Sitting in the central IT PMO, you will own planning and delivery of high-impact, cross-functional programs across Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Platform, Cloud Operations, Network Infrastructure, and Enterprise Identity, etc. You will provide visible leadership, accountability, and governance from intake and prioritization through execution, go-live, and post-implementation optimization.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical program manager with a proven track record delivering complex infrastructure and cloud programs, with deep understanding of Infrastructure, Cloud, SRE and related domains, and also have exceptional communication and collaboration skills to partner effectively with cross functional teams in different geo-locations.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Program Strategy, Delivery & Execution**

* Execute the program roadmap for GIPS domains, aligned with organizational objectives and security requirements.
* Lead multiple concurrent, complex programs across domains such as Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Platform, Cloud Operations, Network Infrastructure, and Enterprise Identity.
* Translate infrastructure and platform goals (reliability, scalability, security posture, cost efficiency, developer and employee experience) into clear program charters, success metrics, and implementation plans.
* Establish program governance, including cadence, forums, decision-making, risk and issue management, and scope control.
* Own the full program lifecycle, from scoping, design, and planning through execution, testing, deployment, and post-go-live optimization.
* Create and own the program plan, including cross-functional deliverables. Negotiate alignment on scope, schedule, and resources with stakeholders, and proactively identify risks and interdependencies to drive mitigations and trade-off decisions.

### **Stakeholders Communication & Engagement**

* Communicate program status, risks, decisions, and outcomes clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
* Drive structured stakeholder engagement through steering committees, executive readouts, business reviews, regular project meetings, and daily stand-ups.
* Track budgets and spend across programs, providing forecasts, variances, and cost-saving opportunities.
* Manage third-party hardware, software, and service vendors to ensure delivery against contracted scope, service levels, and timelines.
* Champion best practices in program management, ITIL processes, and infrastructure lifecycle management, and identify efficiency gains through automation and process improvement.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

Act as a strategic partner to GIPS domain leaders and work closely with cross-functional teams, including:

* **IT Teams:** Partner with the GIPS sub-domain teams and other teams across IT for seamless delivery.
* **Information Security (InfoSec):** Embed security best practices and ensure compliance with security policies.
* **Engineering (R&D):** Collaborate on infrastructure requirements for product development and scalable solutions.

**Experience You'll Need**
--------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* 8+ years of progressive experience in technical program or project management, including at least 5 years delivering infrastructure, cloud, or platform programs.
* Solid background in infrastructure, cloud platforms, or related areas, demonstrated by either hands-on experience in a related technical role or a long track record as a program manager in these domains.
* Proven experience with Agile, Scrum, and hybrid delivery models, and with tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar.
* Proven track record of establishing program governance and driving complex programs to completion in fast-paced environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to define business cases and make data-driven decisions.
* Hands-on proficiency with generative AI tools (e.g. Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) to automate program documentation, risk analysis, and executive reporting, and a track record of integrating AI tools into daily program management.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive).

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Formal program management certifications (e.g., PMP, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Certified Scrum Master).
* Master's degree.
* Experience in high-growth technology or SaaS companies.
* Experience with security and compliance practices in infrastructure programs.

**Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation**
----------------------------------------------------------------------

Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

  

**Inclusion @ Rubrik**
----------------------

At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.

Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.

### **Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:**

* Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.
* Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.
* Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.

**Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled**
------------------------------------------------

Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants in all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, promotion, compensation, training, leave, and termination.

Rubrik provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application process or to perform your job, please contact hr@rubrik.com. bba08e45.title: PRINCIPAL, TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER
bba08e45.description:
**About Team**
US Omni Tech at Walmart Global Tech, Bengaluru, is focused on improving Walmart customer experience across both physical & digital and make Walmart the most exciting place to shop. With 4000+ brick and mortar stores and thousands of other suppliers fulfilling Walmart's online/in-store orders for over 1 billion customers - the challenge and complexity is pronounced! We work within the world’s largest retailer yet maintain a start up feel working in small agile teams to revolutionize the fulfilment landscape. As a leader in the supply chain group, you are accountable and responsible for number of critical products/platforms that helps serve our customers in the most cost-effective manner in multiple geographies and businesses.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Your main responsibilities will revolve around managing large software development projects.
  
  
You will work closely with architects and engineering leaders to ensure the successful completion of these projects. To do this, you will need to have a deep understanding of software architecture and contribute to architectural decision-making processes.
  
  
You will also need to build strong relationships with stakeholders across Walmart, ensuring alignment on roles, responsibilities, and project cadences.
  
  
Your role will involve defining goals, stage gates, critical delivery paths, and key deliverables for large-scale programs that incorporate multiple programs with dependencies across multiple areas of work, timelines, and resource constraints.
  
  
Efficient engineering resource utilization and delivery will be a priority, and you will need to simplify and clarify priorities and create plans with appropriate milestones for advance planning and executive buy-in.
  
  
You will also establish a resource capacity allocation process and tool to transform the planning process.
  
  
Your problem-solving and decision-making skills will be crucial in navigating any setbacks or obstacles that may arise.
  
  
Overall, as a seasoned professional, your expertise and passion for driving technical projects to success will be invaluable in this role at Walmart Global Tech.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**
A bachelor’s degree in computer science/engineering or equivalent.
  
  
Overall around 18+years of technical experience with 10+ years of leadership experience as a Technical Program Manager in software delivery within a related industry managing aggressive schedules and significant business impact.
  
  
Strong leadership skills, with the ability to effectively manage and motivate a team of technical program managers and engineers.
  
  
Experience supporting and executing a large software portfolio, collaborating with multiple business stakeholders.
  
  
Experienced in system/platform design concepts, architecture, technical design, services, APIs, and technologies.
  
  
Build positive relationships and collaborate with product managers to understand target personas and business process needs, which you will then translate into features and user stories that engineers will leverage to iterate products quickly.
  
  
Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a love for data and solving complex problems.
  
  
Expertise in change & risk management methodologies, project management tools, techniques, project tracking tools, dashboards, and reports
  
  
Strong communicator in both verbal and written forms and are equally adept in communicating upwards, outwards, and downward.
  
  
Deep understanding of JIRA, JIRA Align, Big Picture, Airtable etc.
  
  
**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**

0249ad50.description:

ab8cacc1.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Infrastructure
ab8cacc1.description:
**About The Role**
We are seeking an accomplished, highly self-driven Senior Technical Program Manager to lead programs supporting Rubrik IT's Global Infrastructure and Platform Services (GIPS) organization. Sitting in the central IT PMO, you will own planning and delivery of high-impact, cross-functional programs across Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Platform, Cloud Operations, Network Infrastructure, and Enterprise Identity, etc. You will provide visible leadership, accountability, and governance from intake and prioritization through execution, go-live, and post-implementation optimization.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical program manager with a proven track record delivering complex infrastructure and cloud programs, with deep understanding of Infrastructure, Cloud, SRE and related domains, and also have exceptional communication and collaboration skills to partner effectively with cross functional teams in different geo-locations.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Program Strategy, Delivery & Execution
  
  

* Execute the program roadmap for GIPS domains, aligned with organizational objectives and security requirements.
* Lead multiple concurrent, complex programs across domains such as Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Platform, Cloud Operations, Network Infrastructure, and Enterprise Identity.
* Translate infrastructure and platform goals (reliability, scalability, security posture, cost efficiency, developer and employee experience) into clear program charters, success metrics, and implementation plans.
* Establish program governance, including cadence, forums, decision-making, risk and issue management, and scope control.
* Own the full program lifecycle, from scoping, design, and planning through execution, testing, deployment, and post-go-live optimization.
* Create and own the program plan, including cross-functional deliverables. Negotiate alignment on scope, schedule, and resources with stakeholders, and proactively identify risks and interdependencies to drive mitigations and trade-off decisions.

Stakeholders Communication & Engagement
  
  

* Communicate program status, risks, decisions, and outcomes clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
* Drive structured stakeholder engagement through steering committees, executive readouts, business reviews, regular project meetings, and daily stand-ups.
* Track budgets and spend across programs, providing forecasts, variances, and cost-saving opportunities.
* Manage third-party hardware, software, and service vendors to ensure delivery against contracted scope, service levels, and timelines.
* Champion best practices in program management, ITIL processes, and infrastructure lifecycle management, and identify efficiency gains through automation and process improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  
Act as a strategic partner to GIPS domain leaders and work closely with cross-functional teams, including:
  
  

* IT Teams: Partner with the GIPS sub-domain teams and other teams across IT for seamless delivery.
* Information Security (InfoSec): Embed security best practices and ensure compliance with security policies.
* Engineering (R&D): Collaborate on infrastructure requirements for product development and scalable solutions.

Experience You'll Need
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* 8+ years of progressive experience in technical program or project management, including at least 5 years delivering infrastructure, cloud, or platform programs.
* Solid background in infrastructure, cloud platforms, or related areas, demonstrated by either hands-on experience in a related technical role or a long track record as a program manager in these domains.
* Proven experience with Agile, Scrum, and hybrid delivery models, and with tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar.
* Proven track record of establishing program governance and driving complex programs to completion in fast-paced environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to define business cases and make data-driven decisions.
* Hands-on proficiency with generative AI tools (e.g. Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) to automate program documentation, risk analysis, and executive reporting, and a track record of integrating AI tools into daily program management.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Formal program management certifications (e.g., PMP, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Certified Scrum Master).
* Master's degree.
* Experience in high-growth technology or SaaS companies.
* Experience with security and compliance practices in infrastructure programs.

Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation
  
  
Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.

* Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.

da7ad943.description:
**Role Objective**

The Telecalling Executive will be the engine of our sales funnel. You will manage a high volume of incoming interest, ensuring every lead is contacted promptly, vetted for quality, and categorized within our CRM. Your success is measured by the accuracy of your lead profiling and the efficiency of your handovers to the senior sales team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **High-Volume Outreach:** Manage a daily flow of **75–100 leads**, ensuring rapid response times to maintain lead "warmth."
* **Dual-Sector Profiling:** Qualify leads across both **Luxury Residential** and **Commercial Real Estate** portfolios based on budget, intent, and location preference.

4f6fce8b.title: Sr Solution Sales - AI Platform
4f6fce8b.description:
Lexsi Lab is a frontier AI research lab and platform company building the
****AI Engineering Layer for mission-critical AI****

. We help enterprises turn open and closed models into
****governed, auditable, production-grade systems****

without vendor or infrastructure lock-in.

Founded by pioneers in deep learning, with research hubs in Mumbai and Paris, Lexsi operates at the intersection of
****AI safety, interpretability, alignment, and systems engineering****

. Our work is published at top-tier venues (ICML, IJCNN, WWW, ACL), and our patented technologies, such as
****DL-Backtrace****

, enable explainability and auditability at a scale that enterprise AI demands.

Our customers deploy AI in environments where failures are expensive, regulation is real, and evidence matters: banking, financial services, insurance, and other high-risk domains.

The Role

We are looking for a
****Senior AI Solutions Architect****

to lead strategic, high-value customer engagements and support large enterprise transactions. This is a senior, customer-facing pre-sales role for someone who combines
****deep AI understanding, system-level thinking, and executive communication skills****

.

You will work closely with sales leadership, researchers, and engineers to shape deals from first conversation to closure. You will regularly engage with CXOs, Heads of AI, Risk, and Engineering, helping them understand how to build
****sovereign, governed, and defensible AI systems****

using Lexsi’s platform and research-led primitives.

This role is not about running delivery projects. It is about
****owning technical credibility in complex sales cycles****

.

What You’ll Do

You will lead technical discovery, solution design, and executive-level presentations for large, multi-stakeholder customers across Europe, the Middle East, and South Asia. You will frame customer problems around AI sovereignty, risk, governance, cost, and control, and translate them into clear architectures and evidence-backed solutions.

You will own the technical narrative in proposals, RFPs, and regulatory questionnaires, working closely with internal research and engineering teams to ensure accuracy, rigor, and feasibility. You will support advanced demos and proofs-of-concept, and help customers understand how Lexsi enables governed LLM gateways, explainability at scale, alignment and fine-tuning pipelines, and runtime observability.

Internally, you will act as the voice of the customer, feeding structured insights back into product, platform, and go-to-market strategy.

Who You Are

You have significant experience working with AI systems and have spent time in
****pre-sales, solution architecture, or technical consulting roles****

tied to complex enterprise deals. You have built or shipped AI products and understand modern ML systems beyond surface-level tooling.

You are comfortable discussing topics such as explainability, alignment, evaluation, and deployment trade-offs with both researchers and senior enterprise stakeholders. You can walk into a high-stakes meeting and clearly explain why governance, auditability, and model optionality matter, without losing the room in technical detail.

You write clearly, present confidently, and operate well in ambiguity. You enjoy shaping solutions rather than following scripts.

Why This Role at Lexsi

You will work at the frontier of
****trustworthy and mission-critical AI****

, influencing how advanced research is adopted in real enterprises. You will play a visible role in large strategic deals and help define how Lexsi is positioned with regulators, banks, and global institutions.

This is a role for someone who wants to sit where
****research, product, and revenue intersect****

, and who enjoys being trusted with conversations that actually matter.
