62dbbd4e.title: Security Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
62dbbd4e.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in cybersecurity, with a focus on application security, secure Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices, and vulnerability management, particularly within cloud-native or hybrid environments.
* Experience with cloud and software development.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related technical field.
* Experience with AI-powered security tools for automated vulnerability detection, exploit generation, and code fix remediation.
* Experience in a customer-facing technical role, delivering product and solution briefings, partnering with security leaders and technical teams, and optimizing for production results.
* Understanding of the impact of AI on both offensive and defensive security strategies, including how AI can be leveraged to exploit binaries and firmware as source code.
* Familiarity with platforms for deploying and managing security agents or AI models for security applications, particularly in code analysis and remediation workflows.

**About the job**
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
  
  
As a Customer Engineer, you will help grow our cyber security business by building and expanding relationships with new and existing customers. You will be a trusted advisor to customers and an advocate for our security solutions. You will provide support to C-level, security leaders, cloud security architects and security analysts, using both technical and business skill sets to lead projects forward. You will accompany customers in discovering the technology/solution and consult around the best way to secure and ensure compliance. You will optimize for results when in production, leading with empathy, while identifying innovative ways to multiply the impact of the team.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Work with the team to identify and qualify business opportunities, understand customer technical objections, and develop the strategy to resolve technical blockers.
* Work directly with customers to demonstrate and prototype Google Cloud product integrations in customer/partner environments.
* Recommend integration strategies, enterprise architectures, platforms, and application infrastructure required to complete solutions using best practices on Google Cloud.
* Share security experience to support the technical relationship with customers, including product and solution briefings and proof-of-concept work, partnering with product management to prioritize solutions impacting customer engagement with Google Cloud.
* Support customer-facing presentations and conduct workshops to share the experience and be a subject matter expert on cyber security.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

974229dc.title: Sr. Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India - HCLS
974229dc.description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect in AWS Industries HCLS segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud and AI architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
  
  
You will partner some of the worlds largest companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a small set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind-share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.
  
  
**Here Are Some Other Qualities We Are Looking For**
Enjoy working with large, global customers as an active contributor to a diverse team. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
  
  
Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
* Architect AI-ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS
* In partnership with the account management team, formulate and execute a strategy
* Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
* Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
* Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community
* Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers
* Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
* Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

A day in the life
  
  

* Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
* Develop proof-of-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
* Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
* Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
* Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures

**About The Team**
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
  
  
The HCLS Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic Healthcare and Life Sciences accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in a professional field

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**PeopleCert**
 is looking for a 
**Director-ITIL (Presales)**
to provide ITIL subject matter expertise to the global ITIL ecosystem (including Business Development, ITIL Ambassadors, training organizations, universities, Governments, and corporations). This role sits in the intersection between Business Development, Product, and Marketing. This is a global role with travel expected, and the successful candidate can be located anywhere.

* Connecting with corporates, government entities and other professional organizations to help grow the awareness and the market size of the ITIL products.
* Working closely with global ITIL Business Development to sell more ITIL products.
* Working closely with Product Management, and Product Development to provide input to content development
* Working closely with global Marketing to promote the ITIL brand
* Supporting the ITIL partner organizations with client calls, sales enablement activities, marketing support and other resources to sell more ITIL products.

* Inspiring and motivating the ITIL ecosystem, including ITIL Ambassadors, and the official ITIL Community Group.
* Forging and nurturing high-impact relationships with senior decision-makers in the ecosystem to promote ITIL products.
* Participating in conferences, ITIL education events, and strategic forums promoting ITIL.
* Collaborating group-wide (inc. LanguageCert, ITIL, City & Guilds, DevOps) to drive group-wide performance.
* Providing input (as required) to PeopleCert reports and business updates
* Ensure alignment with company values — Quality, Innovation, Passion, Integrity, Clarity, and Velocity.

* 10+ years' experience working with ITIL products. This includes real-world consulting and/or practitioner experience beyond just providing training courses
* Understanding of other digital product and service management products, such as COBIT, IT4IT, ISO20001.  Established record of working with the bodies that own or promote these products is an advantage
* Extensive understanding of ITIL training partner organizations.

* Extensive experience of undertaking webinars, speaking at conferences, and other marketing activities

* Work in an international, dynamic and fun atmosphere
* Two free vouchers for all certifications from PeopleCert's Portfolio per year for all employees
* Huge learning experience in using best practices and global environment
* Constant personal and professional development

7d2e8135.title: Customer Solutions Engineer - Forward Deployment Engineering
7d2e8135.description:
Customer Solutions Engineer - Forward Deployment Engineering

Company: KAVIA AI

Location: India — Remote

Type: Full-time

Reports to: Chief Operating Officer and Head of Customer Solutions Engineering

Experience: 4–8 years

Compensation: INR 20,00,000 to INR 28,00,000 annual CTC, based on background, experience, and demonstrated customer-facing technical ownership

About KAVIA AI

KAVIA AI is an enterprise software company building the enterprise software engineering platform for complex codebases.

We help engineering teams understand, plan, change, and validate large software systems. KAVIA connects code understanding, workflow automation, artifact generation, reviewable code, and validation across repositories and environments.

Our platform is used by enterprise teams working on consequential software systems. As KAVIA’s product and customer footprint grow, we are expanding the customer engineering capability that turns difficult technical use cases into successful pilots and production adoption.

The Role

This is a hands-on, customer-facing engineering role at a growing enterprise software company. At KAVIA, the Customer Solutions Engineer serves as a Forward Deployed Engineer: part software engineer, part technical problem solver, and part pilot owner.

Reporting to KAVIA’s Chief Operating Officer and Head of Customer Solutions Engineering, you will work closely with enterprise engineering customers, KAVIA’s product and engineering teams, and company leadership. You will understand a customer’s codebase and operating constraints, demonstrate KAVIA against the right problem, translate that problem into a tightly scoped pilot, and stay accountable through technical validation.

Success in this role is not measured by the number of demos delivered. It is measured by whether KAVIA earns technical confidence: the right problem is selected, the evaluation is credible, blockers are resolved, results are documented, and the customer can make an informed production decision.

This is not a conventional sales-engineering role built around standard demonstrations, and it is not a support role limited to routing issues. You must be comfortable reading unfamiliar code, working directly in technical environments, and communicating clearly with both engineers and senior stakeholders. The role requires regular overlap with US and European business hours and may include occasional customer travel.

What You’ll Do

Lead Technical Discovery

* Run structured discovery with engineering leaders, architects, developers, and other technical stakeholders.
* Understand the customer’s codebase, architecture, repositories, build and test systems, development workflow, constraints, and desired outcome.
* Separate the stated request from the underlying engineering problem, and identify where KAVIA can create measurable value.
* Surface dependencies, security or deployment requirements, data-access constraints, technical risks, and decision criteria early.
* Determine whether an opportunity is technically ready for a demonstration or pilot, and say so clearly when it is not.

Prepare and Deliver Tailored Demonstrations

* Design demonstrations around the customer’s actual use case rather than rely on a generic product walkthrough.
* Select representative code, workflows, and evidence that make KAVIA’s value understandable and technically credible.
* Configure and test the demonstration environment, anticipate likely questions, and prepare recovery paths when live systems behave unexpectedly.
* Explain KAVIA’s reasoning, outputs, limitations, and deployment options with precision and without overclaiming.
* Capture questions and objections, follow up with clear technical answers, and identify what must be proven next.

Convert Use Cases into Well-Scoped Pilots

* Translate discovery into a concise pilot definition with a clear problem statement, scope, inputs, deliverables, responsibilities, dependencies, schedule, and acceptance criteria.
* Define success measures that compare KAVIA-assisted work with the customer’s current process, including time, effort, quality, completeness, or validation outcomes where appropriate.
* Keep pilots narrow enough to execute quickly while meaningful enough to support a purchase or deployment decision.
* Align customer and internal stakeholders on what is in scope, what is not, and what evidence will constitute success before work begins.

Own Pilot Execution and Resolve Technical Blockers

* Serve as the technical owner for assigned pilots from kickoff through final validation.
* Work directly with repositories, manifests, branches, build systems, APIs, development environments, and deployment configurations as required by the engagement.
* Use KAVIA hands-on to investigate the customer’s problem, generate or review outputs, and validate results against agreed criteria.
* Diagnose blockers, distinguish product issues from environment or integration issues, and coordinate the right engineering response without losing momentum.
* Maintain a clear execution plan, technical decision log, risk list, and next action for every active pilot.
* Escalate product gaps and delivery risks early, with enough evidence for engineering and leadership to act.

Move Customers to Technical Validation

* Design and run the final validation against the agreed acceptance criteria, including build, test, review, or workflow evidence where applicable.
* Present results honestly, including what worked, what remains unresolved, and what would be required for production use.
* Quantify before-and-after outcomes when the evidence supports them and avoid unsupported or inflated claims.
* Produce the technical readout, recommendations, open issues, and proposed next step needed for the customer and KAVIA to make a decision.
* Support the transition from successful pilot to deployment, expansion, or a clearly defined follow-on phase.

Turn Customer Learning into Reusable Assets

* Write concise technical follow-ups, solution notes, pilot plans, validation summaries, runbooks, and implementation guidance.
* Contribute credible technical evidence and approved results to case studies, sales collateral, product documentation, and enablement material.
* Convert repeated customer patterns into reusable demo assets, pilot templates, checklists, and internal playbooks.
* Bring structured customer feedback to product and engineering, distinguishing one-off requests from broadly valuable product improvements.
* Help improve KAVIA’s customer-engineering methods as the company builds a repeatable enterprise adoption motion.

What We’re Looking For

Required

* 4–8 years of professional software engineering, solutions engineering, implementation engineering, or forward deployment engineering experience, with substantial hands-on technical ownership.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals and production experience in at least one widely used programming language such as Python, Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, C, or C++.
* Ability to enter an unfamiliar codebase, form a useful system model, trace dependencies, diagnose failures, and make progress without a fully specified playbook.
* Working knowledge of Git-based development, APIs, build and test workflows, CI/CD, containers, cloud or on-premises environments, and modern software delivery practices.
* Experience leading technical discovery, demonstrations, proofs of concept, pilots, implementations, or similarly bounded customer engagements.
* Ability to translate an ambiguous customer problem into a clear technical plan, measurable success criteria, and disciplined execution.
* Strong written and spoken English, including the ability to explain complex technical matters to engineers, executives, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Sound judgment under pressure, intellectual honesty about product limitations, and the confidence to challenge an unworkable scope or unsupported claim.
* Strong project ownership, including action tracking, risk management, documentation, follow-through, and timely escalation.
* Ability to maintain dependable overlap with US or European business hours when customer meetings and pilot execution require it.
* Comfort working in a startup environment where priorities change, processes are still being built, and customer outcomes matter more than role boundaries.

Strong Plus

* Experience with enterprise developer tools, AI-assisted software engineering, code intelligence, software modernization, testing, or engineering productivity platforms.
* Experience with complex brownfield systems, multi-repository codebases, embedded Linux, Android, Yocto, RDK, OpenWrt, automotive software, telecom software, or similar platform environments.
* Experience designing secure enterprise deployments, including customer-controlled cloud, self-hosted, restricted-network, or air-gapped environments.
* Experience working with large language models, agentic workflows, retrieval systems, knowledge graphs, or evaluation frameworks.
* Experience gathering defensible before-and-after metrics and presenting technical validation results to enterprise decision-makers.
* Experience working across product, engineering, sales, and customer teams without losing clarity about technical ownership.
* Startup experience or a record of building repeatable methods from early customer engagements.

A Note from KAVIA

We are not looking for someone who has used every technology or worked in every domain listed above.

We are looking for a strong, hands-on engineer who can earn trust with enterprise customers, bring structure to ambiguous technical work, and stay accountable until the customer has credible evidence. Applicants with demonstrated engineering depth and customer-facing ownership are encouraged to apply, even if their current title is not Customer Solutions Engineer or Forward Deployment Engineer.

How to Apply

* Please apply with your resume and a short note addressing the following: Your current location in India and your ability to maintain regular overlap with US business hours.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeKv92ccKCbznHuF8fh5V\_6M1FuhEoMuyBPZJU2Wn5TzpRv5Q/viewform?usp=header

We are seeking an experienced **Sr. Solution Finance Architect** to lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and functional support of Oracle Cloud Financials for global projects. * Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Experience deploying structured practitioner enablement frameworks, certification programs, or readiness portals at scale.
* Track record of using AI and agentic capabilities to increase personal productivity and impact in daily workflows.
* Ability to influence senior partner practice directors, delivery executives, and cross-functional leadership across Sales, PSO, and Engineering.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Equipped with your business acumen and extensive product knowledge, you are right on the front line of interacting with our partners, and helping them find ways to grow using Google's newest product offerings. Your knowledge of relevant verticals and relationships with key industry players will help shape our great applications and content for products such as YouTube, Google TV and Commerce.

As the Partner Delivery Excellence Lead, you will serve as the principal embedded delivery authority based out of one of our primary tech hubs (Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai or Gurgaon). You will sit directly within strategic Global System Integrators' (GSIs) delivery environments, partnering shoulder-to-shoulder with GSI Google Cloud Platform(GCP) Practice Leaders, Delivery Executives, and Lead Architects. Your core objective is to ensure active GSI-led customer deployments are executing flawlessly without risk of failure, milestone slip, or architectural drift.  
  
Bringing deep technical depth in Google Cloud, Data & Analytics and Artificial Intelligence (GenAI/Agentic Workflows), you will monitor project health telemetry, identify early delivery friction, and serve as the critical bridge to internal Google stakeholders, mobilizing Professional Services (PSO), Customer Engineering (CE) and Partner Leadership to deploy rapid remediation before issues escalate to the customer. Additionally, you will advocate delivery upskilling across thousands of GSI practitioners, driving adoption of Google Cloud’s Delivery Readiness Portal (DRP), Delivery Navigator (DelNav), reference architectures, and safeguarding programs.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Serve as the embedded Google Cloud delivery authority within partner Global Delivery Centers (GDCs), establishing operational oversight across enterprise cloud transformation engagements to safeguard architectural integrity and milestone adherence.
* Identify technical roadblocks and delivery risks early, mobilizing cross-functional Google Cloud teams (PSO, Support, Partner Development Managers, Customer Engineering) to execute closed-loop remediation before issues impact customers.
* Provide authoritative architectural guidance across Data & Analytics and AI/ML (Vertex AI, agentic workflows), validating partner delivery approaches on complex, mission-critical workloads.
* Drive programmatic enablement across partner delivery benches utilizing Google Cloud readiness assets, Delivery Navigator runbooks, and safeguarding programs.
* Synthesize delivery patterns and partner capabilities back to Center of Excellence (CoE) and PSO teams, informing joint service offerings and governance policies.

**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Are you an experienced Cloud architect/developer who can assist our customers in Application modernization, Design and development of cloud native applications and/or re-engineering applications that can fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like to work on a variety of game changing projects, at the forefront of application development and cloud technology adoption? This role is open for Delhi/NCR.
  
  
As an architect you would champion applications to be cloud optimized by making them well-architected ,enabling them to reap the benefits of elasticity, horizontal scalability, automation and high availability. You should have a knack of GenAI tooling to driving application modernization at scale with GenAI tools.
  
  
On the AWS platform services such as Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling, Elastic Load Balancing, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Amazon Elastic Container Services to name just a few, provide opportunities to design and build cloud ready applications.
  
  
AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands on technical architects to help accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. This is an opportunity to join Amazon’s world class technical teams, working with some of the brightest engineers while also developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies.
  
  
Professional Services engage in a wide variety of projects for internal customers and partners, providing collective experience from across the AWS customer base and are obsessed about success for the internal customers. Our team collaborates across the entire AWS organization to bring access to product and service teams, to get the right solution delivered and drive feature innovation based upon customer needs.
  
  
Amazon aims to be the most customer centric company on earth. Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers critical applications for hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands on Mig and Mod (MM) Architects with:
  
  

* Strong Consulting, client-facing (CXO) level communication driving cloud solutioning and leading technical workshops
* Ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders into implementable solution adhering to well architected framework.
* Problem-solving and analytical thinking driving envisioning , presales and be a thought leader in the domain driving Application discovery , Risk mitigation strategies, Performance testing and validation, Migration and Post-migration optimization
* Deep expertise in large scale cloud migrations, and AWS infrastructure to drive complex cloud transformation journey from Onprem successfully modernizing them to help realize true value from cloud
* Deep expertise in VMware technologies having worked on vSphere administration, vCenter management, NSX networking, vSAN storage, HCX for migrations, VMware Cloud on AWS
* Ability to drive Migration discovery to Mobilize to lead and drive Migration and Modernization end to end.
* Strong experience on Cloud Infra, network, Security and cloud resiliency (DR)
* Ability to modernize application in .Net, Java, Python and get them out of legacy framework to realize true potential of cloud
* hand-on experience in designing and developing web applications, APIs, microservices, and data integrations for cloud native applications
* Knowledge of cloud-native design patterns, including microservices architecture and event-driven systems.
* Demonstrated experience building scalable and highly available applications on AWS, leveraging services such as Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, etc.
* Preferred experience in optimizing cloud-based architectures for scalability, security, and high performance.
* Experience working in Agile development environments, with a strong focus on iterative delivery and continuous improvement.
* Ability to advise on and implement AWS best practices across application development, deployment, and monitoring

**Additional Desired Skills**

* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
* Scripting (Python, PowerShell)
* CI/CD pipelines
* Programming Skill with Java, .Net
* Container technologies
* Database migrations
* Knowledge of compliance frameworks
* Multi-cloud experience

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
* Knowledge of security and compliance standards including HIPAA and GDPR
* Knowledge of at least one programming language such as Java, C#, JavaScript, Python, Ruby or Perl
* 3+ years of continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) experience
* Experience in Kubernetes, Docker or containers ecosystem, or experience in software development
* Experience in database (eg. SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with fully automated machine training (automatic re-training, automatic testing)

At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance-based incentive programs, a family-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

 **Position Responsibilities:**

* Lead and execute the strategy to build highly reliable and scalable data and analytics cloud platforms to ensure the business requirements are met

* 2+ years of experience implementing self-service analytics platforms using modern BI tools and APIs that empower business users with governed access to trusted data
* 3+ years of experience in Data Science, Statistics, Machine Learning and GenAI

dbce7bcb.title: Service Delivery Manager
dbce7bcb.description:
**Hello,**
**FCM part of FCTG**
is one of the world’s largest travel management companies and a trusted partner for nationals and multinational companies. With a 24/7 reach in 97 countries, FCM’s flexible technology anticipates and solves client needs, supported by experts who provide in-depth local knowledge and duty of care as part of the ultimate personalised business travel experience.
  
  
As part of the ASX-listed Flight Centre Travel Group, FCM delivers the best market-wide rates, unique added-value benefits, and exclusive solutions.
  
  
**Winner of the World's Leading Travel Management Company Award at the WTM for nine consecutive years (2019-2011),**
FCM is constantly transforming the business of travel through its empowered and accountable people who deliver 24/7 service and are available online and offline. FCM has won the coveted
**Great Place to Work certification for the fifth time**
! FCM Travel India is one of India’s Top 100 Great Mid-size Workplaces 2024 and the Best in Professional Services.
  
  
A leader in the travel tech space, FCM has proprietary client solutions. FCM provides specialist services via FCM Consulting and FCM Meetings & Events.
  
  
**Summary**
The Service Delivery Manager is the local manager for Techlab team members and is responsible for service delivery governance across assigned technology business units, local people processes, recruitment, and the transition of services or modules to the local team. Global stakeholders (Product Managers, Product Owners, Technical Leads and Engineering Managers) own delivery priorities, work assignment and day-to-day direction, and treat global and local members as one team. The role ensures services are delivered with high quality, strong stakeholder engagement, effective resource utilisation and consistent operational governance, risks and issues are proactively managed, team members are well supported, and agreed service and delivery outcomes are achieved.
  
  
**Day In The Life**
**Service Delivery Leadership**

* Own service delivery governance across assigned business units, ensuring delivery commitments, priorities and outcomes are clearly understood and achieved. Priorities and work assignment for work directed by global stakeholders remain with those stakeholders; the SDM is accountable for operational delivery of services fully transitioned to the local team.
* Establish effective delivery governance, operating rhythms and performance reporting across multiple teams and workstreams.
* Ensure delivery is aligned with business objectives, customer expectations and agreed service commitments.
* Support accountability across delivery teams by proactively raising blockers, dependencies, risks and issues with the responsible stakeholders and escalating where needed.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong, trusted relationships with business stakeholders, technology leaders, product owners, project managers and delivery teams.
* Act as a key point of contact for service and delivery-related matters, providing clear and transparent communication on progress, capacity, risks and priorities.
* Facilitate regular stakeholder reviews, QBRs and delivery forums, ensuring actions and decisions are documented and followed through.
* Understand stakeholder needs and translate them into clear local actions, resourcing requirements and actionable outcomes, without altering task priorities set by global stakeholders.
* Run a fortnightly or monthly cadence with global stakeholders (Product Managers, Product Owners, Technical Leads and Engineering Managers); collect, consolidate and track feedback on local team members.
* Attend sprint demos and reviews to understand what and how the team is delivering, so that feedback and coaching are well informed.
* Align with stakeholders on workforce and capacity risks (attrition, planned absences, hiring needs) and remain reliably available for cross-time-zone calls and escalations.
* Partner with vendors and outgoing teams during transitions, managing expectations on timelines, scope and handover quality.

**Project & Delivery Management**

* Support delivery of projects and initiatives across multiple technology teams through demos, reviews and Jira dashboards (read-only), ensuring scope, timelines, dependencies, risks and outcomes are visible and actively managed with the responsible stakeholders.
* Coordinate local capacity, availability and resourcing across multiple concurrent initiatives, working with global stakeholders who own prioritisation and work assignment.
* Apply Agile, Lean and appropriate project management practices to improve predictability, flow and delivery outcomes.
* Monitor delivery milestones, capacity and key performance indicators and drive corrective action through the responsible stakeholders where required.

**Resource & Capacity Management**

* Plan and optimise local team capacity, availability and rosters across competing priorities and workstreams, in partnership with global stakeholders who direct work allocation.
* Identify resource constraints, capability gaps and emerging capacity requirements and work with leadership to address them.
* Support workforce planning, recruitment requirements and effective utilisation of delivery resources.
* Work with team leaders and managers to ensure appropriate skills, coverage and succession plans are in place.

**Service Quality, Governance & Risk**

* Establish and maintain delivery governance, standards and controls to ensure consistent and high-quality outcomes.
* Track KPIs, service performance, delivery health, risks, issues and dependencies, providing timely escalation and resolution.
* Drive effective risk and issue management, ensuring mitigation and recovery plans are established for material delivery risks.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, SOPs, knowledge transfer and operational readiness are maintained.

**Continuous Improvement & Transformation**

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve delivery efficiency, quality, customer experience and team effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve automation, reduce operational friction and strengthen delivery maturity.
* Promote adoption of Agile, Lean, DevOps and other relevant delivery practices where appropriate.
* Use delivery data, stakeholder feedback and operational insights to identify and implement measurable improvements.
* Use Jira workflows and dashboards (as a read-only observer) to understand team flow, workload and delivery health.
* Model responsible use of AI tools and apply them to feedback summarisation, reporting, documentation and pipeline tracking.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach and mentor delivery professionals and team leaders, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous learning.
* Develop high-performing teams through regular feedback, capability development and clear performance expectations.
* Create an environment that encourages ownership, innovation, knowledge sharing and customer-centric behaviour.
* Support effective change management and help teams adapt to evolving business and technology priorities.
* Coach team members on productivity and effectiveness, particularly when the need arises from stakeholder feedback, in partnership with the stakeholders concerned.

**Transition to Operations and Service / Module Transition**

* Ensure projects and technology initiatives have appropriate transition plans before moving into production or ongoing service operations.
* Coordinate with service operations and support teams to ensure effective handover, documentation, training and knowledge transfer.
* Ensure operational readiness, support ownership and post-implementation activities are clearly defined.

*Where a service or module moves from a vendor or global team to the local team for full ownership, the SDM owns the transition end to end.*

* Plan: Define scope with the outgoing party, build the transition plan (knowledge transfer, shadowing, reverse shadowing, handover) and align contractual aspects with vendor management, procurement and legal where relevant.
* Resourcing: Assess skills and capacity, identify owners, plan hiring ahead of need, arrange training, and manage key-person dependencies and workload impact on individuals.
* Governance: Run regular checkpoints, track milestones and risks, hold the outgoing party to its obligations, and ensure access, environments, tooling and compliance are in place.
* Readiness: Agree objective readiness criteria and sign-off gates, plan hypercare, and set up Jira workflows, queues and escalation paths for the service.
* Steady state: Remain accountable for SLA performance, incident trends, capacity and key-person risk; hold 30/60/90-day reviews and capture lessons learned. Daily work direction sits with a designated local service owner or tech lead.

**People Process Governance & Performance Support**
*Global stakeholders own the evaluation of work, performance judgements and day-to-day development conversations. The SDM drives the process, ensures it runs on time and with quality, and supports both sides.*

* Appraisals: Drive the calendar, briefings, templates and follow-up for goal setting, mid-year check-ins, stakeholder input, ratings and calibration; quality-check inputs for gaps, bias and missing evidence; facilitate delivery of final feedback.
* PIPs: Ensure stakeholder-defined expectations are specific, measurable and time-bound; set review cadence, track progress, keep records and coordinate outcomes with HR.
* Probation: Track timelines, trigger checkpoints, consolidate evidence-based assessments and coordinate confirmation or extension.
* 1:1s: Ensure stakeholders hold regular 1:1s. Hold local check-ins focused on wellbeing, workload, aspirations and concerns, not task direction.
* Growth: Run promotion and role-change processes; shape development plans and coordinate stretch opportunities with stakeholders.

**Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**
*Global stakeholders define requirements and decide technical and team fit. The SDM runs the end-to-end process and keeps everyone informed.*

* Intake: Initiate new and replacement requisitions; run calibration calls with stakeholders on scope, must-have skills, seniority, fit and working hours; convert them into a hiring brief.
* Sourcing and screening: Work with talent acquisition, screen profiles against calibrated requirements (including a first-level technical fit check), and share shortlists with a fit-and-gap summary.
* Interviews: Coordinate panels across time zones, brief interviewers, chase timely evidence-based feedback, and monitor pipeline health.
* Reporting and closure: Share regular progress updates (pipeline, time-to-hire, risks), facilitate the selection discussion, and coordinate offer, negotiation, notice-period tracking and joining.

**Local Operations & Onboarding**

* Manage WFH/WFO rosters and ensure availability during business hours and overlap windows with global teams.
* Approve and track leave in the local system, and communicate planned absences to stakeholders to avoid delivery impact.
* Own the pre-joining and first-30-days experience for new hires, and coordinate access, equipment, offboarding and vendor-related administration with HR, IT and admin.
* Ensure compliance with local policy and code of conduct.

**Wellbeing, Engagement & Conflict Resolution**

* Be the first point of contact for team members' concerns; monitor workload, morale and burnout risk and raise issues with stakeholders.
* Represent team aspirations (career, projects, learning) to global stakeholders.
* Mediate conflicts or misalignment between global stakeholders and local members, including cross-location cultural friction.

Escalate risks, attrition signals and systemic issues to senior leadership with recommendations
  
  
**You'll Be Perfect For The Role If You Have**

* Proven experience managing multiple concurrent initiatives and leading multi-disciplinary technology teams. Proven experience running appraisal cycles, PIPs, probation reviews and leave management; driving end-to-end recruitment or hiring coordination for technology roles; and leading a service, module or knowledge transition, including vendor or cross-team handovers.
* 15+ years of total professional experience, including 5+ years of delivery management and/or project management experience and 4+ years managing people in technology or engineering teams.
* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience). Relevant certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum/Agile, SAFe, ICAgile, ITIL, CIPD or equivalent are advantageous.
* Normal business hours, with flexibility required to support global stakeholders and delivery requirements, including cross-time-zone calls, overlap windows and escalations.

3760fd00.title: Technical Delivery Manager
3760fd00.description:
**"ABOUT US:**
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a commitment to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, handle risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years.
  
  
Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.
  
  
LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia PaDecific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.
  
  
**OUR PEOPLE:**
People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential.
  
  
We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and exciting experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.
  
  
We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and exciting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise.
  
  
**PROGRAMME SUMMARY:**
LSEG are embarking on a large transformation programme to streamline and optimise our current capabilities, and to deliver next-generation, industry-standard Financial Crime (FC) processes, technologies and tools to support our Customer and Third-Party onboarding. While continuing to meet internal stringent policies and our external obligations, this programme shall introduce new ways of working and standards, drive efficiencies and transforme the way we deliver value towards customer journey lifecycle at LSEG.

A fantastic opportunity for a proven and experienced Technical Delivery Manager with a background in Know Your Customer (KYC), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Financial Crime (FC), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Sanctions, Transaction Monitoring and Regulatory Transformation, to lead and support the delivery of key technology initiatives underpinning the FC Transformation programme.
  
  
The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of business, technology and programme delivery, driving requirements definition, collaborator alignment, execution governance and change implementation. This individual will act as a trusted partner to business leaders, technology teams, architects, vendors and programme leadership, ensuring the successful delivery of strategic and regulatory initiatives through the full delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Lead Business and Technology Transformation**

* Partner with business, operations, risk and technology stakeholders to define strategic objectives, business requirements and delivery outcomes.
* Analyse business processes, operating models, systems and data flows to find opportunities for optimisation and transformation.
* Lead requirements definition activities including workshops, process mapping, user story development and acceptance criteria definition.

**Drive Delivery Excellence**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex technology initiatives from discovery through implementation.
* Develop delivery plans, manage dependencies and ensure alignment across multiple teams and workstreams.
* Identify and proactively manage risks, issues and delivery challenges.
* Monitor progress against achievements and ensure successful execution of programme commitments.

**Build Strong Partnerships**

* Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders.
* Facilitate alignment across teams with differing priorities and objectives.

* Influence decision-making through data-driven insights and thoughtful recommendations.

**Lead High-Performing Teams**

* Create an inclusive environment where individuals can grow, develop and perform at their best.
* Support career development, succession planning and capability building across the team.
* Ensure resources are effectively allocated to meet programme and organisational priorities.

**Deliver Sustainable Technology Solutions**

* Collaborate with architecture, engineering and product teams to design and implement scalable solutions.
* Support delivery of Financial Crime technology capabilities including onboarding, KYC, CDD, screening, monitoring and reporting solutions.
* Ensure solutions align with governance, security, data and regulatory requirements.
* Promote continuous improvement and adoption of standard methodologies across delivery teams.

**Enable Data-Driven Decisions**

* Partner with data, reporting and engineering teams to define information requirements and reporting solutions.
* Support delivery of management information, operational insights and performance reporting.
* Ensure data quality, integrity and consistency across delivered solutions.

**Experience**
**What You'll Bring**

* Significant experience leading business analysis and technology delivery within Financial Services, Risk, Compliance or Financial Crime domains.
* Demonstrated success delivering large-scale business and technology transformation initiatives.
* Experience leading and developing teams in a people management capacity.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders across business, operations and technology organisations.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex, fast-paced environment.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong understanding of Financial Crime processes including KYC, Customer Due Diligence, Sanctions Screening and Transaction Monitoring.
* Excellent business analysis, process improvement and requirements management capabilities.
* Strong project and delivery management experience, including planning, dependency management and governance.
* Ability to simplify complex problems and translate business needs into practical technology solutions.
* Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working within Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery environments.
* Knowledge of enterprise technologies, data platforms, workflow solutions and system integrations.

**Preferred**

* Experience delivering Financial Crime technology platforms, in-house built solutions around customer
* Professional certifications in Business Analysis, Agile, Project Management or Product Management.
* Experience working across global teams and multiple time zones.

**Why Join Us?**
This is an opportunity to shape the future of Financial Crime technology at LSEG, leading critical transformation initiatives that improve customer experience, strengthen controls and support global regulatory obligations.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to lead talented teams, influence strategic decisions and drive delivery of solutions that create meaningful business impact across the organisation.
  
  
**We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India ‘25**
**Career Stage:**
Manager
  
  
**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**
Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
  
  
Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of

,
**Excellence**
and
**Change**
underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.
  
  
Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.
  
  
We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.
  
  
LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

87ffc366.title: Sr. Engagement Manager, AWS Professional Services India
87ffc366.description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Engagement Manager to lead and deliver complex, multi-workstream cloud transformation programs for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India. In this role, you will own the end-to-end delivery lifecycle of large and complex customer engagements, shaping cloud strategies, driving business outcomes, and acting as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders.
  
  
The ideal candidate is an experienced program leader with deep IT consulting expertise, a proven track record in delivering complex technical programs across enterprise customers, and the ability to navigate ambiguity with limited guidance. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on incredibly high standards, and are passionate about mentoring others and scaling delivery best practices across teams.
  
  
You will lead matrixed teams of AWS consultants, partners, and customer resources across multiple workstreams simultaneously. You are expected to drive delivery excellence, maximize engagement value, manage risks proactively, and serve as a force multiplier for your peers and the broader organization. You will actively contribute to pre-sales, build deep customer trust, and leverage AI/GenAI to drive delivery innovation.
  
  
In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Engagement Management Delivery Practice Manager.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own and lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-workstream cloud transformation programs, ensuring business outcomes are achieved within schedule, scope, and financial constraints.
* Shape and validate cloud delivery strategies for complex engagements, applying frameworks such as the Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF), Well-Architected Framework (WAF), and Engagement Delivery Framework (EDF).
* Serve as a strategic advisor to senior customer stakeholders, leading steering committees, driving alignment, and building deep trusted relationships.
* Proactively identify, manage, and escalate risks and issues; develop and execute mitigation plans; redirect distressed programs to delight customers.
* Maximize engagement value by negotiating conditions of acceptance, managing scope changes, and amending contractual terms within project constraints.
* Drive delivery excellence across engagements by defining and sharing EM best practices, creating reusable mechanisms, and establishing operational excellence.
* Actively mentor and develop team members; perform Technical Promotion Assessments (TPAs) and coach Engagement Managers to raise the bar.
* Participate in pre-sales activities, contributing to proposals, scoping, and business development for complex services engagements.
* Leverage Agentic AI and GenAI to optimize delivery processes, improve team productivity, and drive innovative customer outcomes.
* Collaborate with cross-functional AWS teams including Delivery Consultants, Account Executives, Cloud Architects, and Partner teams to solution and deliver cloud programs.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP, Prince2, PgMP, SAFe or SCRUM/Agile certification
* 9+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Partner delivery experience — enabling and managing delivery through third-party partners

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

8994bea7.title: Engagement Manager, Customer Success
8994bea7.description:
If you've spent the last few years in consulting, you know the work: get inside a client's operation, find where value is leaking, and go after it. This is that job, except here you keep the clients. You keep an ongoing relationship with the clients where your engagement would normally end.
  
  
You'll run a book of Nash's strategic and enterprise customers, four or five strategic accounts or about ten enterprise ones. When a deal is sold, a Solutions Consultant scopes and builds each deployment. Your role during onboarding is to learn the operation alongside them and take the lead once the customer is live.From there, your job is to make sure every account gets the most out of Nash, and to keep finding what would make it better.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  

* Learn each operation from the inside. Join during onboarding with the Solutions Consultant and Engineers, so by go-live you know how the customer runs as well as the people who built it.
* Find the opportunities and go after them. Every account has four kinds:

+ Adoption: customers are engaged with the services they purchased, as well as all future releases of Nash that are applicable to their operations, including our AI Agents.
+ Operations: better on-time performance, lower cost per delivery, fewer exceptions.
+ Efficiency: accounts that run cleanly, with day-to-day work handled by Support instead of you.
+ Growth: a well-run account surfaces new opportunities. You bring them to the Account Executive and Solutions Consultant to pursue.

* Run each account on a cadence. Quarterly adoption goals, a regular operating review with the customer's team, and business reviews with their leadership.
* Spot risk early. Know the health of every account in your book, and act before a problem becomes an escalation.
* Work across Nash. Support handles day-to-day requests, Solutions Consultants and Engineering handle builds, and Account Executives handle the commercial side. You're the one who knows what each account needs from all of them.
* Keep up with the product. Nash ships product quickly, including AI capabilities. Know what's new before your customers ask, and bring it to them when it fits.

Who you are
  
  

* From consulting or strategic customer work. Two or more years in strategy or operations consulting, or in strategic customer success or account management at an enterprise software company.
* A problem finder. You look at an operation and see where it could be better, and you structure the case for fixing it.
* An operator. You get things done by working with other people and following through until the job is complete.
* Data fluent. You're at home in dashboards and spreadsheets, and you can pull the numbers that make your case.
* Fluent with AI. You already use AI tools in your daily work, and you pick up new ones quickly.
* Credible at every level. With executives and with the people running the operation every day.
* Logistics experience helps, but isn't required. How you think matters more.

How you're measured
  
  

* Adoption goals for each account, set quarterly.
* The health of every account in your book.
* How efficiently each account runs.
* The opportunities you surface for the Account Executive and Solutions Consultant.

How we hire
  
  

* Apply, then send a short Loom (2 to 3 minutes) on why Nash and why this role.
* A conversation with the hiring manager.
* A conversation with a Nash colleague.
* A case study on a real customer situation.
* Offer.

**More about**
**Nash**
**Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics.**
Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.
  
  
Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.
  
  
We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.
  
  
Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco.
  
  
**What You’ll Love About Us**
✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career!
  
  
✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates
  
  
✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
  
  
✅ Flexible paid time off
  
  
✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

28fe039c.title: Associate Technical Program Manager
28fe039c.description:
**Who are we and what do we do?**

BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000+ real devices and browsers.

With over 1,200 employees and a remote-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.

Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.

**Location: This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.**  
  
**Job Responsibilities:**

Lead the management of key programs across multiple functions and product lines.

Define timelines and project plans with financial, resource and material requirements.

Oversee delivery, release management, and deployment to ensure timelines are met.

Own and maintain consistent use of project management tools across teams.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure scope, timeline and resource

alignment across teams

Document progress of tasks to identify and manage risks and dependencies across

multiple projects

Proactively identify blockers and remove them to guarantee effective execution.

Expertise in effective stakeholder management.

**Requirements:**

5+ years of experience working in a top technology MNC or tech start-up in India.

2 years of Program Management experience is a must.

Prior engineering experience in a hand-on development/ testing or related role is

mandatory. A coder turned Program/ Project manager is highly preferred for this role.

Self-starter and ability to build programs from scratch. Must have a positive

attitude and ability to roll-up their sleeves to get things done.

Conflict management experience to drive decision making across the board

Strong exposure with Waterfall/ Scrum/ Kanban/ SAFe/ Agile development processes.

Bachelor of Engineering / Technology, Master of Computer Application or equivalent.

**Good to have:**

Experience handling both JIRA and Waterfall Projects.

Should have experience using JIRA tool either as Scrum Master or Team member, admin

experience preferred.

Hands on experience on Budget, Cost, Issue and Risk Management is a plus.

Able to generate, define, capture, interpret and refine Metrics based on organization

needs.

Demonstrated technical proficiency and effectiveness working closely with engineers.

User-driven approach to build delightful products users love.

Intellectually curious, self-motivated, a fast learner with a strong bias for action

Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.

Superior attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

PMP or Scrum Master certification.

**Benefits:**

  

In addition to your total compensation, you will be eligible for following benefits, which will be governed by the Company policy:

  

* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive INR 5,00,000 coverage for employee, spouse, up to 2 dependent children, and parents or parents-in-law
* Statutory Benefits: Gratuity per the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972
* Paid Time Off: 25 days of paid leave annually (Annual & Sick Leave) plus gazetted public holidays and special life-event leaves
* Remote-First work environment that allows our people to work from home
* Remote-First Allowance for home office setup, connectivity, accessories, co-working spaces, wellbeing to ensure an amazing remote work experience
