97760cf1.title: Program Manager - GeoAnalytics
97760cf1.description:
**About us**

WRI India, an independent knowledge organisation registered as India Resources Trust, provides objective information and practical proposals to foster environmentally sound and socially equitable development. Through research, analysis, and recommendations, WRI India puts ideas into action to build transformative solutions to protect the earth, promote livelihoods, and enhance human well-being. Know more: wri-india.org

**Job Highlight:**

WRI India is seeking a Manager – GeoAnalytics to strengthen the GeoAnalytics team's capabilities in geospatial analytics, software engineering and digital product development. This role will have a dual focus: leading the development and operationalization of Climate Lens, WRI India's integrated climate intelligence and decision-support platform, while managing and contributing to the development of geospatial software applications and analytical solutions across WRI India's programmes.

The position will combine product management, technical leadership, software development and project coordination. The successful candidate will work closely with research and programme teams to translate complex environmental, climate and urban challenges into robust, scalable and user-oriented digital solutions.

The role will be responsible for ensuring that analytical methodologies and research outputs are translated into reusable digital products, supported by sound software architecture, reliable data infrastructure and effective user experiences. The candidate will also contribute to building shared technical capabilities, reusable software components and engineering standards within the GeoAnalytics team.

**What you will do:**

The role will be structured around two complementary areas of responsibility.

1. Climate Lens – Digital Product Development and Management (50%)

Lead the end-to-end development, implementation and continuous improvement of Climate Lens, ensuring that it evolves into a scalable and operational climate intelligence platform supporting evidence-based planning, adaptation and investment decisions.

Product Strategy and Management

* Lead the product development roadmap for Climate Lens, translating the platform vision, strategic objectives and programme requirements into defined product features, development priorities and implementation plans.
* Work closely with GeoAnalytics, Cities and other programme teams to identify user needs, define product requirements and translate climate research methodologies into digital workflows.
* Define product specifications, functional requirements, user journeys, workflows, wireframes and feature-level development plans.
* Coordinate product development activities across research, design, data science and software engineering teams, ensuring alignment between analytical requirements and technical implementation.
* Manage product priorities, timelines, resources, dependencies and delivery milestones.

Technical Development and Integration

* Lead the development and operationalization of Climate Lens
* Oversee the development of shared platform capabilities, including climate data integration, climate hazard and vulnerability assessment, risk prioritization, adaptation planning, scenario modelling and decision-support functionalities.
* Drive the digital productization of WRI India's Climate Hazard Vulnerability Assessment (CHVA) methodology into standardized, configurable and reusable analytical workflows.
* Coordinate the integration of the Urban NbS FinLink finance-search functionality into Climate Lens, ensuring that users can access project assessment and climate finance discovery capabilities across the three geographic applications.
* Work with software developers and technical partners to define system architecture, APIs, databases, data pipelines and integration requirements.
* Ensure that the platform is modular, interoperable, scalable and designed for future expansion across cities, states and thematic applications.

Product Quality, Validation and Adoption

* Establish product development processes, including prototyping, technical validation, user acceptance testing (UAT), release management and continuous improvement.
* Coordinate pilot testing and stakeholder consultations with government agencies, urban local bodies and other intended users.
* Define product performance indicators and monitor platform adoption, user engagement, analytical utilization and institutional uptake.
* Translate user feedback and implementation experience into product enhancements and development priorities.
* Develop product documentation, user guides, technical specifications and onboarding materials.
* Support institutional partnerships, technical presentations and resource mobilization related to Climate Lens.

2. GeoAnalytics and Software Development (50%)

Lead and contribute to the development of geospatial software applications, data-driven solutions and reusable technology components across WRI India's programmes and projects.

Application Development

* Design, develop and maintain full-stack web applications, geospatial platforms, dashboards and digital tools to address programme and research requirements.
* Develop backend services, APIs and frontend applications using appropriate modern software development frameworks and technologies.
* Develop and maintain geospatial data services and workflows using technologies such as PostGIS, GeoServer, GDAL, GeoPandas and Google Earth Engine.
* Build reusable software components, libraries and modules that can be applied across multiple WRI India products and projects.
* Contribute to the development of open-source, interoperable and publicly accessible digital products, including platforms aligned with Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) principles.
* Integrate geospatial analytics, data visualization and AI/ML capabilities into digital applications where relevant.

Engineering Standards

* Establish and promote good software engineering practices, including coding standards, version control, documentation, code reviews and testing.
* Support the implementation of pipelines, deployment processes, cloud infrastructure and application monitoring.
* Evaluate emerging geospatial technologies, open-source frameworks and AI-enabled development approaches for their potential application within WRI India.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to developers, research associates and other members of the GeoAnalytics team.
* Maintain technical documentation, reusable code repositories and institutional knowledge resources.

Project Coordination and Collaboration

* Coordinate with programme teams to understand project requirements, define technical scope and ensure timely delivery of analytical and software development outputs.
* Manage technical work plans, development milestones, resource requirements and project dependencies.
* Provide technical guidance to project teams and support the integration of geospatial and software solutions into programme activities.
* Contribute to research publications, technical reports, proposals, presentations and other institutional knowledge products.

**What you will need:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Geoinformatics, Geography, Geospatial Science, Remote Sensing or a related technical discipline.
* 6–8 years of relevant professional experience in software development, geospatial technology, digital product development or a related field.

**Potential Salary and Benefits:** *INR 18,00,000 to 24,00,000 Annum*

*“Salary shall be commensurate with experience, skills, and internal parity. WRI India offers a generous and comprehensive benefits package.”*

**Location: New Delhi**

**Duration**: 1 Year (Extendable based on performance and project requirements)

**Start date:** As soon as possible

**List of Documents to be attached:**

* **Cover Letter**
* **Resume**

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted for interview purpose.

**How to Apply**

Qualified applicants should apply online at wri-india.org career section. All applications must be submitted online through this career portal in order to be formally considered. Only select applicants will be contacted for interview. There will be a writing test conducted with final candidates. Please do not contact program staff directly for this position.

*Kindly note that WRI India’s recruitment process does not involve any payment at any stage. Applicants will never be asked to share bank account or financial information as part of the application. All official communication and offer letters are issued only through authorised WRI India email IDs.*

***Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) @WRI India***

*WRI India values and promotes diversity, equity and inclusion across all areas of our work and workforce. Integrating these values into our actions fosters a progressive and collaborative culture and can also enhance our impact. It is our responsibility to create a welcoming working environment for people of diverse cultures, backgrounds and experience to learn together. We are responsible for fostering a safe and inclusive workplace where questions, concerns and information about diversity, equity and inclusion are part of our ongoing dialogue and development.*

***Learn more about WRI India’s commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI).*** **Click Here**

**People-centric to the core:**

We keep our people at the center of everything we do - from a welcoming work environment to benefits and a culture that encourages staff to stay healthy, happy, engaged, and growing.

**Some of the non-monetary benefits that our staff get:**

**Health benefits:** We cover health insurance for you and your loved ones for up to INR 8 lakhs

**Term Insurance:** Our term insurance policy covers life coverage of 50 lakhs per staffmember

**Employee Assistance program:** Promoting mental well-being and supporting staff in achieving a satisfying work-life balance

**Health & Nutrition:** Personalized diet recommendation from a certified dietitian based on the physical health condition and lifestyle

**Flexible work schedule:** Alternative work arrangements for all who are eligible by nature of their job

**Learning culture**: Workshops and trainings to empower staff, encourage new learning opportunities

**Rest and Recharge weeks:** We encourage staff to take time off to rest, rejuvenate, upskill, and pursue their interests.

**Our leave policy:** Avail personal time off at 36 per year, along with public holidays, maternity, paternity, and adoption leaves.

**Equal employment @WRI India**

*We believe in equal employment, it is our policy to recruit and provide opportunities for advancement in all job classifications without regard to caste, religion, sex, age, marital status, sexual orientation, parental status, or disability.*

70733455.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Strategic programs, PRISM, Last Mile Delivery Tech
70733455.description:
**Description**
How does Amazon deliver millions of packages faster than customers expect, across the globe, every single day?
  
  
If that question excites you, keep reading. We're looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead the strategy and execution of programs across Last Mile Delivery. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where your work will shape the delivery experience for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide.
  
  
At Amazon, we're working to be the most Customer-centric company on earth. One customer experience that we’re constantly looking to take to a new level is how we fulfill and deliver their orders. Our Last Mile organization is at the forefront of this mission: pioneering new products and services, partnering with Delivery Service Partners and Amazon Flex, and building a world-class operation that spans North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific. Last Mile is one of the most customer-visible and strategically important pillars of this work, and you'll be at the center of it.
  
  
As part of Amazon Delivery's PRISM (Central TPM) organization, you will own the end-to-end program strategy for last mile initiatives, driving cross-functional alignment across business, product, and engineering teams to launch and scale programs that move the needle on delivery speed. You will partner with senior leaders across multiple organizations to define priorities, remove blockers, and deliver results.
  
  
The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, brings strong business and technical judgment, and has a track record of delivering complex programs. You are a crisp communicator who can influence at the VP level and translate business goals into actionable roadmaps. If you want to solve one of the most challenging problems in logistics, making delivery faster for every customer, everywhere, this is your role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Serve as the single-threaded leader owning complex programs across multiple VP organizations
* Identify business and technical requirements with science, operations, product, and engineering stakeholders, translating them into specifications, scoped deliverables, and program roadmap from design through launch
* Lead design and implementation efforts across cross-functional teams, making trade-offs to optimize time-to-market
* Own stakeholder communication through all stages of the product lifecycle, clearly articulating goals, roles, and desired outcomes
* Drive high-level strategic initiatives while being willing to roll up your sleeves and get the job done

The right candidate will have a strong program management background, demonstrated experience leading large to extra-large projects, and a well-rounded technical foundation. You must thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Your day starts by connecting the dots across teams, aligning product, engineering, and operations leaders on what matters most for our customer and business. You will run strategic reviews, unblock cross-functional dependencies, and make trade-off decisions that keep programs on track. Some days you are deep in data, shaping the roadmap; other days you are in a room full of senior leaders driving alignment on the next big bet. No two days look the same, but every day you are directly influencing how fast customers get their packages.
  
  
**About The Team**
PRISM is Amazon Delivery's central Technical Program Management organization. We drive programs that span Last Mile and partner organizations including Robotics, Pharmacy, Prime Air, and more. The problems we solve sit at the intersection of customer experience, technology, and operations at massive scale. If you want to work on programs that shape how Amazon delivers to customers globally, this is the team to be on.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of software development experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- ADCI - Karnataka

3e2c0cf4.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, UnifiedAuth
3e2c0cf4.description:
**Description**
Unified Authorization is responsible for securing customer and corporate communication across all of Amazon. Whether it's the retail website, Alexa, or Kindle, we ensure actors are authenticated and authorized to take the requested action. Every aspect of Amazon's business interacts with our systems, including enabling the next generation of retail services on AWS infrastructure. As a global security provider, we're at the intersection of resiliency, availability, and the need to move at agile internet speed.
  
  
You are an experienced technical program manager who can work closely with product management and other business partners to define strategy and requirements, and help lead teams from concept through delivery and subsequent operation. You have regular communication with senior management on status, risks and product strategy. You have excellent listening, writing skills and very strong technical competency. You're a thought leader, but you don't just know how to solve the problem, you prove it by leading team to build the solution. Last but not the least; you have a high bar for quality and passion for design and architecture.
  
  
As the ideal candidate you will be experienced in working closely with a team of software development engineers and have a proven track record of working on complex software solutions using an agile methodology. You will have the ability to dive deep into the understanding of problems in order to help your team make the right decisions for the product and the business. You will have a proven track record of working across organizational lines. You will also be a strong communicator and will have proven abilities in managing through ambiguous situations.
  
  
**About The Team**
Unified Auth is responsible for securing every service transaction within Amazon SDO’s service-oriented architecture (SOA) by authenticating the services involved in the transaction, authorizing APIs access, and enforcing least-privilege access to Amazon’s business data such as Cart, Order, Customer Identity, Item, Employee Information and more. Unified Auth’s systems are classified as Maximally Secure Applications (MSA) by Amazon Security as they control access to all Amazon services. Amazon’s SOA is large, complex, and ever-growing. A single Amazon customer interaction such as adding an item into cart, proceeding to checkout, adding/changing payment methods, confirming purchase, etc. spans tens to hundreds of inter-service interactions that must be secured and observed using Unified Auth’s systems. Stores, Alexa, Ring, IMDB, Prime Video, Advertisement, Selling Partners, Pharmacy, Ordering and Payments, Fulfillment Centers, and Amazon’s internal systems such as PXT rely on Unified Auth solutions to meet rising access control security and privacy standards, such as Digital Markets Act (DMA) compliance, GDPR, and SOC 2 Type II certification.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- ADCI HYD 13 SEZ

2156fd4b.title: Technical Program Manager III, AI & Data
2156fd4b.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
**Technical Program Manager III, AI & Data**
Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools that deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. This role sits in the AI and Data Organisation, supporting the AI and Analytics Platform team which makes AI, ML, analytics, metrics, behavioural data and experimentation fast, governed, reliable, self-service and cost effective for every Expedia team.
  
  
As a Technical Program Manager III, you will lead complex, cross-functional programs, connecting strategic goals to clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and predictable delivery. You will own integrated program plans from concept through completion and make scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and critical paths visible so teams can make timely, informed trade-offs. You will raise risks and blockers early, apply sound judgment to options and trade-offs, and create clarity on ownership, decisions, and next steps. This role also strengthens portfolio visibility and operating rhythms across teams and divisions by creating practical planning and reporting mechanisms, and applying AI, automation, and reusable delivery frameworks to improve how work gets done.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead strategic program delivery. Translate business objectives and product or technical requirements into integrated plans, milestones, workstreams, and execution priorities. Drive delivery end to end, adapting plans as scope, sequencing, capacity, or context changes.
* Connect work to business outcomes: Partner with Functional Area and team leaders to assess whether proposed work supports AI and Data and Expedia Group priorities. Define success criteria and measurable outcomes before execution, and use results to guide decisions and continuous improvement.
* Make the portfolio visible: Maintain an accurate view of programs including commitments, status, dependencies, risks, and changes. Develop roadmaps and concise leadership updates that provide the right visibility with minimal overhead and be candid when commitments are at risk or information is unresolved.
* Enable planning and prioritization: Support quarterly planning cycles that connect team commitments to Expedia Group goals. Facilitate prioritization and trade-off discussions so leaders and teams can focus capacity on the most important outcomes.
* Drive cross-functional alignment: Coordinate engineering, product, design, data, business, and partner teams. Build trusted working relationships and help surface and resolve program-level questions about system design, APIs, data, operating models, and delivery approaches; document decisions, owners, and their implications so teams can move forward with shared understanding.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and change: Identify issues and bottlenecks early, maintain clear ownership and mitigation plans, and escalate when needed. Track cross-team dependencies and critical paths, frame trade-offs, and communicate impacts to scope, schedule, and outcomes.
* Establish effective operating mechanisms: Create or improve governance, status reporting, decision forums, team communications, and delivery practices that support transparent decisions and reliable execution without unnecessary process. Use expertise to recommend practical approaches when teams face ambiguity.
* Advance AI & Data delivery frameworks: Use appropriate AI-enabled tools and automation to streamline program planning, synthesis, reporting, risk identification, and repeatable workflows. Develop reusable program frameworks and self-service paths that help teams spend more time on high-value work. Help teams safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled capabilities, applying foundational AI/ML concepts in real product and engineering contexts and using judgment about human review, data handling, and appropriate tool use.
* Measure and improve: Define and report program and team outcomes, delivery health, and relevant performance metrics. Monitor product or capability performance after launch, identify opportunities to simplify processes, and turn insights into actionable improvements. Use data and operational insights to improve predictability, workflow, and delivery quality.
* Build trusted partnerships: Develop strong working relationships with stakeholders who have varied perspectives. Communicate technical and business concepts clearly to delivery teams, partners, senior leaders, and executives.
* Stay curious: Keep learning about the AI and Data domain, the business, emerging AI tools, and better ways of working; apply relevant learning to continually improve program delivery.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* You have 5+ years of experience leading technical programs with cross-functional dependencies in platform, infrastructure, data, analytics, or similarly complex engineering environments.
* Prior technical background and core understand of SDLC is a foundational requirement for success in this role
* You have experience planning and delivering moderately complex programs across multiple teams, including managing timelines, dependencies, risks, milestones, and execution reporting.
* You are skilled at building clarity and accountability through dashboards, status communication, governance mechanisms, and structured operating rhythms.
* You are comfortable influencing without authority and aligning engineering, product, and business stakeholders around trade-offs, priorities, and next steps.
* You have strong technical fluency and can understand distributed systems, APIs, services, data flows, architecture discussions, and operational risks well enough to ask the right questions and surface gaps early.
* You use data and metrics to make program decisions, identify trends, surface risks, and tell a clear story to technical and leadership audiences.
* You have experience operating effectively in ambiguous environments and creating structure that helps teams move forward with confidence.
* You communicate clearly and concisely across different audiences and can translate complex technical or delivery topics into actionable updates and decisions.
* You bring a strong ownership mindset, sound judgment, and the ability to work collaboratively across teams, functions, and time zones.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering complex, technical programs at scale, particularly where operational excellence, reliability, security, production readiness, or customer outcomes are central.
* Demonstrated ability to influence architecture and technical decisions across teams or domains without direct authority, including communicating trade-offs and helping teams reach alignment.
* Experience establishing program metrics, dashboards, or feedback mechanisms that surface execution challenges and improve predictability and delivery performance.
* Practical experience applying AI-assisted program or engineering tools, or AI/ML concepts, to improve product capabilities, delivery workflows, risk management, or business outcomes.
* Experience with one or more of the following: data platforms, semantic or metrics layers, experimentation platforms, BI or self-service analytics, or developer-facing platform products.
* You have experience driving platform adoption or consolidation efforts across multiple customer groups and partner organizations.
* Experience supporting data governance or management capabilities such as metadata, lineage, access control, certification, or data quality.
* Experience driving platform adoption or consolidation across customer groups and partner organizations, including programs supporting executive reporting, experimentation, or shared analytics at scale.

**Accommodation requests**
Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation.
  
  
**About Expedia Group**
Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.
  
  
**Important notice**
Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. 20dacf9e.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Network Design & Planning
20dacf9e.description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
  
  
Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
  
  
At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
  
  
When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
  
  
**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
*This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office.*
**Summary Of How You Will Impact Skylo**
Skylo is hiring a
**Senior**
**Technical Program Manager for Network Design & Planning**
to help fulfill Skylo’s mission of making satellite connectivity available to all. Based in Bangalore, this individual will drive the planning and execution of the team’s most important cross-functional programs, including new market and ground station launches, core and RAN capacity expansions, vendor deliveries, regulatory capabilities, and service maturity initiatives. You will bring structure, visibility, and pace to complex technical work spanning engineering teams, vendors, satellite operators, and MNO partners across multiple time zones.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**

* Own end-to-end delivery of Network Design & Planning programs, such as network expansions, new ground station and market launches, core and RAN capacity upgrades, and regulatory capabilities (e.g. Lawful Intercept, emergency alerts).
* Build and maintain integrated program plans, milestones, dependencies, and resource plans across engineering, operations, product, and partner teams.
* Manage technical deliveries from network vendors (including our 5G core vendor), tracking scope, releases, acceptance testing, and contractual milestones.
* Coordinate with satellite operators, MNO partners, and ground station providers on joint technical plans and launch readiness.
* Identify and manage program risks, issues, and decisions, and drive timely escalation and resolution.
* Establish program operating rhythms, including status reporting, steering reviews, and dashboards for engineering leadership.
* Drive service maturity initiatives with Operations, including launch readiness checklists, runbooks, and handover from design to operations.
* Track network capacity and budget plans alongside engineering leads, and support vendor and procurement processes.
* Continuously improve the team’s planning, intake, and delivery processes and tooling (e.g. Jira, Confluence).
* Communicate clearly across time zones (India, Europe, and the US) to keep stakeholders aligned.

**What We Look For**

* 8+ years of experience in telecom, with at least 4 years in technical program or project management of network deployments, expansions, or vendor deliveries.
* Solid technical understanding of mobile networks (RAN, 4G/5G core, IMS, IP transport) sufficient to engage credibly with engineers and vendors.
* Proven track record delivering complex, multi-team technical programs on time, including with external vendors and partners.
* Strong skills in program planning, dependency and risk management, and executive-level status reporting.
* Experience managing network equipment or software vendors, including release tracking and acceptance testing.
* Experience working across distributed, multi-time-zone teams.
* Proficiency with program management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or MS Project.
* Experience with satellite communications or Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) is a plus.
* PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification is a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong stakeholder management and facilitation abilities.

**What We Offer**
With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range benefits such as:
  
  

* Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
* Comprehensive occupational health coverage
* Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
* A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
* Once in a lifetime opportunity to be a part of developing and running world’s first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network and service
* Access to world-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
* Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends multi-national characteristics

**EEO Statement**
Skylo is an equal-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  
  
We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

0dfe4342.title: Support Engineer III, AMC, Ad-Tech Solutions
0dfe4342.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) is a new secure, privacy-safe, and dedicated cloud-based environment in which advertisers can easily perform analytics across multiple, pseudonymized data sets to generate insights. Inputs can include an advertiser’s own data sets, as well as their Amazon Advertising campaign events, such as impressions, clicks, and conversions. AMC enables advertisers to perform campaign measurement, audience refinement, supply optimization, and more, enabling advertisers to make more informed decisions about their cross-channel marketing investments. Our services ingest billions of behavioral signals every day. Speed, scale, and accuracy are critical to our success.  
  
This is a customer-facing role that demands strong technical depth across AWS services, excellent communication skills, and a project management mindset. You will be the bridge between customers and internal teams, ensuring a seamless onboarding experience while advocating for customer needs.  
  
Are you passionate about driving customer success? Interested in learning new technologies? Do you thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment? AMC is seeking a Sr Support Engineer to provide support to partners and external customers as they build business-critical applications on our platform. You'll also work directly with Amazon Advertising product and engineering teams to ensure that customer issues are resolved as expediently as possible.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
In this role, you will independently resolve customer issues and blockers by providing knowledgeable and responsive technical support on AMC. Our customers are large enterprises, direct and agencies.You would often interact with customers’ Data Analysts and other Data focused stakeholders. You would use advanced SQL skills to build confidence and solutions. You will have ownership for issue investigation, identifying root cause and software defects, conceive and provide workarounds if acceptable to customers for continuity. You will gather sufficient information that helps reproduce issues and contribute to building software fixes. This is a complex, and fast-paced environment as you will own the most critical part of the customer experience and delivering on our customers’ most basic need. While we obsess over issue resolution, in this role you will also develop tools to scale our support & service quality, and provide critical input for product prioritization to address root causes of why the customer experienced an issue in the first place. Our advertising customers are likely Amazon customers, and we take seriously maintaining the high customer service bar set by Amazon to be the level at which we need to operate.  
A day in the life
  
  

* Track, investigate, and resolve customer questions and issues using appropriate communication channel including phone, email, and live as well as asynchronous at various levels of complexity and customer impact.
* Act as an escalation point for the most complex and in-depth issues that potentially span multiple external and internal organizations.
* Communicate directly with internal organizations to complete root cause analyses, issue investigation, workarounds and defect resolution.
* Develop and implement complex repro cases to identify potential software defects, mis-configurations, or issues in customer environments.
* Use case management tools to manage and prioritize issues based on multiple factors including customer impact.
* Build & Contribute to training material and documentation for both internal and customer-facing users.
* Actively seeking solutions to customer needs, communicating trends to leadership, and suggesting innovative solutions on behalf of the customer experience.
* Providing support directly to data analysts who are using Amazon Marketing Cloud.
* Writing queries, code samples, tutorials, and technical articles for the customer community
* Working with customers to understand how they are using our services, and providing feedback to development teams
* Collaborating with internal stakeholders to drive timely customer communication
* Driving internal projects that improve support-related processes and our customer's user experience
* Customer Onboarding: Own end-to-end technical onboarding of customers onto Amazon Ads solutions, ensuring smooth and timely implementation.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve technical issues across the AWS stack, working closely with customers and internal engineering teams to drive resolution.
* Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer — collect and synthesize VOC (Voice of the Customer) feedback, and translate customer questions, pain points, and feature requests into engineering and program-level requirements.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, product, and program teams to drive resolution of customer issues and influence the product roadmap based on customer insights.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
* 3+ years of technical support experience
* 2+ years of scripting language experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of cloud platforms and cloud computing such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, etc.

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

+ Cloud landing zones and enterprise-scale platform design
+ Resiliency, performance, security, and compliance frameworks

* Lead architecture and design reviews for large programs (multi-team, multi-region, regulated environments).
* Drive best practices across Azure Well-Architected, SRE principles, and modern engineering standards.

**Growth, Sales & Microsoft Partnership**

* Own practice-level pipeline: identify opportunities, shape pursuits, and close deals.
* Lead pre-sales activities: solutioning, estimates, SoWs, proposals, and executive presentations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Microsoft stakeholders; co-sell and co-innovate.
* Develop industry-specific value propositions and demonstrate ROI (cost optimization, time-to-market, resilience, security posture).

**Delivery & Program Oversight**

* Provide executive oversight for key accounts and programs; ensure delivery to scope, schedule, budget, and outcomes.
* Establish delivery metrics (velocity, quality, stability, availability, cost) and continuously improve.
* Sponsor complex migrations and transformations:

+ Datacenter exit / cloud migration
+ Hybrid/multi-cloud connectivity
+ Enterprise DevSecOps rollouts

**People Leadership & Capability Building**

* Build, mentor, and scale multi-disciplinary teams (architects, engineers, SRE, DevOps, cloud ops).
* Create career paths, skills matrices, learning plans, and certification targets.
* Drive hiring strategy and talent planning; build a strong bench and partner ecosystem.

**Microsoft-Centric Technical Scope (What you’re expected to be strong in)**
You don’t need to hands-on code daily, but you must be able to
**lead design decisions**
, challenge teams, and speak credibly with senior client stakeholders.

* Azure Landing Zones / enterprise-scale design (identity, network, security, governance)
* Hub-spoke, vWAN, Private Link, DNS, connectivity patterns
* Azure compute (VMs, AKS), storage, Azure SQL, PaaS patterns
* Resilience and DR patterns, multi-region architecture, observability

**Application Modernization**

* Modernization strategies (6Rs), domain-driven modernization, microservices and event-driven design
* .NET modernization, containerization, API management patterns
* Integration with Microsoft ecosystem (Entra ID, Key Vault, Service Bus/Event Hubs, Functions, Logic Apps)

**DevSecOps & Platform Engineering**

* GitHub / Azure DevOps, CI/CD, IaC (Terraform/Bicep), policy-as-code
* Secure SDLC, secrets management, supply-chain security

Developer platform concepts (golden paths, reusable templates, inner-source
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering (or equivalent experience).

* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.

8f24ba5e.title: AMS Cloud EPM Planning Consultant
8f24ba5e.description:
Overview:
  
At Peloton, we don't just implement technology. We transform the way organizations work, compete, and grow. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in the US, Peloton is one of the most respected and fastest-growing global Oracle consulting firms, delivering Advisory, Consulting, and Managed Services to leading organizations across many industries, including Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Consumer Packaged Goods, and more.
  
Peloton Consulting Group has the vision and connected global capabilities to help organizations envision, implement, and realize the benefits of digital transformation. Our team has the best practices, knowledge, industry expertise, and know-how. We make digital transformation a reality by leveraging AI, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Supply Chain Management (SCM), Human Capital Management (HCM), Customer Experience (CX), Analytics, and Data Management for the cloud. Through connected capabilities, we bring people, processes, and technology together. We help organizations go further faster. That is the Peloton way!
  
What truly sets us apart is our people. We are team players. We are energetic and entrepreneurial. We are problem solvers and innovative thinkers who believe the best outcomes are built together. We believe in quality, appreciate creativity, recognize individual contributions, and place trust in every member of our team. If you bring strong business or technical expertise and want to do meaningful work alongside people who are equally passionate about getting it right, we think you'll feel right at home here.
  
This role requires a balance of client relationship management, operational oversight, and strategic thinking to ensure services are delivered efficiently and aligned with evolving client business needs.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
This role requires candidates to work in IST hours from 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM and have a minimum of 6+years of relevant professional experience, also during day light saving have to work from 6:30 PM to 3:30AM IST.
  
While this is a remote opportunity open to candidates across India, applicants based in Hyderabad or Bangalore will be preferred, as these are our primary hiring locations.
  
  
The consultant will work as part of the Application Managed Services (AMS) / Support team, providing functional and technical support for Oracle EPBCS (Enterprise Planning and Budgeting Cloud Service). The role focuses on ensuring smooth planning, budgeting, and forecasting operations while supporting business users and resolving production issues.
  
  
- Provide L2/L3 support for Oracle EPBCS planning applications including budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes.
  
  
- Support planning cycles (monthly, quarterly, annual budgeting and forecasting activities)
  
  
- Resolve issues related to business rules, calculation scripts, forms, reports, dashboards, and security configurations
  
  
- Monitor and support data loads and integrations using Data Management / FDMEE or related tools
  
  
- Troubleshoot and resolve application errors, performance issues, and data discrepancies
  
  
- Support planning model structures including assumptions, versions, scenarios, and hierarchies
  
  
- Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and provide permanent fixes or workarounds
  
  
- Assist with data validation, reconciliation, and tie-outs between planning and source systems
  
  
- Handle incident, service request, and minor enhancement tickets within SLA timelines
  
  
- Support user access management, security roles, and application maintenance activities
  
  
- Coordinate with technical teams for issue resolution, integrations, and system enhancements
  
  
- Maintain support documentation, knowledge base articles, and issue resolution logs
  
  
- Support business users during planning cycles and financial forecasting periods
  
  
- Ensure adherence to ITIL processes (incident, problem, and change management)
  
  
- Participate in shift-based support coverage for global users if required
  
  
  
Required Qualifications & Experience
  
  
- 5-10 years of experience in Oracle EPM Planning / EPBCS implementation or support (AMS preferred)
  
- Hands-on experience in Oracle EPBCS or Oracle EPM Planning Cloud applications
  
- Experience supporting or participating in at least one full planning cycle (budgeting/forecasting)
  
- Strong understanding of planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes and best practices
  
- Exposure to business rules, calculation scripts, forms, and reporting in EPBCS
  
- Experience with Data Management / FDMEE or equivalent integration tools
  
- Understanding of financial planning concepts and variance analysis
  
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
  
- Experience working in a client-facing AMS or support environment
  
- Good communication and ability to work independently in a remote setup
  
- Alignment with delivery values: ownership, teamwork, can-do attitude, and client focus
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
- Experience with other EPM modules such as FCCS, ARCS, or Narrative Reporting (EPRCS)
  
- Exposure to ERP integrations (Oracle Cloud ERP or similar systems)
  
- Experience supporting enterprise finance transformation or planning modernization programs
  
- Experience in shift-based global support models
  
- Ability to mentor junior team members in support environments
  
  
Compensation:
  
Peloton provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, business needs, and geographic location. Peloton also offer bonus opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package including
  
- Competitive base salary with performance-based bonus
  
  
- Vacation, Leave, and Holiday pay
  
  
- Annual Health Wallet
  
  
- Group Medical Insurance
  
  
- Group Term Accident & Life Insurance
  
  
- Paid holidays and PTO
  
  
  
Peloton Group is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

f4f4fe75.title: RC-DR-Cloud Security Assessment-Senior
f4f4fe75.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Digital Risk – Cloud Security**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
As part of our Risk Consulting, you will be joining the Digital Risk Consulting Team.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Senior Consultant with expertise in Cloud Security and Risk Assessment’ to lead the audit/review of security architecture and controls across hybrid cloud environments. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Evaluate key cloud security solutions such as Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Cloud Workload Protection Platforms (CWPP), Identity and Access Management (IAM), Cloud Access Security Brokers (CASB), Web Application Firewalls (WAF), Cloud encryption and key management services, Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), and security automation tools with respect to hybrid cloud security posture (AWS, Azure, GCP, and on-premises).
* Evaluate the effectiveness of the implementation and operations of vulnerability management and patching programs, including timely identification, prioritization, and remediation of cloud and on-premises vulnerabilities
* Evaluate security hardening standards and secure cloud configuration best practices across all environments.
* Assess AWS, Azure, and GCP environments against industry standards, regulatory requirements, and cloud security best practices.
* Review and design cloud security architectures, landing zones, network segmentation, identity and access management, privileged access management, encryption, and key management controls.
* Conduct cloud security strategy, maturity, governance, and target-state assessments to support cloud adoption and transformation initiatives.
* Perform technical security configuration reviews across cloud infrastructure, platforms, containers, Kubernetes, serverless services, and cloud-native security controls.
* Assess cloud security posture using CSPM and CNAPP solutions such as Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Prisma Cloud, or equivalent tools.
* Conduct cloud security audits, risk and compliance reviews, maturity assessments, and third-party or vendor security assessments.
* Develop actionable security improvement recommendations and prioritised roadmap strategies based on identified cloud risks, control gaps, and target-state objectives
* Evaluate DevSecOps implementation to embed security into CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployments.
* Evaluate the current practice followed of cloud security monitoring and incident management
* Conducting risk assessments and vulnerability analyses in cloud environments and propose mitigation strategies
* Support larger Internal Audit and Cyber security audits engagements especially on domains related to cloud security
* Develop cloud security policies/procedures to protect data in the cloud and prevent unauthorized access.
* Good understanding of cloud security standards/regulations globally and within the MENA region (KSA, UAE, Qatar)
* Communicate cloud security risks, strategies, and remediation plans clearly to technical teams and senior management
* Ability to translate complex technical details into clear, business-understandable language for effective communication with stakeholders/business users

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong technical knowledge of AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI and on-premises security architectures and controls.
* Proven ability to evaluate cloud security technologies, policies and processes.
* Experience conducting cloud risk assessments against global/MENA specific standards/regulations
* Experience managing cloud security metrics, reporting, and audit readiness.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience in incident management and response in cloud environments.
* Familiarity with DevSecOps and secure CI/CD practices in Cloud

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 5–8 years of experience in cloud security, with hands-on expertise in hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Knowledge of CIS Benchmarks, NIST, ISO 27001, CSA CCM, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience leading client workshops, assessments, cloud security strategy engagements, and preparing executive-level reports and recommendations.
* Open to travel to MENA (up to 50% of the time)
* Excellent communication skills with consulting experience preferred

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* A bachelor's or master's degree in B. TECH/B. E, MS in computer science, MBA (IT or Systems) or a related discipline.
* Certifications such as CCSP, CCSK, AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, or CISM preferred.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate
* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer)

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

2cacb25f.title: Solution Architect
2cacb25f.description:
*There is an immediate need for an experienced*
***Solution Architect***
*at SupraITS Canada through its subsidiary Atomic North India. If you’re someone who can see both the big picture and the technical details, enjoys designing scalable systems, and thrives on solving complex engineering and infrastructure challenges then this position is for you.*
**LOCATIONS:**
This role is remote/hybrid and is available for candidates located in: Delhi, Chennai or Jammu
  
  
**About Supra Its**
Founded in 1999, Supra ITS has grown into a globally trusted IT partner, delivering world-class Managed IT, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Application Services, and Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) Services. Headquartered in Mississauga, Supra ITS operates with 650+ employees worldwide, including Network Operations Centers (NOCs) in Canada and India, ensuring 24/7 IT support and seamless service delivery.
  
  
Supra ITS provides a full spectrum of IT solutions, including server and network management, private cloud, disaster recovery, service desk support, and advanced security services. With a security-first approach and SLA-driven commitments, Supra ITS takes complete ownership of IT services, allowing clients to focus on growth while ensuring uninterrupted operations.
  
  
**Canon Partnership**
In 2021, Canon Canada made an equity investment in Supra ITS, recognizing a shared vision to deliver world-class technology and managed services across North America.
  
  
What began as a strategic investment has since evolved into an integrated partnership, combining Canon’s innovation and enterprise solutions with Supra ITS’s agility, customer focus, and managed services expertise.
  
  
Today, we operate as a unified force, driving rapid growth across North America through automation, cloud, cybersecurity, and business process solutions. Together, Canon and Supra ITS are accelerating digital transformation for customers, delivering secure, scalable, and performance-driven IT solutions that redefine what it means to be truly customer-centric.
  
  
Canon Canada’s strategic investment in Supra ITS strengthens this commitment by integrating Canon’s cutting-edge technologies with Supra’s agile IT services. This partnership fosters innovation, enhances efficiency, and accelerates digital transformation, providing customers with superior IT solutions that are scalable, secure, and customer centric.
  
  
For more information, visit www.supraits.com.
  
  
**About Atomic North**
Atomic North is the India-based subsidiary of Supra ITS, serving as the global delivery and operations centre behind Supra’s Managed IT, Application Services, and BPO businesses. As an integral part of Supra ITS’ international ecosystem, Atomic North ensures operational transparency, and seamless collaboration with our North American leadership teams. As Supra ITS scales rapidly across North America in partnership with Canon, Atomic North is expanding its leadership team in India to support the company’s next phase of growth, maturity, and operational excellence.
  
  
**Team Overview**
This is your opportunity to join a dynamic company with a team that works very well together and has solid organized structures in place. Supra’s head office is based in Brampton, Ontario with offices across North America and growing, you will be part of a growing team and evolving company.
  
  
Our global delivery operations are in India through our subsidiary, Atomic North. With Canon’s strategic equity partnership and a strong North American customer base, Supra ITS is scaling its India operations to deliver world-class infrastructure services, automation, and cybersecurity solutions.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a strategic technical leader who can balance architecture, reliability, security, cost, and team growth while guiding engineers and driving long-term technical vision.
  
  
As Solution Architect, you'll define the technical strategy for the AI ITSM Agent Platform. You'll make cloud infrastructure decisions, design systems for scale, build and mentor the engineering team, and ensure we execute with excellence. You'll report to the CTO and own the platform's technical roadmap for 18–24 months.
  
  
**YOU ARE!**
An experienced Solution Architect with 8+ years’ experience in production software engineering
  
  
2+ years’ experience in architecture or technical leadership.
  
  
Can articulate technical vision to C-level and engineers
  
  
Writes clear RFCs and design docs that guide implementation
  
  
Runs effective technical discussions; makes decisive trade-off decisions
  
  
Builds and mentors engineers; creates psychological safety and growth
  
  
Transparent: admits when you don't know; seeks expertise
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**What you’ll own**

* Technical architecture: design system for 10x growth (compute, data, async processing, observability)
* Cloud infrastructure on AWS/GCP/Azure: serverless vs. containerized, multi-region strategy, cost optimization
* Security & compliance: authentication, authorization, encryption, audit logging, data privacy
* Observability: monitoring, logging, alerting, SLOs/SLIs, incident response
* Team building: hire engineers (junior through architect), establish best practices, mentorship
* Technology choices: databases, message queues, vector DBs, agent frameworks, deployment platforms
* Reliability: design for 99.9% uptime, disaster recovery, data integrity
* Cost optimization: right-sizing resources, pricing models, vendor management

**Tech Stack**

* Clouds - AWS (EC2, ECS, RDS, Lambda, S3) or GCP (Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, Cloud Run) or Azure
* Full Stack - React, TypeScript, FastAPI, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker
* Distributed - Message queues, load balancing, replication, sharding
* Agents/AI - LLM integration patterns, agent orchestration, MCP, vector scaling, Claude Agents
* Observability - Structured logging, metrics, traces, alerting (Datadog, ELK, etc.)

**Technical Experience**
**Deep Technical Knowledge:**

* Mastery across full stack: React, TypeScript, FastAPI, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker
* Can jump into any layer and make informed decisions or code changes
* Deep understanding of trade-offs between technologies

**Cloud Architecture (AWS, GCP, Or Azure—Deep In One)**

* Compute options: EC2/VMs vs. Lambda/serverless vs. Kubernetes; when each is appropriate
* Database scaling: read replicas, Multi-AZ, replication, sharding strategies
* Networking: VPC design, security groups, load balancing, multi-region failover
* Security: encryption, secrets management, IAM, audit logging, compliance
* Cost optimization: right-sizing, reserved instances, spot instances, pricing models

**System Architecture At Scale**

* Microservices vs. monolith: when each is appropriate
* Asynchronous processing: message queues, job processors, event-driven architecture
* Caching strategies: cache invalidation, CDN, in-memory, database-level
* API design patterns: rate limiting, circuit breakers, bulkheads

**Operational Excellence**

* Observability: structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, alerting
* SLOs/SLIs: defining reliability targets, measuring against them
* Incident response: post-mortems, root cause analysis, blameless culture
* Deployment strategies: blue-green, canary, feature flags, rollback

**AI & Agent Systems**

* LLM integration patterns: streaming, token management, rate limiting
* Agent workflow architecture: planning, memory, reflection, tool use
* Vector embedding pipelines: batch processing, caching, similarity search at scale
* Cost optimization for LLM usage: token counting, batching, caching

**Preferred Qualifications**
While not required, preference may be given to candidates with experience in the following areas:
  
  

* Redis caching and optimization
* Message queues (Celery, Bull)
* GraphQL experience
* Advanced prompt engineering and fine-tuning experience

Skills: python,ai agents,cloud architecture,typescript

181a3647.description:
**Job Summary**
Responsible for the management, operations, delivery and support of defined IT applications and/or infrastructure services; directs and coordinates the efforts of people to accomplish goals and objectives using available resources.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

2cb3662b.title: Expert Service Delivery Manager
2cb3662b.description:
**Overview:**
The Service Delivery Manager is a senior operations position providing leadership for rotational team and collaborate with duty managers supporting 100+ clients on a rotating shift pattern, responsible for the efficient and professional execution of activities associated with providing an exceptional level of hospitality for clients' mission-critical systems. The Service Delivery Manager also serves as the accountable owner of Change Management governance for the entire business unit under the Altera Cloud Operations Change Management Process (v2.1) — chairing the Technical Review Board (TRB), overseeing implementation and validation, and holding final closure authority across all towers and shifts.
  
  
Change Implementation, Validation & Closure
  
  

* Facilitate TRB meeting for change reviews across cloud BU.
* Staff and lead the Hosting Response Bridge (HRB), providing 24x7 monitoring across the post-change stability window; trigger swarms the moment an anomaly is detected.
* Enforce alert-suppression discipline and confirm pre-change baseline capture and post-change comparison before closure.
* Oversee validation against Validation Test Library pass/fail criteria and evidence — including mandatory application and technical validation for production changes.
* Hold final closure authority: confirm the 24-hour or TRB approved closure window with HRB observation if the change was clean and evidence is complete before authorizing closure; refuse closure otherwise.
* Invoke rollback directly against a pre-agreed trigger without further approval; escalate exceptions to the Tower Leader.
* Carry open items into shift handover with clear owners so closure is never missed across a shift boundary.

Operational Leadership & Incident Management
  
  

* Major incident / critical issue early detection and fast remediation for all matters during their shift.
* Ensure all client requests, incidents, and problems are addressed in a timely and professional manner.
* Run stand-up calls with their team, managing proper hand-over of activities and client status between shifts and teams.
* Allocate resources as necessary across teams to provide efficient, effective resolution of issues.
* Identify and implement operational process improvements across teams.
* Assist Shift Site Reliability Engineers with client communication and escalations.
* Drive results through agreed KPIs for alerts, monitoring tools, and case/ServiceNow (SNOW) metrics.

TRB Ownership & Change Process Governance
  
  

* Chair the Technical Review Board: the final gate reviewing risk classification, architectural impact, rollback adequacy, and monitoring plan for every change; approve, send back for rework, or escalate.
* Pre-agree and record rollback triggers at TRB, each with a maximum time-to-decide.
* Own and continuously improve the end-to-end process, intake template, and Validation Test Library across all towers.
* Track and report TRB gate-hold and rework rates monthly; a near-zero rework rate signals the board is a formality, not a control.

People Management
  
  

* Provide detailed and accurate job performance feedback for each resource working under their guidance.
* Supervise employee attendance and participation.
* Inspire and motivate employees on their rotating shift.

Reporting Relationships
  
  
The Service Delivery Manager has primary responsibility for the rating and review of each employee dedicated to rotating with them, with input from the Tower Manager. The Tower Manager is accountable for best practices, effective training/testing, and the overall architecture and direction of their service delivery tower, and provides functional direction and input into employee ratings. Employees have a hard-line reporting relationship into their Tower Manager, with a dotted line to the Service Delivery Manager.
  
  
Metrics Ownership
  
  

* Report monthly: peer-review SLA breaches, TRB gate-hold/rework rates, closure refusals, change success and change-caused incident rates (24-hr/7-day), rollback invocation/success rate, and process exceptions by tower, alongside case/SNOW and alerting KPIs.
* Success rate for changes driven thought TRB , all changes should be successful.
* Bi-weekly reporting of change management team control deck.

1b3ddb5b.title: AMS Cloud EPM ARCS Consultant
1b3ddb5b.description:
Overview:
  
At Peloton, we don't just implement technology. We transform the way organizations work, compete, and grow. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in the US, Peloton is one of the most respected and fastest-growing global Oracle consulting firms, delivering Advisory, Consulting, and Managed Services to leading organizations across many industries, including Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Consumer Packaged Goods, and more.
  
Peloton Consulting Group has the vision and connected global capabilities to help organizations envision, implement, and realize the benefits of digital transformation. Our team has the best practices, knowledge, industry expertise, and know-how. We make digital transformation a reality by leveraging AI, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Supply Chain Management (SCM), Human Capital Management (HCM), Customer Experience (CX), Analytics, and Data Management for the cloud. Through connected capabilities, we bring people, processes, and technology together. We help organizations go further faster. That is the Peloton way!
  
What truly sets us apart is our people. We are team players. We are energetic and entrepreneurial. We are problem solvers and innovative thinkers who believe the best outcomes are built together. We believe in quality, appreciate creativity, recognize individual contributions, and place trust in every member of our team. If you bring strong business or technical expertise and want to do meaningful work alongside people who are equally passionate about getting it right, we think you'll feel right at home here.
  
This role requires a balance of client relationship management, operational oversight, and strategic thinking to ensure services are delivered efficiently and aligned with evolving client business needs.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
This role requires candidates to work in IST hours from 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM and have a minimum of 6+ years of relevant professional experience.
  
While this is a remote opportunity open to candidates across India, applicants based in Hyderabad or Bangalore will be preferred, as these are our primary hiring locations.
  
  
The consultant will work as part of the Application Managed Services (AMS) / Support team, providing ongoing functional and technical support for Oracle ARCS (Account Reconciliation Cloud Service) and related EPM Cloud applications. The role focuses on ensuring smooth reconciliation processes, resolving production issues, and supporting business users in financial close activities.
  
  
- Provide L2/L3 support for Oracle ARCS including Reconciliation Compliance and Transaction Matching modules
  
- Monitor and support month-end and period-end reconciliation processes to ensure timely completion
  
- Resolve issues related to reconciliations, matching rules, data loads, profiles, and automated business rules
  
- Troubleshoot and fix issues in ARCS configurations, security, reports, and workflow processes
  
- Support data integration activities between ERP/source systems and ARCS, including validation and reconciliation
  
- Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and provide permanent fixes or workarounds
  
- Assist in data validation, tie-outs, and discrepancy resolution between source systems and ARCS
  
- Handle incident tickets, service requests, and minor enhancement requests within SLA timelines
  
- Support user access, security roles, and application maintenance activities
  
- Coordinate with technical teams for system issues, enhancements, and integration fixes
  
- Maintain support documentation, knowledge base articles, and issue resolution logs
  
- Ensure adherence to ITIL processes (incident, problem, and change management)
  
- Support business users during financial close cycles and audit-related activities
  
- Participate in shift-based support as required for global clients
  
  
  
Required Qualifications & Experience
  
- 6–10 years of experience in Oracle ARCS / FCCS implementation or support (AMS preferred)
  
- Hands-on experience in Oracle EPM Cloud support or post-go-live environments
  
- Exposure to FDM / FDMEE / Data Management tools
  
- Understanding of reconciliation processes, financial close cycle, and reporting
  
- Knowledge of GAAP, IFRS, SOX compliance, and financial controls
  
- Experience with ERP systems (Oracle, SAP, PeopleSoft, etc.)
  
- Strong skills in data reconciliation, issue troubleshooting, and analysis
  
- Exposure to intercompany eliminations, currency translation, and financial reporting concepts
  
- Familiarity with Smart View and Financial Reporting tools
  
- Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  
- Ability to work in a client-facing AMS/support environment
  
- Alignment with delivery values: ownership, teamwork, can-do attitude, and client focus
  
  
Compensation:
  
Peloton provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, business needs, and geographic location. Peloton also offer bonus opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package including
  
- Competitive base salary with performance-based bonus
  
  
- Vacation, Leave, and Holiday pay
  
  
- Annual Health Wallet
  
  
- Group Medical Insurance
  
  
- Group Term Accident & Life Insurance
  
  
- Paid holidays and PTO
  
  
Peloton Group is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
