b628dbb6.description:
**Who we are?**

***About Johnson Controls***

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services, and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results, and help move society forward.

Visit johnsoncontrols.com for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms.

**What you will do**

We are looking for a technically skilled and customer-focused **Implementation & Support Technical Specialist** to deploy, configure, maintain, and support **ShopperTrak retail analytics solutions** across retail customer environments. The role is responsible for Pre Sales discussion with end-to-end implementation of traffic counting systems, occupancy solutions, retail analytics platforms, data integrations, and ongoing technical support.

The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in retail technology, networking, field deployments, troubleshooting, and customer engagement. The specialist will work closely with sales, project management, customer success, product engineering, and retail customers to ensure successful implementation and operational excellence.

**How you will do it**  
**Solution Design, Implementation & Deployment:**

* Pre Sales engagement with client along with Sales team for Designing the solution to provide all required KPI’s by client.
* Coordinating with Subcon for best quote and installation planning and supporting Subcon team to find suitable Subcon in unrepresented areas.
* Install, configure, and commission ShopperTrak traffic counting and retail analytics solutions.
* Conduct site surveys and assess infrastructure readiness including network, power, mounting locations, and connectivity requirements.
* Deploy and configure:

* + ShopperTrak Vision sensors
  + Traffic counting devices
  + Occupancy monitoring solutions
* Validate sensor performance, counting accuracy, and data quality.
* Execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and customer sign-off procedures.
* Coordinate implementation activities with retailers, contractors, IT teams, and project managers.
* Ensure deployments meet project timelines, quality standards, and customer expectations.

**Technical Support & Operations :**

* Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for ShopperTrak hardware and software solutions.
* Troubleshoot:
  + Sensor communication issues
  + Network connectivity failures
  + Analytics data synchronization problems
* Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
* Monitor system health and proactively address performance issues.
* Manage incidents, service requests, and escalations according to SLA commitments.
* Coordinate with global engineering and product support teams for complex issues.
* Ensuring PO to Subcon is issued on time to meet SLA committed to clients.

**Documentation & Compliance :**

* Create and maintain:
  + Solution Design including markup plans wherever required.
  + Installation guides
  + Technical runbooks
  + Site documentation
  + Network diagrams
  + Support procedures
  + Knowledge base articles
* Maintain deployment records and configuration management documentation.
* Ensure all Implementation and Services reports are available for submitting to client for timely recognizing the revenue.
* Ensure compliance with customer security and data privacy requirements.

**What we look for**

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics Engineering, Telecommunications, or related discipline.

**Experience**

* 3-7 years of experience in:
  + Retail technology deployments
  + Field implementation
  + Technical support
  + Systems integration
  + IoT or analytics solutions

**Technical Skills**

**Networking**

* TCP/IP
* DNS
* DHCP
* VPN
* Firewall fundamentals
* LAN/WAN troubleshooting

**Operating Systems**

* Windows
* Linux fundamentals – will be added advantage

**Tools**

* ServiceNow/Remedy
* Jira
* Power BI
* Excel (Advanced)
* Remote support tools

**Preferred Experience**

* Solution deployment and support.
* Retail implementation projects.
* Traffic counting and occupancy monitoring technologies.
* Sensormatic Solutions ecosystem knowledge.
* Multi-site retail rollout experience.
* Supporting large retail brands.
* Experience working with supermarkets, fashion retailers, department stores, specialty retail, and shopping malls.

**Key Competencies**

* Advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis
* Customer-facing communication skills
* Project coordination
* Technical documentation
* Stakeholder management
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to work independently in field environments

**Success Metrics**

* On-time implementation delivery (>95%)
* Customer acceptance and sign-off success rate
* SLA compliance for incident resolution
* System uptime and device availability
* Traffic count accuracy targets
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) scores
* Reduction in recurring incidents
* Successful customer training and onboarding completion

**What we offer:**

We offer a challenging and exciting position as part of a global, multi-industrial corporation. Joining us provides a stimulating work environment, career development opportunities, and the chance to make a significant impact on society.

756a972d.title: Sr Service Delivery Manager
756a972d.description:
**Overview:**
The Service Delivery Manager is a senior operations position providing leadership for rotational team and collaborate with duty managers supporting 100+ clients on a rotating shift pattern, responsible for the efficient and professional execution of activities associated with providing an exceptional level of hospitality for clients' mission-critical systems. The Service Delivery Manager also serves as the accountable owner of Change Management governance for the entire business unit under the Altera Cloud Operations Change Management Process (v2.1) — chairing the Technical Review Board (TRB), overseeing implementation and validation, and holding final closure authority across all towers and shifts.
  
  
Change Implementation, Validation & Closure
  
  

* Facilitate TRB meeting for change reviews across cloud BU.
* Staff and lead the Hosting Response Bridge (HRB), providing 24x7 monitoring across the post-change stability window; trigger swarms the moment an anomaly is detected.
* Enforce alert-suppression discipline and confirm pre-change baseline capture and post-change comparison before closure.
* Oversee validation against Validation Test Library pass/fail criteria and evidence — including mandatory application and technical validation for production changes.
* Hold final closure authority: confirm the 24-hour or TRB approved closure window with HRB observation if the change was clean and evidence is complete before authorizing closure; refuse closure otherwise.
* Invoke rollback directly against a pre-agreed trigger without further approval; escalate exceptions to the Tower Leader.
* Carry open items into shift handover with clear owners so closure is never missed across a shift boundary.

Operational Leadership & Incident Management
  
  

* Major incident / critical issue early detection and fast remediation for all matters during their shift.
* Ensure all client requests, incidents, and problems are addressed in a timely and professional manner.
* Run stand-up calls with their team, managing proper hand-over of activities and client status between shifts and teams.
* Allocate resources as necessary across teams to provide efficient, effective resolution of issues.
* Identify and implement operational process improvements across teams.
* Assist Shift Site Reliability Engineers with client communication and escalations.
* Drive results through agreed KPIs for alerts, monitoring tools, and case/ServiceNow (SNOW) metrics.

TRB Ownership & Change Process Governance
  
  

* Chair the Technical Review Board: the final gate reviewing risk classification, architectural impact, rollback adequacy, and monitoring plan for every change; approve, send back for rework, or escalate.
* Pre-agree and record rollback triggers at TRB, each with a maximum time-to-decide.
* Own and continuously improve the end-to-end process, intake template, and Validation Test Library across all towers.
* Track and report TRB gate-hold and rework rates monthly; a near-zero rework rate signals the board is a formality, not a control.

People Management
  
  

* Provide detailed and accurate job performance feedback for each resource working under their guidance.
* Supervise employee attendance and participation.
* Inspire and motivate employees on their rotating shift.

Reporting Relationships
  
  
The Service Delivery Manager has primary responsibility for the rating and review of each employee dedicated to rotating with them, with input from the Tower Manager. The Tower Manager is accountable for best practices, effective training/testing, and the overall architecture and direction of their service delivery tower, and provides functional direction and input into employee ratings. Employees have a hard-line reporting relationship into their Tower Manager, with a dotted line to the Service Delivery Manager.
  
  
Metrics Ownership
  
  

* Report monthly: peer-review SLA breaches, TRB gate-hold/rework rates, closure refusals, change success and change-caused incident rates (24-hr/7-day), rollback invocation/success rate, and process exceptions by tower, alongside case/SNOW and alerting KPIs.
* Success rate for changes driven thought TRB , all changes should be successful.
* Bi-weekly reporting of change management team control deck.

**Essential Responsibilities**

Solution Architecture & Delivery

* Own end-to-end technical design across the application, integration, automation, and cloud

infrastructure layers of the solution stack for enterprise initiatives prioritized on EBITDA and TWC

impact, building on the governed data platform in Microsoft Fabric.

reference architectures, and reusable design patterns.

resolve technical and organizational blockers, and engage the right people without needing step-by-step

direction.

(QAD), Microsoft 365, reporting, and operational platforms.

through production deployment.

change management and user adoption.

* Define plans to deliver change in 13 month increments, using agile methodologies to deliver

incremental improvements in quick time periods.

* Deploy solutions, train end users, and drive adoption.

AI & Automation Strategy

objectives.

support tools.

agentic solutions, robotic process automation, and machine learning applications, using Microsoft

Foundry and Azure AI Services where they fit.

adjacent solutions.

  

* Establish standards, governance, and reusable patterns for automation and AI development across the

business.

* Rapidly prototype to demonstrate possibilities to business leaders and build the case for investment.
* Conduct build-versus-buy analysis and advise leadership on where internal development delivers better

value than third-party engagement.

* Identify technical, delivery, and adoption risks early and develop mitigation strategies that optimize cost

and risk.

* Maintain current expertise in a rapidly evolving technology landscape through industry conferences,

vendor technical briefings, certification programs, and continuous hands-on evaluation of new platforms

and tools.

* Bring external market and technology insight back into the business, assessing new capabilities against

Gexpro's operating needs and recommending where they warrant investment or piloting.

Business Partnership & Process Improvement

* Engage directly with branch teams, functional support, vertical and site leadership, customers, and

suppliers to identify process gaps and simplification opportunities.

* Gather business requirements independently and translate them into technical requirements and

solution designs without intermediary analysis.

* Drive strategic initiatives aimed at improving business KPIs through defining the issue, analyzing and

prioritizing root causes, making improvements, and verifying results.

* Gather data on existing processes, identify where the top problems are, and demonstrate improvement

results after positive changes are made.

* Build and present business cases, cost-benefit analyses, and solution recommendations to executive

leadership, including the CEO.

* Communicate clearly and proactively, in writing and in conversation, keeping business leaders, IT,

vendors, and delivery partners aligned on status, decisions, risks, and next steps.

* Gain the "hearts and minds" of employees globally to change the way they work and improve the

top/bottom line and customer service.

Vendor & Program Leadership

* Lead technology vendor evaluations and selection processes, including requirements definition,

demonstrations, scoring, and commercial recommendation.

* Own the business case and secure funding approval for technology investments.
* Partner with IT, vendors, and business stakeholders to integrate solutions into existing enterprise

systems.

* Govern third-party delivery partners through the implementation lifecycle, including regular working

sessions, scope management, and acceptance of delivered work against requirements.

* Configure and lead the setup of supporting IT infrastructure required for third-party and internal

solutions.

Leadership & Team Development

* Manage and develop direct reports, including goal setting, work assignment, performance feedback, and

career development planning.

  

* Provide technical mentorship through code review, design review, and pairing; establish the engineering

standards and practices the team works to.

* Onboard and ramp early-career technical hires, building their capability in cloud, automation, and AI

development.

* Scope and delegate work appropriately, balancing individual delivery against team throughput and

development goals.

Skills, Knowledge, And Education

Required

* At least six years of professional experience spanning technology delivery and business process

improvement.

* Resourcefulness and self-direction: demonstrated ability to take an objective, determine how to move it

forward, and solve problems independently without needing to be guided through every step.

* Experience leading multiple AI, automation, or application solutions from concept through deployment

with measurable business outcomes.

* Demonstrated experience owning solutions end-to-end: business requirements, solution architecture,

development, integration, deployment, adoption, and ongoing improvement.

* Proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Hands-on experience designing and building applications and services on Microsoft Azure (for example,

Azure Functions, App Service, Logic Apps, and API Management).

* Working knowledge of cloud architecture, security, identity, and cloud-native solution design.
* Experience designing system integrations and APIs across enterprise platforms.
* Working knowledge of enterprise systems (Microsoft 365, ERPs, etc.).
* Understanding of Robotic Process Automation and enterprise automation platforms (for example,

Power Automate).

* Experience leading vendor selection and managing third-party delivery partners.
* Strong project and program management capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of process improvement.
* Proven ability to translate ambiguous business problems into actionable technical solutions.
* Experience driving change management and user adoption.
* Experience working cross-functionally within the business and with external partners.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready presentation and experience

presenting to executive audiences.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate effectively and work across

all levels of the organization.

* Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and the ability to rapidly acquire and apply new

technical skills as the technology landscape changes.

* Team oriented with a hands-on leadership style.

Preferred

* Experience with Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI Services, and the broader Microsoft AI ecosystem.
* Experience designing and building applications using generative AI services, models, APIs, and SDKs.
* Experience with AI agents and agentic workflows, including tool/function calling, orchestration, and

integration with enterprise systems.

* Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containerization, and cloud deployment practices.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric and Power BI as governed data sources for AI solutions.
* Relevant Microsoft Azure or AI certifications, including current Microsoft Applied Skills credentials.
* Experience mentoring technical staff or providing technical leadership across cross-functional teams.

experience.

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.

With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Solution Architect owns the end to end technical and architectural design of complex enterprise solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives, enterprise architecture standards, and platform capabilities. This role bridges business strategy and technology execution by defining scalable, secure, and cost-effective solution architectures, providing architectural governance, and guiding delivery teams through design and implementation.

**Architecture & Engineering**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 12-18 years of experience in solution architecture, system design, and enterprise scale delivery.
* Strong expertise in Azure Databricks, Apache Spark (PySpark), Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and scaled distributed data processing.
* Proficiency with Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, and modern data orchestration tools. Hands-on experience building end-to-end data pipelines using Python and PySpark.
* Deep understanding of technical architecture patterns, microservices, APIs, kafka, and integration frameworks.
* Solid experience with DevOps and CI/CD tooling (Azure Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Terraform or similar)
* Work closely with multiple architects to align on the right architecture design.
* Drive adoption of enterprise architecture design standards.
* Propose alternative solutions when standard approaches don’t fit, while staying aligned to enterprise principles

**Data & Platform Architecture**

* Experience designing largescale data platforms and Lakehouse-style architectures.
* Knowledge of data governance, security, metadata management, and lineage.
* Strong understanding of data governance, security, compliance, and cloud cost optimization.

**DevOps & Non-Functional Requirements**

* Experience driving DevOps, CI/CD, and automated deployment practices at the architectural level.
* Strong focus on performance, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization.

**Leadership & Communication**

* Proven ability to influence architectural decisions across teams and stakeholders.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate complex designs clearly.
* Excellent analytical, communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in Oil & Gas, subsurface, facilities, or industrial data platforms.
* Familiarity with OSDU aligned architectures and industry data standards.
* Relevant cloud or architecture certifications.
* Experience working with OSDU (Open Subsurface Data Universe) data models or similar energy industry data standards.

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, supporting business requirements across the world. Accordingly, the work hours for employees will be aligned to support business requirements. The standard work week will be Monday to Friday. Working hours are 8:00am to 5:00pm or 1:30pm to 10:30pm.
  
  
**What We Can Offer You**
Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.
  
  
Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.
  
  

* Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.
* Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.
* Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron’s values and business priorities.

**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced OCI Cloud Architect to manage and support Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments across Development, UAT, and Production, including Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) application environments. The role requires strong expertise in cloud security, application hosting, patching, upgrades, CI/CD pipelines, and the design of highly available and disaster-resilient :
  
  

* Own the architecture and day-to-day operation of the OCI compartments across production, DR and non-production tiers (DEV, TST, UAT, QA, SIT).

* Design and maintain High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions for OCI and EBS.
* Run vulnerability management and enforce security and governance standards.
* Perform DR testing, failover exercises, and ensure RTO/RPO objectives are met.
* Apply shift-left automation to reduce repeat incidents, and support FinOps review of compute, load balancer and storage consumption.
* Operate within the customer's change management (CAB), incident and problem management processes.
* Experience operating in an ITIL-aligned managed service with SLA/XLA reporting and multi-vendor governance.
* Excellent troubleshooting and stakeholder communication; comfortable working within a shift roster.
* Monitor performance, availability, capacity, and cost across OCI and EBS environments.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure, database, and application issues across all environments.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, SOPs and runbooks; participate in service governance and reporting against SLA/XLA measures.
* Collaborate with application, database, DevOps, and security teams.

**Key Skills & Qualifications**

* Deep hands-on OCI experience - networking, security, governance, compartment and tenancy design, multi-region architecture.
* Proven experience running Oracle EBS environments at the infrastructure, OS and database layers.
* Oracle Database 19c on Exadata (Exadata VM clusters / DB Systems), Data Guard, backup and recovery.
* Terraform and CI/CD pipeline delivery; automation-first operating mindset.
* Strong Linux administration and scripting skills (Bash, Python).
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* OCI Architect and/or Oracle EBS certifications (preferred).

8beafc32.title: Senior Program Manager
8beafc32.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Program Manager based in India.**
The Senior Program Manager will lead complex, large-scale data and AI transformation programs for strategic enterprise customers, ensuring successful delivery and measurable business outcomes. You will oversee multiple workstreams, coordinate multidisciplinary teams, and manage critical delivery dimensions, including budgets, resources, timelines, and client expectations. Acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, you will translate business objectives into actionable roadmaps while proactively managing risks and opportunities. You will collaborate with sales, engineering, architecture, and delivery leadership to strengthen customer relationships and drive long-term account growth. Beyond client engagements, you will contribute to improving organizational delivery standards, governance frameworks, and operational best practices. This is an opportunity to influence strategic initiatives within a remote-first, globally distributed data and AI consulting environment.
  
  
**Accountabilities**
As Senior Program Manager, you will take end-to-end ownership of strategic customer programs, ensuring consistent execution, financial performance, and alignment with business objectives. You will combine strong client leadership with operational discipline, team development, and continuous improvement to deliver high-impact data and AI initiatives.
  
  

* Program and Client Delivery: Lead complex, multi-workstream data and AI programs for strategic enterprise customers, from initial discovery through execution and scaling, ensuring alignment with client objectives and measurable outcomes.
* Strategic Roadmap Development: Translate business priorities into actionable data and AI roadmaps, connecting architecture, engineering, and delivery activities to clear business value and milestones.
* Resource and Financial Management: Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, revenue targets, margins, forecasts, and resource allocation across multiple concurrent customer engagements while maintaining high utilization and delivery quality.
* Program Governance: Establish and maintain robust governance frameworks, including operating cadences, RACI structures, risk and issue logs, decision tracking, change control processes, and stakeholder communication plans.
* Risk and Issue Management: Proactively identify delivery, scope, and resource-related risks, develop recovery strategies, and drive issues through to resolution.
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders, including C-level executives, facilitating strategic alignment, informed decision-making, and effective management of competing priorities.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, account management, engineering, architecture, and delivery leadership to strengthen customer success and overall account health.
* Team Leadership and Mentorship: Lead and mentor multidisciplinary teams across geographies and time zones, supporting professional development, improving delivery standards, and coaching other Program Managers and Technical Program Managers.
* Client Engagement and Innovation: Facilitate workshops, innovation forums, and onsite sessions to accelerate stakeholder alignment, solution adoption, and value realization.
* Delivery Excellence: Develop and refine program management methodologies, playbooks, templates, documentation standards, and key performance indicators across the delivery organization.
* Business Development Support: Contribute to proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs), executive presentations, account plans, and strategic roadmaps in collaboration with sales and delivery teams.
* Account Growth: Identify and support upselling and cross-selling opportunities for data and AI solutions, helping expand strategic customer relationships.
* Operational Transformation: Champion process improvements, automation, and the adoption of AI-powered tools to increase delivery efficiency, predictability, and scalability.
* Organizational Development: Help develop future leaders and promote a culture of accountability, psychological safety, transparency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Requirements**
The ideal candidate is a highly experienced technical program management professional with a strong consulting background and a proven ability to deliver complex data and AI initiatives for enterprise customers. You should combine commercial awareness, technical understanding, executive communication skills, and exceptional leadership capabilities. The role requires someone who can navigate complex stakeholder environments, manage multiple strategic engagements simultaneously, and consistently translate business objectives into successful delivery outcomes.
  
  

* 15+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, leading complex, multi-workstream initiatives.

1f6b4bb1.title: Senior Program Manager
1f6b4bb1.description:
**About the Role**

You will own end-to-end delivery of private label programs for our key US big-box retail partners. You'll be the single point of contact for the retailer's cross-functional teams: Sourcing, Product Development, Quality, Packaging and Logistics. Internally, you'll drive PlayShifu's design, packaging, quality and operations teams so that every deliverable lands on time and to spec. You will run each program from product shortlisting to PO release, production and shipment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and run the Time & Action (TnA) plan for every program, working backwards from retailer calendars. It covers design freeze, tooling, T0/T1/T2, packaging, testing, production, inspections and ship dates.
* Lead weekly calls with retailer Sourcing, Quality and Logistics teams. Publish status updates and escalate risks early.
* Hold internal teams accountable to TnA milestones, and flag dependencies and delays before they become misses.
* Manage the retailer's PD portal: create product IDs, track design feedback and revisions, and coordinate sample requests and timelines with internal teams against retailer ETDs.
* Work with our Toy Design team so that every feedback loop closes within the agreed timelines.
* Consolidate documentation from internal teams, including BOM, measurements, claims and Manufacturing Variability. Get it submitted and approved on time.
* Translate the retailer's structural packaging guidelines and feedback into clear briefs and deadlines for our internal packaging team.
* Consolidate all packaging content (copy, claims, warnings, specs, imagery) from internal teams and submit it to the retailer.
* Lead the retailer-side proofing process with the retailer's artwork agency. Review soft and hard proofs for UPC/EAN, regulatory copy, battery instructions and font requirements, and route corrections through the internal packaging team.
* Track testing, inspection and audit milestones (DUPRO, FRI, TOP, quality and responsible sourcing audits) against the TnA. Work through the internal quality and operations teams, who manage labs, inspection agencies and factories.
* Act as the retailer's point of contact on quality and compliance. Make sure that issues, corrective actions and approvals are closed on time.
* Represent PlayShifu in placement and production-readiness reviews alongside the operations and quality team.
* Work with the operations team's systems & item setup function to keep vendor portal data (costing, item setup, case pack, vendor order points, factory mapping) accurate and consistent with what's been agreed with the retailer.
* Track item-wise progress from costing to PO release, and flag gaps or delays that could hold up a business award or PO.
* Support cost submissions and cost-change management, working with the Head of Sales.

**Requirements**

* 8–12 years in program management, merchandising or sourcing for consumer products. Toys, juvenile, hardlines or seasonal/outdoor preferred.
* Hands-on experience delivering private label programs for US big-box retailers. Buying house, sourcing agency, export house or vendor-side experience is ideal.
* Working knowledge of retailer vendor portals, product development workflows, packaging development and product compliance and testing. You need enough depth to review the work and challenge it. Hands-on vendor management is not required.
* Proven ability to drive cross-functional teams without direct authority. You set the timelines, hold teams accountable and escalate early.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication. You'll be the face of PlayShifu to senior retailer stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail, comfort with structured trackers, and the ability to run several programs in parallel.
* Willingness to work with a US time-zone overlap, and to travel occasionally to retailer offices and production-readiness reviews.

**What We Offer**

* Visibility and ownership from day one, working directly with leadership.
* A fast-growing business with some of the world's largest retailers as partners.
* Freedom to build processes for a program that is set to scale significantly.

**FICO (NYSE: FICO)**
is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Business Partner in our Domain Risk Pre-Sales unit, you'll identify and cultivate new opportunities related to credit and fraud risk, combining deep business knowledge across both domains with a consultative, solutions-based approach to selling. This role focuses on building new revenue streams through the expansion of FICO Platform capabilities, working closely with the Asia Pacific sales team to translate client business challenges into compelling and credible solutions.
  
  
**What You’ll Contribute**

* Partner with clients on discovery and scoping sessions to uncover business challenges and growth opportunities, then develop proposals and business cases that demonstrate value.
* Contribute to client account plans and lead deal structuring and negotiations, working with internal teams to shape and position solutions that protect existing business and win new deals.
* Contribute to go-to-market strategy and market sizing, tracking industry trends and maintaining a strong grasp of our products and the competitive landscape.
* Support innovation workshops, quarterly business reviews, and PoC/PoV engagements, acting as a credit and fraud risk subject matter expert for financial services, insurance, retail, and telecommunications clients.
* Apply your knowledge of the risk management lifecycle, including originations, customer management, fraud, collections, and digital transformation, to build platform demos with Key Account Managers, Solution Sales Executives, and Platform Presales teams.
* Develop strategic plans, proposals, business cases, and executive presentations, tailoring content for audiences ranging from technical teams to C-level executives.
* Build FICO Platform brand awareness and thought leadership through social media, case studies, blogs, white papers, webinars, and event presentations.
* Up to 50% travel across the region.

**What We’re Seeking**

* Exceptional executive-level communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to engage C-suite stakeholders, boards, and senior leadership, translating complex business insights and technical detail into business impact, ROI, and actionable strategy across strategic planning documents, proposals, and business cases.
* Experience in credit and/or fraud risk management, with a proven track record of achieving meaningful loss reduction and/or customer experience improvements, complemented by sales experience as a vendor and demonstrated project leadership and results orientation.
* Comprehensive understanding of the risk management lifecycle across the entire customer journey, with senior-level expertise across multiple credit and fraud risk domains including originations, transactional/payment fraud, online/mobile banking fraud, application fraud, first party fraud, customer management, and collections.
* Extensive experience working with payment processors, payment gateways, payment networks, issuers, and acquirers, including authorization flows, real-time decisioning, and processor, gateway, and network-specific operating models.
* End-user knowledge of credit and fraud risk management solutions, authorization systems, authentication solutions, loan origination systems, and other decision management platforms.
* Bachelor's degree in business, analytics, data science, or a related field of study, or equivalent experience.

**Our Offer to You**

* An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
* The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
* Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
* An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

**Why Make a Move to FICO?**
At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.
  
  
FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:
  
  

* Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
* Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
* Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!
  
  
Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers
  
  
FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. While our qualifications are clearly related to role success, each candidate’s profile is unique and strengths in certain skill and/or experience areas can be equally effective. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.
  
  
Information submitted with your application is subject to the FICO Privacy policy at https://www.fico.com/en/privacy-policy

d5edaa4a.title: Consulting Solutions Engineer

**Own Every Moment at NetApp**
At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.
  
  
Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Consulting Solution Engineer within NetApp's Sales organization, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, channel partners, and internal stakeholders. You will play a critical role in driving revenue growth by aligning NetApp's technology solutions with customer business objectives and leading technical sales engagements across a high-value account portfolio.
  
  
This is a highly visible, customer-facing role offering significant opportunities for career growth and exposure to strategic enterprise customers. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise, consultative selling skills, executive presence, and the ability to build lasting relationships with customers, partners, Client Executives, and Sales Leaders.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Partner with Client Executives to develop and execute account strategies that drive revenue growth and market expansion.
* Build trusted relationships with technical stakeholders, business leaders, and C-level executives.
* Lead technical discovery sessions to understand customer challenges, requirements, and business objectives.
* Architect, demonstrate, and position NetApp solutions aligned to customer outcomes.

* Collaborate with channel partners and internal teams to drive opportunities and achieve territory goals.
* Present NetApp’s technology vision, value proposition, and competitive differentiation.

Job Requirement
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of enterprise storage, data protection, disaster recovery, and hybrid cloud solutions.
* Ability to present complex technical solutions to both technical and executive audiences.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and customer engagement skills.
* Experience influencing enterprise technology buying decisions and driving technical wins.

**Education & Experience**

* Minimum 15 years of experience in Technical Presales, Solution Engineering, or a related customer-facing technology role.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate degree or equivalent advanced qualification preferred. Cross-Functional Skills:
* Nvidia Certification, exposure to AI workloads and solutioning skills, worked on solutions with CSPs for AI Cloud. Knowledge on sizing solutions for AI workload and able to converse on solution stack. Basic understanding of machine learning fundamentals, deep learning, LLMs, and vector/streaming databases. Act as the knowledge bridge between infra stakeholders, data scientists, ML engineers, and DevOps/security teams and able to bring in skills to stitch complex solutions together. Proficiency in Kubernetes, big data platforms, and cloud-native architecture.

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.
  
  
**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**
At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.
  
  
NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.

We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.
  
  
If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.

250664e2.description:

A Lead Consultant at Argano is a highly experienced professional in the consulting family responsible for managing mid-to-large-size client engagements and contributing to the growth and development of the consulting practice. The Oracle Cloud Supply Chain Planning - Lead Consultant will focus on guiding and assisting clients through all phases of an Oracle Cloud Demand Management or Supply Planning implementation. * Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, , Engineering, etc.
* MBA, relevant master's degree or PhD.

**Experience**

* Experience with one or more of the following modules:

+ Demand Management
+ Supply Planning
+ Sales & Operations Planning
+ Replenishment Planning
+ Global Order Promising
+ Backlog Management
+ Production Scheduling

* Ability to lead a team, work independently and manage multiple task assignments.
* Prior experience leading or managing projects.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, and communication skills
* High commitment to exceed performance expectations.
* Ability to write functional specification based on user requirements.
* Senior enough to be able to independently handle client expectations.
* Professional approach when dealing with internal and external customers.
* Ability to maintain a positive attitude under stressful circumstances.
* Proficient with MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

* Thought Leadership: Providing thought leadership and industry expertise is critical in projects.

Argano is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying customized AI solutions using fine-tuning techniques, Knowledge Graphs, and GraphRAG.

The candidate will be responsible for architecting scalable AI solutions, optimizing LLM performance, and implementing advanced training methodologies such as Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO).

**4. AI Engineering & Implementation**

30ec2566.title: Senior Solutions Architect, APJC (Developer Platform) - India Market
30ec2566.description:
### **About Us**

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in.

### **Location:** **Singapore**

### **About Developer GTM**

The Developer GTM organization is a highly collaborative startup within Cloudflare, dedicated to attracting, inspiring, and growing the next generation of builders. We are redefining developer acquisition in a world where AI and distributed agents are reshaping the stack. Our mission is to create accessible and exciting pathways for developers to discover Cloudflare—whether through ecosystem partnerships, high-impact content, or creative field engagement.

We are a diverse team of builders, storytellers, and connectors united by one goal: to make Cloudflare the most empowering and exciting place for developers to build.

### **About the Role**

As a Senior Solutions Architect for the Developer Platform, you will shape and lead the regional technical strategy for our customer and partner engagements across APJC.

In this role, you will partner closely with engineering leaders, architects, developers, security teams, and executives to define architectures, validate technical approaches, and confidently transition production workloads onto Cloudflare. Rather than focusing on a single account, you will operate across a dynamic portfolio of engagements, ensuring broad impact.

A central part of your role involves translating your field experience into reusable organizational knowledge. You will create architectural frameworks, provide technical guidance, and champion the needs of regional customers directly to our product teams. This is a senior, individual-contributor role that beautifully balances hands-on architecture, executive collaboration, and regional technical leadership. You will report directly to the Director of Developer GTM, APJC.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Shape Strategy:** Guide the technical strategy for Developer Platform customers and partners across the region.
* **Design & Translate:** Transform business, application, security, and operational requirements into secure, scalable, and highly maintainable architectures on Cloudflare.
* **Collaborate & Advise:** Partner with engineering executives and senior stakeholders to advise on application modernization, distributed systems, AI architecture, and platform strategy.
* **Facilitate Discovery:** Lead architecture discovery sessions, technical workshops, proofs of concept, design reviews, and production-readiness discussions in a supportive, consultative manner.
* **Create Frameworks:** Establish reference architectures, architectural standards, and governance patterns that empower our customers and the broader APJC field organization.
* **Stay Hands-On:** Build, review, and troubleshoot representative applications and integrations.
* **Champion the Region:** Serve as a Developer Platform technical leader through presentations, written guidance, and internal enablement.
* **Mentor & Grow:** Support and mentor fellow solutions architects and technical colleagues navigating complex customer engagements.
* **Bridge Teams:** Build effective, continuous feedback loops between customers, field teams, and product leaders, translating regional needs into actionable product and go-to-market recommendations.

### **What Success Looks Like**

By the end of your first year, you will have:

* Become a trusted technical advisor and collaborative partner to customers, partners, and internal leaders.
* Established clear, actionable technical strategies and adoption plans for priority engagements.
* Helped customers successfully validate and launch their production workloads on Cloudflare.
* Published reusable reference architectures and field guidance that elevate the entire team.
* Improved the field organization's ability to position, architect, and deliver Cloudflare's developer and AI solutions.
* Cultivated the technical leadership of your colleagues through active mentorship and enablement.
* Provided product teams with consistent, evidence-based insights into regional customer requirements and adoption barriers.
* Become recognized as a supportive, authoritative Developer Platform leader across APJC.

### **What We're Looking For**

* **Meaningful Experience:** A strong background in solutions architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or a related customer-facing technical role. While candidates often bring 10+ years of experience, we care most about your demonstrated scope, impact, and ability to deliver results.
* **Language Skills:** Professional fluency in English and a major language spoken in India, with the ability to comfortably lead technical and executive discussions in both languages, to support clients in that region. A significant portion of your portfolio will consist of clients based in India.
* **Strategic Collaboration:** A track record of owning complex technical strategies involving developers, infrastructure teams, security stakeholders, and senior executives.
* **Technical Depth:** Deep working knowledge of distributed application architecture (compute, storage, networking, security, reliability, and observability).
* **Hands-On Capability:** Software-development experience, including the ability to build or review production-quality applications and proofs of concept (preferably in JavaScript or TypeScript).
* **Ecosystem Knowledge:** A strong understanding of modern web technologies, serverless/cloud-native architectures, modern software-delivery practices, and at least one major public cloud platform.
* **Influential Leadership:** A proven ability to influence without direct authority, thoughtfully mentor colleagues, and turn individual solutions into shared organizational capabilities.
* **Communication:** Excellent written, presentation, and facilitation skills tailored for developer, architectural, and executive audiences.
* **Travel:** Ability to travel up to 30%, primarily within APJC, including India (supported by flexible planning).

### **Nice-to-Have (Bonus Skills)**

* Experience building and operating production applications on Cloudflare's Developer Platform.
* Experience designing AI inference, agentic, retrieval-augmented generation, or data-intensive applications.
* Familiarity with customers, technology partners, or developer communities in India.
* A background in public speaking, technical writing, open-source contribution, or community building.
* Relevant cloud or architecture certifications.
* A degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, OR equivalent practical experience.

**Important Note:** *At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. You don't need to tick every single box to be right for this role. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.*

### **What Makes Cloudflare Special?**

We're not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We're a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

**Project Galileo**: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare's enterprise customers-at no cost.

**Athenian Project**: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

**1.1.1.1**: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here's the deal - we don't store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you'd like to be a part of? We'd love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

**Description**
AWS Global Sales (AGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Are you excited to work with the team that enables India’s conglomerates to build innovative services with AWS, scaling to serve billion+ Indians? The Conglomerates team in AWS India is looking for a Solutions Architect who can work with our customers who are augmenting their existing business empires with new business models on the foundations of payment infrastructure like UPI, quick commerce, widespread 5G internet access, affordable smartphones, exploding digital content, identity infrastructure like Aadhaar and world class AI & cloud infrastructure. These new businesses are rapidly and profoundly changing everyday life of billion+ Indians through their platforms & services for E-commerce, Smart Factories, Connected Vehicles, Travel & Hospitality, FinTech and many more.
  
  
#aws-ags-India
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Your broad responsibilities will include, owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects, and developing deep expertise in the AWS technologies as well as broad know-how around how applications and services are constructed using the AWS platform. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (DEI) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
The selected candidate will work with subsidiairies / JV of large Indian conglomerates to map business requirements to technology. The candidate will also ensure right TCO while meeting the functional & non-functional requirements. The Conglomerates team is one of the most diverse teams you would ever get in your career. Our team members have deep technology experience spanning areas of Analytics, IoT, AI/ML, GenAI, Observability, Resiliency & Security. Top it up with years of domain expertise across Automotive, Manufacturing, e-Commerce, Telco, Travel & Hospitality - this is the team where Tech meets Business for the largest movers & shakers of India's push to $5T economy.

d85b5a33.description:
We are building a secure, enterprise-grade AWS platform for our PERN-stack (PostgreSQL, Express, React, Node.js) ERP applications. A detailed blueprint (about 170 documented steps) already exists from our first setup. We need a hands-on cloud engineer to build the same setup for two more group companies, from the first AWS account to a live production application, and to hand everything over with full documentation.

Responsibilities (for each company)

1. Account & billing - AWS account creation, root MFA, company billing and GST invoicing, budgets and cost-anomaly alerts .

2.AWS Organization -Organization with Dev / Prod / Security OUs; Dev, Prod and Audit accounts; centralized root access

3. Guardrails (SCPs)-Region lock (Mumbai), CloudTrail protection, data-protection and security-lock policies, all tested.

4.Identity & access -IAM Identity Center, enforced MFA, groups and permission sets, least privilege, emergency admin, no IAM users or long-term keys.

5. Security & monitoring- Organization CloudTrail with protected log bucket, GuardDuty (incl. RDS protection), IAM Access Analyzer, Security Hub, EventBridge + SNS alerting, encryption by default, default-VPC removal.

6.Network -VPC and CIDR planning, 3-tier subnets, route tables, NAT, VPC endpoints, security groups, VPC flow logs.

7. Data layer- RDS PostgreSQL (private, encrypted, Multi-AZ for production), database roles (app / migrator / read-only), Secrets Manager, ElastiCache (Valkey/Redis) with RBAC, AWS Backup with vault lock.

8. Compute & delivery- EC2 launch templates (Graviton), user-data bootstrap, Session Manager (no SSH), ALB + Auto Scaling for production, CloudFront + S3 for the React frontend, WAF, ACM certificates, Route 53.

- Recommend product improvements based on customer feedback and competitor analysis.

- Support the Sales and Marketing teams with product positioning and competitive differentiation.

- Work closely with the Sales and Business Development teams throughout the sales cycle.

- Participate in customer meetings, technical discussions, and proposal presentations.

- Support opportunity qualification and bid/no-bid decisions.

- Assist in preparing product brochures, pitch decks, and sales presentations.

- Support customer negotiations by clarifying technical scope and solution capabilities.

- Ensure proper handover of confirmed project requirements to the delivery team.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Strong customer interaction, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

- Business requirement gathering and analytical thinking.

- Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical customers.

\*Technical & Functional\*

- Basic understanding of APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and software integration.

Preferred / Additional Skills

- Understanding of software implementation and post-sales support.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Relevant professional experience in IT pre-sales, technical consulting, business analysis, or software solution consulting will be considered.

**Key Performance Expectations**

The selected candidate should be capable of:

1. Understanding customer requirements and preparing accurate solution proposals.

2. Independently coordinating product demonstrations and customer presentations.

3. Preparing professional technical and commercial documentation.

4. Supporting sales opportunities through timely proposal submissions.

c0131750.title: Solution Architect, IT/ITES Vertical
c0131750.description:
**Description**
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
  
  
Working closely with internal teams at AWS, you’ll identify how our customers push the boundaries and how we can improve our services to obsess over our customers.
  
  
Being a thought leader who creates and presents content you’ll help all of our customers scale and grow in non-linear ways, using AWS as their building blocks.
  
  
In this role, you will push technology boundaries and help scale some of the emerging companies across various Verticals in India. You will have the opportunity to partner with customers early in their cloud journey and help them scale as well as customers further in their cloud journey where you can have visible and measurable impact in their growth ambitions.
  
  
You will test traditional thinking by pushing the boundaries for your customers and AWS to dream and deliver beyond what they think is possible.
  
  
Our customers’ needs are moving fast, so you will too. Be part of the team helping our emerging customers find innovative and transformative ways to reinvent their business!
  
  
#aws-ags-India
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Work directly with customers to accelerate their business outcomes and recommend best-practice cloud architectures in line with their long-term business needs.
* Drive technical solutions discussions with your customers, diving deep into the details to solve complex technical problems and use your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures.
* Scope and own customer engagements, with attention towards clear and well-defined objectives and success criteria.
* Work backwards from your customer's business needs to accelerate adoption of the most appropriate AWS technology
* Define and execute on the strategy by engaging highly technical teams (Solutions Architects, Technical Account Managers, AWS professional services consultants and consulting/managed services partners).
* Act as a thought leader in the wider community, playing a key role in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops.
* Share the voice of the customer to influence the roadmap of new features and services for the AWS platform. Proactively work within the organisation to influence the evolution of the platform.
* Serve as a key technical member of the Solutions Architecture team through influencing decision makers across multiple domains to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the AWS platform which align to long-term business goals.

A day in the life
  
  
Our solutions architects are experienced technologists with technical breadth and depth coupled with strong interpersonal skills. The variety of customers is huge as we work across all industries within the SMB segment, like FSI, Retail , IT& ITeS , Media and Entertainment to name a few. On a daily basis you will work alongside people who are leading the way in designing cloud bases architecture. We are the trusted advisor to our customers, so challenge our customers to think differently, learn more build elegant, transformative solutions!
  
  
As a Solutions Architect you’ll own the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. They work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. To do this they collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, support, product teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of cloud architecture
* 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 7+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* 7+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
