4b8e88ab.title: Lead Managed Services Consultant
4b8e88ab.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
  
  
By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.
  
  
Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
Lead managed services delivery for enterprise SaaS customers by owning platform strategy, governance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives. Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, driving adoption, business value realization, platform optimization, and long-term success. Experience with customer community platforms such as Sprinklr Community or similar solutions is highly desirable and will be considered an advantage.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead end-to-end managed services delivery, ensuring platform stability, governance, adoption, and alignment with customer business objectives.
* Drive strategic consulting engagements, helping customers optimise digital experiences, engagement models, operational processes, and platform utilisation.
* Act as the primary advisor to customer stakeholders, providing guidance on best practices, platform capabilities, governance frameworks, and roadmap planning.
* Lead requirements discovery, solution design, enhancement planning, and execution of continuous improvement programmes.
* Establish governance frameworks covering user administration, access management, workflows, content lifecycle management, and operational controls.
* Oversee platform health checks, audits, release management activities, and optimisation reviews.
* Lead investigation and resolution of complex platform, workflow, configuration, and user experience challenges.
* Own reporting, analytics, adoption measurement, and recommendations to improve customer outcomes.
* Provide leadership and mentorship to consultants and delivery teams supporting managed services engagements.
* Partner with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and customer leadership teams to deliver successful business outcomes.
* Provide architectural guidance on integrations, APIs, authentication, SSO, enterprise connectivity, and ecosystem solutions.
* Establish reusable delivery standards, governance playbooks, operational frameworks, and best practice models.
* Contribute to customer digital transformation initiatives, ensuring scalable and sustainable platform adoption.

**What Makes You Qualified?**
**Must Have Qualifications**

* 8-12 years of experience in Managed Services, SaaS Consulting, Digital Experience Platforms, Customer Engagement Solutions, or Enterprise Software implementations.
* Proven experience managing enterprise SaaS platforms and customer-facing managed services engagements.
* Strong consulting experience involving solution design, customer advisory services, governance reviews, and stakeholder management.
* Expertise in platform governance, operational excellence, adoption strategies, user management, workflows, and business process optimisation.
* Strong understanding of user experience principles, digital engagement strategies, information architecture, and customer journey optimisation.
* Working knowledge of web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, responsive design principles, and modern digital experiences.
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, integrations, authentication models, SSO, webhooks, and enterprise system connectivity.
* Experience facilitating workshops, executive reviews, solution discussions, and strategic planning sessions.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and customer management skills.
* Experience leading distributed delivery teams and managing multiple customer engagements simultaneously.

**Good To Have Skills**

* Experience with customer support communities, brand advocacy programs, knowledge communities, or peer-to-peer support ecosystems.
* Exposure to SEO, search optimization, content strategy, and digital engagement best practices.
* Understanding of CRM platforms, customer support ecosystems, and customer experience technologies.
* Experience managing globally distributed communities and enterprise-scale engagement programs.
* Program management and service delivery leadership experience within managed services organizations.

**Who You Are**

* A strategic consultant with strong expertise in enterprise SaaS platforms, managed services, and customer success.
* Skilled at balancing business objectives, operational requirements, and technical considerations.
* Comfortable engaging with executive stakeholders while collaborating effectively with technical teams.
* A proactive leader who drives continuous improvement, innovation, and customer value realisation.
* Experience with customer communities and digital engagement platforms is considered a strong advantage.

**What Success Looks Like**

* High customer satisfaction, adoption, and business value realisation.
* Well-governed, scalable, and optimised platform operations.
* Successful execution of transformation, optimisation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Improved user adoption, engagement, and operational efficiency metrics.
* Trusted advisor status with customer leadership and key stakeholders.
* Consistent delivery of managed services KPIs, governance objectives, and customer success outcome

**We focus on our mission**
: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
  
  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**
: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
  
  
**We invest in our people**
: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
  
  
To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
  
  
To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
  
  
**EEO - Our philosophy**
: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
  
  
Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
  
  
**Warning about Recruiting Scams:**
Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
  
  
If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

a1a1dca6.title: Jr Broadcasting & Delivery Manager
a1a1dca6.description:
We are looking for an experienced Broadcast Technology & Operations Manager with 5+ years of experience in broadcast operations, playout, live transmission, and technical coordination. The candidate should have hands-on experience in managing Live Sports/Events and GEC (General Entertainment Channel) playout operations, including broadcast automation, master control room (MCR) operations, channel monitoring, content management, live feed handling, troubleshooting, and coordination with technical and operations teams. The role requires a strong understanding of the complete broadcast chain and the ability to manage incidents in a 24x7 broadcast environment while ensuring channel availability, quality, and operational continuity. Key Responsibilities 1. Live & GEC Playout Operations • Manage day-to-day Live and GEC channel playout operations. • Oversee live event workflows including: o Live feed acquisition o Feed switching o Primary/backup feed management o Live event insertion o SCTE/event trigger management o Slates and channel branding o Commercial/ad-break management o Return to scheduled programming • Manage GEC playout workflows including: o Daily playlists o Content ingestion o Scheduling o Primary and backup playlists o Channel branding o Logo and graphics insertion o Ad and break management o Emergency/manual intervention • Ensure uninterrupted channel transmission and timely resolution of operational issues. 2. Broadcast Technology Management • Manage and monitor broadcast systems including: o Playout automation systems o MCR systems o Video servers o Encoders/decoders o Transcoders o Satellite/IP contribution feeds o Monitoring and QC systems o Storage and content management systems • Understand and troubleshoot IP, OTT and hybrid broadcast workflows. • Work with technologies such as SRT, RTMP, RTP, UDP, HLS, MPEG-TS, SCTE35/104 and other broadcast protocols. • SRT Gateway Management: Configure, manage, and troubleshoot SRT Gateway input and output feeds, including SRT caller/listener/rendezvous modes, stream routing, IP/port configuration, latency, encryption/passphrase, bitrate, and primary/backup feed switching. Ensure reliable contribution and distribution of live feeds across broadcast and OTT workflows. 3. Live Event Operations • Manage technical and operational requirements for live sports and entertainment events. • Coordinate pre-event technical checks, and signal testing. • Ensure availability of: o Primary and backup feeds o Encoding/transcoding resources o Contribution links o Playout resources o Monitoring o Storage and recording • Monitor live events and coordinate rapid resolution of issues. • Maintain incident timelines and post-event reports. 4. GEC Channel Operations • Manage daily GEC channel operations and playlist execution. • Ensure correct content, metadata, duration and scheduling. • Monitor playlist integrity and identify: o Missing content o Corrupt files o Incorrect duration/timecodes o Playlist discrepancies o Audio/video issues o Logo/branding issues o SCTE/ad-break issues • Coordinate with Content, Programming, Traffic, QC and Technology teams for issue resolution. • Ensure changes received from the content/programming team are correctly implemented and acknowledged. 5. Monitoring & Incident Management • Monitor channels, feeds and systems on a continuous basis. • Establish and maintain incident management and escalation procedures. • Ensure all incidents are properly documented with: o Incident start time o Detection time o Action taken o Feed/channel impact o Root cause o Recovery time o Total outage/downtime • Maintain incident logs and daily operational reports. • Ensure screenshots/logs/evidence are captured for critical incidents. • Conduct RCA for recurring technical and operational issues. 6. Team Management • Lead and manage Broadcast Operations/Playout teams. • Plan shift schedules and ensure adequate 24x7 coverage. • Train operators and supervisors on: o Playout systems o Live event workflows o Channel monitoring o Troubleshooting o Incident management o Emergency procedures • Define SOPs, checklists and escalation matrices. • Conduct performance reviews and identify training requirements. • Ensure operational teams follow documented processes consistently. 7. Technical Troubleshooting • Act as the first-level technical escalation point for complex broadcast issues. • Troubleshoot issues related to: o Video/audio o Playout servers o Automation o Encoders/decoders o Transcoding o IP connectivity o Satellite feeds o Storage o Network o Streaming o SCTE/ad insertion • Coordinate with NOC, Network, Cloud, Engineering and vendor teams for advanced troubleshooting. 8. Cloud & IP Broadcast Workflows • Good understanding of cloud-based broadcast workflows. • Experience working with platforms such as: o AWS o Google Cloud o Azure o Cloud-based playout/transcoding platforms • Understand cloud storage, compute, networking and media processing workflows. • Experience with hybrid on-premise + cloud broadcast environments will be an advantage. 9. Documentation & Process Improvement • Develop and maintain: o SOPs o Technical documentation o Operational checklists o Escalation matrices o Incident reports o RCA reports o Shift handover documents • Identify operational bottlenecks and recommend automation/process improvements. • Work with technology teams to improve reliability and reduce manual intervention. Required Technical Skills Broadcast & Playout • Strong understanding of Live and GEC playout workflows • MCR/NOC operations • Broadcast automation • Playlist management • Channel branding • Ad-break management • SCTE-35 / SCTE-104 • Live feed switching • Primary/backup workflows • Channel monitoring • Audio/Video QC • SRT Gateways Video & Audio • MPEG-2 / H.264 / H.265 • MPEG-TS • HD/SD workflows • Frame rates and resolutions • Audio formats and channel mapping • Timecode concepts • Video/audio troubleshooting IP & Streaming • TCP/IP and UDP • RTP/RTMP/SRT • HLS • Multicast • Network troubleshooting • Contribution and distribution workflows Broadcast Infrastructure • Playout servers • Video servers • Encoders/decoders • Transcoders • Storage systems • SDI/IP gateways • Satellite contribution/downlink • Monitoring systems • Redundancy and failover systems Preferred Experience Experience with one or more of the following will be an advantage: • GV / Grass Valley • GV AMPP • Harmonic • Ateme • Imagine Communications • Cinegy • PlayBox • Broadpeak • AWS MediaLive / MediaConnect • Google Cloud Media workflows • FFmpeg • SRT • SCTE • OTT streaming platforms Key Competencies • Strong broadcast technology knowledge • Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills • Ability to work under pressure during live events • Strong incident and escalation management • Good communication and coordination skills • Ability to manage multiple channels/events simultaneously • Strong understanding of broadcast operational risks • Good leadership and team-management skills • Ability to make quick decisions during live incidents • Strong documentation and reporting skills Qualification • Bachelor's/Diploma in B.E. or B.Eng., Broadcast Engineering, Electronics, Telecommunications, IT, or a related field. • 5+ years of relevant experience in broadcast technology, playout, MCR/NOC or live broadcast operations. • Candidates with significant hands-on experience in Live Sports + GEC Playout will be preferred. Working Environment • Willingness to work in a 24x7 broadcast operations environment. • Comfortable working in rotational shifts and during weekends/holidays when required. • Must be capable of handling high-pressure situations during live broadcasts. • Strong focus on uptime, reliability, broadcast quality and operational continuity. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) • Channel uptime and availability • Live event uptime • Incident response and resolution time • Number of recurring incidents • Playout accuracy • Playlist/content accuracy • Successful execution of live events • SLA compliance • RCA closure • Operational efficiency • Team performance and SOP compliance • Reduction in manual interventions and operational errors

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

add45747.title: Solutions Architect, ISV
add45747.description:
**Description**
AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
  
  
Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
  
  
AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud-based solutions.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
  
  
Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
  
  
You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
  
  
As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
  
  
To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
  
  
Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9).
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
  
  
**About The Team**
ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
* 4+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
* Can create proof of concepts, demos, and/or scripts from scratch or leveraging reusable components.
* Able to create technical content that is easily adopted and reusable by others.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS, or experience implementing a cloud-based technology solution
* Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Cloud Technology Certification
* Able to present to technical and business audiences (training, workshops, publications)
* 4 years’ experience as a Solution Architect or related role.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

3b46b20a.title: Oracle Cloud HCM Consultant
3b46b20a.description:
Overview:
  
At Peloton, we don't just implement technology. We transform the way organizations work, compete, and grow. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in the US, Peloton is one of the most respected and fastest-growing global Oracle consulting firms, delivering Advisory, Consulting, and Managed Services to leading organizations across many industries, including Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Consumer Packaged Goods, and more.
  
Peloton Consulting Group has the vision and connected global capabilities to help organizations envision, implement, and realize the benefits of digital transformation. Our team has the best practices, knowledge, industry expertise, and know-how. We make digital transformation a reality by leveraging AI, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Supply Chain Management (SCM), Human Capital Management (HCM), Customer Experience (CX), Analytics, and Data Management for the cloud. Through connected capabilities, we bring people, processes, and technology together. We help organizations go further faster. That is the Peloton way!
  
What truly sets us apart is our people. We are team players. We are energetic and entrepreneurial. We are problem solvers and innovative thinkers who believe the best outcomes are built together. We believe in quality, appreciate creativity, recognize individual contributions, and place trust in every member of our team. If you bring strong business or technical expertise and want to do meaningful work alongside people who are equally passionate about getting it right, we think you'll feel right at home here.
  
Peloton is seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud HCM Solution Architect to play a key role in a high-growth practice area. This is a strategic, hands-on role responsible for leading end-to-end solution design and guiding clients through complex HCM transformations using Oracle Cloud.
  
As a Solution Architect, you will partner with business and IT stakeholders to define future-state architectures, align business processes with Oracle leading practices, and ensure scalable, high-quality solution delivery across the HCM suite.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
Responsibilities will vary depending on the level and experience of the individual. The consultant will work as part of a project team delivering analytical, solution-oriented services to Fortune 1000 clients. Based upon experience, specific responsibilities may include:
  
• Developing an understanding of a client’s current state process and developing future state recommendations based on Oracle’s best business practices
  
• Recommending roadmaps to close performance gaps and developing high level implementation plans
  
• Gathering and analyzing benefits and open enrollment requirements
  
• Aligning business requirements and best practices to implement a technical solution • Defining new and refining existing business processes
  
• Contributing to continuous improvement and development of Peloton processes and intellectual property
  
  
Required Experience & Skills:
  
• Qualified candidates must have a BS or BA degree in Business, Technology, or equivalent degree or experience in HCM.
  
• Overall 6+ years of Experience with minimum of 2 to 3 years of experience in Oracle HCM Cloud.
  
• Minimum 2 years of experience in implementing Core HR, Benefits, Compensation, Absence, Talent, Payroll, ORC and OTL.
  
• Minimum of 2-3 modules and cross module knowledge.
  
• Experience in writing configuration workbooks and Understanding in Application Implementation Methodology.
  
• Experience with either development or reviewing fast formulas a plus.
  
• Ability to quickly understand HR concepts and apply to technology.
  
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  
• Proven ability to work remotely and independently in support of clients
  
• Fit with Peloton culture and company values: teamwork, innovation, integrity, service, “can-do” attitude, and communicating your ideas.
  
  
Compensation:
  
Peloton provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, business needs, and geographic location. Peloton also offer bonus opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package including
  
- Competitive base salary with performance-based bonus
  
  
- Vacation, Leave, and Holiday pay
  
  
- Annual Health Wallet
  
  
- Group Medical Insurance
  
  
- Group Term Accident & Life Insurance
  
  
- Paid holidays and PTO
  
  
  
Peloton Group is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

2bfb811d.title: Solution Engineer
2bfb811d.description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.
  
  
We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.
  
  
Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.
  
  
Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The System Solution Engineer is accountable for the strategic oversight, successful implementation and reliable maintenance of the core Customer Services technology stack, including systems like Genesys, Zendesk, Teramind, and associated Data & Quality Management (QM) tools. This role acts as the primary subject matter expert, ensuring system stability, optimal performance, and continuous feature adoption. The purpose is to maximize agent efficiency, ensure compliance and align the capabilities of these platforms directly with operational objectives to deliver a seamless, high-quality agent & customer experience.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities**

* System Ownership & Strategy: Take full ownership of the technical health, lifecycle management, and multi-year roadmap for the entire Customer Services IT systems portfolio (including Genesys Cloud, Zendesk, Teramind, and integrated 3rd party tools).
* Cross-System Integration: Define and govern the strategic approach for integrating different platforms (telephony, CRM, WFM, QA) to ensure data flow, system compatibility, and a unified agent experience.
* Vendor & Budget Management: Manage key technology vendor relationships and oversee system-related budgets and capacity planning.Provide L3 subject matter expertise and guidance on how agents and supervisors can best utilize the appointed systems.
* Maintain an expert-level understanding of new features and market trends across the CS technology landscape to drive continuous feature adoption.
* Assesses situations to make appropriate recommendations based on operational needs.
* Adheres to support processes and best practices.
* Prepares and/or reviews functional requirements documentation.
* System Configuration, Development & Change Management: Design, develop, test, and deploy complex system configurations, integrations, and changes based on business requirements.
* Hands-on Coding: Write and maintain ad-hoc scripts, APIs, and microservices (e.g., using Python, Go, or JavaScript) to facilitate system integrations and custom functionality.
* Adapts to prestigeless work within a small team environment.
* Participate in operational meetings for technical guidance and solution proposals.

**Qualification /Personal Characteristics**
**:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 5 or more years of IT experience supporting applications and infrastructure in a contact center or large-scale enterprise environment.
* Proven experience as a solutions architect or lead engineer, with a strong portfolio of successfully delivered projects.
* Strong, demonstrable experience with Customer Service platforms (e.g., Genesys Cloud, Zendesk, Teramind, WFM systems).
* Expertise in designing systems on cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.
* Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, APIs and RESTful services.
* Programming knowledge (Python, Go, or JavaScript preferred) for ad-hoc scripts and integrations.
* Ability to troubleshoot and diagnose issues related to hardware, software, VoIP or network connectivity.
* Strategic Communication & Stakeholder Alignment: Excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical issues and translate system capabilities into business value for both technical and non-technical stakeholders (e.g., leadership, operations teams).
* Analytical & Problem Solving Mindset: Ability to think strategically, solve complex, cross-functional technical problems, and demonstrate strong analytical skills with a hands-on approach.
* Organizational & Team Skills: Prestigeless team player with strong organizational, detailed orientation, and planning skills to manage multiple priorities effectively.

Do you like to work on a variety of game changing projects, at the forefront of application development and cloud technology adoption? This role is open for Delhi/NCR.
  
  
As an architect you would champion applications to be cloud optimized by making them well-architected ,enabling them to reap the benefits of elasticity, horizontal scalability, automation and high availability. You should have a knack of GenAI tooling to driving application modernization at scale with GenAI tools.
  
  
On the AWS platform services such as Amazon EC2, Auto Scaling, Elastic Load Balancing, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Amazon Elastic Container Services to name just a few, provide opportunities to design and build cloud ready applications.
  
  
AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands on technical architects to help accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. This is an opportunity to join Amazon’s world class technical teams, working with some of the brightest engineers while also developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies.
  
  
Professional Services engage in a wide variety of projects for internal customers and partners, providing collective experience from across the AWS customer base and are obsessed about success for the internal customers. Our team collaborates across the entire AWS organization to bring access to product and service teams, to get the right solution delivered and drive feature innovation based upon customer needs.
  
  
Amazon aims to be the most customer centric company on earth. Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers critical applications for hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.
  
  
Key job responsibilities

a8c0731a.title: Architect, IT Solutions, Copilot & Agentic AI Platforms
a8c0731a.description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care.
  
  
As Edwards accelerates its AI-driven transformation, we are seeking an Architect, IT Solutions to serve as the enterprise technical authority for our two most strategic agentic AI platforms — Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks. This is a multi-faceted architecture role that spans platform leadership, integration design, and end-to-end solution architecture. You will define how these platforms are built, extended, integrated, and governed across the enterprise.
  
  
This role works alongside our existing Azure infrastructure architect and complements cloud expertise with deep, platform-specific technical authority. If you thrive at the intersection of enterprise architecture, applied AI, and business-facing delivery — and want to shape how a global lifescience company adopts agentic AI at scale — this is the role for you.
  
  
**How you’ll make an impact:**
**Platform Architecture Leadership — Copilot & Moveworks**

* Own the enterprise platform architecture for Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks — serving as the definitive technical authority on capabilities, extensibility, and best practices.
* Define the ecosystem blueprint, platform standards, extensibility patterns, and long-term technical roadmap for both platforms.
* Evaluate and recommend new platform features, plugins, connectors, and agentic AI capabilities as they emerge from Microsoft and Moveworks.

**Integration Architecture**

* Design and govern the integration layer connecting Copilot and Moveworks to enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, JDE, Active Directory, HRIS, LMS, and CMDB.
* Define API strategies, event-driven patterns, connector frameworks, and messaging standards that enable secure, reliable, and scalable data flows across platforms.
* Partner with the Azure architecture team to ensure integration patterns align with cloud infrastructure, identity (Entra ID), and security standards.

**Lead Solution Architecture**

* Provide end-to-end solution design and technical authority for all AI agent, copilot, and automation solutions built on these platforms.
* Lead architecture reviews, approve design decisions, and ensure solutions are production-ready, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable, repeatable architectural patterns and executable design strategies.

**Governance, Mentorship & Innovation**

* Develop, institute, and maintain platform-specific design methodologies, development standards, security patterns, and operational best practices.
* Provide training, coaching, and technical mentorship to Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs), solution developers, and IT team members on Copilot and Moveworks architecture.
* Survey emerging developments in agentic AI — including multi-agent orchestration, RAG patterns, and tool-using agents — and recommend approaches that extend platform value.
* Develop and maintain architecture models, reference designs, integration maps, and documentation for current and proposed implementations.

**What you’ll need (Required):**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Progressive IT experience, including significant depth in platform architecture, integration architecture, or solution architecture.
* Experience in an architect role working with cross-functional teams (within IT and/or business) on enterprise-level or complex system implementations.
* Deep expertise in at least one of the following: Microsoft Copilot ecosystem (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Graph API, Graph Connectors, Copilot extensibility) or Moveworks platform (conversational AI, enterprise integrations, workflow automation).
* Strong integration architecture skills: REST/GraphQL APIs, event-driven architectures, enterprise connectors, middleware, and messaging patterns (e.g., Azure Service Bus, Logic Apps, Power Automate).
* Proven ability to design end-to-end solution architectures for enterprise AI, automation, or digital workplace platforms.
* Experience defining platform standards, governance frameworks, and reusable architectural patterns at enterprise scale.
* Strong understanding of identity, security, and compliance requirements in enterprise AI deployments (e.g., Entra ID, conditional access, DLP, data classification).
* Expert-level documentation and communication skills — ability to create architecture blueprints, integration maps, and present complex technical concepts to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, including cross-functional negotiation, vendor management, and the ability to drive alignment across distributed teams.

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio — building custom copilots, plugins, connectors, topics, and generative AI orchestration.
* Hands-on experience with Moveworks platform — configuring enterprise virtual agents, workflow automation, knowledge integration, and analytics.
* Experience with agentic AI patterns including multi-agent orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool-using agents, and planner-executor models.
* Experience integrating AI platforms with enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, Active Directory, LMS, and CMDB.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) as an automation and extensibility layer.
* Experience deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., medical device, pharmaceuticals, financial services) with attention to governance and responsible AI practices.
* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* Professional certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, TOGAF, or equivalent architecture frameworks.
* Track record of mentoring engineers and building technical communities of practice.

**Why is this role different?**
This is not a generic enterprise architect role. You will be the single technical authority for two of the most strategic AI platforms at Edwards Lifesciences — platforms that are actively transforming how our work, decide, and collaborate. You will shape the architecture, set the standards, and mentor the next generation of Forward-Deployed AI Engineers who build on these platforms every day.
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of platform strategy, hands-on architecture, and business impact — with direct visibility to senior IT leadership and the opportunity to influence how a global healthcare company scales agentic AI responsibly.
  
  
Recruiting scam alert: Read our notice about potential recruiting scams.

You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**

You will leverage your expertise in migration solutions for hybrid cloud platforms to drive successful migrations.

51eddf9c.title: Digital Solutions & Delivery Manager
51eddf9c.description:
We are looking for a customer-facing delivery lead who combines the rigor of a Digital Project Manager, the curiosity and analytical depth of a Business Analyst, and the habits of someone who already runs much of their own work with AI.

Our projects run on an AI-first delivery harness: a shared set of AI agents, templates, workflows and quality checks that takes work from requirement through design, build, test and release. You will lead delivery on it. That means learning it quickly, using it every day, making sure your team uses it properly, and owning the quality of what it produces.

You will be the primary bridge between the customer’s business stakeholders, technical delivery, and QA teams. You will understand why a customer needs change, shape what should be delivered, and ensure it is delivered successfully.

This is not a meeting-coordination or documentation-only role. You should be equally comfortable challenging the customer business and technical stakeholder, shaping a base solution design, refining an insurance journey, tracing a data integration, reviewing release readiness, and automating the routine work that would otherwise distract you from high-value customer conversations.

This role suits someone who:

* Communicates clearly and confidently. Is comfortable having tough conversations about scope, cost, timelines and quality, and stays calm when a customer pushes back
* Is technically sound, and can hold an end-to-end conversation on requirements, journy flow, architecture, integrations, data and release management
* Has a keen eye for detail and is not shy of reading. AI drafts a lot of our material, and nothing goes to a customer until a person has read it, checked it against the source and cut anything vague, padded or generic. On your projects, that person is you
* Brings structure without being chased: keeps the backlog, plan, status reports and RAID log current, so the team and the customer always have an accurate picture of where things stand
* Picks up new tools and ways of working quickly, automates their own work first, and keeps looking for new ways AI can make them and their team faster and better
* Gets excited about doing many times more with the same team
* Is happy to work from our Noida office and to travel to customer sites in India and overseas as and when required

**Responsibilities**

**Requirements, Customer Engagement & Business Outcomes**

* Elicit, analyze and validate business, functional, non-functional, regulatory and integration requirements; translate them into concise BRDs/FSDs where, appropriate, epics, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Produce the base solution design for new requirements and change requests using our AI-first approach: generate the first draft with the delivery harness, test it against the requirement, the existing implementation and known constraints, then refine and agree it with architects and tech leads.
* Own and maintain the product backlog: clarity, traceability, dependencies, prioritization and change control; keep it refined ahead of each sprint and ensure customer sign-off on scope and acceptance criteria.
* Own day-to-day customer communication and build credible, trusted relationships across business, technology and leadership stakeholders.
* Lead discovery workshops, challenge incomplete requirements, surface business problems, establish measurable outcomes and propose practical solutions.
* Conduct difficult conversations professionally: negotiate scope, explain trade-offs, manage escalations, communicate delays and secure clear decisions without avoiding accountability.
* Understand customer goals, operational pain points, growth priorities and changing market conditions; identify incremental value opportunities and share them with account and solution leaders.

**Delivery, governance and release ownership**

* Convert agreed scope into delivery plans, sprint/release goals, estimates, milestones, ownership, dependencies, RAID logs and realistic stakeholder commitments.
* Run Agile ceremonies and customer governance with purpose; maintain JIRA/Confluence and publish regular, decision-ready status reports, RAID logs and delivery metrics that show what has changed, what is at risk and what decision is needed, rather than status theatre.
* Work hands-on with engineering, QA, UX, DevOps and vendors to resolve blockers, assess change impact and prevent requirement-to-build gaps.
* Drive UAT planning, scenarios, defect triage, customer acceptance, go/no-go readiness, deployment coordination, release notes, hypercare and handover to support.
* Communicate risks early and transparently, and own corrective action through resolution; track delivery against scope, quality, schedule and customer outcomes.

**AI-first delivery and framework adoption**

* Run day-to-day delivery on our AI-first delivery harness and approved AI tools, using them for meeting preparation and summaries, action tracking, requirement drafts, solution design drafts, story/criteria generation, gap analysis, test scenarios, reporting and release documentation.
* Drive adoption of the delivery framework within the team: onboard new members onto it, make sure work follows the agreed workflow, templates and quality checks, notice where people work around it, and feed improvements back to the framework owners.
* Connect workflows where practical (for example, JIRA, Confluence, collaboration tools and approved AI assistants) to reduce manual updates, duplicate entry and administrative effort.
* Regularly identify, prototype, measure and scale repeatable automations.
* Own the quality of everything AI produces on your project. Read and review AI-generated requirements, designs, test scenarios, reports and customer communication before they are published; check facts against the source, remove generic or padded content, and make sure every document is accurate, specific and something you would put your name to.

**Qualifications**

* Should be a B.Tech/BE/MCA
* At least 3 years of demonstrated delivery ownership across discovery, requirements, implementation, UAT and production release in software product or IT solutions environments.
* Excellent written and spoken communication: able to write a clear status report, decision note or escalation email, and to hold their own with clients, developers and senior stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and comfortable reading long documents closely; able to spot errors, gaps, contradictions and generic filler in requirements, designs and AI-generated content.
* Evidence of personally using AI and automation to improve the way work is executed; ability to demonstrate real workflows, limitations, safeguards, how AI output is reviewed before use, and measurable results.
* Familiarity with digital buying journeys in the BFSI sector, including customer onboarding, fulfilment, and servicing.
* Working knowledge of tools such as JIRA, Lucid Charts, Confluence or similar tools.
* Experience maintaining a backlog, delivery plan and RAID log, and producing regular status reporting for customer governance.
* Ability to create detailed UML diagrams (Use Case, Sequence, Activity) for complex processes.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
* Ability to pick up a new delivery framework or toolset quickly and bring a team along with it.
* Hands-on experience running agile delivery (Scrum or Kanban) and working in agile teams.

**﻿Apply:**

To apply for the job, email our Talent Acquisition Team at
careers@infoaxon.com,
mentioning the Job Title in the subject line, along with your latest CV.

* Experience enabling shared components through SDK-style or innersource models, including versioning and release management.
* Proven ability to lead without authority across engineering, product, UX, and security.

**Nice to have**

* Experience consolidating internal systems and managing build/buy/adopt decisions.

c4dc6336.title: Sr Tech Infra Program Manager, DCPD
c4dc6336.description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost cloud infrastructure platform that empowers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries to innovate and invent.
  
  
Do you have the business background, complex cross functional program management experience, financial expertise, legal/regulatory comprehension and technical understanding? Can you communicate effectively, find clarity in ambiguity, and simplicity in complexity ? Have you managed complex infrastructure projects ?
  
  
If yes, then come and explore this exciting role. This role in Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) Hyderabad, Telengana builds infrastructure that hosts AWS cloud services. It delivers AWS cloud infrastructure in a challenging, high growth, fast paced and customer focused work environment. In this role, you will lead cross functional teams to deliver usable data center capacity. You will partner with senior stakeholders to develop, document, manage and deliver infrastructure designs, implementation schedules and budgets. You will earn trust of your partners in your ability to solve complex issues and steer teams in right direction to deliver results, on-time and at-cost.
  
  
You must be an exceptionally strong communicator (both written and verbal), and possess relevant experience in managing technical and strategic programs. If you bring past experience in data center deployment programs, great. If not, then having a background in program and project management, architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering managing a team with strong urge to learn will be essential.
  
  
Come Join us, have fun, and create history!!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Senior Infrastructure TPM owns delivery of new DC across one or more availability zones in Hyderabad, Telangana India. The Sr TIPM manages delivery of ~5 projects at any time. They bridge internal customers, business functions, (Planning, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Policy, Operations), and functional delivery teams (Construction, Commissioning, Controls, Fiber and Network) to enable on-time and right sized delivery of new DC capacity. The Sr TIPM is able to guide and develop partner teams to accomplish the regions goal.
  
  
The scope begins with early expansion planning, which includes a feasibility analysis to approve expansion plans and associated build timelines. They evaluate multiple factors prior to approving a new plan of record, including owned/leased/collocated DC supply, utility delivery (power, water, and fiber), and long lead equipment (LLE) availability. It requires region-wide knowledge and monitoring of in-flight projects, major risks, and remediation efforts to ensure DC delivery is not only on track to meet supply commitments but also to meet customer demand, which is constantly changing.
  
  
A successful TPM Manager must be capable of managing a combination of metrics, tools, and mechanisms to remain aware of ongoing risks or issues that require their action, decision, mitigations, or effort to identify alternative solutions communicating up, down, and across the organization to align direction, gain support and drive remediation efforts
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
* Master's degree in a related technical field

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management
* Experience in construction of data center delivery (design, commissioning and construction), mission critical facilities, or equivalent industrial/manufacturing facility builds

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- ADSIPL - Telangana
  
  
Job ID: A10587454
